-- Sound slots. "kit:<name>" resolves through SoundKit.play; raw ids through SoundKit.playId.
Config.ASSETS = {
	bonkClonk      = "rbxassetid://122682383632262", -- snappy cartoon bonk, 0.65s (owner picked #2 on the audition board)
	rumbleLoop     = "rbxassetid://1837834264", -- APM "REVERSE HARD STOP-Noise Build 03", 4.0s: builds and hard-stops exactly at the silence beat
	bassDrop       = "kit:catchBigHit",
	waterExplosion = "kit:splashBig",
	roar           = "kit:catchGod",      -- TODO: replace — creature roar, ~2-3s
	plink          = "kit:catchCommon",   -- the second bonk: tiny, comically quiet
	memeAudio      = "kit:catchSecret",   -- TODO: replace — the heel-turn meme track (owner upload)
	cardWhoosh     = "kit:catchSparkle",
	VOLUMES = {
		bonkClonk = 0.85, rumbleLoop = 0.8, bassDrop = 0.9, waterExplosion = 0.8,
		roar = 0.7, plink = 0.18, memeAudio = 0.6, cardWhoosh = 0.4,
	},
}

-- Quality tier: "low" on touch devices or when the player opted down; else "high".
function Config.qualityFor(player: Player): string
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	if player:GetAttribute("CinematicLowQuality") == true then return "low" end
	if UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled then return "low" end
	return "high"
end

function Config.timescale(): number
	local o = workspace:GetAttribute("CinematicTimescale")
	return (type(o) == "number" and o > 0) and o or Config.DEBUG_TIMESCALE
end

return Config


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/CatchCinematic/HypeUI.lua =====
--!strict
-- CatchCinematic.HypeUI -- screen-space overlay for the MAX BRAINROT hype beat:
-- banner slam, wobbling rainbow name, confetti, speed lines, meme fly-ins, the
-- HOLD TO SKIP prompt, and the bag-streak target used by BrainrotRig's
-- compressAndStreak. Own ScreenGui "CatchCinematicUI", DisplayOrder 55 (above
-- PullCeremony's 50), IgnoreGuiInset true, ResetOnSpawn false, parented under
-- PlayerGui. Font FredokaOne throughout via the label() helper below -- copied
-- from PullCeremony's own recipe (TextLabel + UIStroke), which is what keeps
-- FredokaOne surviving the game-wide UIPolish font override.
--
-- ALL MOTION IS HAND-LERPED FROM A CLOCK -- task.spawn + os.clock() stepping
-- loops, exactly like PostFX/AudioBus in this folder. NEVER TweenService on
-- UIScale (silently no-ops in this place -- see Config.lua's header) and NEVER
-- UIGradient.Rotation for the rainbow name (the gradient-rotation gotcha):
-- the wobble writes TextColor3 per character, per frame, instead.
--
-- Per-character name labels are positioned BY HAND (TextService:GetTextSize
-- per character), deliberately NOT via UIListLayout, even though a list
-- layout is the obvious way to flow characters. Recon-verified in this
-- codebase: "UIListLayout eats Position" -- a layout-managed child's Position
-- gets silently overwritten on the layout's next pass, which would fight the
-- per-frame sine Y-offset every single frame. See nameText() below.
--
-- Every random draw (confetti/speed-line spawn params, meme-text assignment)
-- comes from the injected `rng: Random`, drawn ONCE when the effect triggers
-- -- never per-frame, never math.random -- so a given seed replays identically
-- (RockRig's convention in this folder, copied here).
--
-- cfg is a COMBINED table -- { HYPE = Config.HYPE, SKIP = Config.SKIP,
-- PARTICLES = Config.PARTICLES } -- built by the caller (Sequencer/harness).
-- This module never requires Config itself.
--
-- Test-only internal seam: bagTarget()'s public signature takes no arguments
-- (contractual), so `self._bagSearchRootOverride` is the seam a harness pokes
-- directly to force the fallback branch without touching the real, live
-- GameHUD (renaming NavRail for a test would be far too invasive on a Team
-- Create place). Production code should never set this field.
--
-- IgnoreGuiInset SHIFTS ABSOLUTEPOSITION MATH (recon-verified gotcha,
-- confirmed live in this place: GuiInset reads (0, 58) here -- an
-- IgnoreGuiInset=true ScreenGui's own AbsolutePosition comes back (0, -58),
-- NOT (0, 0), even though its AbsoluteSize is still the full true viewport.
-- Every fixed-pixel Y position placed inside this gui -- and every TRUE
-- absolute screen Y read from another gui (e.g. bagTarget()'s NavRail hit)
-- and then used to place something INSIDE this gui -- has to be run through
-- topOffset()/bottomOffset() below or it lands `GuiInset.Y` pixels off from
-- where it visually should be. GuiInset.X is untouched (topbars are
-- horizontal), so X never needs this.
--
-- `timescale` (HypeUI.new's 5th arg, optional, default 1): every wall-clock
-- task.spawn loop's elapsed-time computation divides by it, so
-- Config.DEBUG_TIMESCALE-style tuning slows/speeds this module's bursts in
-- lockstep with the rest of the Sequencer's beats. `memeFlyIns(t)` is exempt
-- on purpose -- it stays a pure function of the caller's own `t`, and the
-- Sequencer's `t` is presumed already timescaled at the source.
--
-- `interrupt()` contract: the Sequencer calls this the instant a skip
-- resolves. It hard-cuts every in-flight hype effect (banner, name letters,
-- confetti, speed lines, meme slots, card pops) in the SAME synchronous
-- call -- generation counters bumped and the transient instances destroyed
-- outright, not merely faded. It deliberately does NOT touch the ScreenGui
-- itself or anything owned by showSkipPrompt/setSkipProgress/hideSkipPrompt
-- -- the skip prompt's own lifecycle is the Sequencer's call, made
-- separately (typically hideSkipPrompt() alongside interrupt()).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local STROKE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(20, 16, 8)

local function guiInsetY(): number
	local ok, inset = pcall(function()
		return GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	end)
	if ok and typeof(inset) == "Vector2" then
		return inset.Y
	end
	return 0
end

-- Converts a TRUE absolute screen Y (or a "pixels below the true top" value
-- for a Scale-0, AnchorPoint.Y=0 element) into the Position.Offset this
-- IgnoreGuiInset gui needs to land there.
local function topOffset(trueY: number): number
	return trueY + guiInsetY()
end

-- For AnchorPoint.Y=1, Position Y-Scale=1 elements: desiredPx = pixels above
-- the TRUE bottom of the screen.
local function bottomOffset(desiredPx: number): number
	return guiInsetY() - desiredPx
end

-- Reference pixel offsets from the top of the screen for the three stacked
-- hype elements, tuned at a ~1380x791 viewport (generous enough that even
-- the banner's peak bounce scale, up to Config.HYPE.bannerScalePop e.g.
-- 1.35x, never reaches down into the name band, and the name band, even
-- unshrunk, never reaches into the meme band). These are NOT used directly
-- for placement -- HypeUI.new() converts each to a FRACTION of the gui's
-- AbsoluteSize.Y at construction time (self._bannerYFrac etc.), and every
-- placement multiplies that fraction by the CURRENT AbsoluteSize.Y. This
-- keeps the three bands proportionally spaced (same relative gaps) across
-- different viewport heights instead of a fixed pixel gap that would eat a
-- shrinking screen alive.
local BANNER_Y_REF = 32
local NAME_Y_REF = 280
local MEME_Y_REF = 460

export type HypeCfg = {
	bannerScalePop: number?,
	zoomPunchTimes: { number }?,
	memeTexts: { string }?,
	confettiBurst: number?,
	speedLineCount: number?,
}
export type SkipCfg = {
	delay: number?,
	holdSeconds: number?,
	exitFadeSeconds: number?,
}
export type QualityCfg = { mult: number?, budget: number? }
export type ParticlesCfg = { high: QualityCfg?, low: QualityCfg? }

export type HypeUICfg = {
	HYPE: HypeCfg?,
	SKIP: SkipCfg?,
	PARTICLES: ParticlesCfg?,
}

type ConfettiPiece = {
	frame: Frame,
	x0: number,
	y0: number,
	vx: number,
	vy0: number,
	gravity: number,
	spin0: number,
	spinSpeed: number,
	life: number,
}

type SpeedLine = {
	frame: Frame,
	angleRad: number,
	delay: number,
	life: number,
}

type MemeSlot = {
	label: TextLabel,
	textIndex: number,
	fromLeft: boolean,
}

-- Copied verbatim (shape) from PullCeremony's label() -- the house recipe:
-- AutomaticSize XY TextLabel + a UIStroke sized off TextSize. AutomaticSize
-- guarantees TextFits is trivially true for every label this module creates.
local function label(parent: Instance, text: string, size: number, color: Color3, strokeT: number?): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.Font = FONT
	l.TextSize = size
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
	l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	l.Parent = parent
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = strokeT or math.max(3, size / 14)
	s.Color = STROKE_COLOR
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
	s.Parent = l
	return l
end

local HypeUI = {}
HypeUI.__index = HypeUI

export type Ui = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		_hype: HypeCfg,
		_skip: SkipCfg,
		_particles: ParticlesCfg,
		_quality: string,
		_reducedMotion: boolean,
		_rng: Random,
		_timescale: number,
		_gui: ScreenGui,
		_destroyed: boolean,

		-- F3: fractions of AbsoluteSize.Y, computed once at construction from
		-- BANNER_Y_REF/NAME_Y_REF/MEME_Y_REF at the CURRENT viewport height.
		_bannerYFrac: number,
		_nameYFrac: number,
		_memeYFrac: number,

		_bannerLabel: TextLabel?,
		_bannerScale: UIScale?,
		_bannerGen: number,
		_lastBannerPeak: number?,

		_nameFrame: Frame?,
		_nameChars: { TextLabel },
		_nameGen: number,
		_lastNameAmp: number?,

		_confettiHost: Frame?,
		_confettiPieces: { ConfettiPiece },
		_confettiGen: number,

		_speedHost: Frame?,
		_speedLines: { SpeedLine },
		_speedGen: number,
		_lastSpeedTravel: number?,

		_memeHost: Frame?,
		_memeSlots: { [number]: MemeSlot },
		_memeAssignment: { number },

		_skipHost: Frame?,
		_skipLabel: TextLabel?,
		_skipFillBar: Frame?,
		_skipGen: number,

		_bagSearchRootOverride: Instance?,
	},
	HypeUI
))

function HypeUI.new(cfg: HypeUICfg, quality: string, reducedMotion: boolean, rng: Random, timescale: number?): Ui
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local playerGui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	assert(playerGui ~= nil, "[HypeUI] no PlayerGui found -- must run client-side")

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "CatchCinematicUI"
	gui.DisplayOrder = 55
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local ts = tonumber(timescale)
	local resolvedTimescale = (ts and ts > 0) and ts or 1

	-- F3: capture the CURRENT viewport height as the reference and express
	-- every band as a fraction of it -- see the BANNER_Y_REF header comment.
	local refH = gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if refH <= 0 then
		refH = 720
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_hype = cfg.HYPE or {},
		_skip = cfg.SKIP or {},
		_particles = cfg.PARTICLES or {},
		_quality = quality or "high",
		_reducedMotion = reducedMotion == true,
		_rng = rng,
		_timescale = resolvedTimescale,
		_gui = gui,
		_destroyed = false,

		_bannerYFrac = BANNER_Y_REF / refH,
		_nameYFrac = NAME_Y_REF / refH,
		_memeYFrac = MEME_Y_REF / refH,

		_bannerLabel = nil,
		_bannerScale = nil,
		_bannerGen = 0,
		_lastBannerPeak = nil,

		_nameFrame = nil,
		_nameChars = {},
		_nameGen = 0,
		_lastNameAmp = nil,

		_confettiHost = nil,
		_confettiPieces = {},
		_confettiGen = 0,

		_speedHost = nil,
		_speedLines = {},
		_speedGen = 0,
		_lastSpeedTravel = nil,

		_memeHost = nil,
		_memeSlots = {},
		_memeAssignment = {},

		_skipHost = nil,
		_skipLabel = nil,
		_skipFillBar = nil,
		_skipGen = 0,

		_bagSearchRootOverride = nil,
	}, HypeUI)

	return (self :: any) :: Ui
end

function HypeUI:_particleMult(): number
	local q = self._particles[self._quality] or self._particles.high
	if q and type(q.mult) == "number" then
		return q.mult :: number
	end
	return 1
end

function HypeUI:_screenSize(): Vector2
	local size = self._gui.AbsoluteSize
	if size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0 then
		return size
	end
	return Vector2.new(1280, 720)
end

-- ===================== banner =====================
-- "MASSIVE" slam with an impact scale-bounce: UIScale.Scale is set PER FRAME
-- by a hand-lerp loop (0 -> bannerScalePop overshoot -> settle at 1), never
-- TweenService (which silently no-ops on UIScale in this place).
function HypeUI:banner(text: string, color: Color3)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	if not self._bannerLabel or not self._bannerLabel.Parent then
		local l = label(self._gui, "", 88, color, 8)
		l.Name = "Banner"
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, topOffset(self._bannerYFrac * self:_screenSize().Y))
		l.ZIndex = 5
		local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Scale = 0
		scale.Parent = l
		self._bannerLabel = l
		self._bannerScale = scale
	end

	local l = self._bannerLabel :: TextLabel
	local scale = self._bannerScale :: UIScale

	-- shrink-to-fit: measure at a base size, scale down only if it would
	-- overflow 90% of the viewport width.
	local maxWidth = self:_screenSize().X * 0.9
	local baseSize = 88
	local bounds = TextService:GetTextSize(text, baseSize, FONT, Vector2.new(10000, 500))
	local sizeToUse = baseSize
	if bounds.X > maxWidth then
		sizeToUse = math.max(28, math.floor(baseSize * (maxWidth / bounds.X)))
	end
	l.TextSize = sizeToUse
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color
	local strokeInst = l:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if strokeInst then
		strokeInst.Thickness = math.max(3, sizeToUse / 14)
	end

	self._bannerGen += 1
	local myGen = self._bannerGen
	local peak = self._reducedMotion and 1.08 or (self._hype.bannerScalePop or 1.35)
	self._lastBannerPeak = peak

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local riseDur = 0.22
		local settleDur = 0.28
		local total = riseDur + settleDur
		while self._bannerGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and l.Parent do
			local elapsed = (os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale
			local s: number
			if elapsed < riseDur then
				local u = elapsed / riseDur
				s = peak * (1 - (1 - u) ^ 3)
			elseif elapsed < total then
				local u = (elapsed - riseDur) / settleDur
				local e = 1 - (1 - u) ^ 3
				s = peak + (1 - peak) * e
			else
				s = 1
			end
			scale.Scale = s
			if elapsed >= total then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if self._bannerGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and scale.Parent then
			scale.Scale = 1
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== name text =====================
-- Sizes.Label(...) output, wobbling rainbow: per-character TextLabels, hand
-- positioned (see module header re: UIListLayout), per-frame sine Y-offset +
-- hue rotation via TextColor3 -- never UIGradient.Rotation.
function HypeUI:nameText(text: string)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	if self._nameFrame and self._nameFrame.Parent then
		self._nameFrame:Destroy()
	end
	self._nameGen += 1
	local myGen = self._nameGen
	self._nameChars = {}

	local host = Instance.new("Frame")
	host.Name = "NameHost"
	host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	host.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, topOffset(self._nameYFrac * self:_screenSize().Y))
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	host.ZIndex = 5
	host.Parent = self._gui
	self._nameFrame = host

	if #text == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- shrink-to-fit: measure the WHOLE string at a base size, scale down if
	-- it would overflow -- this is what guarantees the long-name case
	-- ("Golden Massive Kraken Congelato") always fits on screen.
	local maxWidth = self:_screenSize().X * 0.88
	local baseSize = 54
	local wholeBounds = TextService:GetTextSize(text, baseSize, FONT, Vector2.new(10000, 500))
	local finalSize = baseSize
	if wholeBounds.X > maxWidth then
		finalSize = math.max(16, math.floor(baseSize * (maxWidth / wholeBounds.X)))
	end

	local amp = self._reducedMotion and 3 or 8
	self._lastNameAmp = amp

	-- Per-character labels are sized EXPLICITLY from a direct TextService
	-- measurement, AutomaticSize = None -- NOT via the shared label() helper's
	-- AutomaticSize=XY. Verified live (failing harness run) that AutomaticSize
	-- on a label created and then immediately fought over every frame by this
	-- same function's own wobble loop (Position + TextColor3 writes starting
	-- the instant this loop finishes, before nameText() even returns -- see
	-- task.spawn below) can occasionally settle on an AbsoluteSize a hair
	-- tighter than TextFits itself requires, for a SPECIFIC character, in a
	-- way that would not reproduce in isolation. A deterministic, generously
	-- padded explicit Size sidesteps that race outright rather than chasing
	-- its exact trigger.
	local chars: { TextLabel } = {}
	local baseXs: { number } = {}
	local cursorX = 0
	for i = 1, #text do
		local ch = string.sub(text, i, i)
		local measured = TextService:GetTextSize(ch, finalSize, FONT, Vector2.new(1000, 500))
		local charLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		charLabel.Name = "Char" .. i
		charLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		charLabel.Text = ch
		charLabel.Font = FONT
		charLabel.TextSize = finalSize
		charLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		charLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		charLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(measured.X + 6, measured.Y + 16)
		charLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		charLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cursorX, amp)
		charLabel.ZIndex = 5
		charLabel.Parent = host
		local charStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		charStroke.Thickness = 3
		charStroke.Color = STROKE_COLOR
		charStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
		charStroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
		charStroke.Parent = charLabel
		table.insert(chars, charLabel)
		table.insert(baseXs, cursorX)
		cursorX += measured.X
	end
	host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cursorX, finalSize * 1.3 + amp * 2)
	self._nameChars = chars

	local hueSpacing = 0.045
	local hueSpeed = self._reducedMotion and 0.15 or 0.4
	local waveSpacing = 0.35
	local waveSpeed = self._reducedMotion and 3.5 or 6.0

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while self._nameGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and host.Parent do
			local t = (os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale
			for i, ch in ipairs(chars) do
				local phase = (i - 1) * waveSpacing
				local y = amp + math.sin(t * waveSpeed + phase) * amp
				ch.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(baseXs[i], y)
				local hue = (t * hueSpeed + (i - 1) * hueSpacing) % 1
				ch.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== confetti =====================
function HypeUI:confetti()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	if self._confettiHost and self._confettiHost.Parent then
		self._confettiHost:Destroy()
	end
	self._confettiGen += 1
	local myGen = self._confettiGen

	local host = Instance.new("Frame")
	host.Name = "ConfettiHost"
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	host.ZIndex = 3
	host.Parent = self._gui
	self._confettiHost = host

	local mult = self:_particleMult()
	-- F2: reducedMotion cuts the burst to 30% (floored) on top of the
	-- quality mult, and (below) halves burst speeds and caps spin.
	local reducedCountMult = self._reducedMotion and 0.3 or 1
	local count = math.max(0, math.floor((self._hype.confettiBurst or 90) * mult * reducedCountMult))
	local rng = self._rng
	local palette = {
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 92),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 61),
		Color3.fromRGB(97, 214, 130),
		Color3.fromRGB(88, 176, 255),
		Color3.fromRGB(213, 122, 255),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	}

	local screenW = self:_screenSize().X
	local pieces: { ConfettiPiece } = {}
	for _ = 1, count do
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.Name = "Piece"
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rng:NextInteger(5, 9), rng:NextInteger(9, 16))
		f.BackgroundColor3 = palette[rng:NextInteger(1, #palette)]
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.ZIndex = 3
		f.Parent = host

		local x0 = rng:NextNumber() * screenW
		local y0 = -20 - rng:NextNumber() * 80
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, y0)

		-- F2: "burst speeds halved" + spin capped to +/-60 deg/s under
		-- reducedMotion. Life is left alone -- only motion INTENSITY is cut.
		local vx = (rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1) * 60
		local vy0 = 80 + rng:NextNumber() * 60
		local spinSpeed = (rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1) * 420
		if self._reducedMotion then
			vx *= 0.5
			vy0 *= 0.5
			spinSpeed = math.clamp(spinSpeed, -60, 60)
		end

		table.insert(pieces, {
			frame = f,
			x0 = x0,
			y0 = y0,
			vx = vx,
			vy0 = vy0,
			gravity = 220 + rng:NextNumber() * 80,
			spin0 = rng:NextNumber() * 360,
			spinSpeed = spinSpeed,
			life = 1.3 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.8,
		})
	end
	self._confettiPieces = pieces

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local maxLife = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
			maxLife = math.max(maxLife, p.life)
		end
		-- Exit ONLY on `t > maxLife` -- see speedLines() for why an
		-- `anyAlive`-based early exit is the wrong condition to combine with
		-- a per-piece delay/life window (confetti pieces have no delay here,
		-- so this specific loop never hit that bug, but the same pattern is
		-- avoided on principle).
		while self._confettiGen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local t = (os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale
			for _, p in ipairs(pieces) do
				if t <= p.life and p.frame.Parent then
					local x = p.x0 + p.vx * t
					local y = p.y0 + p.vy0 * t + 0.5 * p.gravity * t * t
					p.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
					p.frame.Rotation = (p.spin0 + p.spinSpeed * t) % 360
					local fadeStart = p.life * 0.75
					if t > fadeStart then
						p.frame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp((t - fadeStart) / (p.life - fadeStart), 0, 1)
					end
				end
			end
			if t > maxLife then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if self._confettiGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and host.Parent then
			host:Destroy()
			if self._confettiHost == host then
				self._confettiHost = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== speed lines =====================
function HypeUI:speedLines()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	if self._speedHost and self._speedHost.Parent then
		self._speedHost:Destroy()
	end
	self._speedGen += 1
	local myGen = self._speedGen

	local host = Instance.new("Frame")
	host.Name = "SpeedLineHost"
	host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	host.ZIndex = 4
	host.Parent = self._gui
	self._speedHost = host

	local mult = self:_particleMult()
	-- F2: reducedMotion halves the line count (floored, min 0) on top of the
	-- quality mult. Existing life/travel reductions below are unchanged.
	local reducedCountMult = self._reducedMotion and 0.5 or 1
	local count = math.max(0, math.floor((self._hype.speedLineCount or 14) * mult * reducedCountMult))
	local rng = self._rng

	local lines: { SpeedLine } = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.Name = "Line"
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 40)
		f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.Rotation = (i - 1) * (360 / count) + (rng:NextNumber() * 8 - 4)
		f.ZIndex = 4
		f.Parent = host

		table.insert(lines, {
			frame = f,
			angleRad = math.rad(f.Rotation - 90),
			delay = rng:NextNumber() * 0.12,
			life = (self._reducedMotion and 0.28 or 0.42) + rng:NextNumber() * 0.1,
		})
	end
	self._speedLines = lines

	local travel = self._reducedMotion and 0.4 or 0.6 -- fraction of half-screen travelled
	-- test-introspection only (F4): lets the harness verify the reduction
	-- without needing to sample a wall-clock animation in flight.
	self._lastSpeedTravel = travel

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local maxLife = 0
		for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
			maxLife = math.max(maxLife, l.delay + l.life)
		end
		-- Exit ONLY on `t > maxLife` (every line's delay+life window is
		-- necessarily over by then). An `anyAlive`-based early exit is WRONG
		-- here and was a real bug: every line has its own positive `delay`
		-- (staggered starts), so at t~0 NO line has started yet (lt < 0 for
		-- all of them) -- "nothing currently alive" at the very first
		-- synchronous pass is not the same as "finished", but a combined
		-- `or not anyAlive` treated it that way and self-destroyed the whole
		-- host before a single line ever animated, before this task.spawn
		-- even reached its first task.wait() (verified live: _speedHost
		-- read back nil immediately after speedLines() returned).
		while self._speedGen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local t = (os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale
			for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
				local lt = t - l.delay
				if lt >= 0 and lt <= l.life and l.frame.Parent then
					local a = lt / l.life
					local dist = a * travel * 0.5
					local px = 0.5 + math.cos(l.angleRad) * dist
					local py = 0.5 + math.sin(l.angleRad) * dist
					l.frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(px, py)
					l.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 40 + a * 120)
					l.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + a * 0.85
				elseif lt > l.life then
					l.frame.Visible = false
				end
			end
			if t > maxLife then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if self._speedGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and host.Parent then
			host:Destroy()
			if self._speedHost == host then
				self._speedHost = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== meme fly-ins =====================
-- Driven EXPLICITLY by the caller's cinematic-timeline `t` (the Sequencer's
-- own master clock) rather than an internal timer, because Config.HYPE.
-- zoomPunchTimes are ABSOLUTE cinematic seconds the Sequencer already tracks.
-- Pure in t: the same t always yields the same visual state, independent of
-- call history (the meme-text assignment is drawn once from rng, not
-- re-rolled per call).
function HypeUI:memeFlyIns(t: number)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	local texts = self._hype.memeTexts or {}
	local punchTimes = self._hype.zoomPunchTimes or {}
	if #texts == 0 or #punchTimes == 0 then
		return
	end

	if not self._memeHost or not self._memeHost.Parent then
		local host = Instance.new("Frame")
		host.Name = "MemeHost"
		host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		host.ZIndex = 6
		host.Parent = self._gui
		self._memeHost = host
	end
	local host = self._memeHost :: Frame

	if #self._memeAssignment == 0 then
		for i = 1, #punchTimes do
			self._memeAssignment[i] = self._rng:NextInteger(1, #texts)
		end
	end

	local dur = 0.6

	for i, punchT in ipairs(punchTimes) do
		local localT = t - punchT
		local active = localT >= -0.05 and localT <= dur

		local slot = self._memeSlots[i]
		if active then
			if not slot then
				local fromLeft = (i % 2) == 1
				local txt = texts[self._memeAssignment[i]] or texts[1]
				local l = label(host, txt, 42, Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 200), 4)
				l.Name = "Meme" .. i
				l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				l.ZIndex = 6
				slot = { label = l, textIndex = self._memeAssignment[i], fromLeft = fromLeft }
				self._memeSlots[i] = slot
			end

			local a = math.clamp(localT / dur, 0, 1)
			local restX = 0.5
			local edgeX = slot.fromLeft and -0.25 or 1.25
			local exitX = slot.fromLeft and 1.25 or -0.25
			local x: number
			if a < 0.35 then
				local u = a / 0.35
				x = edgeX + (restX - edgeX) * (1 - (1 - u) ^ 3)
			elseif a < 0.7 then
				x = restX
			else
				local u = (a - 0.7) / 0.3
				x = restX + (exitX - restX) * (u * u)
			end
			slot.label.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, topOffset(self._memeYFrac * self:_screenSize().Y))
		elseif slot then
			slot.label:Destroy()
			self._memeSlots[i] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- ===================== bag target =====================
function HypeUI:bagTarget(): Vector2
	if self._destroyed then
		return Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	local screen = self:_screenSize()
	local fallback = Vector2.new(screen.X / 2, screen.Y - 40)

	local ok, found = pcall(function(): Vector2?
		local root: Instance? = self._bagSearchRootOverride
		if not root then
			local player = Players.LocalPlayer
			root = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		end
		if not root then
			return nil
		end
		local gameHud = root:FindFirstChild("GameHUD")
		local chrome = gameHud and gameHud:FindFirstChild("Chrome")
		local navRail = chrome and chrome:FindFirstChild("NavRail")
		if not navRail then
			return nil
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(navRail:GetChildren()) do
			local nm = string.lower(child.Name)
			if string.find(nm, "bag", 1, true) or string.find(nm, "backpack", 1, true) then
				local hit = child:FindFirstChild("Hit", true)
				local target: GuiObject? = nil
				if hit and hit:IsA("GuiObject") then
					target = hit
				elseif child:IsA("GuiObject") then
					target = child
				end
				if target then
					local pos = target.AbsolutePosition
					local size = target.AbsoluteSize
					return pos + size / 2
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end)

	if ok and found then
		return found :: Vector2
	end
	return fallback
end

-- ===================== card arrive =====================
function HypeUI:cardArrive(color: Color3)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	-- bagTarget() returns a TRUE absolute screen point; topOffset() converts
	-- it into this (IgnoreGuiInset) gui's own local offset (see module header).
	local pos = self:bagTarget()
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Name = "CardArrive"
	card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, topOffset(pos.Y))
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 44)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = color
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.ZIndex = 9
	card.Parent = self._gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = card
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Color = STROKE_COLOR
	stroke.Parent = card
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 0
	scale.Parent = card

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local popDur = 0.16
		local holdDur = 0.12
		local shrinkDur = 0.22
		local total = popDur + holdDur + shrinkDur
		while not self._destroyed and card.Parent do
			local elapsed = (os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale
			if elapsed < popDur then
				local u = elapsed / popDur
				scale.Scale = 1.3 * (1 - (1 - u) ^ 3)
			elseif elapsed < popDur + holdDur then
				scale.Scale = 1.3 - 0.3 * ((elapsed - popDur) / holdDur)
			elseif elapsed < total then
				local u = (elapsed - popDur - holdDur) / shrinkDur
				scale.Scale = math.max(0, 1 - u)
				card.BackgroundTransparency = u
				stroke.Transparency = u
			else
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if card.Parent then
			card:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== skip prompt =====================
function HypeUI:showSkipPrompt()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	if not self._skipHost then
		local host = Instance.new("Frame")
		host.Name = "SkipHost"
		host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		host.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, bottomOffset(24))
		host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 54)
		host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		host.ZIndex = 7
		host.Parent = self._gui

		local track = Instance.new("Frame")
		track.Name = "Track"
		track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
		track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.ZIndex = 7
		track.Parent = host
		local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		trackCorner.Parent = track

		local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Name = "Fill"
		fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		fill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 216, 77)
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.ZIndex = 8
		fill.Parent = track
		local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		fillCorner.Parent = fill

		local l = label(host, "HOLD TO SKIP", 20, Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240), 3)
		l.Name = "Label"
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		l.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -14)
		l.ZIndex = 7

		self._skipHost = host
		self._skipLabel = l
		self._skipFillBar = fill
	end

	local host = self._skipHost :: Frame
	self._skipGen += 1

	host.Visible = true
	for _, d in ipairs(host:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
			d.TextTransparency = 0
			local st = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if st then
				st.Transparency = 0
			end
		elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
			d.BackgroundTransparency = (d.Name == "Track") and 0.25 or 0
		end
	end
	(self._skipFillBar :: Frame).Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
end

function HypeUI:setSkipProgress(alpha: number)
	if self._destroyed or not self._skipFillBar then
		return
	end
	local a = math.clamp(tonumber(alpha) or 0, 0, 1)
	self._skipFillBar.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
end

function HypeUI:hideSkipPrompt()
	if self._destroyed or not self._skipHost then
		return
	end
	local host = self._skipHost :: Frame
	self._skipGen += 1
	local myGen = self._skipGen
	local seconds = math.max(self._skip.exitFadeSeconds or 0.18, 0.02)

	local startText: { [TextLabel]: number } = {}
	local startStroke: { [UIStroke]: number } = {}
	local startBg: { [Frame]: number } = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(host:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
			startText[d] = d.TextTransparency
		elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
			startStroke[d] = d.Transparency
		elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
			startBg[d] = d.BackgroundTransparency
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while self._skipGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and host.Parent do
			local a = math.clamp(((os.clock() - t0) / self._timescale) / seconds, 0, 1)
			for d, s in pairs(startText) do
				d.TextTransparency = s + (1 - s) * a
			end
			for d, s in pairs(startStroke) do
				d.Transparency = s + (1 - s) * a
			end
			for d, s in pairs(startBg) do
				d.BackgroundTransparency = s + (1 - s) * a
			end
			if a >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if self._skipGen == myGen and not self._destroyed and host.Parent then
			host.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

-- ===================== interrupt =====================
-- Hard-cuts every in-flight HYPE effect IMMEDIATELY, in this same
-- synchronous call: bumps every generation counter (so no straggling
-- task.spawn loop writes another frame) and destroys the transient
-- instances outright -- banner, name letters, confetti, speed lines, meme
-- slots, and any live card pop(s). Deliberately does NOT touch the
-- ScreenGui itself, and does NOT touch anything owned by
-- showSkipPrompt/setSkipProgress/hideSkipPrompt -- see the module header's
-- "interrupt() contract" for why (the Sequencer owns the skip prompt's own
-- lifecycle and calls it separately). Meme-text assignment (_memeAssignment)
-- is intentionally preserved -- it's a per-cinematic constant, not a
-- per-effect one, and clearing it would make a post-interrupt memeFlyIns
-- re-roll which meme text goes with which punch, breaking "pure in t".
function HypeUI:interrupt()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end

	self._bannerGen += 1
	if self._bannerLabel then
		self._bannerLabel:Destroy()
		self._bannerLabel = nil
		self._bannerScale = nil
	end

	self._nameGen += 1
	if self._nameFrame then
		self._nameFrame:Destroy()
		self._nameFrame = nil
	end
	self._nameChars = {}

	self._confettiGen += 1
	if self._confettiHost then
		self._confettiHost:Destroy()
		self._confettiHost = nil
	end
	self._confettiPieces = {}

	self._speedGen += 1
	if self._speedHost then
		self._speedHost:Destroy()
		self._speedHost = nil
	end
	self._speedLines = {}

	if self._memeHost then
		self._memeHost:Destroy()
		self._memeHost = nil
	end
	self._memeSlots = {}

	for _, child in ipairs(self._gui:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == "CardArrive" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

-- ===================== cleanup =====================
function HypeUI:cleanup()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	self._bannerGen += 1
	self._nameGen += 1
	self._confettiGen += 1
	self._speedGen += 1
	self._skipGen += 1

	pcall(function()
		self._gui:Destroy()
	end)

	self._bannerLabel = nil
	self._bannerScale = nil
	self._nameFrame = nil
	self._nameChars = {}
	self._confettiHost = nil
	self._confettiPieces = {}
	self._speedHost = nil
	self._speedLines = {}
	self._memeHost = nil
	self._memeSlots = {}
	self._memeAssignment = {}
	self._skipHost = nil
	self._skipLabel = nil
	self._skipFillBar = nil
	self._bagSearchRootOverride = nil

	-- M6: these fields aren't optional in the type (HypeCfg/SkipCfg/
	-- ParticlesCfg/Random), so the final release goes through an `any`
	-- alias rather than widening their declared types just for cleanup.
	local selfAny: any = self
	selfAny._hype = nil
	selfAny._skip = nil
	selfAny._particles = nil
	selfAny._rng = nil
end

return HypeUI


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/CatchCinematic/PostFX.lua =====
--!strict
-- CatchCinematic.PostFX -- the hype grade. Creates its OWN Lighting instances
-- (CinematicCC / CinematicBloom / CinematicBlur), tagged, and NEVER touches any
-- pre-existing Lighting effect (this place already has a ColorCorrection,
-- TundraGrade, SunRays, Atmosphere, GardensGrade -- all off-limits).
--
-- Every animated value here (ColorCorrectionEffect.Saturation/Contrast,
-- BloomEffect.Intensity, BlurEffect.Size) is a hand-lerp: render-throttle-safe
-- and proven correct, rather than depending on TweenService progress, which
-- read back as stalled during a backgrounded/render-throttled verification
-- session (not a place-wide TweenService defect). Each of hypeOn/easeBack/flash
-- runs its own task.spawn stepping loop with task.wait().
-- hypeOn/easeBack share a generation counter (_gen) so the later call always
-- wins and cleanly supersedes an in-flight one -- no property fight between two
-- competing loops. flash() uses a separate counter (_flashGen) because it drives
-- a different property (Brightness) and must not be cancelled by a hypeOn/
-- easeBack call landing mid-pulse.
--
-- Baselines for the hand-lerp are simply 0 (Saturation/Contrast/Bloom.Intensity/
-- Blur.Size all default to 0 on a freshly-created instance) -- no snapshot
-- needed, unlike AudioBus, because these are OUR OWN new instances with nothing
-- pre-existing to remember.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local CINEMATIC_TAG = "CatchCinematicPostFX"

export type PostFXCfg = {
	hypeSaturation: number?,
	hypeContrast: number?,
	hypeBloomIntensity: number?,
	blurSizeHigh: number?,
	blurSizeLow: number?,
	flashSeconds: number?,
	easeBackSeconds: number?,
}

local PostFX = {}
PostFX.__index = PostFX

export type Fx = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		_cfg: PostFXCfg,
		_quality: string,
		_reducedMotion: boolean,
		_cc: ColorCorrectionEffect,
		_bloom: BloomEffect,
		_blur: BlurEffect,
		_gen: number,
		_flashGen: number,
		_destroyed: boolean,
	},
	PostFX
))

function PostFX.new(cfg: PostFXCfg, quality: string, reducedMotion: boolean): Fx
	local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	cc.Name = "CinematicCC"
	cc.Saturation = 0
	cc.Contrast = 0
	cc.Brightness = 0
	cc.Parent = Lighting
	CollectionService:AddTag(cc, CINEMATIC_TAG)

	local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bloom.Name = "CinematicBloom"
	bloom.Intensity = 0
	bloom.Size = 24
	bloom.Threshold = 2
	bloom.Parent = Lighting
	CollectionService:AddTag(bloom, CINEMATIC_TAG)

	local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
	blur.Name = "CinematicBlur"
	blur.Size = 0
	blur.Parent = Lighting
	CollectionService:AddTag(blur, CINEMATIC_TAG)

	local self = setmetatable({
		_cfg = cfg,
		_quality = quality,
		_reducedMotion = reducedMotion,
		_cc = cc,
		_bloom = bloom,
		_blur = blur,
		_gen = 0,
		_flashGen = 0,
		_destroyed = false,
	}, PostFX)
	return (self :: any) :: Fx
end

-- Quick white-pulse via ColorCorrectionEffect.Brightness, up then back down.
-- Skipped entirely when reducedMotion is true, per the brief.
function PostFX:flash()
	if self._destroyed or self._reducedMotion then
		return
	end
	self._flashGen += 1
	local myGen = self._flashGen
	local seconds = math.max(self._cfg.flashSeconds or 0.08, 0.02)
	local cc = self._cc
	local upT = seconds * 0.35
	local downT = math.max(seconds - upT, 0.01)

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while self._flashGen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / upT, 0, 1)
			cc.Brightness = a
			if a >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if self._destroyed or self._flashGen ~= myGen then
			return
		end
		local t1 = os.clock()
		while self._flashGen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t1) / downT, 0, 1)
			cc.Brightness = 1 - a
			if a >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

-- Hand-lerped Saturation/Contrast/Bloom up + blur per quality (blur target is 0
-- on "low" -- dropped entirely, per Config.POSTFX's own comment).
function PostFX:hypeOn(seconds: number)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	seconds = math.max(seconds, 0.05)
	self._gen += 1
	local myGen = self._gen
	local cfg = self._cfg
	local cc, bloom, blur = self._cc, self._bloom, self._blur

	local blurTarget = (self._quality == "low") and (cfg.blurSizeLow or 0) or (cfg.blurSizeHigh or 8)
	local startSat, startCon = cc.Saturation, cc.Contrast
	local startBloom, startBlur = bloom.Intensity, blur.Size
	local targetSat = cfg.hypeSaturation or 0.35
	local targetCon = cfg.hypeContrast or 0.12
	local targetBloom = cfg.hypeBloomIntensity or 0.9

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while self._gen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / seconds, 0, 1)
			local e = a * a * (3 - 2 * a) -- smoothstep
			cc.Saturation = startSat + (targetSat - startSat) * e
			cc.Contrast = startCon + (targetCon - startCon) * e
			bloom.Intensity = startBloom + (targetBloom - startBloom) * e
			blur.Size = startBlur + (blurTarget - startBlur) * e
			if a >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

-- Hand-lerped back toward baseline (0 on every axis). Supersedes any in-flight
-- hypeOn via the shared generation counter.
function PostFX:easeBack(seconds: number)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	seconds = math.max(seconds, 0.05)
	self._gen += 1
	local myGen = self._gen
	local cc, bloom, blur = self._cc, self._bloom, self._blur
	local startSat, startCon = cc.Saturation, cc.Contrast
	local startBloom, startBlur = bloom.Intensity, blur.Size

	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while self._gen == myGen and not self._destroyed do
			local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / seconds, 0, 1)
			local e = 1 - (1 - a) ^ 3
			cc.Saturation = startSat * (1 - e)
			cc.Contrast = startCon * (1 - e)
			bloom.Intensity = startBloom * (1 - e)
			blur.Size = startBlur * (1 - e)
			if a >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

-- Destroys all three instances, always -- idempotent, safe even if hypeOn was
-- never called.
function PostFX:cleanup()
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	self._gen += 1
	self._flashGen += 1
	pcall(function()
		self._cc:Destroy()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		self._bloom:Destroy()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		self._blur:Destroy()
	end)
end

return PostFX


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/CatchCinematic/RockRig.lua =====
--!strict
-- CatchCinematic.RockRig -- the skipping stone's post-bonk choreography: an
-- absurdly-hanging ricochet arc, a slow hover, a fall back down onto the
-- player's head (the "second bonk" at secondBonkT), a plink pause, then a
-- chaotic tumble back down into the water it came from, then hidden.
--
-- Rock:update(t, headPos) is a PURE function of cinematic time t (seconds since
-- the sequence started): calling it twice with the same (t, headPos) always
-- produces the same model CFrame and the same hidden/visible state, regardless
-- of call order or history. All per-instance variance (ricochet lateral drift
-- direction/magnitude, spin axis) is drawn from the injected `rng: Random`
-- exactly ONCE, in RockRig.new -- never per-frame, never via math.random.
--
-- cfg is Config.ROCK, optionally carrying three extra timing fields the
-- Sequencer should merge in (same pattern Task 3's ScreenShake.new(cfg).shakeMult
-- established -- see that module's header and Task 3's report "Concern #1"):
--   apexT          -- default 3.2, matches Config.BEATS.dread's t1 (end of dread)
--   secondBonkT    -- default 5.6, should be Config.SECOND_BONK_T
--   descentSeconds -- default 1.4, time spent falling from hover down to headPos
-- Built-in defaults match this task's brief exactly, so passing bare Config.ROCK
-- today still produces the documented choreography; Task 7 only needs to merge
-- these in if it ever wants apexT/secondBonkT to track a tuned Config.BEATS or
-- Config.SECOND_BONK_T that drifts from these defaults.
--
-- Choreography (derived from the brief's "0->~3.2s ... slow sine hover at top,
-- descent to headPos arriving at secondBonkT, plink pause, tumble over
-- tumbleSeconds, then hidden"):
--   [0, apexT]                      ricochet up, flattened-apex curve (absurd hang)
--   (apexT, hoverEndT]              slow sine hover at the apex (bob returns to 0
--                                    at both ends -- HOVER_PERIOD is chosen so the
--                                    hover window is one whole period by default)
--   (hoverEndT, secondBonkT]        descent to headPos, accelerating (gravity feel)
--   (secondBonkT, secondBonkT+plinkPauseSeconds]           held at headPos (plink)
--   (..., ...+tumbleSeconds]        tumble: a little hop, then falls back to bonkPos
--   after that                      hidden (Transparency 1, emitters/lights off)
--
-- The rock model comes from RockDesign.Build(rockId, rockColor) -- unchanged,
-- reused verbatim -- and is driven entirely by Model:PivotTo (never welds), so
-- its own Fx-kit particles/lights/trail (if any) ride along for free.

export type RockRigCfg = {
	ricochetApex: number?,
	ricochetLateral: number?,
	spinRadPerSec: number?,
	plinkPauseSeconds: number?,
	tumbleSeconds: number?,
	apexT: number?,
	secondBonkT: number?,
	descentSeconds: number?,
}

local RockRig = {}
RockRig.__index = RockRig

export type Rock = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		_cfg: RockRigCfg,
		_stage: Folder,
		_bonkPos: Vector3,
		_rng: Random,
		_model: Model,
		_origTransparency: { [BasePart]: number },
		_driftDir: Vector3,
		_driftDist: number,
		_spinAxis: Vector3,
		_hidden: boolean,
	},
	RockRig
))

local FALLBACK_HEAD_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 5, -8) -- used only if headPos is nil
local HOVER_BOB_STUDS = 0.6
-- Seconds per hover sine cycle. Chosen so bob(0) == bob(hoverEndT-apexT) == 0
-- when the default apexT/secondBonkT/descentSeconds are used (hover window = 1.0s
-- = one whole period). A caller-overridden window that isn't a whole multiple of
-- this just means a sub-stud discontinuity at the hover->descent handoff, not a
-- correctness bug.
local HOVER_PERIOD = 1.0
local TUMBLE_HOP_STUDS = 2.5

local function flattenedApex(p: number): number
	p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - p) ^ 2.4
end

function RockRig.new(
	cfg: RockRigCfg,
	stage: Folder,
	rockId: string?,
	rockColor: Color3?,
	bonkPos: Vector3,
	rng: Random
): Rock
	local RockDesign = require(script.Parent.Parent.RockDesign)

	local model = RockDesign.Build(rockId, rockColor)
	model.Parent = stage

	local origTransparency: { [BasePart]: number } = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			origTransparency[d] = d.Transparency
		end
	end

	-- Drawn ONCE from rng: deterministic per seed, reused by every update() call.
	-- driftDist is scaled into [0.4, 1.0] * ricochetLateral so every catch gets
	-- some sideways drift, never exactly zero (a dead-straight ricochet reads as
	-- a bug, not a choice).
	local driftAngle = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
	local driftDir = Vector3.new(math.cos(driftAngle), 0, math.sin(driftAngle))
	local driftDist = (0.4 + rng:NextNumber() * 0.6) * (cfg.ricochetLateral or 6)
	local spinAxis = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1, rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1, rng:NextNumber() * 2 - 1)
	if spinAxis.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		spinAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	else
		spinAxis = spinAxis.Unit
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_cfg = cfg,
		_stage = stage,
		_bonkPos = bonkPos,
		_rng = rng,
		_model = model,
		_origTransparency = origTransparency,
		_driftDir = driftDir,
		_driftDist = driftDist,
		_spinAxis = spinAxis,
		_hidden = false,
	}, RockRig)
	return (self :: any) :: Rock
end

function RockRig:_hoverEndT(): number
	local cfg = self._cfg
	local secondBonkT = cfg.secondBonkT or 5.6
	local descentSeconds = math.max(cfg.descentSeconds or 1.4, 0.1)
	return secondBonkT - descentSeconds
end

-- Idempotent (no-op if already in the requested state) so update() can call it
-- unconditionally every frame without repeatedly walking every descendant.
function RockRig:_setHidden(hidden: boolean)
	if self._hidden == hidden then
		return
	end
	self._hidden = hidden
	for _, d in ipairs(self._model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Transparency = hidden and 1 or (self._origTransparency[d] or 0)
		elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("PointLight") then
			d.Enabled = not hidden
		end
	end
end

function RockRig:update(t: number, headPos: Vector3?)
	local cfg = self._cfg
	local apex = cfg.ricochetApex or 120
	local apexT = math.max(cfg.apexT or 3.2, 0.1)
	local spin = cfg.spinRadPerSec or 9.0
	local plinkPause = math.max(cfg.plinkPauseSeconds or 0.35, 0)
	local tumbleSeconds = math.max(cfg.tumbleSeconds or 0.8, 0.05)
	local secondBonkT = cfg.secondBonkT or 5.6
	local hoverEndT = self:_hoverEndT()
	local plinkEndT = secondBonkT + plinkPause
	local tumbleEndT = plinkEndT + tumbleSeconds

	local target = headPos or (self._bonkPos + FALLBACK_HEAD_OFFSET)
	local bonk = self._bonkPos
	local hoverPos = bonk + Vector3.new(0, apex, 0) + self._driftDir * self._driftDist

	local pos: Vector3
	if t <= apexT then
		local p = t / apexT
		local h = apex * flattenedApex(p)
		pos = bonk + Vector3.new(0, h, 0) + self._driftDir * self._driftDist * p
	elseif t <= hoverEndT then
		local bobT = t - apexT
		local bob = HOVER_BOB_STUDS * math.sin((bobT / HOVER_PERIOD) * math.pi * 2)
		pos = hoverPos + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)
	elseif t <= secondBonkT then
		local dp = math.clamp((t - hoverEndT) / math.max(secondBonkT - hoverEndT, 1e-3), 0, 1)
		local ease = dp * dp -- accelerating fall, gravity feel
		pos = hoverPos:Lerp(target, ease)
	elseif t <= plinkEndT then
		pos = target
	elseif t <= tumbleEndT then
		local tp = math.clamp((t - plinkEndT) / tumbleSeconds, 0, 1)
		local hop = TUMBLE_HOP_STUDS * math.sin(tp * math.pi)
		pos = target:Lerp(bonk, tp) + Vector3.new(0, hop, 0)
	else
		pos = bonk
	end

	local spinCF = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(self._spinAxis, spin * t)
	self._model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * spinCF)
	self:_setHidden(t > tumbleEndT)
end

function RockRig:cleanup()
	if self._model and self._model.Parent then
		self._model:Destroy()
	end
end

return RockRig


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/CatchCinematic/ScreenShake.lua =====
--!strict
-- CatchCinematic.ScreenShake — trauma-based shake sampler. Owns NO camera writes;
-- CameraRig calls Shake:sample(dt) each frame (via the fn installed through
-- Rig:setShakeSource) and applies the returned (offset, rollDeg) itself, AFTER the
-- base CFrame, inside its single RenderStepped-bound writer.
--
-- cfg is Config.SHAKE, optionally with one extra field merged in by the caller:
--   shakeMult — reduced-motion multiplier (Config.REDUCED_MOTION.shakeMult when the
--   player has reduced motion on, else 1/omitted). Applied to trauma inside sample().

export type ScreenShakeCfg = {
	dreadRampTo: number?,
	eruption: number?,
	riseSustain: number?,
	traumaDecayPerSec: number?,
	maxOffset: number?,
	maxRollDeg: number?,
	shakeMult: number?,
}

local ScreenShake = {}
ScreenShake.__index = ScreenShake

export type Shake = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		_cfg: ScreenShakeCfg,
		_trauma: number,
		_sustain: number,
		_t: number,
		_seedX: number,
		_seedY: number,
		_seedZ: number,
		_seedRoll: number,
	},
	ScreenShake
))

function ScreenShake.new(cfg: ScreenShakeCfg): Shake
	local self = setmetatable({
		_cfg = cfg,
		_trauma = 0,
		_sustain = 0,
		_t = 0,
		_seedX = math.random() * 1000,
		_seedY = math.random() * 1000,
		_seedZ = math.random() * 1000,
		_seedRoll = math.random() * 1000,
	}, ScreenShake)
	return self
end

function ScreenShake:add(trauma: number)
	local n = tonumber(trauma) or 0
	self._trauma = math.clamp(self._trauma + n, 0, 1)
end

-- Floor beneath which trauma will not decay — the "rise" beat's ambient sustain.
function ScreenShake:setSustain(level: number)
	self._sustain = math.clamp(tonumber(level) or 0, 0, 1)
end

function ScreenShake:sample(dt: number): (Vector3, number)
	local d = tonumber(dt) or 0
	local cfg = self._cfg
	local decayPerSec = cfg.traumaDecayPerSec or 1.4

	self._trauma = math.clamp(math.max(self._sustain, self._trauma - decayPerSec * d), 0, 1)
	self._t += d

	local mult = cfg.shakeMult or 1
	local effectiveTrauma = math.clamp(self._trauma * mult, 0, 1)
	local mag = effectiveTrauma * effectiveTrauma -- applied magnitude = trauma^2

	local maxOffset = cfg.maxOffset or 0.9
	local maxRollDeg = cfg.maxRollDeg or 1.2

	-- Smooth per-axis noise, distinct seeds so axes don't move in lockstep.
	local nx = math.noise(self._t * 13, self._seedX)
	local ny = math.noise(self._t * 13, self._seedY)
	local nz = math.noise(self._t * 13, self._seedZ)
	local nr = math.noise(self._t * 13, self._seedRoll)

	local offset = Vector3.new(nx, ny, nz) * (mag * maxOffset)
	local rollDeg = nr * mag * maxRollDeg

	return offset, rollDeg
end

return ScreenShake


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/CatchCinematic/Sequencer.lua =====
--!strict
-- CatchCinematic.Sequencer -- THE CONDUCTOR. Everything Tasks 1-6 built (CameraRig,
-- ScreenShake, WaterFX, RockRig, BrainrotRig, PostFX, AudioBus, HypeUI) is composed
-- here into the 17.9s Massive catch cinematic and its 4.3s trimmed Huge cut.
--
-- ================================ BEAT MAP ================================
--   t (s)        beat        enter fn         per-frame fn      exit fn
--   0.00-0.35    bonk        enterBonk        --                --
--   0.35-1.60    travel      enterTravel      --                --
--   1.60-5.60    dread       enterDread       updateDread       --
--   5.60-6.35    silence     enterSilence     --                exitSilence
--   6.35-7.20    eruption    enterEruption    updateEruption    --
--   7.20-13.70   rise        enterRise        updateRise        --
--   13.70-16.20  hype        enterHype        updateHype        --
--   16.20-17.90  handoff     enterHandoff     updateHandoff     --
--
-- Run EVERY frame regardless of beat, in this order (see stepInner):
--   1. clock advance + the pre-eruption result hold      5. rock:update(t) (pure in t)
--   2. cancel deadline check                             6. the second bonk one-shot
--   3. ThrowResult name reconciliation -> swapModel      7. beat enter/exit dispatch
--   4. skip poll + skip/cancel fade state machines       8. end-of-timeline check
--
-- The trimmed variant (Config.HUGE_TRIM) simply drops `silence` and `hype` and
-- re-times the rest; the SAME enter/update fns run for the beats it keeps, and the
-- rock's apexT/secondBonkT/descentSeconds are re-derived from the trimmed bounds
-- (see rockTimings) so the second bonk still lands inside the rise beat.
--
-- ================================ TIMESCALE ================================
-- Config.timescale() is a SPEED multiplier -- Config's own header says
-- "0.25 = quarter speed", i.e. 0.25 makes everything take FOUR TIMES LONGER in wall
-- time. Exactly two derived numbers are used in this module, and nothing else:
--   run.speed   = Config.timescale()   -- cinematic seconds per real second
--   run.stretch = 1 / run.speed        -- real seconds per cinematic second
-- The rules, applied without exception:
--   * the conductor advances the master clock by  dt * run.speed
--   * every duration handed to a module that runs on its OWN wall clock
--     (CameraRig flyTo/orbit/punchFOV/returnToPlayer, PostFX hypeOn/easeBack,
--     WaterFX cascade, BrainrotRig revealColors/compressAndStreak, AudioBus fades)
--     is passed as  cinematicSeconds * run.stretch
--   * HypeUI's 5th constructor arg is a DURATION multiplier, not a speed one -- its
--     own header: "every wall-clock loop's elapsed-time computation divides by it".
--     That is the INVERSE of Config.timescale(), so HypeUI gets run.stretch. Set
--     CinematicTimescale = 0.25 and the beats, the module durations and HypeUI's
--     bursts all stretch 4x together, which is the whole point of the knob.
--   * durations that live INSIDE a module's own cfg -- Config.WATER's
--     domeRiseSeconds/columnSeconds/cascadeSeconds and Config.POSTFX's
--     flashSeconds/easeBackSeconds -- are unreachable from a call site, so buildRun
--     hands those constructors SCALED SHALLOW COPIES (see scaleDurations). Without
--     that, a 0.25x run stretched the beats while the water dome and the eruption
--     flash kept running at 1x, which reads as the effects desynchronising from the
--     cutscene rather than the cutscene slowing down.
--   * Config.CANCEL_TIMEOUT is scaled too. It is a deadline on the GRANT, but what
--     it actually protects is "the timeline must not reach the eruption unresolved",
--     and the timeline is what stretches. Unscaled, a 0.25x run cancelled every
--     single time, mid-dread, before the beats had gone anywhere. Scaled, the cancel
--     always lands at the same PLACE in the cut (t ~= 3.0) at every timescale.
-- Deliberately NOT scaled, because they are input/UX rather than choreography: the
-- SKIP hold duration, the skip/cancel luminance dip, and ScreenShake's trauma decay
-- (sampled on real dt). A slowed-down debug run must not demand a 4x longer press.
-- Accepted un-scaled 1x leftovers, all module-internal constants this module cannot
-- reach without editing those modules: WaterFX's ring lifetimes and godray spin, and
-- BrainrotRig's EYE_TWITCH_SECONDS. All are short one-shots; none carry a beat.
--
-- ================================ LIFECYCLE ================================
-- ONE `run` table per play (deliberately loose-typed -- it is a private bag of
-- per-play state, not a contract), ONE trove (`run.trove`) drained LIFO by
-- cleanup(), and ONE render-step binding as the conductor. cleanup() is wired to
-- every exit: normal end, skip-into-handoff (which still ends normally), cancel
-- timeout, Humanoid.Died, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, the conductor's pcall error
-- handler, and TWO watchdogs -- one inside the conductor (covers a stalled beat) and
-- a task.delay backstop (covers the conductor itself no longer being called, which
-- the first one by definition cannot). Both are identity-guarded on `run`, and
-- finish() is idempotent.
--
-- Sequencer.play is BLOCKING (the caller wraps it in task.spawn). Its return value
-- answers exactly one question: "did I take over?" -- false means DECLINED, and the
-- caller must stage its own stock landing. A decline can only happen before anything
-- is parented into the world, so a false return is always safe to fall back from.
-- Because the return only arrives ~10.7s later, the accept/decline answer is ALSO
-- delivered synchronously through opts.onCommit (and run.committed), so a caller
-- never has to infer it from timing. Whether the run then SUCCEEDED is a different
-- flag, reported through Bridge.finish(gen, ok) to whoever adopted the catch.
--
-- SKIP SAFETY: skipping jumps to the handoff, which surfaces, reveals and awards the
-- creature -- so it is gated on the grant having landed. Held early, the dip goes to
-- full dark and WAITS there; if the grant never comes, the cancel path takes over
-- from that same dark frame. A skip can never show a catch the cancel path exists to
-- prevent.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local folder = script.Parent
local Config = require(folder:WaitForChild("Config"))
local CameraRig = require(folder:WaitForChild("CameraRig"))
local ScreenShake = require(folder:WaitForChild("ScreenShake"))
local WaterFX = require(folder:WaitForChild("WaterFX"))
local RockRig = require(folder:WaitForChild("RockRig"))
local BrainrotRig = require(folder:WaitForChild("BrainrotRig"))
local PostFX = require(folder:WaitForChild("PostFX"))
local AudioBus = require(folder:WaitForChild("AudioBus"))
local HypeUI = require(folder:WaitForChild("HypeUI"))
local Bridge = require(folder:WaitForChild("Bridge"))
local Sizes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SizeConfig"))

local STAGE_NAME = "CatchCinematicStage"
local FADE_GUI_NAME = "CatchCinematicFade"
-- CameraRig binds its writer at Camera.Value + 1 (= 201). This conductor runs at 199,
-- two slots earlier, so every camera target it sets for a frame is already in place
-- when the rig samples it later in that same frame.
-- PER-RUN *AND* PER-VM UNIQUE. BindToRenderStep keys on the name string, so two
-- bindings sharing one name make an unbind ambiguous -- Roblox warns "removed different
-- functions with same reference name" and one run silently loses its conductor (which
-- only surfaces later, as a backstop-watchdog kill). A run counter alone is unique only
-- WITHIN a Lua VM, and every execute_luau harness gets its own VM whose counter also
-- starts at zero -- so both would bind "...Sequencer1". The salt closes that: it is
-- drawn once per module load, i.e. once per VM. Production is single-VM and the `active`
-- debounce already forbids two concurrent runs, so this is belt-and-braces -- it just
-- costs one GUID.
local BIND_NAME = "CatchCinematicSequencer"
local BIND_PRIORITY = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1
local runCounter = 0
local VM_SALT: string
do
	local ok, guid = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(guid) == "string" then
		VM_SALT = string.sub((string.gsub(guid, "%-", "")), 1, 8)
	else
		-- GenerateGUID needs no HTTP permission and does not fail in practice; this is
		-- only so a bind name always exists rather than being nil.
		VM_SALT = string.format("%08x", math.floor(os.clock() * 1e6) % 0xFFFFFFFF)
	end
end

local TRAVEL_BACK_STUDS = 24 -- how far short of the splash the low fly-out parks
local VIEW_DIST_PAD = 10 -- MassiveEmergence's viewDist pad: max(X,Z)*mult + 10
local DIP_MAX = 0.82 -- darkest the skip/cancel luminance dip ever gets (never 1.0)
local PUNCH_HOLD = 0.22 -- cinematic seconds a hype zoom-punch stays pulled in
local WATCHDOG_PAD = 8 -- real seconds of slack before the watchdog kills a run
local CANCEL_DIP_IN, CANCEL_DIP_OUT = 0.15, 0.6 -- real seconds, cancel wind-down dip

-- The cfg fields that are DURATIONS and therefore have to be timescaled before the
-- constructor sees them. Listed explicitly rather than pattern-matched on the name:
-- Config.WATER also holds domeHeightFrac/columnHeightMult/rippleAccel, and silently
-- scaling one of those would be a very quiet geometry bug.
local WATER_DURATION_FIELDS = { "domeRiseSeconds", "columnSeconds", "cascadeSeconds" }
local POSTFX_DURATION_FIELDS = { "flashSeconds", "easeBackSeconds" }

-- Skip input a SPECTATOR's key press must not count as. A bystander is still walking
