-- price/cost pill. kind: "cash" (green->yellow, dark text) or "gem" (orange, white text)
function M.bazaarPill(parent, text, kind)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = (kind == "gem") and "GemPill" or "CashPill"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = BZ.white
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	btn.Text = text or ""
	btn.TextSize = 16
	btn.ZIndex = (parent.ZIndex or 1) + 1
	btn:SetAttribute("NoPolish", true) -- LemonPop: pill governs its own label
	btn.Parent = parent
	M.corner(btn, 10)
	if kind == "gem" then
		M.gradient(btn, BZ.gem1, BZ.gem2, 90)
		btn.TextColor3 = BZ.white
		bzTextStroke(btn, 1.6)
	else
		M.gradient(btn, BZ.cash1, BZ.cash2, 90)
		btn.TextColor3 = BZ.cashText
	end
	bzStroke(btn, BZ.ink, 2.5)
	-- pills live inside a Row, so a shadow parented to the SAME row (not the
	-- row's parent) tracks the row's list-managed position automatically --
	-- no PropertyChangedSignal needed, unlike panel/header/close above.
	bzShadow(btn, 3, 10)
	wireClick(btn, "uiClick") -- SFX2
	return btn
end

-- Mutates an EXISTING button in place (the pattern every live call site
-- actually uses instead of bazaarPill, since their buttons are authored once
-- and just get recoloured on state changes -- often every data refresh, which
-- is exactly why bzShadow's idempotency above matters here). kind is unused
-- but kept for call-site symmetry with bazaarPill.
function M.bazaarRestylePill(btn, c1, c2, textColor)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = BZ.white
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	btn:SetAttribute("NoPolish", true) -- LemonPop: caller-chosen pill colours survive the polish pass
	btn.TextColor3 = textColor
	M.corner(btn, 10)
	M.gradient(btn, c1, c2, 90)
	for _, s in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") then s:Destroy() end
	end
	bzStroke(btn, BZ.ink, 2.5)
	bzShadow(btn, 3, 10)
	wireClick(btn, "uiClick") -- SFX2
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/UpgradeConfig.lua =====
-- Permanent, repeatable upgrades sold by Enzo the Upgrader.
local M = {}

-- ===================== EXTENDED FOR MID/LATE GAME (2026-07-28) =====================
-- The original 4 upgrades were all MaxLevel 8 and topped out around $57M (Income) --
-- trivial next to the extended rock ladder (21 rocks up to VoidHeart $2T). This pass
-- lengthens each ladder into the mid/late game WITHOUT changing any existing level's
-- meaning or price:
--
--   * Levels 0..7 are untouched. BasePrice, Growth and PerLevel are unchanged, so
--     every level a current player already bought costs and does exactly what it did.
--     No saved Upgrades table needs migrating.
--   * A soft "knee" kicks in at the old cap (Knee = 8). At or above the knee the price
--     grows by GrowthLate (a gentler ~2.1-2.3x) instead of the steep early Growth, so
--     the new levels are a real money sink but a "moderate" one -- reachable in a
--     session or two of established play, not a wall. Income (the primary sink) runs
--     longest, to L16 (~$114B to fully max); Luck stops at L12 so total throw-luck
--     inflation stays modest (top Lucky Charm 1.96x, up from 1.64x).
--
-- Early levels stay cheap on purpose (3000-5000): the first upgrades a new player can
-- afford should not gate the opening hour.
M.List = {
	{ Id = "Luck",    Name = "Lucky Charm",     Icon = "\u{1F340}", Desc = "Better rarity rolls",  MaxLevel = 12, BasePrice = 4000, Growth = 3.70, GrowthLate = 2.30, Knee = 8, PerLevel = 0.08 },
	{ Id = "Power",   Name = "Strong Arm",      Icon = "\u{1F4AA}", Desc = "Skip rocks farther",   MaxLevel = 12, BasePrice = 3000, Growth = 3.55, GrowthLate = 2.30, Knee = 8, PerLevel = 0.05 },
	{ Id = "Income",  Name = "Golden Touch",    Icon = "\u{1F4B0}", Desc = "Brainrots earn more",  MaxLevel = 16, BasePrice = 5000, Growth = 3.80, GrowthLate = 2.25, Knee = 8, PerLevel = 0.10 },
	{ Id = "Offline", Name = "Campfire Keeper", Icon = "\u{26FA}",  Desc = "Bank more while away", MaxLevel = 12, BasePrice = 3000, Growth = 3.30, GrowthLate = 2.10, Knee = 8, PerLevel = 0.50 },
}

M.ById = {}
for _, u in ipairs(M.List) do M.ById[u.Id] = u end

function M.Level(upgrades, id)
	return (upgrades and upgrades[id]) or 0
end

-- cost to go from `level` -> level+1, or nil if maxed.
-- Below the knee the steep early Growth applies (so existing level prices are
-- unchanged); at/above the knee a gentler GrowthLate takes over for the mid/late
-- extension. Continuous at the knee: price there equals BasePrice*Growth^Knee.
function M.Price(id, level)
	local u = M.ById[id]
	if not u or level >= u.MaxLevel then return nil end
	local knee = u.Knee or u.MaxLevel
	if level < knee then
		return math.floor(u.BasePrice * (u.Growth ^ level))
	end
	local kneePrice = u.BasePrice * (u.Growth ^ knee)
	local lateGrowth = u.GrowthLate or u.Growth
	return math.floor(kneePrice * (lateGrowth ^ (level - knee)))
end

function M.Mult(upgrades, id)
	local u = M.ById[id]
	if not u then return 1 end
	return 1 + M.Level(upgrades, id) * u.PerLevel
end

function M.IncomeMult(upgrades) return M.Mult(upgrades, "Income") end

-- Offline earnings are deliberately stingy until the player invests in Campfire
-- Keeper. Two separate dials, both driven by that upgrade's level:
--   HOURS -- how long the camp keeps banking after you leave
--   RATE  -- what share of your live income it banks (never the full amount)
-- Level 0 = 30m at 6.5%; level 12 (max) = 12h30m at 66.5%.
M.OfflineBaseHours     = 0.5
M.OfflineHoursPerLevel  = 1
M.OfflineBaseRate       = 0.065
M.OfflineRatePerLevel   = 0.05

function M.OfflineHours(upgrades)
	return M.OfflineBaseHours + M.Level(upgrades, "Offline") * M.OfflineHoursPerLevel
end

function M.OfflineRate(upgrades)
	return M.OfflineBaseRate + M.Level(upgrades, "Offline") * M.OfflineRatePerLevel
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ReplicatedStorage/Modules/WheelConfig.lua =====
-- WheelConfig: the free daily spin.
--
-- Shared deliberately. The client draws the wheel from this exact table and the server
-- rolls from it, so a segment can never show one prize and pay another. The client is
-- told WHICH slot won and animates to it; it never decides the outcome.
--
-- Weights are whole percents and must total 100 -- see the assertion at the bottom.
-- To retune, change the numbers and keep the sum at 100; nothing else needs touching.

local WheelConfig = {}

WheelConfig.COOLDOWN   = 24 * 60 * 60   -- rolling 24h from the last spin, not calendar midnight
WheelConfig.BOOST_TIME = 10 * 60        -- seconds a boost lasts
WheelConfig.BOOST_MULT = 1.30           -- +30%

-- Order here is the order around the wheel, clockwise from the top. The two boosts sit
-- opposite each other and the 1% jackpot sits between two commons, so the pointer is
-- never parked next to two big prizes at once.
-- Each slot carries three separate display strings because the wedge shows all three at
-- different radii, the way a real prize wheel does:
--   Name   big, curved along the outer arc
--   Value  what you actually get, under the icon
--   Short  the compact form, used where space is tight (the world wheel)
-- Colours are deliberately saturated and high-contrast against white outlined text;
-- muted tones read as grey mush at wheel scale.
WheelConfig.SLOTS = {
	{ Id = "Cash1k",    Kind = "Cash",  Amount = 1000,    Weight = 35,
	  Name = "SMALL CASH",  Value = "+$1,000",     Label = "$1,000",     Short = "$1K",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(214, 219, 226), Text = Color3.fromRGB(52, 58, 68), Icon = "\u{1F4B5}" },

	{ Id = "LuckBoost", Kind = "Boost", Stat = "Luck",    Weight = 15,
	  Name = "LUCK BOOST",  Value = "+30%  10 MIN", Label = "30% LUCK",   Short = "LUCK",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(64, 206, 227), Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Icon = "\u{1F340}" },

	{ Id = "Cash10k",   Kind = "Cash",  Amount = 10000,   Weight = 25,
	  Name = "BIG CASH",    Value = "+$10,000",    Label = "$10,000",    Short = "$10K",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 62),  Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Icon = "\u{1F4B0}" },

	{ Id = "Cash2500k", Kind = "Cash",  Amount = 2500000, Weight = 1,
	  Name = "JACKPOT",     Value = "+$2,500,000", Label = "$2,500,000", Short = "$2.5M",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(255, 199, 26), Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Icon = "\u{1F3C6}" },

	{ Id = "PowerBoost",Kind = "Boost", Stat = "Power",   Weight = 15,
	  Name = "POWER BOOST", Value = "+30%  10 MIN", Label = "30% POWER",  Short = "POWER",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(240, 74, 74),  Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Icon = "\u{1F4AA}" },

	{ Id = "Cash100k",  Kind = "Cash",  Amount = 100000,  Weight = 9,
	  Name = "HUGE CASH",   Value = "+$100,000",   Label = "$100,000",   Short = "$100K",
	  Colour = Color3.fromRGB(178, 96, 232), Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Icon = "\u{1F48E}" },
}

WheelConfig.TOTAL_WEIGHT = 0
for _, s in ipairs(WheelConfig.SLOTS) do
	WheelConfig.TOTAL_WEIGHT += s.Weight
end

-- Loud on purpose: a wheel whose odds silently stop summing to 100 is the kind of bug
-- nobody notices until players do the maths for you.
assert(WheelConfig.TOTAL_WEIGHT == 100,
	("WheelConfig weights must total 100, got %d"):format(WheelConfig.TOTAL_WEIGHT))

function WheelConfig.SlotById(id)
	for i, s in ipairs(WheelConfig.SLOTS) do
		if s.Id == id then return s, i end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Weighted pick. Server-only in practice, but it lives here so the odds and the labels
-- can never drift apart.
function WheelConfig.Roll(rng)
	local r = (rng and rng:NextNumber() or math.random()) * WheelConfig.TOTAL_WEIGHT
	local cum = 0
	for i, s in ipairs(WheelConfig.SLOTS) do
		cum += s.Weight
		if r <= cum then return i, s end
	end
	return #WheelConfig.SLOTS, WheelConfig.SLOTS[#WheelConfig.SLOTS]
end

-- "1 in 100" reads better than "1%" for the jackpot; used on the prize list.
function WheelConfig.OddsText(slot)
	if slot.Weight >= 10 then return slot.Weight .. "%" end
	return ("%g%%  (1 in %d)"):format(slot.Weight, math.floor(100 / slot.Weight + 0.5))
end

return WheelConfig


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/CellarDoor.server.lua =====
-- CellarDoor: the padlocked hatch on the grass west of the fishing hut.
--
-- The key does not exist in the game yet, so hasKey() is false for everyone today and
-- every trigger falls through to the rattle. The whole unlock path below is already
-- wired though -- padlock drops, both leaves swing, the prompt retires -- so shipping
-- the key later is one of:
--     * give the player a Tool named exactly KEY_NAME (Backpack or equipped), or
--     * player:SetAttribute("HasCellarKey", true) from whatever grants it.
-- Nothing in this script needs editing for either.
--
-- The cellar is a WORLD door, not a per-player one: once any keyholder opens it, it
-- stays open for the rest of that server. Making it per-player would mean replicating
-- two different door states to two different clients, which is a client-side rebuild
-- of the whole hatch -- not worth it for a shared overworld prop.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")

local cellar   = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld"):WaitForChild("Cellar")
local entrance = cellar:WaitForChild("Entrance")
local padlock  = entrance:WaitForChild("Padlock")
local prompt   = padlock.Body:WaitForChild("CellarPrompt")

local KEY_NAME   = cellar:GetAttribute("RequiredKey") or "Cellar Key"
local OPEN_TIME  = 1.1              -- seconds for the leaves to swing
local OPEN_ANGLE = math.rad(105)

local leaves = {}
for _, name in ipairs({ "LeafWest", "LeafEast" }) do
	local leaf = entrance:WaitForChild(name)
	local hingeX = leaf:GetAttribute("HingeX")
	table.insert(leaves, {
		model = leaf,
		pivot = Vector3.new(hingeX, 4.55, 87),
		-- the leaf swings up and away from its own hinge, so the direction of the
		-- rotation is just which side of the hinge the plank sits on
		sign  = hingeX < leaf.PrimaryPart.Position.X and 1 or -1,
		base  = leaf:GetPivot(),
	})
end

local function setAngle(theta)
	for _, l in ipairs(leaves) do
		local t = CFrame.new(l.pivot) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, l.sign * theta) * CFrame.new(-l.pivot)
		l.model:PivotTo(t * l.base)
	end
end

local function play(name)
	local snd = padlock.Body:FindFirstChild(name)
	if snd then snd:Play() end
end

local function notify(player, message)
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if remote then
		remote:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = message })
	end
end

local function hasKey(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("HasCellarKey") then return true end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME) then return true end
	local char = player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME) then return true end
	return false
end

local busy = false

local function rattle()
	-- a short shudder against the padlock: the leaves lift a couple of degrees and
	-- drop back, twice, so a locked pull reads as blocked rather than as nothing
	play("LockedRattle")
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		for i = 0, 1, 0.34 do
			setAngle(math.rad(2.5) * math.sin(i * math.pi))
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
	end
	setAngle(0)
end

local function open()
	cellar:SetAttribute("Locked", false)
	prompt.Enabled = false
	play("UnlockClunk")
	task.wait(0.35)

	-- padlock falls off into the grass and is gone for good
	local body = padlock.Body
	for _, d in ipairs(padlock:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
	body.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 4, -6)
	task.delay(4, function() padlock:Destroy() end)

	play("HatchOpen")
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while true do
		local a = math.min((os.clock() - t0) / OPEN_TIME, 1)
		-- ease out, so the leaves land rather than slam
		setAngle(OPEN_ANGLE * (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3))
		if a >= 1 then break end
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	if busy or not cellar:GetAttribute("Locked") then return end
	busy = true

	if hasKey(player) then
		open()
	else
		notify(player, "The cellar is padlocked. You need the " .. KEY_NAME .. ".")
		rattle()
		busy = false
	end
end)

print("CellarDoor online (locked, requires '" .. KEY_NAME .. "')")


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/CenterpieceSpinner.server.lua =====
-- Slowly spins + bobs any decor part tagged with the "Spin" attribute
-- (the Trading Plaza centerpiece gem).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local gems = {}
local gameWorld = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
local container = gameWorld and gameWorld:FindFirstChild("TradingWorld")
if container then
	for _, part in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("Spin") then
			table.insert(gems, { part = part, base = part.Position })
		end
	end
end

local t = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	for _, g in ipairs(gems) do
		if g.part.Parent then
			local bob = math.sin(t * 1.5) * 1.2
			g.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(g.base + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0))
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), t * 0.9, math.rad(45))
		end
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/CinematicCommand.server.lua =====
-- CinematicCommand: Studio/admin debug controls for the Massive Catch Cinematic
-- build (task-8-brief). Two chat commands, both gated identically to
-- ServerScriptService.AdminAnnouncements (RunService:IsStudio() OR the same
-- ALLOWED_USER_IDS allowlist, copied as-is):
--
--   /cinematic [name words...] [massive|huge|hugeold|spectator]
--       Fabricates a MassiveCinematic payload and FireClients it to ONLY the
--       requesting player (or, for "spectator", with UserId=0 so THEIR OWN
--       client takes the spectator branch instead of the thrower branch).
--       GRANTS NOTHING. Touches no PlayerDataManager data, no inventory, no
--       currency -- this is a visual-only remote fire, exactly the one
--       ThrowHandler already fires for a real throw. Unknown brainrot name ->
--       warn(), nothing fired.
--
--   /cinceremony on|off
--       Sets the workspace attribute CinematicCeremonyAfter (boolean), which
--       CatchRevealClient already reads as a live override for
--       Config.RUN_PULL_CEREMONY_AFTER (see that file's ThrowResult handler).
--       Workspace-attribute rather than per-player so it persists across a
--       respawn within the same demo session.
--
-- "massive"/"huge"/"spectator" all set payload.__variantOverride so the demo
-- forces a specific cut regardless of Config.SIZES' CURRENT tuning (Huge is
-- "none" today, pending the owner's side-by-side pick) -- see CinematicClient's
-- own Studio debug seam for why. "hugeold" instead routes to the OLD
-- MassiveEmergence cutscene, bypassing the Sequencer entirely, for the direct
-- comparison. Every payload also sets __debugNoBridge: a fabricated payload has
-- no real ThrowResult behind it, and without this the Sequencer would arm the
-- Bridge, wait out Config.CANCEL_TIMEOUT for a grant that will never come, and
-- cancel the run a few seconds in -- exactly the failure a demo command must
-- not have. Both fields are Studio-only no-ops outside Studio (see
-- CinematicClient), by design: none of this is meant to run on a published
-- server, matching every other test seam in this build.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local cinematicRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("MassiveCinematic")

local BrainrotConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("BrainrotConfig"))
local BrainrotConfigTundra = require(modules:WaitForChild("BrainrotConfigTundra"))
local RarityConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("RarityConfig"))
local RarityConfigTundra = require(modules:WaitForChild("RarityConfigTundra"))

-- Same allowlist as AdminAnnouncements -- copied as-is, not re-derived, so the
-- two commands never drift out of sync on who counts as an admin.
local ALLOWED_USER_IDS = { 71510820 }

local function isAllowed(player: Player): boolean
	return table.find(ALLOWED_USER_IDS, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local function canUse(player: Player): boolean
	return RunService:IsStudio() or isAllowed(player)
end

-- ============================== name -> rarity/colour ==============================
-- BrainrotConfig (hub) and BrainrotConfigTundra (World 2) each carry a plain
-- Rarity STRING per entry (no shared Tier object), so the colour has to come
-- from whichever world's own RarityConfig the name was found in. Built once at
-- module load -- this list only changes with a publish, never mid-session.
local rarityByName: { [string]: { rarity: string, world: string } } = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	rarityByName[e.Name] = { rarity = e.Rarity, world = "hub" }
end
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfigTundra) do
	-- Tundra wins on a name collision (57 W1 crossovers per the tundra-crossover
	-- build): a name reachable in both worlds shows its Tundra rarity here,
	-- which is almost always the rarer/more "plausible" one for a MASSIVE demo.
	rarityByName[e.Name] = { rarity = e.Rarity, world = "tundra" }
end

local colorByRarity = { hub = {}, tundra = {} }
for _, t in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
	colorByRarity.hub[t.Name] = t.Color
end
for _, t in ipairs(RarityConfigTundra) do
	colorByRarity.tundra[t.Name] = t.Color
end

local FALLBACK_RARITY = "Rare"
local FALLBACK_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local function rarityAndColorFor(name: string): (string, Color3)
	local info = rarityByName[name]
	if not info then
		return FALLBACK_RARITY, FALLBACK_COLOR
	end
	local color = colorByRarity[info.world][info.rarity] or FALLBACK_COLOR
	return info.rarity, color
end

-- ============================== end pos / surface Y ==============================
-- Same recipe as ServerScriptService.Modules.ThrowHandler's surfaceYOf/
-- throwZoneOf: any BasePart named ThrowZone under Workspace.GameWorld, tested
-- by CFrame:PointToObjectSpace against the zone's own half-size (+6 on Y,
-- matching the throw code's generous stance allowance). Walked fresh per
-- command rather than cached against GameWorld.DescendantAdded/Removing like
-- ThrowHandler does -- this runs on a chat message, not a per-throw hot path.
local DEFAULT_SURFACE_Y = 1.5

local function surfaceYForCharacter(character: Model?): number
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return DEFAULT_SURFACE_Y
	end
	local gw = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
	if not gw then
		return DEFAULT_SURFACE_Y
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(gw:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "ThrowZone" then
			local rel = d.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace((hrp :: BasePart).Position)
			local half = d.Size / 2
			if math.abs(rel.X) <= half.X and math.abs(rel.Z) <= half.Z and math.abs(rel.Y) <= half.Y + 6 then
				local sy = d:GetAttribute("SurfaceY")
				return (type(sy) == "number") and sy or DEFAULT_SURFACE_Y
			end
		end
	end
	return DEFAULT_SURFACE_Y
end

-- HRP + lookVector * 60, flattened and snapped to the standing zone's surface
-- (or the hub default). Returns nil only when the player has no character at
-- all (dead/loading) -- the command simply declines rather than throwing.
local function endPosFor(player: Player): (Vector3?, number?)
	local character = player.Character
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local look = (hrp :: BasePart).CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	else
		flat = flat.Unit
	end
	local raw = (hrp :: BasePart).Position + flat * 60
	local surfaceY = surfaceYForCharacter(character)
	return Vector3.new(raw.X, surfaceY, raw.Z), surfaceY
end

-- ============================== /cinematic ==============================

local DEFAULT_NAME = "Kraken Congelato"
local VARIANTS = { massive = true, huge = true, hugeold = true, spectator = true }

-- Pebble: RockConfig's own cheapest/first rock, MaxDistance 25, Color (140,140,140).
local ROCK_ID = "Pebble"
local ROCK_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)

local function fireCinematic(player: Player, name: string, variant: string)
	local endPos, surfaceY = endPosFor(player)
	if not endPos then
		warn("[CinematicCommand] " .. player.Name .. ": no character to throw from, nothing fired")
		return
	end

	local rarity, color = rarityAndColorFor(name)

	local payload: { [string]: any } = {
		UserId = (variant == "spectator") and 0 or player.UserId,
		BrainrotName = name,
		Rarity = rarity,
		RarityColor = color,
		Mutation = nil,
		Size = "Massive",
		RockId = ROCK_ID,
		RockColor = ROCK_COLOR,
		Seed = math.random(1, 2 ^ 30),
		EndPos = endPos,
		SurfaceY = surfaceY,
		TotalTime = 0.1, -- near-immediate bonk, per task-8-brief
		NContacts = 1,
		SegTime = 0.1,
		-- Studio-only debug seam CinematicClient reads -- see that file and this
		-- module's own header comment. Never meaningful outside Studio.
		__debugNoBridge = true,
	}

	if variant == "huge" then
		payload.Size = "Huge"
		payload.__variantOverride = "trimmed"
	elseif variant == "hugeold" then
		payload.Size = "Huge"
		payload.__variantOverride = "hugeold"
	else
		-- "massive" and "spectator" both want the full cut, forced regardless of
		-- Config.SIZES.Massive's current value (today "full" anyway, but the demo
		-- command should not go quiet the moment the owner starts flipping that
		-- tunable while comparing variants).
		payload.__variantOverride = "full"
	end

	cinematicRemote:FireClient(player, payload)
end

local function parseCinematic(player: Player, body: string)
	local tokens = {}
	for w in body:gmatch("%S+") do
		table.insert(tokens, w)
	end

	local variant = "massive"
	if #tokens > 0 then
		local lastLower = string.lower(tokens[#tokens])
		if VARIANTS[lastLower] then
			variant = lastLower
			table.remove(tokens)
		end
	end

	local name = (#tokens > 0) and table.concat(tokens, " ") or DEFAULT_NAME

	local models = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainrotModels")
	if not (models and models:FindFirstChild(name)) then
		warn("[CinematicCommand] " .. player.Name .. ": unknown brainrot '" .. name .. "' -- nothing fired")
		return
	end

	fireCinematic(player, name, variant)
end

-- ============================== /cinceremony ==============================

local function parseCinCeremony(player: Player, body: string)
	local arg = string.lower(string.match(body, "%S+") or "")
	if arg == "on" then
		Workspace:SetAttribute("CinematicCeremonyAfter", true)
	elseif arg == "off" then
		Workspace:SetAttribute("CinematicCeremonyAfter", false)
	else
		warn("[CinematicCommand] " .. player.Name .. ": /cinceremony expects 'on' or 'off'")
	end
end

-- ============================== chat wiring ==============================
-- Same shape as AdminAnnouncements.parseCommand: "<command> " prefix -> body,
-- bare "<command>" -> empty body, anything else -> nil (not this command).
local function stripCommand(message: string, command: string): string?
	local prefix = command .. " "
	if message:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
		return message:sub(#prefix + 1)
	elseif message == command then
		return ""
	end
	return nil
end

local function onPlayerChatted(player: Player, message: string)
	local cinBody = stripCommand(message, "/cinematic")
	if cinBody then
		-- SPLIT GATE (review fix, task 8): /cinematic is Studio-only, full stop --
		-- deliberately NOT the isAllowed() allowlist branch canUse() gives
		-- /cinceremony below. Every seam this command depends on to be USEFUL
		-- (__variantOverride and __debugNoBridge, both read in CinematicClient) is
		-- itself gated on RunService:IsStudio(), so a live-server admin invocation
		-- could only ever produce a degraded run: huge/hugeold silently no-op
		-- (Config.SIZES.Huge is "none" today) and massive/spectator would arm the
		-- REAL Bridge (skipBridge never engages outside Studio) and hard-cancel
		-- ~3s in waiting for a ThrowResult that will never come. Worse than merely
		-- degraded: arming the real Bridge on a live server opens a genuine
		-- cross-contamination window -- if that SAME admin has a real Massive
		-- catch in flight when they run this, its authentic ThrowResult can adopt
		-- into this demo's armed generation, and the real catch's reveal plays out
		-- through the fabricated payload's leftover cosmetic fields (name/rarity/
		-- colour). Non-data-corrupting (no grant, no currency, nothing written),
		-- but a real and entirely avoidable failure mode for a command that cannot
		-- do anything useful outside Studio anyway. So: Studio only, no allowlist
		-- fallback -- unreachable on a published server even for an admin.
		if RunService:IsStudio() then
			parseCinematic(player, cinBody)
		end
		return
	end

	local ceremonyBody = stripCommand(message, "/cinceremony")
	if ceremonyBody then
		-- /cinceremony only ever flips the cosmetic workspace attribute
		-- CinematicCeremonyAfter, which the REAL catch pipeline's
		-- CatchRevealClient reads -- no MassiveCinematic fire, no Bridge contact,
		-- so the live-server admin allowlist (canUse -- IsStudio() OR isAllowed())
		-- stays safe to keep here.
		if canUse(player) then
			parseCinCeremony(player, ceremonyBody)
		end
		return
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		onPlayerChatted(player, message)
	end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)

local TAU = math.pi * 2
local BOB_AMP = 0.1
local PROXIMITY_RANGE = 60

local function familyOf(name)
	local base = name
	local changed = true
	while changed do
		local newBase = base:gsub("_s%d+$", ""):gsub("_%d+$", "")
		changed = newBase ~= base
		base = newBase
	end
	return base
end

local function groupKeyOf(name)
	return (name:gsub("_s%d+$", ""))
end

local function partVolume(part)
	local size = part.Size
	return size.X * size.Y * size.Z
end

local resolved = {}

local function makeAnchor(model, priceTag)
	if not priceTag then return end
	local existingAnchor = model:FindFirstChild("PriceTagAnchor")
	if existingAnchor then
		priceTag.Adornee = existingAnchor
		return
	end
	local adornee = priceTag.Adornee
	if not adornee then return end

	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name = "PriceTagAnchor"
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.CanTouch = false
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CFrame = adornee.CFrame
	anchor.Parent = model
	priceTag.Adornee = anchor
end

-- The egg price tags shipped with MaxDistance = inf, the only GUIs in the game with no
-- cap at all (every other sign is 47-220), so they stayed legible from clear across the
-- map. They also bled into each other badly: the eggs sit in a straight line 4 studs
-- apart, and a 160px billboard is about 3.2 studs wide, so viewed ALONG the row the
-- gaps foreshorten toward nothing while each tag keeps its full width -- the five names
-- rendered as one unreadable smear. Three things fix it together:
--   * a real MaxDistance, so they only appear when you are at the stall
--   * a smaller tag, which shrinks both the text and the footprint
--   * alternating heights, which is the only one that survives an edge-on viewing angle
-- Done here rather than on the instances so any egg added later is covered too.
local TAG_MAX_DISTANCE = 45
local TAG_SIZE = UDim2.fromOffset(88, 40)
local TAG_BASE_Y = 1.7          -- the offset the tags already used
-- THREE levels, not two. With a 2-cycle, eggs 1 and 3 still share a row only 8 studs
-- apart and still collide at a shallow angle; a 3-cycle guarantees no neighbour ever
-- shares a row, and same-row pairs end up 12 studs apart.
local TAG_STAGGER_LEVELS = 3
local TAG_STAGGER_STEP = 0.95
local NAME_MAX_TEXT = 15
local PRICE_MAX_TEXT = 14

local function capText(label, maxSize)
	if not label then return end
	-- TextScaled with no constraint means a short name renders BIGGER than a long one,
	-- so capping also makes the row visually consistent, not just smaller.
	local c = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
	if not c then
		c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		c.Parent = label
	end
	c.MaxTextSize = maxSize
end

local function styleTag(model, priceTag)
	if not priceTag then return end
	priceTag.MaxDistance = TAG_MAX_DISTANCE
	priceTag.Size = TAG_SIZE
	capText(priceTag:FindFirstChild("NameLabel"), NAME_MAX_TEXT)
	capText(priceTag:FindFirstChild("PriceLabel"), PRICE_MAX_TEXT)

	-- Stagger by position in the row (sorted along Z) rather than by creation order, so
	-- the pattern is stable no matter what order the models happen to be parented in.
	local parent = model.Parent
	if not parent then return end
	local row = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name:find("Egg") and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui") then
			table.insert(row, c)
		end
	end
	table.sort(row, function(a, b) return a:GetPivot().Position.Z < b:GetPivot().Position.Z end)
	local idx = 1
	for i, c in ipairs(row) do
		if c == model then idx = i break end
	end
	local level = (idx - 1) % TAG_STAGGER_LEVELS
	priceTag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, TAG_BASE_Y + level * TAG_STAGGER_STEP, 0)
end

local function setupModel(eggName, model)
	local cfg = EGG_CONFIG[eggName]
	if not cfg then return end

	local state = {
		model = model,
		bobPeriod = cfg.bobPeriod,
		bobPhase = math.random() * TAU,
		bodyParts = {},
		floaters = {},
		rings = {},
		crownAssembly = nil,
	}

	local byFamily = {}
	local byGroup = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "PriceTagAnchor" then
			local fam = familyOf(d.Name)
			byFamily[fam] = byFamily[fam] or {}
			table.insert(byFamily[fam], d)

			local gk = groupKeyOf(d.Name)
			local g = byGroup[gk]
			if not g then
				g = {family = fam, parts = {}}
				byGroup[gk] = g
			end
			table.insert(g.parts, d)
		end
	end

	local excluded = {}

	if cfg.floatFamilyOrder and cfg.floatCount and cfg.floatCount > 0 then
		local pool = {}
		for _, fam in ipairs(cfg.floatFamilyOrder) do
			if #pool >= cfg.floatCount then break end
			local famParts = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(byFamily[fam] or {}) do
				table.insert(famParts, p)
			end
			table.sort(famParts, function(a, b) return partVolume(a) < partVolume(b) end)
			for _, p in ipairs(famParts) do
				if #pool >= cfg.floatCount then break end
				table.insert(pool, p)
			end
		end

		local shell = model.PrimaryPart or (byFamily.shell_body and byFamily.shell_body[1])
		local shellCenter = shell and shell.Position or model:GetPivot().Position
		local shellSize = shell and shell.Size or Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		local shellHalfWidth = (shellSize.X + shellSize.Z) / 4
		local orbitRadius = shellHalfWidth + 0.35

		local n = #pool
		for i, p in ipairs(pool) do
			excluded[p] = true
			local heightFrac = n > 1 and (i - 1) / (n - 1) or 0.5
			local height = shellCenter.Y + (heightFrac - 0.5) * shellSize.Y * 0.5
			table.insert(state.floaters, {
				part = p,
				shellCenter = shellCenter,
				height = height,
				radius = orbitRadius,
				period = 6 + (n > 1 and (i - 1) * (3 / (n - 1)) or 0),
				phase = (i - 1) * (TAU / math.max(n, 1)),
				spinRate = 0.6 + i * 0.15,
			})
		end
	end

	if cfg.ringFamilies then
		local ringGroups = {}
		for gk, g in pairs(byGroup) do
			if cfg.ringFamilies[g.family] then
				table.insert(ringGroups, {key = gk, group = g})
			end
		end
		table.sort(ringGroups, function(a, b) return a.key < b.key end)

		for i, entry in ipairs(ringGroups) do
			local g = entry.group
			local spec = cfg.ringSpecs and cfg.ringSpecs[i]
			if spec then
				local sum = Vector3.new()
				for _, p in ipairs(g.parts) do
					sum = sum + p.Position
					excluded[p] = true
				end
				local center = sum / #g.parts
				local flatCF = CFrame.new(center)
				local localParts = {}
				for _, p in ipairs(g.parts) do
					table.insert(localParts, {part = p, cf = flatCF:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)})
				end
				table.insert(state.rings, {
					parts = localParts,
					center = center,
					tilt = math.rad(spec.tilt),
					period = spec.period,
					dir = spec.dir,
					phase = math.random() * TAU,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	if cfg.crownAssemblyFamilies then
		local parts = {}
		local sumX, sumZ, minY, count = 0, 0, math.huge, 0
		for fam in pairs(cfg.crownAssemblyFamilies) do
			for _, p in ipairs(byFamily[fam] or {}) do
				table.insert(parts, p)
				excluded[p] = true
				sumX = sumX + p.Position.X
				sumZ = sumZ + p.Position.Z
				minY = math.min(minY, p.Position.Y)
				count = count + 1
			end
		end
		if count > 0 then
			local pivot0 = CFrame.new(sumX / count, minY, sumZ / count)
			local localParts = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				table.insert(localParts, {part = p, cf = pivot0:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)})
			end
			state.crownAssembly = {
				parts = localParts,
				pivot0 = pivot0,
				hover = cfg.crownHover,
				bobAmp = cfg.crownBobAmp,
				bobPeriod = cfg.crownBobPeriod,
				yawPeriod = cfg.crownYawPeriod,
				phase = math.random() * TAU,
			}
		end
	end

	if cfg.bodyFamilies then
		for fam in pairs(cfg.bodyFamilies) do
			for _, p in ipairs(byFamily[fam] or {}) do
				if not excluded[p] then
					table.insert(state.bodyParts, {part = p, cf0 = p.CFrame})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local priceTag = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
	makeAnchor(model, priceTag)
	styleTag(model, priceTag)

	resolved[eggName] = state
end

local function getStall()
	local gw = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
	return gw and gw:FindFirstChild("EggStall")
end

local function resolveAll()
	local stall = getStall()
	if not stall then return end

	for eggName in pairs(EGG_CONFIG) do
		local model = stall:FindFirstChild(eggName)
		if model then
			setupModel(eggName, model)
		end
	end

	stall.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Model") and EGG_CONFIG[child.Name] then
			task.defer(function()
				if child.Parent then
					setupModel(child.Name, child)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

resolveAll()

local frameCount = 0
local active = true

local function checkProximity()
	local stall = getStall()
	if not stall then
		active = false
		return
	end
	local origin = stall:GetPivot().Position
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = plr.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and (hrp.Position - origin).Magnitude <= PROXIMITY_RANGE then
			active = true
			return
		end
	end
	active = false
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	frameCount += 1
	if frameCount % PROXIMITY_CHECK_EVERY == 0 then
		checkProximity()
	end
	if not active then
		return
	end

	local t = os.clock()

	for eggName, state in pairs(resolved) do
		local model = state.model
		if not model or not model.Parent then
			resolved[eggName] = nil
			continue
		end

		local bobY = BOB_AMP * math.sin((TAU * t / state.bobPeriod) + state.bobPhase)
		local bobOffset = Vector3.new(0, bobY, 0)
		for _, entry in ipairs(state.bodyParts) do
			if entry.part.Parent then
				entry.part.CFrame = entry.cf0 + bobOffset
			end
		end

		for _, ring in ipairs(state.rings) do
			local spin = (TAU * t / ring.period) * ring.dir + ring.phase
			local ringCF = CFrame.new(ring.center) * CFrame.Angles(0, spin, 0) * CFrame.Angles(ring.tilt, 0, 0)
			for _, entry in ipairs(ring.parts) do
				if entry.part.Parent then
					entry.part.CFrame = ringCF * entry.cf
				end
			end
		end

		local ca = state.crownAssembly
		if ca then
			local hoverY = ca.hover + ca.bobAmp * math.sin((TAU * t / ca.bobPeriod) + ca.phase)
			local yaw = (TAU * t / ca.yawPeriod) + ca.phase
			local assemblyCF = ca.pivot0 * CFrame.new(0, hoverY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
			for _, entry in ipairs(ca.parts) do
				if entry.part.Parent then
					entry.part.CFrame = assemblyCF * entry.cf
				end
			end
		end

		for _, f in ipairs(state.floaters) do
			if f.part.Parent then
				local ang = (TAU * t / f.period) + f.phase
				local orbitCF = CFrame.new(f.shellCenter.X, f.height, f.shellCenter.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
					* CFrame.new(f.radius, 0, 0)
					* CFrame.Angles(t * f.spinRate, t * f.spinRate * 0.7, 0)
				f.part.CFrame = orbitCF
			end
		end
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/ItemStatsService.server.lua =====
-- ItemStatsService -- the read-only supply + price window the Brainrot Index asks.
--
-- WHY A REMOTEFUNCTION RATHER THAN REPLICATED STATE:
-- exists counts and camp prices move constantly, and only matter for the ~20 rows
-- a player is actually looking at. Replicating all 214 classes (x4 mutations) to
-- every client would cost far more than answering the handful that are on screen.
--
-- CONTRACT
--   local map, meta = GetItemStats:InvokeServer({ { Name = "X", Mutation = "Golden" }, ... })
--
--   map[key] = { Tracked = bool, Minted = n?, Exists = n?, Price = n?, Samples = n }
--     key     = Name .. "|" .. (Mutation or "")
--     Tracked = whether the class is worth a serial at all (Legendary+ or mutated).
--               When false the UI should show no supply line, because none exists.
--     Minted / Exists = nil while the mint registry is cold or its DataStore is
--               down. The UI must HIDE the line in that case, never print a
--               confident zero -- "0 exist" is a much worse lie than saying nothing.
--     Price   = 7-day MEDIAN of what players ACTUALLY PAID at the stalls. nil until
--               MinSamples counterparty pairs have traded. Not an official value.
--     Samples = pairs behind Price. Always present (may be 0) so the UI can say
--               "3 of 5 sales needed" honestly instead of inventing a number.
--   meta = { WindowDays, MinSamples } -- so the client's copy cannot drift from
--          PriceIndex's real tuning.
--
--   A nil map means THROTTLED, not "no data". The client must not cache that.
--
-- Standalone Script on purpose: both modules it reads are self-starting, so this
-- needs no ordering against Main's Init sequence and stays out of the wiring list.
-- Every call here is non-yielding, so the invoke returns within the frame.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local MintRegistry   = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.MintRegistry)
local PriceIndex     = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PriceIndex)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local Mutations      = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local getItemStats = remotes:WaitForChild("GetItemStats")

local MAX_ITEMS  = 40    -- one Index page asks for at most 2 classes per row
local BUCKET_MAX = 6     -- burst: opening the panel then paging a few times fast
local REFILL     = 1.5   -- tokens regained per second

-- Only names that really exist may be asked about. Without this, a spammed request
-- could mint registry cache keys (and the DataStore reads behind them) for
-- arbitrary strings.
local rarityOf = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do rarityOf[e.Name] = e.Rarity end
local validMutation = {}
for _, m in ipairs(Mutations.List) do validMutation[m.Name] = true end

local META = { WindowDays = PriceIndex.WindowDays, MinSamples = PriceIndex.MinSamples }

local tokens, lastSeen = {}, {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	tokens[player.UserId] = nil
	lastSeen[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local function takeToken(player)
	local id = player.UserId
	local now = os.clock()
	local have = math.min(BUCKET_MAX, (tokens[id] or BUCKET_MAX) + (now - (lastSeen[id] or now)) * REFILL)
	lastSeen[id] = now
	if have < 1 then
		tokens[id] = have
		return false
	end
	tokens[id] = have - 1
	return true
end

getItemStats.OnServerInvoke = function(player, requests)
	if typeof(requests) ~= "table" then return nil, META end
	if not takeToken(player) then return nil, META end

	local out, seen, count = {}, {}, 0
	for _, req in ipairs(requests) do
		if count >= MAX_ITEMS then break end
		if typeof(req) == "table" then
			local name = req.Name
			local mutation = req.Mutation
			if type(mutation) ~= "string" or mutation == "" then mutation = nil end
			local rarity = (type(name) == "string") and rarityOf[name] or nil

			if rarity and (mutation == nil or validMutation[mutation]) then
				local key = name .. "|" .. (mutation or "")
				if not seen[key] then
					seen[key] = true
					count += 1

					local entry = {}
					-- IsTracked is the single source of truth for "worth a serial";
					-- asking Get() for an untracked class would create a cache key
					-- (and a DataStore read) for a Common nobody will ever quote.
					local tracked = MintRegistry.IsTracked(rarity, mutation)
					entry.Tracked = tracked
					if tracked then
						local okMint, minted, exists = pcall(MintRegistry.Get, name, mutation)
						if okMint and type(minted) == "number" then
							entry.Minted = minted
							entry.Exists = exists
						end
					end

					-- Price is kept for EVERY class, tracked or not: a Common with a
					-- real sale history still has a real price.
					local okPrice, median, samples = pcall(PriceIndex.Get, name, mutation)
					entry.Samples = (okPrice and type(samples) == "number") and samples or 0
					if okPrice and type(median) == "number" then entry.Price = median end

					out[key] = entry
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return out, META
end

-- Sold-out truth for the Index cap badges. Server-side because LimitedStock
-- is; the schedule half of supply status is computed client-side
-- (SupplySchedule is shared and clock-pure). Cheap: 12 table reads, no
-- DataStore touch -- LimitedStock's own 60s refresher keeps the counts warm.
local supplyRemote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
supplyRemote.Name = "GetSupplySnapshot"
supplyRemote.Parent = remotes
supplyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function()
	local out = {}
	for name, cap in pairs(LimitedStock.MAX) do
		local remaining = LimitedStock.Remaining(name)
		out[name] = { cap = cap, minted = remaining and (cap - remaining) or nil }
	end
	return out
end
