===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/BoothHandler.lua =====
-- BoothHandler (Trading Center section)
-- Market stands, Pet Simulator style: claim a stand, put brainrots up for
-- sale at a price you choose, and other players walk up and buy them.
-- EVERY rule is enforced here on the server. The client UI can only ask.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local BrainrotMover = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.BrainrotMover)
-- no require cycle: InventoryHandler only requires PlayerDataManager/BrainrotSpawner
local InventoryHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.InventoryHandler)
local PriceIndex = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PriceIndex)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local MAX_LISTINGS = 3 -- one per display pedestal on the stand
local MAX_PRICE = 1000000000

local booths = {} -- [index] = { index, model, ownerUserId, listings = { {Id, Name, Price} } }
local nextListingId = 1

local BoothHandler = {}

local function formatMoney(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n >= 1000000000 then
		return string.format("%.2fB", n / 1000000000)
	elseif n >= 1000000 then
		return string.format("%.2fM", n / 1000000)
	elseif n >= 1000 then
		return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1000)
	end
	return tostring(n)
end

local function toast(player, message)
	remotes.BoothState:FireClient(player, { Phase = "Toast", Message = message })
end

local function setSign(booth, text)
	local sign = booth.model:FindFirstChild("SignBoard")
	if not sign then return end
	for _, gui in ipairs(sign:GetChildren()) do
		if gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			local label = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
			if label then label.Text = text end
		end
	end
end

-- open=true means the owner asked to open the window (via the stand prompt);
-- otherwise this is a background refresh that must NOT force the window open on
-- their screen while they are off playing elsewhere.
local function pushManageState(booth, open)
	local owner = booth.ownerUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(booth.ownerUserId)
	if not owner then return end
	remotes.BoothState:FireClient(owner, {
		Phase = "Manage",
		Open = open == true,
		BoothIndex = booth.index,
		Listings = booth.listings,
		MaxListings = MAX_LISTINGS,
	})
end

-- Listings are name-based, so show buyers the exact copy the sale will hand
-- over: BrainrotMover.Take picks the least-Mutations.Mult match, so resolve
-- the same way (READ-ONLY) and put its mutation + serial on the tag, e.g.
-- "Golden Tim Cheese #12". The 3s prune tick re-resolves, so the tag tracks
-- the owner's inventory between buyers.
local function resolveListingLabel(ownerData, name)
	local best, bestMult
	if ownerData then
		for _, entry in ipairs(ownerData.Brainrots) do
			if entry.Name == name then
				local mult = Mutations.Mult(entry.Mutation)
				if not bestMult or mult < bestMult then
					best, bestMult = entry, mult
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local text = name
	if best then
		if best.Mutation then text = best.Mutation .. " " .. text end
		if best.Serial then text = text .. " #" .. tostring(best.Serial) end
	end
	return text
end

-- Rebuild the glowing display items + price tags + buy prompts on the counter.
local function refreshDisplays(booth)
	for _, child in ipairs(booth.model:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == "ListingDisplay" then child:Destroy() end
	end
	local owner = booth.ownerUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(booth.ownerUserId)
	local ownerData = owner and PlayerDataManager.Get(owner)
	booth.displayedLabels = {}
	for slot, listing in ipairs(booth.listings) do
		local anchor = booth.model:FindFirstChild("Display" .. slot)
		if anchor then
			local info = BrainrotMover.InfoByName[listing.Name]
			local tier = info and BrainrotMover.TierByName[info.Rarity]
			local displayName = resolveListingLabel(ownerData, listing.Name)
			booth.displayedLabels[slot] = displayName

			local cube = Instance.new("Part")
			cube.Name = "ListingDisplay"
			cube.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 1.8, 1.8)
			cube.Anchored = true
			cube.CanCollide = false
			cube.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			cube.Color = tier and tier.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			cube.CFrame = anchor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.7, 0)
			cube.Parent = booth.model

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 40)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0)
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Parent = cube

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Text = displayName .. "\n$" .. formatMoney(listing.Price)
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			label.TextScaled = true
			label.Parent = billboard

			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.Name = "BuyPrompt"
			prompt.ActionText = "Buy for $" .. formatMoney(listing.Price)
			prompt.ObjectText = displayName
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
			prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
			prompt:SetAttribute("BoothIndex", booth.index)
			prompt:SetAttribute("ListingId", listing.Id)
			prompt:SetAttribute("ItemName", listing.Name)
			prompt:SetAttribute("Price", listing.Price)
			prompt:SetAttribute("SellerName", owner and owner.DisplayName or "?")
			prompt.Parent = cube
			-- NOTE: the server never connects BuyPrompt.Triggered. The client
			-- shows a confirm popup, then fires the BoothBuy remote, and THAT
			-- is validated below.
		end
	end
end

local function releaseBooth(booth)
	booth.ownerUserId = nil
	booth.listings = {}
	refreshDisplays(booth)
	setSign(booth, "AVAILABLE STAND")
	local prompt = booth.model.Counter:FindFirstChild("StandPrompt")
	if prompt then prompt.ActionText = "Claim Stand" end
end

local function boothOwnedBy(player)
	for _, booth in ipairs(booths) do
		if booth.ownerUserId == player.UserId then return booth end
	end
	return nil
end

local function countListed(booth, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, listing in ipairs(booth.listings) do
		if listing.Name == name then n += 1 end
	end
	return n
end

local BUY_RADIUS = 26 -- studs; the buyer must actually be standing at the stand

local function characterNearBooth(player, booth)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return false end
	local counter = booth.model:FindFirstChild("Counter")
	local origin = counter and counter.Position or booth.model:GetPivot().Position
	return (hrp.Position - origin).Magnitude <= BUY_RADIUS
end

-- The sale has already committed in memory; it must eventually land on disk
-- for BOTH sides or one side dupes and the other loses. Save() retries 3x
-- internally - if it still failed, keep retrying in the background. NEVER
-- roll back the in-memory state: the other half may already be saved.
local function retrySave(player, tag)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(30)
			if player.Parent == nil then return end -- left; the PlayerRemoving save path owns it now
			local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
			if not data or data.__noSave then return end
			if PlayerDataManager.Save(player) then
				warn(("[BoothAudit] %s: retry save SUCCEEDED for user %d"):format(tag, player.UserId))
				return
			end
			warn(("[BoothAudit] %s: retry save still failing for user %d"):format(tag, player.UserId))
		end
	end)
end

local function onStandPrompt(booth, player)
	if booth.ownerUserId == nil then
		if boothOwnedBy(player) then
			toast(player, "You already have a stand. Unclaim it first.")
			return
		end
		booth.ownerUserId = player.UserId
		setSign(booth, string.upper(player.DisplayName) .. "'S STAND")
		local prompt = booth.model.Counter:FindFirstChild("StandPrompt")
		if prompt then prompt.ActionText = "Manage Stand" end
		pushManageState(booth, true)
	elseif booth.ownerUserId == player.UserId then
		pushManageState(booth, true)
	else
		local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(booth.ownerUserId)
		toast(player, "This stand belongs to " .. (owner and owner.DisplayName or "someone else") .. ". Hold E on a display item to buy it.")
	end
end

function BoothHandler.Init()
	local tradingCenter = Workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld"):WaitForChild("TradingCenter")
	local boothsFolder = tradingCenter:WaitForChild("Booths")
	for _, model in ipairs(boothsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		local idx = model:GetAttribute("BoothIndex")
		if idx then
			local booth = { index = idx, model = model, ownerUserId = nil, listings = {} }
			booths[idx] = booth
			local prompt = model:WaitForChild("Counter"):WaitForChild("StandPrompt")
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				onStandPrompt(booth, player)
			end)
		end
	end

	remotes.BoothList.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, payload)
		if typeof(payload) ~= "table" or typeof(payload.Action) ~= "string" then return end
		local booth = boothOwnedBy(player)
		if not booth then return end
		local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
		if not data then return end

		if payload.Action == "Add" then
			-- __noSave = this profile's DataStore read failed; anything it "sells"
			-- comes back on its next login, duping the item. Don't let it list.
			if data.__noSave then
				toast(player, "Your profile did not load - rejoin before listing items.")
				return
			end
			local name = payload.Name
			if typeof(name) ~= "string" or not BrainrotMover.InfoByName[name] then return end
			if #booth.listings >= MAX_LISTINGS then
				toast(player, "Your stand is full (" .. MAX_LISTINGS .. " items max).")
				return
			end
			local price = tonumber(payload.Price)
			if not price or price ~= price then return end -- reject non-numbers and NaN
			price = math.floor(price)
			if price < 1 or price > MAX_PRICE then
				toast(player, "Price must be between $1 and $" .. formatMoney(MAX_PRICE) .. ".")
				return
			end
			-- can't list more copies than you actually own
			if countListed(booth, name) + 1 > BrainrotMover.CountOwned(data, name) then
				toast(player, "You don't own enough " .. name .. " to list another.")
				return
			end
			table.insert(booth.listings, { Id = nextListingId, Name = name, Price = price })
			nextListingId += 1
			refreshDisplays(booth)
			pushManageState(booth)

		elseif payload.Action == "Remove" then
			for i, listing in ipairs(booth.listings) do
				if listing.Id == payload.Id then
					table.remove(booth.listings, i)
					break
				end
			end
			refreshDisplays(booth)
			pushManageState(booth)

		elseif payload.Action == "Unclaim" then
			releaseBooth(booth)
			toast(player, "Stand unclaimed.")
		end
	end)

	remotes.BoothBuy.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(buyer, boothIndex, listingId)
		if typeof(boothIndex) ~= "number" or typeof(listingId) ~= "number" then return end
		local booth = booths[boothIndex]
		if not booth or not booth.ownerUserId then return end

		local listingPos, listing
		for i, l in ipairs(booth.listings) do
			if l.Id == listingId then
				listingPos, listing = i, l
				break
			end
		end
		if not listing then
			toast(buyer, "That item was just sold or removed.")
			return
		end

		local seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(booth.ownerUserId)
		if not seller then
			releaseBooth(booth)
			return
		end
		if buyer == seller then
			toast(buyer, "You can't buy from your own stand.")
			return
		end
		if not characterNearBooth(buyer, booth) then
			toast(buyer, "Walk up to the stand to buy this.")
			return
		end

		local buyerData = PlayerDataManager.Get(buyer)
		local sellerData = PlayerDataManager.Get(seller)
		if not buyerData or not sellerData then return end

		-- __noSave = that profile's DataStore read failed, so this sale can never
		-- persist: the item or the cash would dupe or evaporate on rejoin.
		if buyerData.__noSave then
			toast(buyer, "Your profile did not load - rejoin before buying.")
			return
		end
		if sellerData.__noSave then
			toast(buyer, "The seller's profile did not load - this stand can't sell right now.")
			return
		end

		if buyerData.Cash < listing.Price then
			toast(buyer, "Not enough cash \u{2014} that costs $" .. formatMoney(listing.Price) .. ".")
			return
		end
		if BrainrotMover.CountOwned(sellerData, listing.Name) < 1 then
			-- seller no longer owns it (sold or traded it away) -> stale listing
			table.remove(booth.listings, listingPos)
			refreshDisplays(booth)
			pushManageState(booth)
			toast(buyer, "That brainrot is no longer available.")
			return
		end
		-- UNIQUE cap, checked BEFORE the Take below. Refusing inside BrainrotMover.Give
		-- would delete the item mid-transfer, because Take has already pulled it off the
		-- seller by then. Bailing here costs the buyer nothing.
		if not BrainrotMover.WithinUniqueCap(listing.Name,
			BrainrotMover.CountOwned(buyerData, listing.Name), 0, 1) then
			toast(buyer, "You can only have one " .. listing.Name .. ".")
			return
		end

		-- Do the sale. No yields between the checks above and the swap below,
		-- so two buyers can never both pass validation for the same listing.
		-- carry the taken RECORD across so a mutated brainrot stays mutated
		local record = BrainrotMover.Take(seller, sellerData, listing.Name)
		if not record then
			toast(buyer, "That brainrot is no longer available.")
			return
		end
		BrainrotMover.Give(buyer, buyerData, record)
		-- the moved entry may back a Tool in the seller's Backpack (and the buyer
		-- needs a new one) - rebuild both so no Tool points at a moved brainrot
		InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(buyer)
		InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(seller)
		buyerData.Cash -= listing.Price   -- spending: deliberately not through GrantCash
		PlayerDataManager.GrantCash(sellerData, listing.Price)
		table.remove(booth.listings, listingPos)

		-- The swap has settled, so this is a real price: someone chose to pay it
		-- and someone chose to accept it. Feeding it to the index is what lets the
		-- game publish its own honest values instead of players having to trust an
		-- off-platform list. Use the RECORD's name and mutation rather than the
		-- listing's -- a Golden copy is its own market and must not be priced as a
		-- plain one. RecordSale only touches memory and never yields, so it cannot
		-- open a gap in the no-yield window guarded above.
		PriceIndex.RecordSale(record.Name, record.Mutation, listing.Price, buyer.UserId, seller.UserId)

		refreshDisplays(booth)
		pushManageState(booth)
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(buyer)
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(seller)
		-- Save() returning false after the sale committed = one side of it is
		-- only real in memory. Log a durable audit line with everything needed
		-- to hand-restore it, then keep retrying. Never roll back in-memory state.
		local savedBuyer = PlayerDataManager.Save(buyer)
		local savedSeller = PlayerDataManager.Save(seller)
		if not (savedBuyer and savedSeller) then
			warn(("[BoothAudit] SAVE FAILED after sale | buyer=%d seller=%d | item=%s mutation=%s serial=%s | price=$%d | savedBuyer=%s savedSeller=%s"):format(
				buyer.UserId, seller.UserId, record.Name, tostring(record.Mutation), tostring(record.Serial),
				listing.Price, tostring(savedBuyer), tostring(savedSeller)))
			if not savedBuyer then retrySave(buyer, "booth buy " .. record.Name) end
			if not savedSeller then retrySave(seller, "booth sale " .. record.Name) end
		end

		toast(buyer, "\u{2705} Bought " .. listing.Name .. " for $" .. formatMoney(listing.Price) .. "!")
		toast(seller, "\u{1F4B0} " .. buyer.DisplayName .. " bought your " .. listing.Name .. " for $" .. formatMoney(listing.Price) .. "!")
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local booth = boothOwnedBy(player)
		if booth then
			releaseBooth(booth)
		end
	end)

	-- Periodically prune listings whose brainrot the seller no longer owns
	-- (sold at the sell stall, or traded away), so stands don't keep
	-- advertising phantom items until a buyer walks up and fails.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(3)
			for _, booth in ipairs(booths) do
				if booth.ownerUserId then
					local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(booth.ownerUserId)
					local data = owner and PlayerDataManager.Get(owner)
					if data then
						local counts = {}
						local kept = {}
						local changed = false
						for _, listing in ipairs(booth.listings) do
							counts[listing.Name] = (counts[listing.Name] or 0) + 1
							if BrainrotMover.CountOwned(data, listing.Name) >= counts[listing.Name] then
								table.insert(kept, listing)
							else
								changed = true
							end
						end
						if changed then
							booth.listings = kept
							refreshDisplays(booth)
							pushManageState(booth)
						else
							-- the tag shows the exact copy a sale would pick (mutation +
							-- serial), which can go stale WITHOUT the listing set changing
							-- (owner fused / traded / caught copies). Re-resolve here and
							-- rebuild only when a tag actually differs, so an active
							-- BuyPrompt isn't destroyed mid-hold for nothing.
							for slot, listing in ipairs(booth.listings) do
								local want = resolveListingLabel(data, listing.Name)
								if not booth.displayedLabels or booth.displayedLabels[slot] ~= want then
									refreshDisplays(booth)
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	print("BoothHandler online")
end

return BoothHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/BoundsGuard.lua =====
-- BoundsGuard: last-resort containment, enforced server-side.
--
-- Workspace.GameWorld.ValleyBarrier is the actual fence and it holds at every speed a
-- player can really reach: WalkSpeed is 21, and it was measured blocked at 200 and 400
-- studs/s in all eight directions including every corner. What collision CANNOT stop is a
-- client that sets its own velocity directly -- around 2000 studs/s is 2000/60 = 33 studs
-- of travel per physics frame, and no wall thickness beats an arbitrarily large number
-- (the 40-stud walls were punched through at the south-west corner in testing). So the
-- wall cannot be the only line of defence. This runs on the server, where an exploiting
-- client gets no vote, and simply puts anyone who ends up outside the world back at spawn.
--
-- Deliberately GENEROUS. Wrongly teleporting a legitimate player mid-game is far worse
-- than letting an exploiter stand fifty studs past the wall for half a second, so the
-- regions sit ~30 studs OUTSIDE the barrier rather than hugging it, and it takes two
-- consecutive failed checks to act.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local M = {}

-- THE PLAYABLE WORLD IS TWO SEPARATE PLACES. The trading island is 8000 studs away at
-- Y ~2010 and players legitimately teleport there (TeleportService.TRADE_POS is
-- 8000, 2006, 7905). If you ever edit this table, keep BOTH regions -- dropping the
-- island would rubber-band every trading player straight back to the valley the moment
-- they arrived, which would look like the trade portal being broken.
--
-- Measured extents these are derived from:
--   ValleyBarrier  X -295..300   Y  -80..400   Z -430..1030
--   TradingWorld   X 7336..8749  Y 1973..2047  Z 7411..8686
local REGIONS = {
	{ Name = "Valley",  Min = Vector3.new(-325, -140, -460),  Max = Vector3.new(330, 460, 1060) },
	{ Name = "Trading", Min = Vector3.new(7300, 1930, 7375),  Max = Vector3.new(8790, 2110, 8725) },
}

local INTERVAL = 0.25   -- how often each player is checked
-- How far a rig must travel between checks to count as MOVING while it has no live
-- Humanoid. Above ragdoll settle (<0.5 studs) and below walking (WalkSpeed 21 covers
-- 5.25 studs per 0.25s interval), so a corpse lying still is never punished and a
-- client-driven rig always is.
local MOVE_EPS = 2.0
local STRIKES  = 2      -- consecutive out-of-bounds checks before acting (~0.5s of grace)
local WARN_GAP = 10     -- seconds between warns per player, so a stuck exploiter can't spam output

-- Fallback only. The real return point is the SpawnLocation, read live below, because
-- hardcoding it here would silently drift the day someone moves the spawn.
local FALLBACK_RETURN = Vector3.new(24, 6, -16)   -- TeleportService's HUB_POS

local strikes, lastWarn, lastPos = {}, {}, {}
M.Returns = 0   -- count of corrections made this server's lifetime, for a quick sanity read

local function returnPoint()
	local sl = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation")
	if sl then return sl.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
	return FALLBACK_RETURN
end

local function regionOf(p)
	for _, r in ipairs(REGIONS) do
		if p.X >= r.Min.X and p.X <= r.Max.X
			and p.Y >= r.Min.Y and p.Y <= r.Max.Y
			and p.Z >= r.Min.Z and p.Z <= r.Max.Z then
			return r
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Exposed so a test can ask the question without waiting on the loop.
function M.IsInBounds(pos)
	return regionOf(pos) ~= nil
end

function M.RegionName(pos)
	local r = regionOf(pos)
	return r and r.Name or nil
end

local function sendBack(player, pos)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(returnPoint()))
	-- Zero the velocity. Someone who tunnelled out is still travelling at whatever speed
	-- got them through, and without this they punch straight back out on the next frame --
	-- the teleport would just add a stutter to their escape instead of stopping it.
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	M.Returns += 1
	local now = os.clock()
	if not lastWarn[player] or now - lastWarn[player] > WARN_GAP then
		lastWarn[player] = now
		warn(string.format("[BoundsGuard] returned %s from out of bounds at %.0f, %.0f, %.0f",
			player.Name, pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z))
	end
end

function M.Init()
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		strikes[player] = nil
		lastWarn[player] = nil
		lastPos[player] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(INTERVAL)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local char = player.Character
				local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not hrp then
					-- No root part at all: still streaming in, or the character is gone.
					-- There is no position to judge, so no verdict -- but strikes are
					-- DELIBERATELY left alone rather than cleared. Clearing here was half
					-- the fail-open: a client that can delete its Humanoid can also drop
					-- its rig for one frame to wipe the counter.
					lastPos[player] = nil
				else
					-- FindFirstChildOfClass, not FindFirstChild("Humanoid"): a RENAMED
					-- Humanoid is still found by class, so renaming was never an escape.
					-- Destroying or reparenting it is, and so is pinning Health at 0
					-- while the rig keeps being driven.
					local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local alive = hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
					local pos = hrp.Position
					local prev = lastPos[player]
					local moving = prev ~= nil and (pos - prev).Magnitude > MOVE_EPS
					lastPos[player] = pos

					local out = regionOf(pos) == nil
					-- A rig with no live Humanoid that is STILL MOVING is not a corpse --
					-- nothing legitimate drives it -- so it is judged exactly like being
					-- out of bounds. A corpse holding still is left alone (it is about to
					-- respawn anyway), but its strikes are PRESERVED, never cleared.
					if not alive and moving then
						out = true
					end

					if out then
						strikes[player] = (strikes[player] or 0) + 1
						if strikes[player] >= STRIKES then
							strikes[player] = nil
							sendBack(player, pos)
						end
					elseif alive then
						strikes[player] = nil
					end
					-- dead-and-still: falls through with strikes intact
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	print(string.format("BoundsGuard online (%d regions, %.2fs interval)", #REGIONS, INTERVAL))
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/BrainrotMover.lua =====
-- BrainrotMover (Trading Center section)
-- Shared helpers for moving brainrots between players' inventories and
-- keeping the plot pad visuals in sync. Used by TradeHandler and BoothHandler.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local BrainrotSpawner = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.BrainrotSpawner)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local RarityConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RarityConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)

local BrainrotMover = {}

BrainrotMover.InfoByName = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	BrainrotMover.InfoByName[entry.Name] = entry
end
BrainrotMover.TierByName = {}
for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
	BrainrotMover.TierByName[tier.Name] = tier
end

-- Is this name flagged one-per-player in BrainrotConfig?
function BrainrotMover.IsUnique(name)
	local info = BrainrotMover.InfoByName[name]
	return (info and info.Unique) == true
end

-- Cap test for Unique items, netting a transfer in both directions so a straight
-- one-for-one swap of the same unique item still succeeds (you end on 1, not 2).
--   have     = how many the RECEIVER holds right now
--   outgoing = how many the receiver is simultaneously giving away
--   incoming = how many are arriving
-- Always true for non-unique names, so callers can apply it unconditionally.
function BrainrotMover.WithinUniqueCap(name, have, outgoing, incoming)
	if not BrainrotMover.IsUnique(name) then return true end
	return ((have or 0) - (outgoing or 0) + (incoming or 0)) <= 1
end

function BrainrotMover.CountOwned(data, name)
	local n = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if entry.Name == name then n += 1 end
	end
	return n
end

-- Both camps: the same brainrot is rendered on each of the player's plots, so removing
-- it from one and not the other leaves a ghost standing on the world they are not in.
function BrainrotMover.RemovePadVisual(player, padIndex)
	if not padIndex then return end
	for _, plot in ipairs(PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(player)) do
		local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
		if pads then
			for _, child in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
				if child:GetAttribute("PadIndex") == padIndex then
					child:Destroy()
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- NOTE: SpawnOnPlot was deleted. It was a SECOND, divergent spawn path that did not
-- set the Uid attribute or a StorePrompt, so anything received by trade/booth could
-- never be stored, sold or re-traded. Everything now routes through BrainrotSpawner.

-- Removes ONE brainrot with this name from the giver (data + plot visual) and
-- RETURNS THE RECORD that was removed, so the caller can hand the SAME item over.
--
-- Offers are name-based, so a name can match several copies with different
-- mutations. We deliberately take the LEAST valuable match: offering a plain
-- "Broccolo Torpedo" must never consume your Rainbow one off its pad.
function BrainrotMover.Take(giver, giverData, name)
	local bestIndex, bestMult
	for i, entry in ipairs(giverData.Brainrots) do
		if entry.Name == name then
			local mult = Mutations.Mult(entry.Mutation)
			if not bestMult or mult < bestMult then
				bestIndex, bestMult = i, mult
			end
		end
	end
	if not bestIndex then return nil end

	local entry = giverData.Brainrots[bestIndex]
	local record = { Name = entry.Name, Mutation = entry.Mutation, Serial = entry.Serial, MintedAt = entry.MintedAt }
	PlayerDataManager.DrainPending(giver, entry, giverData)
	BrainrotMover.RemovePadVisual(giver, entry.PadIndex)
	table.remove(giverData.Brainrots, bestIndex)
	return record
end

-- Gives ONE brainrot to the receiver (data + plot visual if a pad is free).
-- Pass the RECORD returned by Take so the mutation travels with the item; a bare
-- name string is still accepted for any legacy caller.
--
-- DELIBERATELY DOES NOT ENFORCE THE UNIQUE CAP. Take() has already mutated the giver
-- by the time Give runs, so refusing here would delete the item mid-transfer -- the
-- giver loses it and the receiver never gets it. The cap is therefore checked
-- PRE-FLIGHT by every caller, where a rejection can still fail safely:
--   TradeHandler.executeTrade  -- in the existing validation block, before any Take
--   BoothHandler  BoothBuy     -- alongside the cash/ownership checks, before the Take
--   GianlucaQuest.grantChim    -- before inserting the quest reward
-- Add a new transfer path and you must add the check there too; Give stays total.
function BrainrotMover.Give(receiver, receiverData, record)
	if type(record) == "string" then record = { Name = record } end
	if not record or not record.Name then return end

	local padIndex = PlayerDataManager.FindFreePad(receiverData)
	local uid = PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(receiverData)
	table.insert(receiverData.Brainrots, {
		Name = record.Name,
		Mutation = record.Mutation,   -- <- was silently dropped before; the whole bug
		Serial = record.Serial,       -- mint identity travels with the item...
		MintedAt = record.MintedAt,   -- ...or the serial dies on every trade
		PadIndex = padIndex,
		Pending = 0,
		Uid = uid,
	})
	if padIndex then
		for _, plot in ipairs(PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(receiver)) do
			BrainrotSpawner.Spawn(plot, record.Name, padIndex, record.Mutation, uid)
		end
	end
end

return BrainrotMover


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/BrainrotSpawner.lua =====
-- Single source of truth for putting a brainrot on a plot pad.
--
-- Two visuals, one code path: if ServerStorage.BrainrotModels holds a model whose
-- name matches the config entry, it is cloned; otherwise the entry falls back to the
-- tier-coloured neon cube every brainrot used before real models existed. Adding a
-- model is therefore a content drop, not a code change.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local RarityConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RarityConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)
local MutationFX = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationFX)

local M = {}

local entryByName, tierByName = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do entryByName[e.Name] = e end
for _, t in ipairs(RarityConfig) do tierByName[t.Name] = t end

-- ===== idle motion policy =====
-- BrainrotIdleClient animates any Model tagged "BrainrotBody" by its Motion
-- attribute (bob/sway/hover/spin/shiver -- the presets live in that script).
-- The ladder makes motion itself a rarity read: grounded tiers rock or bob in
-- place, Epic/Legendary lift off and slowly turn, the top tiers do a lazy
-- showcase spin, and Secrets shiver. A BrainrotConfig entry can override any
-- of it with Motion = "spin" etc.; unknown values cost nothing client-side
-- (adopt() ignores what it does not recognise).
local MOTION_BY_RARITY = {
	Common = "ground", Uncommon = "ground", Rare = "ground",
	Epic = "hover", Legendary = "hover",
	Mythic = "spin", God = "spin",
	Secret = "shiver",
}
local function motionFor(entry)
	if entry.Motion then return entry.Motion end
	local m = MOTION_BY_RARITY[entry.Rarity] or "ground"
	if m == "ground" then
		-- deterministic bob/sway split so a row of Commons does not move in
		-- unison; same hash shape BrainrotIdleClient uses for phase stagger
		local h = 0
		for i = 1, #entry.Name do
			h = (h * 33 + string.byte(entry.Name, i)) % 8192
		end
		return (h % 2 == 0) and "bob" or "sway"
	end
	return m
end

-- Authored models are normalised to one height instead of being trusted at their
-- authored scale: Secret Pete is 9.71 studs tall, which on a 5x5 pad would dwarf the
-- plot, overlap its neighbours and push the billboard out of view.
-- Pads are 5x5 with 6.51 studs between centres, so WIDTH is the real constraint,
-- not height -- nothing is above a brainrot to collide with. Normalising by height
-- alone was the bug: the roster's width:height ratio runs from 0.37 to 4.06, so the
-- widest models sprawled across their neighbours while the tall thin ones looked
-- tiny. Fit each model to a BOX instead and the whole roster can grow.
local MODEL_HEIGHT = 6.0        -- target height (was 3.6)
-- Pad centres are 6.51 apart, so this is pushed as close to that as it can go
-- without neighbours touching. It is the binding limit for roughly half the
-- roster (median width:height is 0.94) -- going bigger than this needs either
-- accepted overlap or wider pad spacing on the plot itself.
local MODEL_MAX_WIDTH = 6.3

local function templateFor(name)
	-- moved to ReplicatedStorage so IndexClient can render real silhouettes from these
	-- same models; the server reads them from there instead of ServerStorage now
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainrotModels")
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name) or nil
end

local function buildModelVisual(template, pad)
	local model = template:Clone()
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		model.PrimaryPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	local _, extents = model:GetBoundingBox()
	if extents.Y > 0 then
		-- HeightScale lets the authored size ladder read on the plot (a Secret
		-- should tower over a Common) while the clamp stops any one model running away.
		local heightScale = math.clamp(template:GetAttribute("HeightScale") or 1, 0.7, 1.5)
		local width = math.max(extents.X, extents.Z)
		-- whichever limit bites first: tall-thin models go to full height, wide ones
		-- are held back by their footprint so they never cross onto a neighbour's pad
		local factor = math.min(
			(MODEL_HEIGHT * heightScale) / extents.Y,
			MODEL_MAX_WIDTH / math.max(width, 0.01)
		)
		-- ScaleTo is ABSOLUTE, so go through the current scale rather than assuming 1
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * factor)
	end

	-- Sit the model's BASE on the pad. PivotTo moves the PIVOT, which on a hand-built
	-- model is wherever the author left it and not the bounding-box centre -- so measure
	-- the box after scaling and translate by the delta rather than assuming they agree.
	local boxCF, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local target = pad.Position + Vector3.new(0, pad.Size.Y * 0.5 + boxSize.Y * 0.5 + 0.05, 0)
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + (target - boxCF.Position))

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
		end
	end

	-- Centre the model's pivot on its bounding box, upright. The pack models'
	-- authored PrimaryPart is an arbitrary limb -- often carrying its own
	-- authored PivotOffset -- so GetPivot lands studs off the visual body
	-- (CatchReveal measured 3.75 on a real one; Carloo is 1.42). Everything
	-- that rotates or measures a placed body (BrainrotIdleClient's idle yaw,
	-- the store prompt, walk-up feel) wants the visual centre, and a centred
	-- pivot makes the idle client's rel-capture immune to replication-order
	-- races. NOTE: Model.WorldPivot writes are a silent no-op on these models
	-- (probed live); write the PrimaryPart's PivotOffset directly.
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		local cf = model:GetBoundingBox()
		model.PrimaryPart.PivotOffset = model.PrimaryPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(cf.Position))
	end
	return model
end

-- entryOrName: a BrainrotConfig entry, or its Name
function M.Spawn(plot, entryOrName, padIndex, mutation, uid)
	if not plot or not padIndex then return nil end
	local entry = type(entryOrName) == "table" and entryOrName or entryByName[entryOrName]
	if not entry then return nil end
	local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if not pads then return nil end
	local pad = pads:FindFirstChild("Pad" .. padIndex)
	if not pad then return nil end

	local tier = tierByName[entry.Rarity]

	local template = templateFor(entry.Name)
	local model
	if template then
		model = buildModelVisual(template, pad)
	else
		model = Instance.new("Part")
		model.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5)
		model.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		model.Color = tier and tier.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		model.Anchored = true
		model.CanCollide = false
		model.CFrame = pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.8, 0)
	end
	model.Name = entry.Name
	model.Parent = pads
	model:SetAttribute("PadIndex", padIndex)
	if uid then model:SetAttribute("Uid", uid) end

	-- idle motion: only authored Models breathe -- the fallback cube is a
	-- marker, not a creature (and BrainrotIdleClient ignores non-Models
	-- anyway). Tag + attribute replicate, so the client needs no new wiring;
	-- this line is what turns the whole dormant idle system on.
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		model:SetAttribute("Motion", motionFor(entry))
		CollectionService:AddTag(model, "BrainrotBody")
	end

	-- walk up to a placed brainrot to put it back in your backpack
	local storePrompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	storePrompt.Name = "StorePrompt"
	storePrompt.ActionText = "Store"
	storePrompt.ObjectText = entry.Name
	storePrompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	storePrompt.HoldDuration = 0.35
	-- REACH SCALES WITH THE BODY. The prompt anchors at the model's CENTRE
	-- (buildModelVisual re-pivots there on purpose, just above), so a fixed reach is
	-- really "distance from the middle of the creature". That is fine on a 6-stud
	-- body, but a Massive is ~28 studs tall and ~25 wide: its centre sits 14 studs
	-- up and its flank is 12 studs out, so standing as close as a player physically
	-- can measured 18.3 studs to the anchor. Against a flat 9 the prompt could never
	-- appear from ANY position you could stand in -- a placed Massive was impossible
	-- to store. Measure out to the body's own surface instead and add the walk-up
	-- margin, so "walk up to it and press E" means the same thing at every size.
	-- Normal bodies come out under 9 and keep the original reach exactly.
	local reach = 9
	do
		local bx = model:IsA("Model") and select(2, model:GetBoundingBox()) or model.Size
		local halfW = math.max(bx.X, bx.Z) * 0.5
		local halfH = math.max(bx.Y * 0.5 - 3, 0)   -- 3 studs ≈ where the player's root rides
		-- Standoff GROWS with the body. You stop further from a 47-stud Kraken than from
		-- a 5-stud popsicle -- its edge is nowhere near where your eye says it is -- so a
		-- flat margin left the biggest models with barely any. Proportional keeps small
		-- bodies at exactly 9 while the extremes get real room.
		local standoff = 3 + halfW * 0.25
		reach = math.max(reach, math.sqrt((halfW + standoff) ^ 2 + halfH ^ 2) + 2)
	end
	storePrompt.MaxActivationDistance = reach
	storePrompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	-- MUST stay parented to the top-level instance: InventoryClient reads the Uid off
	-- prompt.Parent, so hanging this on a child part would silently break Store.
	storePrompt.Parent = model

	-- No collect prompt here on purpose: takings are picked up by WALKING OVER the
	-- brainrot (IncomeLoop.WALKUP_COLLECT), so there is nothing to press.

	if mutation then
		model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation)
		local isPart = model:IsA("BasePart")
		local mColor = Mutations.Color(mutation) or (isPart and model.Color) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		-- Recolour the placeholder cube, but never an authored model: flattening all 47
		-- of Pete's parts to one colour would erase the thing that makes him readable.
		if isPart then model.Color = mColor end
		-- All twelve mutations used to render identically here (one light, one
		-- emitter, tinted). MutationFX scales the presentation up the 12-rung
		-- rarity ladder instead, so a Glitched no longer looks like a Golden.
		MutationFX.apply(model, mutation)
	end

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 36)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	-- Set HERE, not on an instance in Studio: this billboard is rebuilt every time a
	-- brainrot is spawned or a plot is restored, so an authored value would be discarded.
	-- 150 matches the campfire BankGui on the same plot, so everything plot-side fades
	-- together rather than a name tag hanging in the air after its plot has gone.
	-- With up to 16 pads across 6 plots these are the most numerous labels in the game;
	-- uncapped, every plot on the map was drawing text at you from anywhere.
	billboard.MaxDistance = 150
	-- Direct child of the top-level instance, because IncomeLoop finds it with
	-- FindFirstChildOfClass (not a recursive search). A Model has no surface of its own,
	-- so it needs an explicit Adornee.
	billboard.Parent = model
	if not model:IsA("BasePart") and model.PrimaryPart then
		billboard.Adornee = model.PrimaryPart
		-- The offset is measured from the ADORNEE, and on these pack models the
		-- PrimaryPart is an arbitrary limb (RootPart, Head, a hand) sitting anywhere
		-- inside the body -- so a fixed lift puts the label through the model's chest
		-- on some and miles above it on others. Measure the real gap to the top of the
		-- bounding box instead. This matters much more now models are 6 studs tall.
		local boxCF, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local toTop = (boxCF.Position.Y + boxSize.Y / 2) - model.PrimaryPart.Position.Y
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, toTop + 1.2, 0)
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = (mutation and (mutation .. " ") or "") .. entry.Name .. "\n\u{1F4B0} $0"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Parent = billboard

	return model
end

-- Wipe any existing brainrot models on the plot, then replay the saved list.
function M.RestoreAll(plot, brainrots)
	if not plot or not brainrots then return 0 end
	local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if not pads then return 0 end
	for _, c in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
		if not c.Name:match("^Pad%d+$") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local placed = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(brainrots) do
		if e.PadIndex and M.Spawn(plot, e.Name, e.PadIndex, e.Mutation, e.Uid) then
			placed += 1
		end
	end
	return placed
end

return M

	BRAINROT = { Cash = 5000 },

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/DailyRewardHandler.lua =====
-- DailyRewardHandler — 30-day login streak calendar with escalating cash rewards,
-- a once-a-week streak-freeze grace (one missed day forgiven), and promo codes.
-- Self-contained: reads DailyStreak / LastClaimDay / LastFreezeDay / RedeemedCodes.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local CodeConfig = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.CodeConfig)
local SeasonPassHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.SeasonPassHandler)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

-- reward per streak-day (1..30), milestone spikes on days 7/14/21/30; cycle repeats
local DAILY_REWARDS = {
	500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000, 100000,
	2000, 4000, 8000, 15000, 30000, 60000, 250000,
	10000, 20000, 40000, 75000, 150000, 300000, 750000,
	25000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 400000, 800000, 1500000, 3000000, 10000000,
}

local FREEZE_COOLDOWN_DAYS = 7

local DailyRewardHandler = {}

local function currentDay()
	return math.floor(os.time() / 86400) -- whole UTC days since epoch
end

local function streakDayFor(streak)
	return ((streak - 1) % #DAILY_REWARDS) + 1
end

local function freezeAvailable(data, today)
	return today - (data.LastFreezeDay or 0) >= FREEZE_COOLDOWN_DAYS
end

-- what streak the next claim WOULD be (mirrors claim(); freeze forgives ONE missed day)
local function projectStreak(data, today)
	local gap = today - data.LastClaimDay
	if gap <= 0 then
		return data.DailyStreak
	elseif gap == 1 then
		return data.DailyStreak + 1
	elseif gap == 2 and freezeAvailable(data, today) then
		return data.DailyStreak + 1
	end
	return 1
end

function DailyRewardHandler.SendState(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local today = currentDay()
	remotes.DailyState:FireClient(player, {
		Claimable = data.LastClaimDay < today,
		Streak = data.DailyStreak,
		NextDay = streakDayFor(projectStreak(data, today)),
		Rewards = DAILY_REWARDS,
		FreezeAvailable = freezeAvailable(data, today),
	})
end

local function claim(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local today = currentDay()
	if data.LastClaimDay >= today then return end -- already claimed today (also guards spam)

	local gap = today - data.LastClaimDay
	local usedFreeze = false
	if gap == 1 then
		data.DailyStreak += 1
	elseif gap == 2 and freezeAvailable(data, today) then
		data.DailyStreak += 1
		data.LastFreezeDay = today
		usedFreeze = true
	else
		data.DailyStreak = 1
	end
	data.LastClaimDay = today
	local day = streakDayFor(data.DailyStreak)
	local reward = DAILY_REWARDS[day]
	PlayerDataManager.GrantCash(data, reward)
	SeasonPassHandler.Notify(player, "DailyClaim", 1)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	remotes.DailyState:FireClient(player, {
		Claimable = false,
		Streak = data.DailyStreak,
		NextDay = day,
		Rewards = DAILY_REWARDS,
		JustClaimed = reward,
		UsedFreeze = usedFreeze,
		FreezeAvailable = freezeAvailable(data, today),
	})
end

local function redeemCode(player, code)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or typeof(code) ~= "string" then return end
	code = code:upper():gsub("%s+", "")
	if #code == 0 or #code > 30 then return end

	local def = CodeConfig[code]
	if not def then
		remotes.RedeemCode:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "Invalid code!" })
		return
	end
	data.RedeemedCodes = data.RedeemedCodes or {}
	if data.RedeemedCodes[code] then
		remotes.RedeemCode:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "Code already redeemed!" })
		return
	end
	data.RedeemedCodes[code] = true
	PlayerDataManager.GrantCash(data, def.Cash or 0)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	remotes.RedeemCode:FireClient(player, { Success = true, Message = ("Code redeemed: +$%d!"):format(def.Cash or 0) })
end

function DailyRewardHandler.Init()
	remotes.DailyClaim.OnServerEvent:Connect(claim)
	remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(redeemCode)

	local function onJoin(player)
		task.spawn(function()
			local tries = 0
			while not PlayerDataManager.Get(player) and tries < 60 do
				task.wait(0.1); tries += 1
			end
			if PlayerDataManager.Get(player) then
				task.wait(1) -- let the client build its UI
				DailyRewardHandler.SendState(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(p) end

	print("DailyRewardHandler online")
end

return DailyRewardHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/DarrelService.lua =====
-- DarrelService -- the ONLY authority on darrel balance. Award/TrySpend never yield.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PDM = require(script.Parent.PlayerDataManager)
local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes")

local M = {}

local QUEST_POOL = {
	{ Id = "throw25",   Kind = "Throw",   Target = 25,    Reward = 3, Text = "Skip 25 rocks" },
	{ Id = "throw60",   Kind = "Throw",   Target = 60,    Reward = 5, Text = "Skip 60 rocks" },
	{ Id = "catchEpic", Kind = "Catch",   Target = 1,     Reward = 4, Text = "Catch an Epic or better" },
	{ Id = "catch3",    Kind = "Catch",   Target = 3,     Reward = 5, Text = "Catch 3 Epic+ brainrots" },
	{ Id = "collect50k",Kind = "Collect", Target = 50000, Reward = 3, Text = "Collect $50k from the campfire" },
	{ Id = "collect250k",Kind = "Collect",Target = 250000,Reward = 5, Text = "Collect $250k from the campfire" },
}

local function utcDay() return math.floor(os.time() / 86400) end

-- 3 deterministic picks per UTC day (same slate for everyone; no Math.random at module scope)
local function slateFor(day)
	local rng = Random.new(day * 7919)
	local pool = table.clone(QUEST_POOL)
	local picks = {}
	for _ = 1, 3 do table.insert(picks, table.remove(pool, rng:NextInteger(1, #pool))) end
	return picks
end

local function daily(data)
	local d = utcDay()
	if not data.DarrelDaily or data.DarrelDaily.Day ~= d then
		data.DarrelDaily = { Day = d, Progress = {}, Claimed = {} }
	end
	return data.DarrelDaily
end

local function push(player, data)
	remotes.DarrelUpdate:FireClient(player, { Darrels = data.Darrels, Daily = M.GetDailyState(player) })
end

function M.Get(player)
	local data = PDM.Get(player); return data and data.Darrels or 0
end

function M.Award(player, n, reason)
	local data = PDM.Get(player); if not data then return false end
	if type(n) ~= "number" then return false end
	n = math.floor(n); if n < 1 or n ~= n or n == math.huge then return false end
	data.Darrels += n
	-- MONEY INVARIANT (Robux receipts): nothing after the mutation above may throw.
	-- A throw here would skip ProductRegistry's ReceiptLog insert while the
	-- leave-save still banks the darrels -- Roblox's retry then grants AGAIN.
	-- The UI pushes are best-effort; tostring() the balance because %d throws on
	-- non-integer-representable values and a corrupted save can put one here.
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		print(("[Darrels] +%d -> %s %s (%s)"):format(n, tostring(data.Darrels), player.Name, reason))
		push(player, data); PDM.PushUpdate(player)
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Darrels] post-award notify failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
	return true
end

function M.TrySpend(player, n, reason)  -- NO YIELDS between check and deduct
	local data = PDM.Get(player); if not data then return false end
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n <= 0 or n ~= n or data.Darrels < n then return false end
	data.Darrels -= n
	print(("[Darrels] -%d -> %d %s (%s)"):format(n, data.Darrels, player.Name, reason))
	push(player, data); PDM.PushUpdate(player)
	return true
end

function M.Notify(player, kind, n)  -- mirrored beside SeasonPassHandler.Notify call sites
	local data = PDM.Get(player); if not data or data.__noSave then return end
	local dd = daily(data)
	dd.Progress[kind] = (dd.Progress[kind] or 0) + (n or 1)
	for _, q in ipairs(slateFor(dd.Day)) do
		if q.Kind == kind and not dd.Claimed[q.Id] and (dd.Progress[kind] or 0) >= q.Target then
			dd.Claimed[q.Id] = true
			M.Award(player, q.Reward, "daily:" .. q.Id)
		end
	end
end

function M.GetDailyState(player)
	local data = PDM.Get(player); if not data then return nil end
	local dd = daily(data)
	local out = { Day = dd.Day, Quests = {} }
	for _, q in ipairs(slateFor(dd.Day)) do
		table.insert(out.Quests, { Id = q.Id, Text = q.Text, Reward = q.Reward, Target = q.Target,
			Progress = math.min(dd.Progress[q.Kind] or 0, q.Target), Claimed = dd.Claimed[q.Id] == true })
	end
	return out
end

function M.Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.defer(function()
			local data = PDM.Get(player)
			if data then push(player, data) end
		end)
	end)

	-- Pull path for initial state: DarrelUpdate's join-time push (above) can race
	-- a client listener that hasn't connected yet, so EggShopClient also INVOKES
	-- this once at startup and once on panel open instead of relying on the push
	-- alone (Task 3 -> Task 7 controller-approved extension). Self-heal instead of
	-- WaitForChild: an unbounded yield here would stall Main's entire synchronous
	-- Init chain if the instance ever went missing.
	local darrelState = remotes:FindFirstChild("DarrelState")
	if not darrelState then
		darrelState = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
		darrelState.Name = "DarrelState"
		darrelState.Parent = remotes
	end
	darrelState.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
		return { Darrels = M.Get(player), Daily = M.GetDailyState(player) }
	end
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/DevWeather.lua =====
-- DevWeather: developer-only shortcuts for forcing a weather event, so each one can be
-- tested without waiting out the 20-minute cooldown and a 50% roll.
--
-- ============================== WHY THIS IS GATED ==============================
-- Weather is GLOBAL and it is not cosmetic: every event is the only source of its paired
-- mutation (MutationConfig.Events), and those mutations multiply a brainrot's cash by up to
-- x95. An ungated command would let any player mint Demon and Angel brainrots on demand and
-- flatten the whole mutation economy. So the allowlist check happens HERE, on the server,
-- and the client half can only ask.
--
-- The client registers the chat command and fires a RemoteEvent; this module decides. That
-- split is deliberate: TextChatCommand.Triggered is only reliably raised on the client that
-- typed it, so a server-side-only command registration cannot be depended on. Putting the
-- authority here means it does not matter where the request comes from.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local WeatherHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.WeatherHandler)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

-- ============================== THE ALLOWLIST ==============================
-- Add your friends' UserIds here. Keep this module in ServerScriptService so clients can
-- never read the list, the same reason Modules.CodeConfig lives server-side.
local ALLOWED = {
	[125861722] = true,   -- yeep1234
}

local DevWeather = {}

local function isDev(player)
	if ALLOWED[player.UserId] then return true end
	-- the place owner always counts. CreatorType is checked because a GROUP-owned place has
	-- no single owner UserId, and game.CreatorId would then be a group id -- matching a
	-- player's UserId against it could authorise the wrong person entirely.
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User and game.CreatorId == player.UserId then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function reply(player, ok, msg)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if r then r:FireClient(player, { Success = ok, Message = msg }) end
end

function DevWeather.Init()
	local request = remotes:FindFirstChild("DevWeatherRequest")
	if not request then
		request = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		request.Name = "DevWeatherRequest"
		request.Parent = remotes
	end

	request.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, arg)
		-- gate FIRST, before any parsing, and stay silent for non-devs: an "unauthorised"
		-- reply would advertise that the command exists to everyone who guesses it.
		if not isDev(player) then return end
		if typeof(arg) ~= "string" then
			reply(player, false, "usage: /wx <event>  |  /wx clear  |  /wx list")
			return
		end
		local want = arg:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if want == "" or want:lower() == "list" then
			reply(player, true, "events: " .. table.concat(WeatherHandler.EventNames(), ", ") .. ", clear")
			return
		end
		-- Long fixed duration: a forced event is for testing, and the normal 4-7 minute
		-- random roll would end it mid-inspection.
		local ok, applied = WeatherHandler.ApplyByName(want, 600)
		if ok then
			print(("[DevWeather] %s forced '%s'"):format(player.Name, applied))
			reply(player, true, ("\u{26C5} %s forced for 10 minutes"):format(applied))
		else
			reply(player, false, ("no event matching '%s'. try: %s, clear")
				:format(want, table.concat(WeatherHandler.EventNames(), ", ")))
		end
	end)

	print(("DevWeather online (%d allowlisted)"):format((function()
		local n = 0
		for _ in pairs(ALLOWED) do n += 1 end
		return n
	end)()))
end

return DevWeather


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/EggHandler.lua =====
-- EggHandler (Forest Egg Shop) -- server-authoritative buy -> roll -> grant.
-- Spend and grant happen back-to-back with no yields in EggHandler's own code in
-- between: TrySpend commits the Darrel deduction, then the roll and the Give must
-- land before anything else can observe the player's state, or a mid-purchase
-- disconnect could pay without delivering (or deliver without paying, if reversed).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PDM = require(script.Parent.PlayerDataManager)
local DarrelService = require(script.Parent.DarrelService)
local BrainrotMover = require(script.Parent.BrainrotMover)
local InventoryHandler = require(script.Parent.InventoryHandler)
local EggConfig = require(RS.Modules.EggConfig)
local BrainrotConfig = require(RS.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local PetConfig = require(RS.Modules.PetConfig)
local PetHandler = require(script.Parent.PetHandler)
local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local M = {}
local rng = Random.new()
local lastBuy = {}  -- [player] = clock, 0.5s debounce

-- Rarity for the EggResult payload (drives the hatch reveal's tier lighting).
-- Sourced from PetConfig since 2026-08-01: the egg tables name PETS now, and a
-- pet name has no BrainrotConfig row, so the old BrainrotConfig lookup would
-- have handed the client a nil Rarity for every hatch.
local function rarityOf(name)
	local id = PetConfig.IdFor(name)
	local def = id and PetConfig.Pets[id]
	return def and def.Rarity
end

-- Pure; exposed for the Task 12 odds simulation. Weights sum to 100 (EggConfig.Validate).
function M.RollFor(egg, r)
	if #egg.Table == 0 then return nil end
	local roll = (r or rng):NextInteger(1, 100)
	local acc = 0
	for _, row in ipairs(egg.Table) do
		acc += row[2]
		if roll <= acc then return row[1] end
	end
	return egg.Table[#egg.Table][1]
end

local function refuse(player, msg)
	remotes.EggResult:FireClient(player, { Ok = false, Message = msg })
end

function M.Init()
	EggConfig.Validate()  -- fail loudly at boot, not at first purchase

	-- Self-heal for unsnapshotted Studio state: the prompt was found disabled once;
	-- server asserts it on every boot.
	local prompt = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld") and workspace.GameWorld:FindFirstChild("EggStall") and workspace.GameWorld.EggStall:FindFirstChild("PromptPart") and workspace.GameWorld.EggStall.PromptPart:FindFirstChild("EggPrompt")
	if prompt then prompt.Enabled = true end

	remotes.EggBuy.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, worldId, eggId)
		if typeof(worldId) ~= "string" or typeof(eggId) ~= "string" then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < 0.5 then return end
		lastBuy[player] = now

		local data = PDM.Get(player)
		if not data then return refuse(player, "Profile not loaded yet.") end
		if data.__noSave then return refuse(player, "Your profile did not load \u{2014} rejoin before buying eggs.") end
		-- Relies on `or` short-circuiting: GetEgg returns a single nil (not nil, nil) when
		-- the egg isn't found, so `world` is nil too -- checking `not egg` first keeps
		-- `not world.Active` from ever indexing a nil `world`.
		local egg, world = EggConfig.GetEgg(worldId, eggId)
		if not egg or not world.Active then return refuse(player, "That egg is not available.") end

		-- ATOMIC COMMIT: no yields from here to the Give.
		if not DarrelService.TrySpend(player, egg.Price, "egg:" .. eggId) then
			return refuse(player, ("Not enough Darrels (need %d)."):format(egg.Price))
		end
		local name = M.RollFor(egg)

		-- Eggs hatch into PETS, not placeable brainrots. The creature lands in data.Pets
		-- (bag -> Pets tab) and never goes onto a plot, so the BrainrotMover unique-cap
		-- pre-check and InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack that used to sit here are gone with it:
		-- pets have no unique cap and are not backpack items.
		--
		-- The rolled name IS a pet name (EggConfig.Validate asserts every row resolves
		-- through PetConfig.IdFor at boot), so this lookup cannot miss for a table that
		-- passed validation -- the guard below is for a roster edited live in Studio
		-- between boot and purchase.
		local petId = PetConfig.IdFor(name)
		if not petId then
			DarrelService.Award(player, egg.Price, "refund:" .. eggId)
			warn(("[EggHandler] %s rolled %s with no PetConfig entry, refunded")
				:format(player.Name, tostring(name)))
			return refuse(player, "That creature is not available yet \u{2014} Darrels refunded.")
		end

		-- Error boundary: anything throwing between the spend and the EggResult fire would
		-- otherwise leave the player charged with no reply. Grant returns false rather than
		-- throwing on a bad id, so both failure shapes refund.
		local ok2, granted, uid = pcall(PetHandler.Grant, player, petId)
		if not ok2 or not granted then
			DarrelService.Award(player, egg.Price, "refund:" .. eggId)
			warn(("[EggHandler] hatch failed, refunded: %s uid=%d egg=%s rolled=%s err=%s")
				:format(player.Name, player.UserId, eggId, name, tostring(granted)))
			return refuse(player, "Hatch failed \u{2014} Darrels refunded.")
		end

		data.EggsOpened[eggId] = (data.EggsOpened[eggId] or 0) + 1
		PDM.PushUpdate(player)
		remotes.EggResult:FireClient(player, {
			Ok = true, EggId = eggId, Name = name, Rarity = rarityOf(name),
			PetUid = uid, PetId = petId,
		})

		local saved = PDM.Save(player)  -- after commit; audit on failure (trade-hardening pattern)
		if not saved then
			warn(("[EggHandler] SAVE FAILED after hatch: %s uid=%d egg=%s got=%s")
				:format(player.Name, player.UserId, eggId, name))
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastBuy[p] = nil end)
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/FusionHandler.lua =====
-- Campfire Fusion: 5 identical UNPLACED brainrots (same name + same mutation)
-- fuse into 1 copy at the next mutation tier:
--
--     none -> Golden -> Diamond -> Rainbow -> Glitched
--
-- Rainbow and Glitched no longer drop from a throw (MutationConfig marks them
-- FusionOnly), so this ladder is now their ONLY source -- 125 plain copies of
-- one brainrot for a Rainbow, 625 for a Glitched. See the design note at the
-- top of ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig for why.
--
-- Glitched is TERMINAL: it deliberately has no key in NEXT_MUTATION, so a fuse
-- request on Glitched copies falls into the "can't be fused further" branch
-- below and is rejected before anything is consumed.
--
-- The event mutations (Wet, Sandy, Electric, Frozen, Aurora, Celestial, Demon,
-- Angel) are intentionally absent from this map -- they stay terminal event
-- rewards and can be neither fused into nor fused from.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local InventoryHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.InventoryHandler)
local SeasonPassHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.SeasonPassHandler)
local MintRegistry = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.MintRegistry)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local FUSE_COUNT = 5
local CAMPFIRE_RANGE = 16

-- key = the mutation you hold ("" means none), value = what 5 of them become.
-- No "Glitched" key on purpose: that is the top of the ladder.
local NEXT_MUTATION = { [""] = "Golden", Golden = "Diamond", Diamond = "Rainbow", Rainbow = "Glitched" }

local validName = {}
local rarityByName = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	validName[e.Name] = true
	rarityByName[e.Name] = e.Rarity
end

local FusionHandler = {}

function FusionHandler.Init()
	remotes.FusionRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, name, mutation)
		local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
		if not data then return end
		if typeof(name) ~= "string" or not validName[name] then return end
		if mutation ~= nil and typeof(mutation) ~= "string" then return end
		if mutation == "" then mutation = nil end

		local result = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
		local nextMut = NEXT_MUTATION[mutation or ""]
		if not nextMut then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "That mutation can't be fused further!" }) end
			return
		end

		-- must be at your own campfire
		local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
		if not plot then return end
		local campfire = plot:FindFirstChild("Campfire", true)
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not campfire or not hrp or (campfire.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > CAMPFIRE_RANGE then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "Stand by your campfire to fuse!" }) end
			return
		end

		-- collect 5 unplaced matching copies
		local matches = {}
		for i, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
			if e.Name == name and e.PadIndex == nil and e.Mutation == mutation then
				table.insert(matches, i)
				if #matches >= FUSE_COUNT then break end
			end
		end
		if #matches < FUSE_COUNT then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = ("Need %d unplaced copies to fuse!"):format(FUSE_COUNT) }) end
			return
		end

		-- remove back-to-front so indices stay valid, then add the fused one
		for i = #matches, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(data.Brainrots, matches[i])
		end
		-- the 5 consumed copies (same name + mutation, so one batched call) are
		-- destroyed for good: record the burn or the registry's live "exists"
		-- counts drift up forever. Gated on IsTracked - the same rule the mint
		-- side (ThrowHandler) uses - so burns are only recorded for classes that
		-- actually mint serials.
		if MintRegistry.IsTracked(rarityByName[name], mutation) then
			pcall(MintRegistry.Burn, name, mutation, FUSE_COUNT)
		end

		-- MINT THE OUTPUT. Burning without minting was the whole defect: every fuse
		-- recorded 5 burns against a mint count fusion never incremented, so Get()'s
		-- exists = max(0, minted - burned) drove Golden/Diamond toward 0 while players
		-- held hundreds -- and Rainbow/Glitched, which MutationConfig makes FusionOnly
		-- (this file's header), reported 0 minted / 0 exists permanently, since fusion
		-- is their ONLY source. IsTracked returns true for any non-empty mutation, so
		-- every rung of the ladder above "" is tracked.
		--
		-- Same shape as ThrowHandler's catch path: Prepare warms the block without
		-- yielding, Mint never yields and never errors (nil = cold registry / store
		-- down), and the pcall is belt-and-braces. A missing serial costs a garnish;
		-- it must never cost the player their fuse.
		local fusedSerial, fusedAt
		if MintRegistry.IsTracked(rarityByName[name], nextMut) then
			pcall(MintRegistry.Prepare, name, nextMut)
			local okMint, serial = pcall(MintRegistry.Mint, name, nextMut)
			if okMint and type(serial) == "number" then
				fusedSerial = serial
				fusedAt = os.time()
			end
		end
		local fused = { Name = name, PadIndex = nil, Pending = 0, Mutation = nextMut, Uid = PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(data) }
		if fusedSerial then
			-- carried the same way BrainrotMover.Give carries them through a trade,
			-- so mint identity survives every later hop
			fused.Serial = fusedSerial
			fused.MintedAt = fusedAt
		end
		table.insert(data.Brainrots, fused)

		InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
		SeasonPassHandler.Notify(player, "Fuse", 1)
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
		if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = true, Message = nextMut .. " " .. name .. " fused!" }) end
		remotes.FusionRequest:FireClient(player, { Name = name, NewMutation = nextMut })
	end)
	print("FusionHandler online")
end

return FusionHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/GamepassService.lua =====
-- ============================================================================
-- GamepassService -- server ownership + effects for the Robux gamepasses in
-- ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GamepassConfig.
--
-- Deliberately HEADLESS: no UI, no auto-prompts, nothing visible. It just:
--   (a) caches who owns which pass,
--   (b) keeps that fresh when a pass is bought mid-session, and
--   (c) exposes the accessors the game / a future shop UI will call:
--        GamepassService.Owns(player, key)        -> bool
--        GamepassService.CashMult(player)         -> number (1 if none owned)
--        GamepassService.LuckMult(player)         -> number
--        GamepassService.PowerMult(player)        -> number
--        GamepassService.ChargeMult(player)       -> number
--        GamepassService.HasFlag(player, flag)    -> bool  (AutoCollect / VIP)
--        GamepassService.Prompt(player, key)      -> opens the Robux buy prompt
--
-- Passes with GamepassId == 0 are skipped, so this stays inert and safe until
-- real ids are filled into GamepassConfig. Ownership cache matches the PetHandler
-- convention (keyed by Player, pcall'd, cleared on PlayerRemoving).
-- ============================================================================
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GamepassConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GamepassConfig)

local GamepassService = {}

-- owned[player] = { [Key] = true }. Session cache; cleared on leave.
local owned = {}

local function refresh(player)
	local set = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
		if g.GamepassId and g.GamepassId > 0 then
			local ok, has = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, g.GamepassId)
			end)
			if ok and has then set[g.Key] = true end
		end
	end
	owned[player] = set
end

function GamepassService.Owns(player, key)
	local set = owned[player]
	return set ~= nil and set[key] == true
end

-- product of a numeric effect across every owned pass (neutral 1 when none)
local function multOf(player, effectName)
	local set = owned[player]
	if not set then return 1 end
	local m = 1
	for _, g in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
		if set[g.Key] and g.Effects and type(g.Effects[effectName]) == "number" then
			m = m * g.Effects[effectName]
		end
	end
	return m
end

function GamepassService.Mult(player, effectName) return multOf(player, effectName) end
function GamepassService.CashMult(player)   return multOf(player, "CashMult")   end
function GamepassService.LuckMult(player)   return multOf(player, "LuckMult")   end
function GamepassService.PowerMult(player)  return multOf(player, "PowerMult")  end
function GamepassService.ChargeMult(player) return multOf(player, "ChargeMult") end

function GamepassService.HasFlag(player, flag)
	local set = owned[player]
	if not set then return false end
	for _, g in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
		if set[g.Key] and g.Effects and g.Effects[flag] == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- Open the Robux purchase prompt (call from a future shop UI / remote). No-op
-- for a pass that has not been created yet.
function GamepassService.Prompt(player, key)
	local g = GamepassConfig.ByKey[key]
	if g and g.GamepassId and g.GamepassId > 0 then
		MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, g.GamepassId)
	end
end

function GamepassService.Init()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(refresh, p) end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.spawn(refresh, p) end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) owned[p] = nil end)

	-- keep the cache fresh the instant a pass is bought this session
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, gamepassId, wasPurchased)
		if not wasPurchased then return end
		local g = GamepassConfig.ByGamepassId(gamepassId)
		if g then
			owned[player] = owned[player] or {}
			owned[player][g.Key] = true
		end
	end)

	print("GamepassService online (" .. #GamepassConfig.List .. " passes configured, headless)")
end

return GamepassService


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/GianlucaQuest.lua =====
-- GianlucaQuest: the "find Gianluca's Secret Chim" questline.
--   1. Talk to Gianluca (client dialogue) -> GianlucaTalk fires -> quest goes ACTIVE.
--   2. Find the SecretChim in the world and take it -> grants the Mythic "Chim".
--   3. Bring the Chim BACK to Gianluca -> he takes it and gives you a Key.
--      (the handover only requires that you HOLD an unplaced Chim -- it does not
--       care which of the three stages you are nominally on)
--
-- State lives in data.ChimQuest:
--   0 = not started   1 = active (searching)
--   2 = holding the Chim   3 = handed it over, Key claimed
--
-- Chim is unobtainable outside this module by construction: its BrainrotConfig entry
-- carries Weight = 0 and no FixedChance, so no throw can roll it at any distance or
-- luck. grantChim is the single source, and it refuses unless the quest is ACTIVE --
-- so "unavailable until the player accepts the quest" is enforced in two places at
-- once, and neither one alone can leak it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local InventoryHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.InventoryHandler)
local BrainrotMover = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.BrainrotMover)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local REWARD_NAME = "Chim"
local KEYS_PER_HANDOVER = 1

local GianlucaQuest = {}

local function getRemote(name, class)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = remotes end
	return r
end
local talkRemote = getRemote("GianlucaTalk", "RemoteEvent")
local stateRemote = getRemote("GianlucaState", "RemoteEvent")

local function sendState(player, note)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, { State = data.ChimQuest or 0, Note = note })
end
GianlucaQuest.SendState = sendState

-- talking to Gianluca starts the hunt
local function startQuest(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	if (data.ChimQuest or 0) == 0 then
		data.ChimQuest = 1
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	end
	sendState(player)
end

-- taking the chim grants the reward (only while the quest is active)
local function grantChim(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local st = data.ChimQuest or 0
	if st ~= 1 then
		if st == 0 then sendState(player, "hint") end   -- found it early: nudge them to Gianluca
		return
	end
	-- Unique cap, belt-and-braces. The ChimQuest state gate above already makes a second
	-- grant impossible, but a player could hold one received by TRADE while their own
	-- quest is still active -- and then this grant would be their second.
	if not BrainrotMover.WithinUniqueCap(REWARD_NAME,
		BrainrotMover.CountOwned(data, REWARD_NAME), 0, 1) then
		local result = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
		if result then
			result:FireClient(player, { Success = false,
				Message = ("You already have a %s \u{2014} take it to Gianluca."):format(REWARD_NAME) })
		end
		return
	end
	table.insert(data.Brainrots, { Name = REWARD_NAME, PadIndex = nil, Pending = 0, Mutation = nil, Uid = PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(data) })
	if data.Discovered then data.Discovered[REWARD_NAME] = true end
	data.ChimQuest = 2
	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	sendState(player, "found")
end

-- handing the Chim back closes the questline and pays out the Key
local function handOver(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local result = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")

	-- Gated on POSSESSION, not on quest stage. The stage-2 check that used to live
	-- here assumed the only way to hold a Chim was this quest's own pickup prompt,
	-- which silently refused any Chim that arrived another way (a trade, an admin
	-- grant, a test override) -- the player would be standing there holding it while
	-- Gianluca insisted he'd lost it. The possession check below is the real
	-- authority and is the one that must not be bypassed; stage is just bookkeeping.

	-- Only an UNPLACED Chim can be handed over. A placed one is earning on a pad, and
	-- requiring pickup first is the same rule SellHandler uses -- it means the handover
	-- never has to tear down a pad model or reconcile a PadIndex.
	local idx, placedOnly = nil, false
	for i, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.Name == REWARD_NAME then
			if e.PadIndex == nil then idx = i; break else placedOnly = true end
		end
	end
	if not idx then
		if result then
			result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = placedOnly
				and ("Your " .. REWARD_NAME .. " is on your base \u{2014} pick it up first (hold E on it).")
				or ("You don't have the " .. REWARD_NAME .. " to give him.") })
		end
		return
	end

	-- drain banked income BEFORE the entry disappears, or it is silently destroyed
	PlayerDataManager.DrainPending(player, data.Brainrots[idx], data)
	table.remove(data.Brainrots, idx)
	data.Keys = (data.Keys or 0) + KEYS_PER_HANDOVER
	data.ChimQuest = 3
	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	if result then
		result:FireClient(player, { Success = true,
			Message = ("\u{1F511} Gianluca took the Chim and gave you a Key! (%d)"):format(data.Keys) })
	end
	sendState(player, "key")
end

-- === TEST HOOK: one-shot questline reset =============================
-- Armed by setting ServerStorage.TestResetChimQuest to a username. Attributes
-- live in the place file, so this survives the Edit -> Play transition (a Lua
-- flag would not -- the server VM is rebuilt on Play).
--
-- Rewinds the questline to "holding the Chim": clears Keys, drops any UNPLACED
-- Chim already owned, then grants exactly one fresh Chim. Placed copies are
-- left alone -- deleting the data entry for one would orphan its pad model.
--
-- Consumed exactly once; the attribute is cleared the moment it fires.
local function maybeTestReset(player)
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local who = ServerStorage:GetAttribute("TestResetChimQuest")
	if type(who) ~= "string" or who == "" then return end
	-- the attribute is "Username" or "Username#token" -- match on the name part only
	if (who:match("^([^#]+)") or who) ~= player.Name then return end
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end

	-- Fire once PER PROFILE, not once per server. Clearing the attribute alone is
	-- not enough: Play runs on a clone of the Edit datamodel, so the cleared value
	-- never writes back, and the reset would re-fire on every Play -- wiping the
	-- Key the player had just earned. The token is stamped on the profile, so
	-- re-arming means giving the attribute a NEW value (e.g. "Name#2").
	if data.ChimTestToken == who then return end
	data.ChimTestToken = who
	ServerStorage:SetAttribute("TestResetChimQuest", nil)

	local dropped = 0
	for i = #data.Brainrots, 1, -1 do
		local e = data.Brainrots[i]
		if e.Name == REWARD_NAME and e.PadIndex == nil then
			table.remove(data.Brainrots, i)
			dropped += 1
		end
	end
	data.Keys = 0
	data.ChimQuest = 2
	table.insert(data.Brainrots, {
		Name = REWARD_NAME, PadIndex = nil, Pending = 0, Mutation = nil,
		Uid = PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(data),
	})
	if data.Discovered then data.Discovered[REWARD_NAME] = true end
	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	sendState(player)
