	warn(("[GianlucaQuest] TEST reset for %s: dropped %d old Chim, granted 1, Keys=0, stage=2")
		:format(player.Name, dropped))
end

function GianlucaQuest.Init()
	-- one remote, two actions. The pre-existing client fires with no arguments, so a
	-- nil/unknown action must keep meaning "talk" or old clients would break.
	talkRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
		if action == "handover" then
			handOver(player)
		else
			startQuest(player)
		end
	end)

	-- hook the chim's pickup prompt (server-authoritative grant)
	task.spawn(function()
		local gw = Workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
		local chim = gw:WaitForChild("SecretChim", 30)
		local prompt = chim and chim:WaitForChild("ChimPrompt", 30)
		if prompt then
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who) grantChim(who) end)
		end
	end)

	local function onJoin(player)
		task.spawn(function()
			local tries = 0
			while not PlayerDataManager.Get(player) and tries < 60 do task.wait(0.1); tries += 1 end
			if PlayerDataManager.Get(player) then
				task.wait(1)
				maybeTestReset(player)
				sendState(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(p) end

	print("GianlucaQuest online")
end

return GianlucaQuest

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/IncomeLoop.lua =====
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)
local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RebirthConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UpgradeConfig)
local DarrelService = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.DarrelService)
local PetHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PetHandler)

local cashPerSecondByName = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	cashPerSecondByName[entry.Name] = entry.CashPerSecond
end

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
local WALKUP_COLLECT   = false  -- USER DECISION U1: the campfire is now the collector
local CAMPFIRE_RADIUS  = 5.60   -- horizontal studs (cylinder, not sphere) == CampStand radius
local CAMPFIRE_Y_BAND  = 6.0    -- vertical studs
local COLLECT_INTERVAL = 2.0    -- seconds between campfire gulps while standing in the fire
local CUE_COOLDOWN     = 2.0    -- matches COLLECT_INTERVAL: one cue per gulp, never more
local BANK_WRITE_EVERY = 3      -- ticks (~1.05 s) between attribute publishes
local cueState, tickCount = {}, 0
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) cueState[p] = nil end)
-- Main requires IncomeLoop (line 11) BEFORE PlotBoardHandler, so resolve the cue remote lazily.
local cueRemote
local function getCueRemote()
	if cueRemote and cueRemote.Parent then return cueRemote end
	cueRemote = remotes:FindFirstChild("CampfireCollected")
	return cueRemote
end
local BRAINROT_RANGE = 7

-- canonical abbreviator, K through Qi -- see Modules.NumberFormat
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat)
local formatShort = NumberFormat.Short
local rateText = NumberFormat.Rate

-- keep each brainrot billboard showing: name, stored cash, and small cash/sec line
local function updateBillboard(model, name, pending, cps)
	local bg = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
	if not bg then return end
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 56)

	local main = bg:FindFirstChild("Main")
	if not main then
		main = bg:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if main then main.Name = "Main" end
	end
	if main then
		main.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		main.TextScaled = true
		main.Text = name .. "\n\u{1F4B0} $" .. formatShort(pending)
	end

	local rate = bg:FindFirstChild("Rate")
	if not rate then
		rate = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		rate.Name = "Rate"
		rate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rate.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15)
		rate.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 41)
		rate.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		rate.TextSize = 12
		rate.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 235, 195)
		rate.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		rate.Parent = bg
	end
	rate.Text = rateText(cps)
end

local function collectAll(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return 0 end
	local total = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.PadIndex and (e.Pending or 0) >= 1 then
			total += math.floor(e.Pending)
			e.Pending = e.Pending - math.floor(e.Pending)
		end
	end
	if total > 0 then
		PlayerDataManager.AddEarnings(player, total, data)
		PlayerDataManager.SyncLeaderstat(player)
		remotes.CashTick:FireClient(player, data.Cash)
	end
	return total
end

local IncomeLoop = {}

function IncomeLoop.Init()
	task.spawn(function()
		local last = os.clock()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.35)
			local now = os.clock()
			local dt = now - last
			last = now
			tickCount += 1

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local okTick, errTick = pcall(function()
				local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
				if data then
					local rebirthMult = RebirthConfig.IncomeMult(data.Rebirths)
					local upMult = UpgradeConfig.IncomeMult(data.Upgrades)
					local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
					local pads = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
					local char = player.Character
					local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					-- accumulate pending for every placed brainrot
					for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
						if e.PadIndex then
							e.Pending = (e.Pending or 0) + (cashPerSecondByName[e.Name] or 0) * Mutations.Mult(e.Mutation) * rebirthMult * upMult * PetHandler.IncomeMult(player) * dt
						end
					end

					local entryByPad = {}
					for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
						if e.PadIndex then entryByPad[e.PadIndex] = e end
					end

					-- billboards + per-brainrot walk-up collect
					local collected = 0
					if pads then
						for _, model in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
							local pi = model:GetAttribute("PadIndex")
							-- Models as well as Parts: BrainrotSpawner clones an authored Model when
							-- one exists, and a BasePart-only gate would silently freeze its billboard
							-- at $0 while the brainrot kept earning.
							if pi and (model:IsA("BasePart") or model:IsA("Model")) then
								local e = entryByPad[pi]
								if e then
									local cps = (cashPerSecondByName[e.Name] or 0) * Mutations.Mult(e.Mutation) * rebirthMult * upMult
									local dispName = e.Mutation and (e.Mutation .. " " .. e.Name) or e.Name
									updateBillboard(model, dispName, e.Pending, cps)
									local mPos = model:IsA("BasePart") and model.Position or model:GetPivot().Position
									if WALKUP_COLLECT and hrp and e.Pending >= 1 and (mPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= BRAINROT_RANGE then
										collected += math.floor(e.Pending)
										e.Pending = e.Pending - math.floor(e.Pending)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if collected > 0 then
						PlayerDataManager.AddEarnings(player, collected, data)
						PlayerDataManager.SyncLeaderstat(player)
						remotes.CashTick:FireClient(player, data.Cash)
					end

					-- campfire bank: publish the hoard, gulp it when the owner stands in the fire
					local total = 0
					for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
						if e.PadIndex then total += (e.Pending or 0) end
					end
					local campfire = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("Campfire")
					if campfire then
						local cs = cueState[player]
						if not cs then cs = { last = -1e9, lastCollect = -1e9, accum = 0, inside = false }; cueState[player] = cs end

						-- CYLINDER test, not .Magnitude: the HRP sits ~1.6 studs above Campfire.Position,
						-- so a sphere would have to be inflated just to reach a standing player.
						local onFire = false
						if hrp then
							local dx = hrp.Position.X - campfire.Position.X
							local dz = hrp.Position.Z - campfire.Position.Z
							local dy = math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - campfire.Position.Y)
							onFire = (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= CAMPFIRE_RADIUS * CAMPFIRE_RADIUS
								and dy <= CAMPFIRE_Y_BAND
						end

						local now = os.clock()
						local fresh = onFire and not cs.inside
						local got = 0
						if onFire and total >= 1 and (fresh or (now - cs.lastCollect) >= COLLECT_INTERVAL) then
							got = collectAll(player) or 0
							cs.lastCollect = now
						end

						if got > 0 then
							DarrelService.Notify(player, "Collect", got)
							total = math.max(total - got, 0)
							cs.accum += got
							if fresh or (now - cs.last) >= CUE_COOLDOWN then
								local r = getCueRemote()
								if r then r:FireClient(player, cs.accum, fresh) end
								cs.last, cs.accum = now, 0
							end
						end
						if cs.inside and not onFire and cs.accum > 0 then
							local r = getCueRemote()                     -- flush on exit
							if r then r:FireClient(player, cs.accum, false) end
							cs.accum = 0
						end
						cs.inside = onFire

						if got > 0 or tickCount % BANK_WRITE_EVERY == 0 then
							campfire:SetAttribute("Banked", math.floor(total))
						end
						if tickCount % BANK_WRITE_EVERY == 0 then
							plot:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", math.floor(data.TotalEarned or 0))
						end
					end
				end
				end)
				if not okTick then
					warn("[IncomeLoop] tick failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(errTick))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return IncomeLoop


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/InventoryHandler.lua =====
-- Brainrot inventory lives in the player's real Roblox Backpack.
-- Each unplaced brainrot = one Tool. Equip it and click to place it on a free pad.
-- Walk up to a placed brainrot and hold E to store it back.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")   -- held-display templates

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local BrainrotSpawner = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.BrainrotSpawner)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)   -- held-display glow
local MutationFX = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationFX)
local SoundKit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SoundKit)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local infoByName = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do infoByName[e.Name] = e end

local InventoryHandler = {}

local function notify(player, ok, msg)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if r then r:FireClient(player, { Success = ok, Message = msg }) end
end

local function findByUid(data, uid)
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.Uid == uid then return e end
	end
	return nil
end

-- padIndex is the spot the player picked. Nil falls back to the first free pad,
-- which is only used if the client could not resolve what they were aiming at.
local function place(player, uid, padIndex)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local entry = findByUid(data, uid)
	if not entry or entry.PadIndex then return end

	local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
	if not plot then notify(player, false, "Claim a base first!") return end

	if padIndex then
		-- never trust the client: the spot must be unlocked and genuinely empty
		local limit = math.min(data.UnlockedSpots or 12, 16)
		if padIndex < 1 or padIndex > limit then
			notify(player, false, "That spot is locked \u{2014} unlock it first.")
			return
		end
		for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
			if e.PadIndex == padIndex then
				notify(player, false, "That spot is taken \u{2014} pick an empty one.")
				return
			end
		end
	else
		padIndex = PlayerDataManager.FindFreePad(data)
		if not padIndex then notify(player, false, "No free spots! Unlock more or store one.") return end
	end

	entry.PadIndex = padIndex
	local placed = BrainrotSpawner.Spawn(plot, entry.Name, padIndex, entry.Mutation, entry.Uid)

	-- Positional, so it is heard by whoever is standing on the base rather than
	-- fired flat at everyone. Deliberately here in place() and NOT in Spawner.Spawn:
	-- Spawn also runs to restore every brainrot when a base is claimed, which
	-- would fire a wall of thuds on join.
	if placed then
		local at = placed:IsA("BasePart") and placed
			or (placed:IsA("Model") and placed.PrimaryPart)
		if at then
			SoundKit.play("place", at, { volume = 0.4, range = 70 })
		end
	end

	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
end

local function store(player, uid)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local entry = findByUid(data, uid)
	if not entry or not entry.PadIndex then return end

	local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
	if plot then
		local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
		if pads then
			for _, m in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
				if m:GetAttribute("Uid") == uid then m:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end
	PlayerDataManager.DrainPending(player, entry, data)
	entry.PadIndex = nil
	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
end

--=============================== held display ==============================--
-- Show the actual brainrot in the player's hand while its tool is equipped.
--
-- Built ON EQUIP and destroyed on unequip, deliberately. A player can hold 100+
-- unplaced brainrots and each model is 10-30 parts; baking a display into every
-- tool would put thousands of parts in one backpack. This way exactly one
-- exists at a time, per player.
-- Carried OUT IN FRONT at chest-to-knee height, big enough to be the thing you
-- notice about a player -- the Steal a Brainrot read the user asked for, rather
-- than a small trophy floating over the head.
local HELD_HEIGHT = 4.2      -- studs tall; nearly as tall as the character
local HELD_MAX_WIDTH = 5.5   -- the roster runs up to 4x wider than tall; without
                             -- this cap those models become absurd slabs
local HELD_FORWARD = 2.6     -- studs in front of the root, clear of the torso
local HELD_DROP = 0.8        -- studs below the root, so it sits at the hips

local function buildHeld(player, tool, entry)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	-- Anchor to the ROOT, not the head or torso. HumanoidRootPart exists on both
	-- R6 and R15 and does not animate, so the creature rides steadily in front
	-- instead of bobbing with the walk cycle. The matching arms-forward carry
	-- pose is applied client-side in BrainrotHoldClient.
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	-- see BrainrotSpawner: the model folder moved to ReplicatedStorage
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainrotModels")
	local template = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)
	if not template then return end

	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = "HeldBrainrot"

	-- Rigged pack models carry Motor6Ds whose C0/C1 assume the authored pose.
	-- Strip them and re-weld from CURRENT positions, or the model explodes apart
	-- the moment its parts are unanchored. FakeRootPart is rig scaffolding that
	-- sits away from the mesh and silently inflates GetBoundingBox -- which was
	-- making every held model come out ~45% under the target size.
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") or d:IsA("AnimationController") or d:IsA("Animator")
			or d:IsA("Bone") or d.Name == "FakeRootPart" then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- ScaleTo is ABSOLUTE (a multiplier on the model's authored size), so scale
	-- RELATIVE to the current scale, and run it twice: the first pass can shift
	-- the bounding box slightly on irregular models.
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		local _, s = model:GetBoundingBox()
		if s.Y > 0.01 then
			-- fit to a box, not just a height: whichever limit bites first
			local factor = math.min(
				HELD_HEIGHT / s.Y,
				HELD_MAX_WIDTH / math.max(s.X, s.Z, 0.01)
			)
			model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * factor)
		end
	end

	local root = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end
	model.PrimaryPart = root

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			-- Massless matters: an unanchored multi-part model welded to a limb
			-- otherwise drags the character's physics around.
			d.Massless = true
		end
	end

	-- Push it out in front and drop it to hip height, then freeze that
	-- relationship. Translating by the BOUNDING BOX delta rather than PivotTo'ing
	-- the pivot directly matters: on these pack models the authored pivot is
	-- rarely the visual centre, so pivoting straight to the target leaves the
	-- creature visibly off to one side.
	local boxCF = select(1, model:GetBoundingBox())
	local target = (hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -HELD_DROP, -HELD_FORWARD)).Position
	model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + (target - boxCF.Position))

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= root then
			local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			w.Part0, w.Part1 = root, d
			w.Parent = root
		end
	end
	local grip = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	grip.Part0, grip.Part1 = hrp, root
	grip.Parent = root

	-- the same escalating treatment a placed copy gets, so carrying a Glitched
	-- around actually looks like carrying a Glitched
	if entry.Mutation then
		MutationFX.apply(model, entry.Mutation)
	end

	model.Parent = tool
end

local function clearHeld(tool)
	local held = tool:FindFirstChild("HeldBrainrot")
	if held then held:Destroy() end
end

--=============================== hotbar budget =============================--
-- Roblox will happily put a Tool in the hotbar for all 130+ unplaced brainrots,
-- which is unusable. The hotbar is capped and the grid panel is the real
-- inventory. This is a TOOL cap, not a data cap: nothing is lost, the rest
-- simply have no Tool until you pick them out of the grid.
local HOTBAR_SLOTS = 6
local hotbar = {}   -- [player] = { uid, ... }, most-recently-chosen LAST

local function hotbarList(player)
	local l = hotbar[player]
	if not l then l = {}; hotbar[player] = l end
	return l
end

local function valueOf(entry)
	local info = infoByName[entry.Name]
	return (info and info.CashPerSecond or 0) * Mutations.Mult(entry.Mutation)
end

local function equippedUidOf(player)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return nil end
	for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("BrainrotTool") then
			return t:GetAttribute("Uid")
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeTool(player, entry)
	local info = infoByName[entry.Name]
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = (entry.Mutation and (entry.Mutation .. " ") or "") .. entry.Name
	tool.RequiresHandle = false
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.ToolTip = (info and ("$" .. tostring(info.CashPerSecond) .. "/s  \u{2022}  " .. info.Rarity .. "  \u{2022}  ") or "")
		.. "aim at an empty spot on your base and click to place"
	tool:SetAttribute("BrainrotTool", true)
	tool:SetAttribute("Uid", entry.Uid)

	-- hold the actual creature out while this tool is equipped
	tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
		clearHeld(tool)   -- idempotent: re-equipping fast must not stack copies
		local ok, err = pcall(buildHeld, player, tool, entry)
		if not ok then
			warn(("[InventoryHandler] held display failed for %q: %s"):format(entry.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end)
	tool.Unequipped:Connect(function() clearHeld(tool) end)

	-- Placement is driven by PlaceBrainrot from the client, which knows which pad
	-- the player is aiming at. Tool.Activated fires here too but carries no aim
	-- information, so it must NOT auto-place or it would steal the chosen spot.
	return tool
end

-- rebuild the backpack so it exactly mirrors the unplaced brainrots
function InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not backpack then return end

	local have = {}
	local function collect(container)
		if not container then return end
		for _, t in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("BrainrotTool") then
				have[t:GetAttribute("Uid")] = t
			end
		end
	end
	collect(backpack)
	collect(player.Character)

	local unplaced = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if not e.PadIndex and e.Uid then unplaced[e.Uid] = e end
	end

	local list = hotbarList(player)
	-- drop anything since placed, sold, fused or traded away
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do
		if not unplaced[list[i]] then table.remove(list, i) end
	end
	-- top up from the most valuable, so a fresh session opens with your best six
	if #list < HOTBAR_SLOTS then
		local inList = {}
		for _, uid in ipairs(list) do inList[uid] = true end
		local rest = {}
		for uid, e in pairs(unplaced) do
			if not inList[uid] then rest[#rest + 1] = e end
		end
		table.sort(rest, function(a, b) return valueOf(a) > valueOf(b) end)
		for _, e in ipairs(rest) do
			if #list >= HOTBAR_SLOTS then break end
			list[#list + 1] = e.Uid
		end
	end

	local want = {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(list) do
		want[uid] = true
		if not have[uid] then
			makeTool(player, unplaced[uid]).Parent = backpack
		end
	end
	for uid, tool in pairs(have) do
		if not want[uid] then tool:Destroy() end
	end

	-- Gianluca's Keys are NOT tools. They are shown as a row in the backpack UI
	-- (see BackpackClient) and cannot be equipped, held or used. An earlier pass
	-- did make them real Tools, so purge any that are still lying around in a
	-- profile from that version.
	for _, container in ipairs({ backpack, player.Character }) do
		if container then
			for _, t in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("KeyTool") then t:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Pull a brainrot out of the grid into the hotbar and equip it. Evicts the
-- oldest slot when full -- never the one currently in hand, and never the one
-- being brought in.
function InventoryHandler.BringToHand(player, uid)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local entry
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.Uid == uid and not e.PadIndex then entry = e break end
	end
	if not entry then return end   -- not owned, or it is placed on the base

	local held = equippedUidOf(player)
	local list = hotbarList(player)
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do
		if list[i] == uid then table.remove(list, i) end
	end
	list[#list + 1] = uid

	-- Evict the LEAST VALUABLE slot, not the oldest. Oldest-first looks tidy but
	-- the initial fill is in value order, so it threw out your best earner the
	-- very first time you pulled anything up from the grid.
	local byUid = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.Uid then byUid[e.Uid] = e end
	end
	while #list > HOTBAR_SLOTS do
		local worstI, worstV = nil, math.huge
		for i = 1, #list do
			local u = list[i]
			if u ~= held and u ~= uid then      -- never drop what is in hand or incoming
				local v = byUid[u] and valueOf(byUid[u]) or 0
				if v < worstV then worstV, worstI = v, i end
			end
		end
		table.remove(list, worstI or 1)
	end

	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)

	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if hum and backpack then
		for _, t in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("Uid") == uid then
				hum:EquipTool(t)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function InventoryHandler.Init()
	-- client resolves which pad the player clicked and sends it here
	remotes.PlaceBrainrot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, uid, padIndex)
		if typeof(uid) ~= "number" then return end
		if padIndex ~= nil and typeof(padIndex) ~= "number" then return end
		-- NaN sails through range checks (NaN < 1 and NaN > limit are both false) and
		-- then corrupts the profile as a table key: unsellable item, dead income tick,
		-- unserialisable save. `% 1 ~= 0` also rejects inf (inf % 1 is NaN) and
		-- fractional indexes in one stroke.
		if padIndex ~= nil and (padIndex ~= padIndex or padIndex % 1 ~= 0) then return end
		place(player, uid, padIndex and math.floor(padIndex) or nil)
	end)

	-- client detects the StorePrompt and asks us to store it (validated here)
	remotes.StoreBrainrot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, uid)
		if typeof(uid) ~= "number" then return end
		local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
		if not plot then return end
		local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
		if not pads then return end
		local owned = false
		for _, m in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Uid") == uid then owned = true break end
		end
		if not owned then return end -- must be a brainrot on your own base
		store(player, uid)
	end)

	-- the grid asks for a brainrot that has no Tool yet
	remotes.EquipBrainrot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, uid)
		if typeof(uid) ~= "number" then return end
		InventoryHandler.BringToHand(player, uid)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) hotbar[p] = nil end)

	local function hook(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.6)
			InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.delay(0.6, function() InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player) end)
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hook(p) end

	-- claiming a base restores models, so refresh which tools should remain
	PlayerDataManager.OnPlotClaimed = function(player)
		task.defer(function() InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player) end)
	end

	print("InventoryHandler online")
end

return InventoryHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/LeaderboardBoards.lua =====
-- LeaderboardBoards: the three physical boards in the lodge plaza.
--
-- Presentation only. LeaderboardHandler owns the data and calls back here after every
-- fetch; this module knows nothing about DataStores and vice versa.
--
-- Built at RUNTIME, not authored into the place. Rebuilding on every server start means
-- the geometry can never drift from the code, and Build() destroys the old folder first
-- so it is safe to call twice.
--
-- Server-built SurfaceGuis, which deviates from PlotSignClient's "server owns the parts,
-- client owns the GUI" split. That split exists because six plot signs update every few
-- ticks with per-plot data; these repaint once a minute with identical content for
-- everyone, so the replication is trivial and one server-side source of truth is both
-- simpler and guaranteed visible even if a client script fails.

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Leaderboard = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.LeaderboardHandler)

local M = {}
local C = Color3.fromRGB

--=============================== placement ================================--
-- The lodge interior is clear across its full width between z=-220 and z=-240, and this
-- row faces the 23-stud doorway at (0, -208): you see all three the moment you walk in.
-- Bump this whenever the layout below changes. Build() rebuilds any folder stamped with
-- an older version, but LEAVES a current one alone -- which is what lets the boards be
-- authored into the place and dragged around in Studio without a server start
-- snapping them back to these coordinates.
local LAYOUT_VERSION = 3

local BOARD_Z      = -240
local FLOOR_Y      = 5.2      -- PlazaFloor top (centre 4.7, 1.0 thick)
local BOARD_W      = 10       -- 1.5x smaller than the 15x14 first pass
local BOARD_H      = 9.33
local SLOTS        = { -14, 0, 14 }   -- 14 apart, just clear of the 13.4-wide cap
local PPS          = 50       -- SurfaceGui pixels per stud -> 500 x 466 canvas

local ROWS_TOTAL   = 50
local ROW_PX       = 34       -- taller rows: the text got bigger, the board got smaller
local TEXT_PX      = 22       -- was 16

--================================= palette ================================--
local WOOD_DARK  = C(104, 66, 38)
local WOOD_MID   = C(170, 116, 68)
local PANEL_TOP  = C(40, 62, 42)
local PANEL_BOT  = C(17, 29, 20)
local INK        = C(12, 9, 7)
local CREAM      = C(255, 242, 219)
local MUTED      = C(198, 176, 152)
local AMBER1     = C(255, 200, 96)
local RANK_COLOR = {
	[1] = C(255, 214, 92),    -- gold
	[2] = C(214, 222, 232),   -- silver
	[3] = C(226, 152, 92),    -- bronze
}

--============================== build helpers =============================--
local function part(parent, name, size, cf, color, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Wood
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = true
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function label(parent, name, size, pos, text, color, textSize, align)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Size = size
	l.Position = pos
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.TextSize = textSize
	l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	l.TextStrokeColor3 = INK
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
	l.RichText = false          -- names are user content; never let one inject markup
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

--============================== one board =================================--
-- Returns { Rows = { {rank=,name=,value=}, ... } } so Paint can address the labels
-- without walking the tree every refresh.
local function buildBoard(parent, board, x)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Leaderboard_" .. board.Id
	model.Parent = parent

	-- Rotated a half turn so the part's FRONT face (local -Z) points to world +Z, at the
	-- doorway. Using NormalId.Front on a turned part is far easier to reason about later
	-- than leaving it square and hanging the GUI off the Back face.
	local facing = CFrame.new(x, 0, BOARD_Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
	local centreY = FLOOR_Y + BOARD_H / 2

	local panel = part(model, "Panel", Vector3.new(BOARD_W, BOARD_H, 0.6),
		facing * CFrame.new(0, centreY, 0), PANEL_BOT, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	-- MUST be queryable. SurfaceGui input is delivered by raycasting the mouse against
	-- the part; with CanQuery off the ray passes straight through and the scroll wheel
	-- does nothing. The rest of the frame stays non-queryable.
	panel.CanQuery = true
	model.PrimaryPart = panel

	-- frame: posts, cap, plinth
	local postX = BOARD_W / 2 + 0.5
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		part(model, "Post", Vector3.new(1.0, BOARD_H + 2.4, 1.0),
			facing * CFrame.new(sx * postX, FLOOR_Y + (BOARD_H + 2.4) / 2 - 0.6, 0), WOOD_DARK)
	end
	part(model, "Cap", Vector3.new(BOARD_W + 3.4, 1.1, 1.6),
		facing * CFrame.new(0, FLOOR_Y + BOARD_H + 1.3, 0), WOOD_MID)
	part(model, "Plinth", Vector3.new(BOARD_W + 3.4, 0.8, 2.0),
		facing * CFrame.new(0, FLOOR_Y + 0.4, 0), WOOD_MID)
	part(model, "Backer", Vector3.new(BOARD_W + 0.6, BOARD_H + 0.6, 0.3),
		facing * CFrame.new(0, centreY, 0.4), WOOD_DARK)

	--------------------------------------------------------------- surface gui
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "Board"
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = PPS
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Parent = panel

	local W, H = BOARD_W * PPS, BOARD_H * PPS   -- 500 x 466

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_TOP
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = gui
	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(PANEL_TOP, PANEL_BOT)
	grad.Rotation = 90
	grad.Parent = bg

	-- title
	local TITLE_H = 46
	local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
	titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TITLE_H)
	titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = C(28, 44, 30)
	titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	titleBar.Parent = bg
	local t = label(titleBar, "Title", UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0),
		board.Icon .. "  " .. board.Title, AMBER1, 24, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	t.TextScaled = true      -- "MOST BRAINROTS CAUGHT" would clip a 500px bar otherwise
	t.TextWrapped = false

	local underline = Instance.new("Frame")
	underline.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
	underline.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TITLE_H)
	underline.BackgroundColor3 = AMBER1
	underline.BorderSizePixel = 0
	underline.Parent = bg

	local FOOT_H = 18
	local listTop = TITLE_H + 5
	local listH = H - listTop - FOOT_H

	-- SCROLLING list, single column. At 22px text on a 500px board only ~12 rows fit,
	-- so the other 38 live below the fold. Roblox routes mouse wheel and touch drag to a
	-- SurfaceGui when the cursor is over the surface -- which is why the Panel part must
	-- keep CanQuery on, or the ray never reaches it and the wheel does nothing.
	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "List"
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, listH)
	list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listTop)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Active = true
	list.ScrollingEnabled = true
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 8
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = AMBER1
	list.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.35
	list.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ROWS_TOTAL * ROW_PX)
	list.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable
	list.Parent = bg

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
	layout.Parent = list

	local rows = {}
	for i = 1, ROWS_TOTAL do
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = "Row" .. i
		row.LayoutOrder = i
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, ROW_PX)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = C(255, 255, 255)
		-- faint zebra banding; 50 unbroken lines of text is unreadable at a glance
		row.BackgroundTransparency = (i % 2 == 0) and 0.94 or 1
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.Visible = false
		row.Parent = list

		rows[i] = {
			frame = row,
			rank  = label(row, "Rank", UDim2.new(0, 58, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
				"", MUTED, TEXT_PX, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left),
			-- "PlayerName", not "Name": a child called Name is shadowed by Instance.Name,
			-- so row.Name would return the string "Row7" instead of the label.
			name  = label(row, "PlayerName", UDim2.new(1, -216, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 0),
				"", CREAM, TEXT_PX, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left),
			value = label(row, "Value", UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0), UDim2.new(1, -146, 0, 0),
				"", AMBER1, TEXT_PX, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right),
		}
	end

	-- an empty-state line, hidden as soon as real rows arrive
	local empty = label(bg, "Empty", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listTop + 40),
		"no data yet", MUTED, 22, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	-- footer stamp so players can tell a stale board from an empty one
	local foot = label(bg, "Updated", UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, FOOT_H), UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -FOOT_H),
		"", MUTED, 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

	return { Rows = rows, Empty = empty, Foot = foot, List = list, Board = board }
end

--================================= painting ===============================--
local built = {}   -- [boardId] = the table returned by buildBoard

function M.Paint(boardId, data)
	local b = built[boardId]
	if not b then return end
	local n = #data
	b.Empty.Visible = (n == 0)
	-- Send the list back to rank 1 on a refresh. Leaving a player parked at rank 40 while
	-- the rows underneath them change identity is worse than losing their scroll position.
	if b.List then b.List.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) end
	for i, row in ipairs(b.Rows) do
		local e = data[i]
		if e then
			row.frame.Visible = true
			row.rank.Text = "#" .. e.Rank
			row.rank.TextColor3 = RANK_COLOR[e.Rank] or MUTED
			row.name.Text = e.Name
			row.name.TextColor3 = RANK_COLOR[e.Rank] or CREAM
			row.value.Text = Leaderboard.FormatValue(b.Board.Format, e.Value)
		else
			row.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
	b.Count = n
	M.TickFooter(b)
end

-- Footer carries the live countdown, so it is redrawn every second rather than only on a
-- fetch. Split out so both the ticker and Paint can call it.
function M.TickFooter(b)
	if not b or not b.Foot then return end
	local secs = math.ceil(Leaderboard.SecondsUntilRefresh())
	if secs < 0 then secs = 0 end
	local left = (b.Count and b.Count > 0) and ("top " .. b.Count) or "waiting for data"
	b.Foot.Text = ("%s  \u{2022}  next update %d:%02d"):format(left, math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
end

-- Adopt boards that are already in the place instead of rebuilding them, so a folder
-- authored in Studio (and dragged wherever the owner likes) survives a server start.
-- Returns nil if anything is missing or renamed, in which case the caller rebuilds.
local function bindExisting(folder)
	local found = {}
	for _, board in ipairs(Leaderboard.BOARDS) do
		local model = folder:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard_" .. board.Id)
		local panel = model and (model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChild("Panel"))
		local gui = panel and panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
		local bg = gui and gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
		local list = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("List")
		if not (bg and list) then return nil end

		local rows = {}
		for i = 1, ROWS_TOTAL do
			local r = list:FindFirstChild("Row" .. i)
			local rank = r and r:FindFirstChild("Rank")
			local nm = r and r:FindFirstChild("PlayerName")
			local val = r and r:FindFirstChild("Value")
			if not (rank and nm and val) then return nil end
			rows[i] = { frame = r, rank = rank, name = nm, value = val }
		end

		if panel then panel.CanQuery = true end   -- older builds had this off
		found[board.Id] = {
			Rows = rows,
			Empty = bg:FindFirstChild("Empty"),
			Foot = bg:FindFirstChild("Updated"),
			List = list,
			Board = board,
		}
	end
	return found
end

-- force: rebuild at the coded coordinates even if a current-version folder exists
function M.Build(force)
	local gw = Workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld") or Workspace
	local existing = gw:FindFirstChild("Leaderboards")

	if existing and not force and existing:GetAttribute("LayoutVersion") == LAYOUT_VERSION then
		local bound = bindExisting(existing)
		if bound then
			built = bound
			return existing, "reused"
		end
	end

	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	built = {}

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Leaderboards"
	folder:SetAttribute("LayoutVersion", LAYOUT_VERSION)
	folder.Parent = gw

	for i, board in ipairs(Leaderboard.BOARDS) do
		built[board.Id] = buildBoard(folder, board, SLOTS[i] or (i - 2) * (BOARD_W + 4))
	end
	return folder, "built"
end

function M.Init()
	M.Build()
	Leaderboard.OnUpdate(function(boardId, rows)
		M.Paint(boardId, rows)
	end)

	-- one-second countdown on every board, so players can see the refresh coming
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for _, b in pairs(built) do
				M.TickFooter(b)
			end
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)

	print(("LeaderboardBoards online (refresh every %ds)"):format(Leaderboard.RefreshInterval()))
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/LeaderboardHandler.lua =====
-- LeaderboardHandler: three global top-50 boards, shared across every server.
--
-- Boards: lifetime cash EARNED, lifetime TIME PLAYED, lifetime BRAINROTS CAUGHT.
-- Each is an OrderedDataStore, which is the only Roblox primitive that can sort across
-- servers. A plain DataStore cannot answer "who are the top 50" at all.
--
-- ============================ HOW IT STAYS CHEAP ============================
-- Two loops, both slow on purpose:
--   PUBLISH  every PUBLISH_EVERY seconds, write the online players' three stats.
--   FETCH    every FETCH_EVERY seconds, pull the top 50 of each board and repaint.
-- Nothing here runs on the throw path, the income tick, or any player action. A busy
-- server writes 3 keys per player per publish, which sits far inside the
-- 60 + 10*players per minute budget even with a full lobby.
--
-- OrderedDataStore only stores INTEGERS (int64). Every value is floored before it is
-- written; TotalEarned is a double in Lua and would silently fail the write otherwise.
--
-- ============================== FAILURE POLICY ==============================
-- Fail SOFT and stay quiet. A leaderboard is decoration: if DataStores are down (or
-- the place has no API access, which is the default in a fresh Studio session) the
-- boards show "no data yet" and everything else in the game carries on. Every request
-- is pcall'd, and a global backoff stops a dead endpoint being hammered.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)

local M = {}

--================================= tuning ==================================--
local TOP_N          = 50
local PUBLISH_EVERY  = 120   -- seconds between writing online players' stats
local FETCH_EVERY    = 60    -- seconds between re-reading the top 50
local TIME_TICK      = 10    -- seconds of playtime credited per tick
local FAIL_BACKOFF   = 45    -- seconds to stand down after a DataStore error

-- Bump the version suffix to reset a board. Old keys are simply orphaned.
M.BOARDS = {
	{
		Id    = "Earned",
		-- v2: was TotalEarned, which counts PRODUCTION only and so read ~$400B low for
		-- anyone who had sold a brainrot. LifetimeEarned counts every source.
		Store = "LB_Earned_v2",
		Title = "TOP EARNERS",
		Icon  = "\u{1F4B0}",
		Field = "LifetimeEarned",
		Format = "cash",
	},
	{
		Id    = "Time",
		Store = "LB_Time_v1",
		Title = "MOST TIME PLAYED",
		Icon  = "\u{23F1}",
		Field = "TimePlayed",
		Format = "duration",
	},
	{
		Id    = "Caught",
		Store = "LB_Caught_v1",
		Title = "MOST BRAINROTS CAUGHT",
		Icon  = "\u{1F3A3}",
		Field = "BrainrotsCaught",
		Format = "count",
	},
}

--================================== state ==================================--
local stores = {}          -- [boardId] = OrderedDataStore
local cached = {}          -- [boardId] = { { Rank, UserId, Name, Value }, ... }
local nameCache = {}       -- [userId] = display name
local gate = 0             -- os.clock() before which we make no requests at all
local lastFetch = 0        -- os.clock() of the last SUCCESSFUL refresh, for the countdown
local warned = false
local started = false
local listeners = {}       -- functions called with (boardId, rows) after every fetch

-- GetOrderedDataStore itself throws when the place has no API access, so even
-- acquiring the handles is guarded. A nil store means that board stays empty.
for _, b in ipairs(M.BOARDS) do
	local ok, s = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore(b.Store)
	end)
	if ok then stores[b.Id] = s end
	cached[b.Id] = {}
end

local function offline(err)
	gate = os.clock() + FAIL_BACKOFF
	if not warned then
		warned = true
		warn("[LeaderboardHandler] DataStore unavailable (" .. tostring(err)
			.. "); boards will stay empty until it recovers")
	end
end

--============================== value display ==============================--
-- Kept here rather than in NumberFormat: "3d 04h" is a leaderboard-only shape, and
-- NumberFormat.Short is about cash magnitudes.
local function formatDuration(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0), 0)
	local d = math.floor(seconds / 86400)
	local h = math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600)
	local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	if d > 0 then return ("%dd %02dh"):format(d, h) end
	if h > 0 then return ("%dh %02dm"):format(h, m) end
	return ("%dm"):format(m)
end

local function formatCount(n)
	n = math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0)
	-- thousands separators; a catch count never needs abbreviating
	local s = tostring(n)
	local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	return (out:gsub("^,", ""))
end

function M.FormatValue(kind, value)
	if kind == "duration" then return formatDuration(value) end
	if kind == "count" then return formatCount(value) end
	local NumberFormat = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.NumberFormat)
	return "$" .. NumberFormat.Short(value)
end

--=============================== name lookup ===============================--
-- Yields on a miss. Only ever called from the fetch loop, never from a player action.
local function nameFor(userId)
	local hit = nameCache[userId]
	if hit then return hit end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	if not ok or type(name) ~= "string" then
		-- an online player is authoritative and free; otherwise show the id
		local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		name = plr and plr.Name or ("User " .. tostring(userId))
		if not plr then return name end   -- do NOT cache a fallback: retry next fetch
	end
	nameCache[userId] = name
	return name
end

--================================ publishing ===============================--
-- One player's three stats. Values only ever move up, so a stale write from a laggy
-- server cannot lower a score -- SetAsync is fine and UpdateAsync would cost double.
local function publishPlayer(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or data.__noSave then return end   -- read-only session: never publish
	for _, b in ipairs(M.BOARDS) do
		local store = stores[b.Id]
		local value = math.floor(tonumber(data[b.Field]) or 0)
		if store and value > 0 then
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), value)
			end)
			if not ok then offline(err); return end
		end
	end
end

function M.PublishAll()
	if os.clock() < gate then return end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		publishPlayer(player)
	end
end

--================================= fetching ================================--
local function fetchBoard(b)
	local store = stores[b.Id]
	if not store then return nil end
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return store:GetSortedAsync(false, TOP_N)   -- false = descending
	end)
	if not ok then offline(pages); return nil end

	local ok2, page = pcall(function() return pages:GetCurrentPage() end)
	if not ok2 then offline(page); return nil end

	local rows = {}
	for i, entry in ipairs(page) do
		local userId = tonumber(entry.key)
		if userId then
			rows[#rows + 1] = {
				Rank = i,
				UserId = userId,
				Name = nameFor(userId),
				Value = entry.value,
			}
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-- Seconds until the next scheduled refresh, for the on-board countdown. Counts from the
-- last SUCCESSFUL fetch, so during a DataStore outage it keeps ticking over rather than
-- freezing on a number that has stopped meaning anything.
function M.SecondsUntilRefresh()
	if lastFetch == 0 then return FETCH_EVERY end
	local left = FETCH_EVERY - (os.clock() - lastFetch)
	-- wrap instead of clamping at 0: a slow fetch should not park the display on "0s"
	if left < 0 then left = left % FETCH_EVERY end
	return left
end

function M.RefreshInterval()
	return FETCH_EVERY
end

function M.Refresh()
	if os.clock() < gate then return end
	for _, b in ipairs(M.BOARDS) do
		local rows = fetchBoard(b)
		if rows then
			cached[b.Id] = rows
			lastFetch = os.clock()
			warned = false
			for _, fn in ipairs(listeners) do
				pcall(fn, b.Id, rows)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- current top-50 for a board; never nil, possibly empty
function M.Get(boardId)
	return cached[boardId] or {}
end

-- called with (boardId, rows) after every successful fetch, and once on registration
-- so a board added later paints immediately instead of waiting a full cycle
function M.OnUpdate(fn)
	table.insert(listeners, fn)
	for _, b in ipairs(M.BOARDS) do
		if #(cached[b.Id] or {}) > 0 then pcall(fn, b.Id, cached[b.Id]) end
	end
end

--=================================== init ==================================--
function M.Init()
	if started then return end
	started = true

	-- playtime: credited in small increments rather than measured across a session,
	-- so a crash, a rejoin, or Main saving before us can cost at most TIME_TICK seconds
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(TIME_TICK)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
				if data then
					data.TimePlayed = (data.TimePlayed or 0) + TIME_TICK
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(PUBLISH_EVERY)
			pcall(M.PublishAll)
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(2)             -- let the first players load in before the first read
		while true do
			pcall(M.Refresh)
			task.wait(FETCH_EVERY)
		end
	end)

	-- last write before they go, so a long session is not lost to the publish interval
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		pcall(publishPlayer, player)
	end)

	print("LeaderboardHandler online")
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/LimitedStock.lua =====
-- LimitedStock: a hard, universe-wide mint cap for the rarest brainrots.
--
-- Why a cap and not just a smaller FixedChance:
--   A probability does not create scarcity, throughput does. At 1 in 1,000,000 an
--   endgame player needs ~550 hours of perfect throws per catch -- which reads as
--   "nobody has it" at 50 players and "fifteen a day" at 5,000. Lowering the odds only
--   moves that threshold. A cap is the only thing that holds no matter how big the game
--   gets, because it bounds the TOTAL rather than the rate.
--
-- The odds and the cap do different jobs and both matter: FixedChance decides how long
-- the window stays open, MAX decides how many exist once it closes.
--
-- Counts MINTS, not current holders. Selling or trading a Pete never frees a slot --
-- "only 5 were ever created" is the property we want, and it survives players quitting.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- [config entry Name] = how many may EVER be granted, across every server, forever.
-- Ladder tracks the Secret tier's internal power ladder: the weakest Secret is
-- the most common trophy, the strongest is nearly one-of-a-kind. Once a cap is
-- hit the name is trade-only forever -- that is the point.
-- Must stay in exact lockstep with SupplySchedule.CAPPED (the shared name set
-- the Index badges read).
-- Roster rebuilt 2026-07-25: these are the 11 Secrets of the new pack roster,
-- ordered by their income ladder so the weakest Secret is the most common
-- trophy and the strongest is nearly one-of-a-kind. Pete sits alone in God tier.
local MAX = {
	["Tralalero Tralala"] = 500,
	["Los Tralaleritos"] = 400,
	["La Vacca Saturno Saturnita"] = 320,
	["Las Vaquitas Saturnitas"] = 250,
	["La Grande Combinasion"] = 200,
	["Los Combinasionas"] = 150,
	["Matteo"] = 120,
	["Odin Din Din Dun"] = 90,
	["Secret Lucky Block"] = 65,
	["Brainrot God Lucky Block"] = 45,
	["Admin Lucky Block"] = 25,
	["Secret Pete"] = 5,
}

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BrainrotSkip_LimitedStock_v1")
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60

local M = {}
M.MAX = MAX

-- [name] = minted count. Deliberately allowed to be stale: it only gates the cheap
-- non-yielding pre-check. TryClaim is the authority.
local minted = {}

function M.IsLimited(name)
	return MAX[name] ~= nil
end

-- Cheap and NEVER yields -- safe to call on the throw path. May be stale by up to
-- REFRESH_SECONDS, and returns false while the count is still unknown, so a claim can
-- still be attempted and correctly refused by TryClaim.
function M.SoldOut(name)
	local cap = MAX[name]
	if not cap then return false end
	local have = minted[name]
	if not have then return false end
	return have >= cap
end

-- Authoritative reservation. YIELDS (UpdateAsync), so call it only when a roll has
-- actually hit -- at 1e-6 that is close to never, which is what keeps this off the
-- per-throw budget entirely.
--
-- UpdateAsync is atomic per key across every server, so two players hitting the last
-- slot in the same instant cannot both win: the second transform sees the first's write.
function M.TryClaim(name)
	local cap = MAX[name]
	if not cap then return true end   -- not a limited item: nothing to reserve

	local granted = false
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(name, function(current)
			current = tonumber(current) or 0
			if current >= cap then
				granted = false
				return nil          -- nil cancels the write: no wasted budget on a refusal
			end
			granted = true
			return current + 1
		end)
	end)

	if not ok then
		-- Fail CLOSED. An outage that let claims through would over-mint permanently and
		-- there is no way to un-mint; refusing costs one player one roll. Loud on purpose.
		warn(("[LimitedStock] UpdateAsync failed for %q (%s) -- refusing the claim to protect the cap")
			:format(name, tostring(err)))
		return false
	end

	if granted then
		minted[name] = (minted[name] or 0) + 1
		print(("[LimitedStock] MINTED %q -- %d of %d now exist"):format(name, minted[name], cap))
	end
	return granted
end

-- nil while the count has not been read yet
function M.Remaining(name)
	local cap = MAX[name]
	if not cap then return nil end
	local have = minted[name]
	if not have then return nil end
	return math.max(cap - have, 0)
end

function M.Init()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			for name in pairs(MAX) do
				local ok, v = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync(name) end)
				if ok then minted[name] = tonumber(v) or 0 end
			end
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
		end
	end)
	print("LimitedStock online")
end

return M


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/MaxwellQuest.lua =====
-- MaxwellQuest: Maxwell the cat's secret questline. Unlocks at Rebirth 3 (below
-- that he only meows -- see CatDialogueClient). Two steps, then a reward:
--   Step 1: discover EVERY Secret-rarity brainrot in the index (one of each).
--   Step 2: reach Rebirth 25.
--   Reward: one God-rarity "Maxwell" brainrot (Unique, questline-only).
--
-- State lives in data.MaxwellQuest:
--   0 = not accepted (locked below Rebirth 3; offered at 3+)
--   1 = collecting Secrets -- progress = how many Secret names are in data.Discovered
--   2 = have every Secret -- now reach Rebirth 25
--   3 = reached Rebirth 25 -- reward ready to claim from Maxwell
--   4 = done, God Maxwell awarded
--
-- The client drives the dialogue (CatDialogueClient) and fires MaxwellTalk with an
-- action ("accept" for 0->1, "claim" for 3->4); the server validates every
-- transition. Progress is pushed back via MaxwellState so the dialogue and the
-- quest tracker always show the real, server-authoritative numbers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local InventoryHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.InventoryHandler)
local BrainrotMover = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.BrainrotMover)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local UNLOCK_REBIRTHS = 3      -- quest is offered at/above this rebirth count
local REBIRTHS_NEEDED = 25     -- rebirth milestone for step 2
local REWARD_NAME     = "Maxwell"  -- God-rarity questline reward (BrainrotConfig)

-- Step 1 is "have one of every Secret in your index" -- built from the config so it
-- tracks the roster automatically (currently the 11 Secret-rarity names).
local SECRET_NAMES = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	if e.Rarity == "Secret" then SECRET_NAMES[#SECRET_NAMES + 1] = e.Name end
end
local SECRET_TOTAL = #SECRET_NAMES

-- how many distinct Secret names sit in the player's discovery index
local function countSecretsDiscovered(data)
	local d = data.Discovered
	if type(d) ~= "table" then return 0 end
	local n = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(SECRET_NAMES) do
		if d[name] then n += 1 end
	end
	return n
end

local MaxwellQuest = {}

local function getRemote(name, class)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new(class); r.Name = name; r.Parent = remotes end
	return r
end
local talkRemote  = getRemote("MaxwellTalk", "RemoteEvent")
local stateRemote = getRemote("MaxwellState", "RemoteEvent")

-- Push the whole quest picture. Step/Of are generic progress numbers the quest
-- tracker reads straight through for its pill, so the card shows live secrets x/N
-- then rebirth x/25 without the tracker needing to know anything Maxwell-specific.
local function sendState(player, note)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local st = data.MaxwellQuest or 0
	local secrets = countSecretsDiscovered(data)
	local rebirths = data.Rebirths or 0
	local step, of
	if st == 1 then step, of = secrets, SECRET_TOTAL
	elseif st == 2 then step, of = math.min(rebirths, REBIRTHS_NEEDED), REBIRTHS_NEEDED
	elseif st == 3 then step, of = 1, 1 end
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, {
		State = st,
		Secrets = secrets,
		SecretsNeeded = SECRET_TOTAL,
		Rebirths = rebirths,
		RebirthsNeeded = REBIRTHS_NEEDED,
		Unlock = UNLOCK_REBIRTHS,
		Step = step,
		Of = of,
		Note = note,
	})
end
MaxwellQuest.SendState = sendState

-- Advance state 2 -> 3 the instant the Rebirth bar is met. Called from every place
-- a rebirth total might already satisfy it (join, reaching step 2 while already
-- past 25, a fresh rebirth) so the player is never stuck on a bar they've cleared.
local function checkRebirthGate(player, data)
	if (data.MaxwellQuest or 0) == 2 and (data.Rebirths or 0) >= REBIRTHS_NEEDED then
		data.MaxwellQuest = 3
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Advance state 1 -> 2 once every Secret is in the index. Chains into the rebirth
-- gate so a maxed-out player can clear both at once.
local function checkSecretGate(player, data)
	if (data.MaxwellQuest or 0) == 1 and countSecretsDiscovered(data) >= SECRET_TOTAL then
		data.MaxwellQuest = 2
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
		checkRebirthGate(player, data)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- talking at Rebirth 3+ accepts the quest; talking any time re-checks both gates
-- (covers Secrets/rebirths gained via trades or offline, not just fresh catches).
local function accept(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	if (data.MaxwellQuest or 0) == 0 and (data.Rebirths or 0) >= UNLOCK_REBIRTHS then
		data.MaxwellQuest = 1
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	end
	checkSecretGate(player, data)
	checkRebirthGate(player, data)
	sendState(player)
end

-- claiming the reward once the whole quest is cleared
local function claim(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	checkRebirthGate(player, data)
	if (data.MaxwellQuest or 0) ~= 3 then sendState(player); return end

	local result = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	-- Unique cap, belt-and-braces. The state gate already blocks a second claim, but
	-- a player could hold one from a trade while their own quest is still open.
	if not BrainrotMover.WithinUniqueCap(REWARD_NAME,
		BrainrotMover.CountOwned(data, REWARD_NAME), 0, 1) then
		if result then
			result:FireClient(player, { Success = false,
				Message = "You already have a Maxwell." })
		end
		data.MaxwellQuest = 4
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
		sendState(player)
		return
	end

	table.insert(data.Brainrots, {
		Name = REWARD_NAME, PadIndex = nil, Pending = 0, Mutation = nil,
		Uid = PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(data),
	})
	if data.Discovered then data.Discovered[REWARD_NAME] = true end
	data.MaxwellQuest = 4
	InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	if result then
		result:FireClient(player, { Success = true,
			Message = "\u{1F408} Maxwell handed you the GOD Maxwell brainrot!" })
	end
	sendState(player, "reward")
end

-- called from ThrowHandler.revealCatch for EVERY catch (guarded by a pcall there).
-- ThrowHandler sets data.Discovered[name] BEFORE this runs, so a freshly-caught
-- Secret is already counted here.
function MaxwellQuest.NotifyCatch(player, tierName)
	if tierName ~= "Secret" then return end
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or (data.MaxwellQuest or 0) ~= 1 then return end
	if checkSecretGate(player, data) then
		sendState(player, "secretset")   -- just completed the whole set
	else
		sendState(player, "secret")      -- a Secret discovered; push new progress
	end
end

-- called from RebirthHandler right after a rebirth increments (guarded by a pcall)
function MaxwellQuest.NotifyRebirth(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	if checkRebirthGate(player, data) then
		sendState(player, "rebirthdone")
	else
		sendState(player)
	end
end

function MaxwellQuest.Init()
	talkRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
		if action == "claim" then
			claim(player)
		else
			accept(player)
		end
	end)

	local function onJoin(player)
		task.spawn(function()
			local tries = 0
			while not PlayerDataManager.Get(player) and tries < 60 do task.wait(0.1); tries += 1 end
			local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
			if data then
				task.wait(1)
				checkSecretGate(player, data)    -- completed the set offline (trade etc.)
				checkRebirthGate(player, data)   -- crossed Rebirth 25 while away
				sendState(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(p) end

	print("MaxwellQuest online")
end

return MaxwellQuest


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/MintRegistry.lua =====
-- MintRegistry: verifiable identity for the brainrots that are worth arguing over.
--
-- Every catch worth tracking is stamped with a SERIAL -- its mint number inside
-- its own (Name, Mutation) class -- and each class carries a live EXISTS count
-- (minted minus burned). Together they turn "a Golden Cappuccino Assassino" into
-- "#47, and only 312 still exist": a number a trade can actually be argued
-- against, and the thing that makes a rare catch feel OWNED rather than farmed.
--
-- ========================= WHY IT IS BUILT THIS WAY ==========================
-- Two requirements pull against each other:
--
--   1. A serial must be unique across EVERY live server. Two servers both handing
--      out #47 for the same class destroys the entire point of a serial.
--   2. The catch path must never yield on, or fail because of, a DataStore. A
--      player who lands a Secret gets their Secret -- the serial is a garnish.
--
-- So serials are NOT allocated one call at a time. Each server RESERVES a block
-- of serials per class in a single UpdateAsync, then hands them out from memory
-- with zero yields, refilling the block in the background before it runs dry.
-- The stored allocator high-water mark (`a`) only ever moves forward, so two
-- servers can never be handed overlapping blocks -- that is what buys uniqueness
-- without a round trip per catch.
--
-- Deliberate consequence: a server that reserves 4 and uses 1 leaves a gap, so
-- serial numbers can run slightly AHEAD of the true mint count. That is the right
-- trade -- Get() reports honest minted/exists counts separately, a gap in the
-- numbering costs nothing, whereas a duplicate serial or a catch stuck behind a
-- DataStore call would cost everything. Gaps are kept small two ways: block size
-- tracks observed demand, and unused block tails are handed BACK at shutdown
-- (safe, because the rollback only applies when nobody else has allocated since).
--
-- Every DataStore touch is pcall'd and the module is fail-open: in Studio without
-- API access every call errors, and the correct behaviour there is simply that no
-- serials appear. Mint() returns nil, nothing throws, nothing blocks a catch, and
-- a global backoff stops a dead store from being hammered.
--
-- WIRING -- ServerScriptService.Main needs:
--     local MintRegistry = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.MintRegistry)
--     MintRegistry.Init()
-- Init() is idempotent AND self-starts on first use, so a missed wire-up costs
-- nothing; the explicit call just makes the lifecycle obvious next to the others.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local MintRegistry = {}

--================================= tuning ==================================--
local STORE_NAME     = "BrainrotMint_v1"
local FLUSH_INTERVAL = 60    -- seconds between flushes of dirty classes
local RESERVE_MIN    = 4     -- smallest serial block a class may reserve
local RESERVE_MAX    = 64    -- largest, so one hot class cannot hoard numbers
local REFILL_AT      = 1     -- reserve the next block once this many remain
local REQUEST_GAP    = 0.35  -- min seconds between DataStore calls (budget guard)
local KEY_COOLDOWN   = 6     -- DataStore throttles repeat WRITES to the same key
local KEY_BACKOFF    = 20    -- per-class cooldown after a failed request
local MAX_KEYS       = 600   -- soft cap on cached classes
local CLOSE_DEADLINE = 20    -- seconds we are willing to spend inside BindToClose
local CLOSE_LANES    = 8     -- parallel requests during shutdown

-- Classes worth a serial: the top tiers, or ANY mutation. Commons would
-- flood the store with keys nobody will ever quote in a trade.
local TRACKED_TIERS = { Legendary = true, Mythic = true, Secret = true, God = true }

--============================== store handle ===============================--
-- GetDataStore itself throws when the place has no API access, so even this is
-- guarded. A nil store means "registry offline": every public call still answers,
-- just without numbers.
local store
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then store = result end
end

--================================= state ===================================--
-- cache[key] = {
--   Key, Minted, Burned,        -- global totals as of the last successful sync
--   Used, PendingBurn,          -- committed locally, not yet written
--   Next, BlockEnd,             -- the serial block we are handing out from
--   PendNext, PendEnd,          -- spare block, promoted when the active one dries
--   Want,                       -- block size requested on the next request
--   Demand,                     -- mints since the last reservation (block sizing)
--   Known, Busy, Touch,
--   NextTry,                    -- backoff after a FAILURE (gated keys are dropped)
--   NoWriteBefore,              -- same-key write throttle (gated keys are requeued)
-- }
local cache = {}
local keyCount = 0

local queue, queued = {}, {}
local started = false
local closing = false
local failStreak = 0
local globalGate = 0   -- os.clock() before which we make no DataStore calls at all
local warned = false

local ensureStarted   -- forward declaration; defined next to Init()

local function now()
	return os.clock()
end

--=============================== key naming ================================--
-- djb2, folded every step so it stays well inside float precision.
local function hash32(s)
	local h = 5381
	for i = 1, #s do
		h = (h * 33 + string.byte(s, i)) % 4294967291
	end
	return h
end

-- DataStore keys cap at 50 characters. Names and mutations are alphanumeric with
-- spaces today, so the readable form survives untouched ("Tung Tung Sahur|Golden")
-- which makes the store legible when auditing supply by hand. Anything longer or
-- stranger falls back to a truncated form plus a hash so it stays collision-safe.
local function classKey(name, mutation)
	local raw = name .. "|" .. (mutation or "-")
	local safe = (raw:gsub("[^%w %-_%.|]", "_"))
	if #safe <= 50 then return safe end
	return string.sub(safe, 1, 39) .. "_" .. string.format("%010d", hash32(raw))
end

--============================== cache helpers ==============================--
-- Drop the coldest classes that hold nothing worth keeping (no unwritten mints,
-- no burns, no reserved block). Anything with unflushed state is never evicted --
-- losing it would lose real supply data.
local lastEvict = -math.huge
local function evictCold()
	-- Rate-limited: if every cached class is dirty there are no victims, and
	-- without this the sweep would re-run (and re-sort) on every single catch.
	-- Overshooting MAX_KEYS for a while is far cheaper than that.
	if now() - lastEvict < 30 then return end
	lastEvict = now()

	local victims = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(cache) do
		if not entry.Busy
			and (entry.Used or 0) == 0
			and (entry.PendingBurn or 0) == 0
			and not entry.Next
			and not entry.PendNext then
			victims[#victims + 1] = entry
		end
	end
	table.sort(victims, function(a, b) return a.Touch < b.Touch end)
	for i = 1, math.min(math.floor(MAX_KEYS * 0.25), #victims) do
		cache[victims[i].Key] = nil
		keyCount -= 1
	end
end

local function getEntry(name, mutation)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
	if type(mutation) ~= "string" or mutation == "" then mutation = nil end

	local key = classKey(name, mutation)
	local entry = cache[key]
	if not entry then
		if keyCount >= MAX_KEYS then evictCold() end
		entry = {
			Key = key, Minted = 0, Burned = 0,
			Used = 0, PendingBurn = 0,
			Want = 0, Demand = 0,
			Known = false, Busy = false, NextTry = 0,
			Touch = now(),
		}
		cache[key] = entry
		keyCount += 1
	end
	entry.Touch = now()
	return entry
end

local function enqueue(entry)
	if not store or closing then return end
	if now() < globalGate then return end   -- store is in backoff; do not pile up work
	if queued[entry.Key] then return end
	queued[entry.Key] = true
	queue[#queue + 1] = entry.Key
	ensureStarted()
end

local function remaining(entry)
	local n = 0
	if entry.Next and entry.BlockEnd then
		n += math.max(0, entry.BlockEnd - entry.Next + 1)
	end
	if entry.PendNext and entry.PendEnd then
		n += math.max(0, entry.PendEnd - entry.PendNext + 1)
	end
	return n
end

-- Ask for the next block. Sized at twice the demand seen since the last
-- reservation, so a class nobody catches stays at RESERVE_MIN (tiny gaps) while a
-- hot class stops needing a round trip every few catches.
local function wantBlock(entry)
	if entry.PendNext then return end          -- already holding a spare
	if (entry.Want or 0) > 0 then return end   -- already asked
	entry.Want = math.clamp(math.floor((entry.Demand or 0) * 2), RESERVE_MIN, RESERVE_MAX)
	enqueue(entry)
end

local function takeSerial(entry)
	if not (entry.Next and entry.BlockEnd and entry.Next <= entry.BlockEnd) then
		if entry.PendNext then
			entry.Next, entry.BlockEnd = entry.PendNext, entry.PendEnd
			entry.PendNext, entry.PendEnd = nil, nil
		end
	end
	if entry.Next and entry.BlockEnd and entry.Next <= entry.BlockEnd then
		local serial = entry.Next
		entry.Next = serial + 1
		entry.Used = (entry.Used or 0) + 1
		return serial
	end
	return nil
end

--============================== the one request ============================--
-- Commits everything this server owes for one class in a SINGLE UpdateAsync:
-- mints used, burns recorded, a new block reserved, and (on shutdown) unused
-- block tails handed back. Stored record is { a = allocated, m = minted, b = burned }.
local function processKey(key, isClose)
	local entry = cache[key]
	if not entry or not store then return end
	if entry.Busy then return end   -- the flush timer and BindToClose can collide

	local used = entry.Used or 0
	local burn = entry.PendingBurn or 0
	local want = entry.Want or 0

	-- On shutdown, give back serials we reserved but never issued. Taken BEFORE
	-- the yield and cleared immediately, so a catch landing mid-shutdown gets no
	-- serial rather than one we are in the middle of releasing.
	local ranges
	if isClose then
		want = 0
		ranges = {}
		if entry.PendNext and entry.PendNext <= entry.PendEnd then
			ranges[#ranges + 1] = { entry.PendNext, entry.PendEnd }
		end
		if entry.Next and entry.Next <= entry.BlockEnd then
			ranges[#ranges + 1] = { entry.Next, entry.BlockEnd }
		end
		entry.Next, entry.BlockEnd = nil, nil
		entry.PendNext, entry.PendEnd = nil, nil
	end

	local hasWork = used > 0 or burn > 0 or want > 0 or not entry.Known
		or (ranges ~= nil and #ranges > 0)
	if not hasWork then return end

	entry.Busy = true
	local result
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
			-- NOTE: this transform can be re-run on conflict, so it must derive
			-- everything from `old` plus the captured constants and must never
			-- mutate captured state (hence the local `taken` below).
			local a, m, b = 0, 0, 0
			if type(old) == "table" then
				a = tonumber(old.a) or 0
				m = tonumber(old.m) or 0
				b = tonumber(old.b) or 0
			end

			local changed = false
			if used > 0 then m += used; changed = true end
			if burn > 0 then b += burn; changed = true end
			if a < m then a = m; changed = true end

			-- roll the allocator back over any tail that is still the top of the
			-- range, repeatedly, so two adjacent blocks both come back
			if ranges and #ranges > 0 then
				local taken = {}
				local swept = true
				while swept do
					swept = false
					for i = 1, #ranges do
						local r = ranges[i]
						if not taken[i] and r[2] == a and (r[1] - 1) >= m then
							a = r[1] - 1
							taken[i] = true
							swept = true
							changed = true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local blockStart, blockEnd
			if want > 0 then
				blockStart = a + 1
				blockEnd = a + want
				a = blockEnd
				changed = true
			end

			result = { a = a, m = m, b = b, s = blockStart, e = blockEnd }
			if not changed then return nil end   -- pure read: cancel the write
			return { a = a, m = m, b = b }
		end)
	end)
	entry.Busy = false

	if ok then
		failStreak = 0
		entry.NextTry = 0
		-- a pure read (nothing to commit) cancels the write, so it costs no quota
		-- and needs no cooldown; anything that actually wrote does
		if used > 0 or burn > 0 or want > 0 or (ranges ~= nil and #ranges > 0) then
			entry.NoWriteBefore = now() + KEY_COOLDOWN
		end
		-- subtract only what we actually committed: anything Mint/Burn added while
		-- the call was in flight stays pending for the next flush
		entry.Used = math.max(0, (entry.Used or 0) - used)
		entry.PendingBurn = math.max(0, (entry.PendingBurn or 0) - burn)
		if want > 0 then
			entry.Want = 0
			entry.Demand = 0
		end
		if result then
			entry.Minted = result.m
			entry.Burned = result.b
			entry.Known = true
			if result.s then
				if entry.Next and entry.BlockEnd and entry.Next <= entry.BlockEnd then
					entry.PendNext, entry.PendEnd = result.s, result.e
				else
					entry.Next, entry.BlockEnd = result.s, result.e
				end
			end
		end
	else
		failStreak += 1
		entry.NextTry = now() + KEY_BACKOFF
		globalGate = now() + math.min(4 * (2 ^ math.min(failStreak, 6)), 300)
		if not warned then
			warned = true
			warn("[MintRegistry] DataStore unavailable (" .. tostring(err)
				.. "); catches will be granted WITHOUT serials until it recovers")
		end
	end
end

--============================ background workers ===========================--
local function worker()
	while not closing do
		local key = table.remove(queue, 1)
		if not key then
			task.wait(0.5)
		else
			queued[key] = nil
			local entry = cache[key]
			if not entry or not store then
				task.wait(0.05)
			elseif now() < globalGate or now() < (entry.NextTry or 0) then
				-- failure backoff (up to 300s): DROP rather than requeue. The unflushed
				-- state stays on the entry and the flush timer picks it up again, so a
				-- dead store can never spin this loop.
				task.wait(0.25)
			elseif now() < (entry.NoWriteBefore or 0) then
				-- same-key write throttle (<=6s): requeue, since a block refill waiting a
				-- whole flush cycle would starve a hot class of serials. Bounded by
				-- KEY_COOLDOWN, so this cannot spin for long.
				queued[key] = true
				queue[#queue + 1] = key
				task.wait(0.15)
			else
				pcall(processKey, key, false)
				task.wait(REQUEST_GAP)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function flushLoop()
	while not closing do
		task.wait(FLUSH_INTERVAL)
		for _, entry in pairs(cache) do
			if (entry.Used or 0) > 0 or (entry.PendingBurn or 0) > 0 or (entry.Want or 0) > 0 then
				enqueue(entry)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Shutdown flush. Bounded on purpose: BindToClose gets ~30s total and the rest of
-- the game needs some of it, so we work in parallel lanes against a deadline and
-- accept losing the tail rather than stalling the shutdown.
local function flushAll()
	if not store then return end
	closing = true

	local pending = {}
	for key, entry in pairs(cache) do
		if (entry.Used or 0) > 0
			or (entry.PendingBurn or 0) > 0
			or (entry.Next and entry.BlockEnd and entry.Next <= entry.BlockEnd)
			or (entry.PendNext and entry.PendEnd and entry.PendNext <= entry.PendEnd) then
			pending[#pending + 1] = key
		end
	end
	if #pending == 0 then return end

	local deadline = now() + CLOSE_DEADLINE
	local index = 0
	local active = 0
	for _ = 1, math.min(CLOSE_LANES, #pending) do
		active += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			while now() < deadline do
				index += 1                      -- no yield between these two lines,
				local key = pending[index]      -- so lanes never take the same key
				if not key then break end
				pcall(processKey, key, true)
			end
			active -= 1
		end)
	end
	while active > 0 and now() < deadline + 2 do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--================================ public API ===============================--

-- Is this catch worth a serial at all? Callers that BURN brainrots (fusion,
-- offerings) should gate MintRegistry.Burn on the same answer, so burns are only
-- recorded for classes that were actually minted.
function MintRegistry.IsTracked(rarityName, mutation)
	if type(mutation) == "string" and mutation ~= "" then return true end
	return TRACKED_TIERS[rarityName] == true
end

-- Warm a class's serial block WITHOUT yielding. Call this the moment you know
-- what is going to be caught; by the time Mint() runs the number is already in
-- memory. Optional -- Mint() works without it, it just misses more often.
function MintRegistry.Prepare(name, mutation)
	if not store then return end
	local entry = getEntry(name, mutation)
	if not entry then return end
	if remaining(entry) <= REFILL_AT then wantBlock(entry) end
end

-- Issue the next serial for this class, or nil if the registry has nothing
-- reserved (cold class, or DataStore down). NEVER yields and NEVER errors:
-- a nil return means "no serial this time", never "no catch this time".
function MintRegistry.Mint(name, mutation)
	local entry = getEntry(name, mutation)
	if not entry then return nil end

	local serial = takeSerial(entry)
	entry.Demand = (entry.Demand or 0) + 1   -- counts misses too, so a class that
	                                         -- keeps missing gets a bigger block
	if store and remaining(entry) <= REFILL_AT then wantBlock(entry) end
	return serial
end

-- Record that `count` (default 1) copies of this class were destroyed. Batched:
-- it only touches memory, and rides the next flush.
function MintRegistry.Burn(name, mutation, count)
	local entry = getEntry(name, mutation)
	if not entry then return end
	local n = math.floor(tonumber(count) or 1)
	if n < 1 then return end
	entry.PendingBurn = (entry.PendingBurn or 0) + n
end

-- minted, exists -- for display. Returns nil, nil when this class has never been
-- read successfully (cold cache or offline store) so UI can hide the line rather
