-- than print a confident zero. A background read is kicked off, so asking again
-- shortly afterwards answers.
function MintRegistry.Get(name, mutation)
	local entry = getEntry(name, mutation)
	if not entry then return nil, nil end
	if not entry.Known then
		enqueue(entry)
		return nil, nil
	end
	local minted = entry.Minted + (entry.Used or 0)
	local burned = entry.Burned + (entry.PendingBurn or 0)
	return minted, math.max(0, minted - burned)
end

function MintRegistry.Init()
	if started then return end
	started = true
	task.spawn(worker)
	task.spawn(flushLoop)
	pcall(function()
		game:BindToClose(function()
			pcall(flushAll)
		end)
	end)
end

ensureStarted = function()
	if not started then MintRegistry.Init() end
end

return MintRegistry


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/OfferingHandler.lua =====
-- Campfire Offering: BURN one unplaced brainrot into the fire in exchange for a
-- small PERMANENT luck bonus (see ReplicatedStorage.Modules.OfferingConfig --
-- sqrt growth, +1% per sqrt(offering), hard-capped at +50%).
--
-- Why this sink exists: fusion cannot absorb the bulk of the faucet (it needs 5
-- identical name+mutation copies and dead-ends at Rainbow), so Commons pile up
-- forever. Offerings accept EVERY tier, and because the reward is sub-linear the
-- sink keeps eating supply without ever out-earning rocks and upgrades as a luck
-- source.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local InventoryHandler = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.InventoryHandler)
local MintRegistry = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.MintRegistry)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local OfferingConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.OfferingConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local CAMPFIRE_RANGE = 16   -- identical reach to FusionHandler's campfire check
local BURN_COOLDOWN = 0.4   -- a double-click must never cost two brainrots

local validName = {}
local rarityByName = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	validName[e.Name] = true
	rarityByName[e.Name] = e.Rarity
end

local lastBurn = {}

local OfferingHandler = {}

local function label(name, mutation)
	if mutation and mutation ~= "" then return mutation .. " " .. name end
	return name
end

function OfferingHandler.Init()
	remotes.OfferBrainrot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, name, mutation)
		local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
		if not data then return end
		if typeof(name) ~= "string" or not validName[name] then return end
		if mutation ~= nil and typeof(mutation) ~= "string" then return end

		local result = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")

		local now = os.clock()
		local prev = lastBurn[player.UserId]
		if prev and now - prev < BURN_COOLDOWN then return end

		-- must be at your OWN campfire (same check as FusionHandler)
		local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player)
		if not plot then return end
		local campfire = plot:FindFirstChild("Campfire", true)
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not campfire or not hrp or (campfire.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > CAMPFIRE_RANGE then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "Stand by your campfire to offer!" }) end
			return
		end

		-- a fresh player must not be able to click themselves down to nothing
		if #data.Brainrots <= 1 then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "You can't burn your last brainrot!" }) end
			return
		end

		-- Pick the LEAST valuable UNPLACED copy of this name -- the same rule
		-- BrainrotMover.Take uses. The client sends the mutation of the row that
		-- was clicked, but selection stays deliberately NAME-based: a burn must
		-- never be able to eat a better copy than the player has spare. The
		-- client shows the exact target in its confirm step so this is visible.
		local bestIndex, bestMult
		for i, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
			if e.Name == name and e.PadIndex == nil then
				local mult = Mutations.Mult(e.Mutation)
				if not bestMult or mult < bestMult then
					bestIndex, bestMult = i, mult
				end
			end
		end
		if not bestIndex then
			if result then result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = ("No spare %s to offer -- placed ones don't count!"):format(name) }) end
			return
		end

		local entry = data.Brainrots[bestIndex]
		local burned = label(entry.Name, entry.Mutation)
		lastBurn[player.UserId] = now

		-- banked cash on the entry is PAID OUT first; burning must not destroy money
		PlayerDataManager.DrainPending(player, entry, data)
		table.remove(data.Brainrots, bestIndex)
		-- the copy is destroyed for good: record the burn so the registry's live
		-- "exists" counts stay honest. Gated on IsTracked - the same rule the
		-- mint side (ThrowHandler) uses.
		if MintRegistry.IsTracked(rarityByName[entry.Name], entry.Mutation) then
			pcall(MintRegistry.Burn, entry.Name, entry.Mutation, 1)
		end
		data.Offerings = (data.Offerings or 0) + 1

		InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack(player)
		PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)

		local luck = OfferingConfig.LuckMult(data.Offerings)
		if result then
			result:FireClient(player, {
				Success = true,
				Message = ("Offered %s - camp luck now x%.2f"):format(burned, luck),
			})
		end
		remotes.OfferBrainrot:FireClient(player, {
			Name = entry.Name,
			Mutation = entry.Mutation,
			Offerings = data.Offerings,
			LuckMult = luck,
		})
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastBurn[player.UserId] = nil
	end)

	print("OfferingHandler online")
end

return OfferingHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/OfflineEarningsHandler.lua =====
-- Offline earnings: on join, pay out a SHARE of what the placed brainrots would
-- have earned while away, over a limited window. Both the share and the window
-- start low and are raised by the "Campfire Keeper" upgrade. Cash is awarded immediately
-- at load; the popup payload is held until the client reports ready (remotes fired
-- before the client connects its listener would be lost).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)
local RebirthConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RebirthConfig)
local UpgradeConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UpgradeConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

local MIN_AWAY_SECONDS = 60 -- ignore quick rejoins

local cashPerSecondByName = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	cashPerSecondByName[entry.Name] = entry.CashPerSecond
end

local pendingPopup = {} -- [userId] = payload

local OfflineEarningsHandler = {}

function OfflineEarningsHandler.OnJoin(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local last = data.LastSeen or 0
	if last <= 0 then return end
	local elapsed = os.time() - last
	if elapsed < MIN_AWAY_SECONDS then return end

	-- both the window and the share are gated behind Campfire Keeper
	local capSeconds = math.floor(UpgradeConfig.OfflineHours(data.Upgrades) * 3600)
	local rate = UpgradeConfig.OfflineRate(data.Upgrades)
	local counted = math.min(elapsed, capSeconds)

	local rebirthMult = RebirthConfig.IncomeMult(data.Rebirths)
	local upMult = UpgradeConfig.IncomeMult(data.Upgrades)
	local cps = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if e.PadIndex then
			cps += (cashPerSecondByName[e.Name] or 0) * Mutations.Mult(e.Mutation) * rebirthMult * upMult
		end
	end

	local payout = math.floor(cps * counted * rate)
	if payout < 1 then return end

	PlayerDataManager.AddEarnings(player, payout, data)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	pendingPopup[player.UserId] = {
		Payout = payout,
		Seconds = counted,
		Capped = elapsed > capSeconds,
		CapSeconds = capSeconds,
		Rate = rate,
	}
end

function OfflineEarningsHandler.Init()
	-- client fires this remote once its popup UI is listening
	remotes.OfflineEarnings.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local payload = pendingPopup[player.UserId]
		if payload then
			pendingPopup[player.UserId] = nil
			remotes.OfflineEarnings:FireClient(player, payload)
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		pendingPopup[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
	print("OfflineEarningsHandler online")
end

return OfflineEarningsHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/PetHandler.lua =====
-- PetHandler (Forest Egg Shop, Task 11) -- pets, shipped disabled.
--
-- PetConfig.ENABLED gates the whole feature. LuckMult/IncomeMult are read by ThrowHandler
-- and IncomeLoop on every throw/tick respectively, so both return a neutral 1 the instant
-- ENABLED is false -- no data lookup, no loop -- so those two seams can be wired live today
-- with zero effect on drop rates or income until a future task flips the flag.
--
-- Grant/PetEquip/the follow rig are NOT gated behind ENABLED: nothing reachable from the
-- (nonexistent) shop UI can call Grant while the feature is off, so there is no live path
-- for a player to ever own a pet. Gating them too would just be dead code guarding dead
-- code. TestAcorn (PetConfig.Pets) exists purely so Grant/equip/the mult seams can be
-- exercised from the command bar ahead of the real shop.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetConfig)

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local PetHandler = {}

local function getRemote(name, class)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then
		r = Instance.new(class or "RemoteEvent")
		r.Name = name
		r.Parent = remotes
	end
	return r
end

local petEquipRemote = getRemote("PetEquip")

-- Offsets from HumanoidRootPart, in the CHARACTER's local space. +Z is behind the
-- player (a CFrame's LookVector is its -Z), so every slot trails.
--
-- Slots 1-3 (the SLOTS_FREE range) form a TRIANGLE: two abreast right behind the
-- player, and the third centred behind that pair. Slots 4-6 only come into play with
-- SLOTS_PREMIUM and continue the same pattern into a second row, so a full six reads as
-- one arrow rather than a crowd.
--
-- Y is deliberately equal across every slot: the bob is the only vertical motion, so a
-- staggered resting height would read as pets sitting at wonky altitudes rather than as
-- a formation.
-- Vector2, not Vector3: X is lateral, Y is how far BEHIND. The vertical position is NOT
-- a constant here -- it is derived per character and per model (see footDrop/modelLift in
-- buildRig), because a fixed Y cannot put pets "just above the feet":
--   * the offset positions the model's PrimaryPart, which can sit anywhere inside the
--     model, so one fixed Y floats one creature and buries another; and
--   * the drop from HumanoidRootPart down to the feet depends on HipHeight.
local SLOT_OFFSETS = {
	Vector2.new(-1.8, 3.2),   -- 1: behind-left  }  the pair, abreast
	Vector2.new(1.8, 3.2),    -- 2: behind-right }  directly behind the player
	Vector2.new(0, 6.0),      -- 3: centred behind the pair -> triangle apex
	Vector2.new(-3.0, 8.6),
	Vector2.new(3.0, 8.6),
	Vector2.new(0, 11.2),
}
-- How far the pet's underside floats above the player's feet at rest. Must exceed the
-- bob's downswing (BOB_HEIGHT/2 = 0.225) or a pet clips through the ground at the bottom
-- of every cycle.
local PET_FOOT_CLEARANCE = 0.5
-- Lateral spread is only +/-1.8 rather than the wider first pass: at 2.2 out and 2.6
-- back the pair read as FLANKING the character instead of trailing it. 1.8 out and 3.2
-- back keeps them clear of the character's ~2-stud silhouette while still sitting
-- visibly behind, which is what "right behind the player" has to look like from the
-- default over-the-shoulder camera.

-- === Gamepass: premium slot cap ===============================================
-- [player] = bool, cached for the session so the cap check never blocks on
-- MarketplaceService more than once per player. Cleared on PlayerRemoving so a
-- rejoin re-checks rather than trusting a stale table keyed by a live Player object.
local premiumCache = {}

-- id == 0 means no gamepass is configured yet -- UserOwnsGamePassAsync is never called
-- with a bogus id; the premium path just stays inert and everyone gets SLOTS_FREE.
local function ownsPremiumSlots(player)
	local id = PetConfig.PET_SLOTS_GAMEPASS_ID
	if id == 0 then return false end
	if premiumCache[player] ~= nil then return premiumCache[player] end
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, id)
	end)
	local result = (ok and owns) and true or false
	premiumCache[player] = result
	return result
end

local function slotCap(player)
	return ownsPremiumSlots(player) and PetConfig.SLOTS_PREMIUM or PetConfig.SLOTS_FREE
end

-- === Boost math =================================================================
-- 1 + sum of equipped pets' matching Boost.Amount. Neutral (1) instantly when the
-- feature is off, or when the player/data/pets can't be resolved -- callers on the hot
-- throw/income paths must never be able to turn a lookup failure into a multiplier of 0.
-- A pet now carries BOTH a luck and an income multiplier (a Secret is 5x luck AND 10x
-- money), which the old single Boost.Type shape could not express.
--
-- Boosts are looked up from PetConfig by Id at READ time, not read off the owned record.
-- That is deliberate: a rebalance in PetConfig then reaches pets players already own,
-- instead of leaving every existing pet frozen at whatever the numbers were on the day it
-- hatched. The stored record's Boost field is still honoured as a fallback so any pet
-- granted under the old shape keeps working.
local function boostsFor(pet)
	if not pet then return 1, 1 end
	local luck, income = PetConfig.BoostsFor(pet.Id)
	if luck == 1 and income == 1 and pet.Boost and pet.Boost.Type then
		-- legacy single-type record
		local amt = 1 + (pet.Boost.Amount or 0)
		if pet.Boost.Type == "Luck" then return amt, 1 end
		if pet.Boost.Type == "Income" then return 1, amt end
	end
	return luck, income
end

-- Stacking is ADDITIVE on the bonus portion: one 5x Secret gives 5x, two give 9x, not 25x.
-- Multiplying would make a third Secret worth more than the first two combined and put
-- luck somewhere no clamp could sensibly follow.
local function boostMult(player, boostType)
	if not PetConfig.ENABLED then return 1 end
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or type(data.Pets) ~= "table" or type(data.PetSlots) ~= "table" then return 1 end

	local petByUid = {}
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.Pets) do
		petByUid[pet.Uid] = pet
	end

	local sum = 0
	for _, uid in ipairs(data.PetSlots) do
		local luck, income = boostsFor(petByUid[uid])
		local mult = (boostType == "Luck") and luck or income
		sum += math.max(0, mult - 1)
	end
	return 1 + sum
end

function PetHandler.LuckMult(player)
	if not PetConfig.ENABLED then return 1 end
	return boostMult(player, "Luck")
end

function PetHandler.IncomeMult(player)
	if not PetConfig.ENABLED then return 1 end
	return boostMult(player, "Income")
end

-- Validates petId against PetConfig.Pets and appends a new owned-pet record. Does NOT
-- equip it -- PetEquip (client-driven) is the only path into data.PetSlots.
--
-- The record stores Uid + Id ONLY. Boosts are resolved from PetConfig on read (see
-- boostsFor) so rebalances apply retroactively; baking them in here is what would
-- freeze every owned pet at its hatch-day numbers.
function PetHandler.Grant(player, petId)
	local def = PetConfig.Pets[petId]
	if not def then return false end
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return false end
	data.Pets = data.Pets or {}

	local uid = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	table.insert(data.Pets, { Uid = uid, Id = petId })
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	return true, uid
end

-- Read by the bag UI so it never has to duplicate the rarity/boost lookup.
function PetHandler.Describe(petId)
	local def = PetConfig.Pets[petId]
	if not def then return nil end
	local luck, income = PetConfig.BoostsFor(petId)
	return { Id = petId, Name = def.Name, Rarity = def.Rarity, Luck = luck, Income = income }
end

-- === Follow rig ================================================================
-- The rig is the pet's REAL model, cloned out of ReplicatedStorage.PetModels --
-- the 15 imported .glb pets, each folder child named after its source file (see
-- PetConfig's Model field).
--
-- ReplicatedStorage.BrainrotModels is kept as a SECOND lookup, not dead weight:
-- the ten retired stand-in pets (PetConfig's "RETIRED" block) are brainrots, and
-- a player who hatched one during testing still owns it and still deserves a rig
-- rather than the placeholder cube. New pets resolve from PetModels; old ones
-- fall through to BrainrotModels; anything in neither gets the placeholder.
--
-- Every part is Massless + CanCollide=false + CanQuery=false: an unanchored multi-part
-- assembly welded together must not add mass or a hitbox to whatever it is following
-- (see InventoryHandler's identical note on held-tool visuals). CanQuery=false also keeps
-- a pet out of the throw/aim raycasts -- a pet floating behind you must never be a
-- surface you can land a rock on.
-- Studs on the model's largest axis after scaling. 2.6 read as tiny next to a ~5-stud
-- character; 4.0 makes a pet a companion rather than a trinket. These models are tall
-- and narrow (e.g. 2.11 x 6.83 x 5.43), so normalising the LARGEST axis to 4.0 leaves
-- them only ~1.2-1.6 studs wide -- still clear of each other at the 3.6-stud lateral
-- spacing of slots 1 and 2.
local PET_TARGET_SIZE = 4.0

-- Resolved lazily rather than at require time: PetModels does not exist until the
-- art is imported, and a nil captured at boot would never recover without a
-- server restart.
local function rsFolder(name)
	return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
end

-- petId is preferred; creatureName is what the old stand-in pets are stored under.
local function findPetSource(petId, creatureName)
	local def = petId and PetConfig.Pets[petId]
	local pets = rsFolder("PetModels")
	if pets and def and def.Model then
		local hit = pets:FindFirstChild(def.Model)
		if hit then return hit end
	end
	-- tolerate the model being renamed to the pet's display name on import
	if pets and creatureName then
		local hit = pets:FindFirstChild(creatureName)
		if hit then return hit end
	end
	local brainrots = rsFolder("BrainrotModels")
	return brainrots and creatureName and brainrots:FindFirstChild(creatureName) or nil
end

local function buildPetModel(creatureName, petId)
	local source = findPetSource(petId, creatureName)
	if not source then return nil end

	local model = source:Clone()
	model.Name = "PetRig"

	-- Defensive strip: these models are pure parts today, but a script, prompt or sound
	-- riding along on a clone that follows the player would be live, six times over.
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("Sound")
			or d:IsA("ClickDetector") then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local biggest, biggestVol
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Massless = true
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.CastShadow = false
			d.Anchored = false
			local vol = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
			if not biggestVol or vol > biggestVol then biggest, biggestVol = d, vol end
		end
	end
	if not biggest then model:Destroy() return nil end
	if not model.PrimaryPart then model.PrimaryPart = biggest end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart

	-- Weld everything to the root. A clone's parts are not guaranteed to arrive jointed,
	-- and an unwelded assembly under AlignPosition comes apart in mid-air.
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= root then
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = root
			weld.Part1 = d
			weld.Parent = d
		end
	end

	-- Normalise to pet scale: these are brainrot models built at 6-7 studs tall, which
	-- would tower over the character if followed at source size.
	local _, bsize = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local largest = math.max(bsize.X, bsize.Y, bsize.Z)
	if largest > 0 then
		local scale = math.clamp(PET_TARGET_SIZE / largest, 0.05, 1)
		pcall(function() model:ScaleTo(scale) end)
	end

	return model, model.PrimaryPart
end

-- Placeholder, used only when a pet's creature has no model in BrainrotModels. Keeps a
-- missing asset from meaning "equip silently does nothing visible".
local CAP_OFFSETS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.5, 1.0, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.5, 1.0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0.5),
	Vector3.new(0, 1.0, -0.5),
	Vector3.new(0.35, 1.0, 0.35),
	Vector3.new(-0.35, 1.0, -0.35),
}

local function buildAcorn()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PetRig"

	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "Root"
	root.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	root.Color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 94, 60)
	root.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	root.Massless = true
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.CanQuery = false
	root.Anchored = false
	root.Parent = model

	for i, offset in ipairs(CAP_OFFSETS) do
		local cube = Instance.new("Part")
		cube.Name = "Cap" .. i
		cube.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		cube.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
		cube.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 30)
		cube.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		cube.Massless = true
		cube.CanCollide = false
		cube.CanQuery = false
		cube.Anchored = false
		cube.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		cube.Parent = model

		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = cube
		weld.Parent = cube
	end

	model.PrimaryPart = root
	return model, root
end

-- [player] = Folder containing every currently-built PetRig model for that player.
local rigFolders = {}
-- [player] = { { att = Attachment, baseY = number, phase = number } }. Drives the bob.
-- Kept separate from rigFolders because the bob animates the HRP-side attachment, not the
-- rig: AlignPosition is already chasing that attachment every frame, so moving IT makes
-- the pet bob smoothly whether the player is standing still or sprinting. Animating the
-- rig part directly would fight the constraint instead of riding it.
local bobbers = {}
local bobConn

local function rigContainer()
	local ws = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local folder = ws:FindFirstChild("PetRigs")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "PetRigs"
		folder.Parent = ws
	end
	return folder
end

local function destroyRig(player)
	local folder = rigFolders[player]
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		rigFolders[player] = nil
	end
	bobbers[player] = nil
end

-- Tears down and fully rebuilds every follow rig for `player` from the CURRENT
-- data.PetSlots. Called after every equip/unequip and every CharacterAdded, so it is
-- always the single source of truth for what is visually following the player --
-- there is no incremental add/remove path to drift out of sync.
local function buildRig(player)
	destroyRig(player)

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not hrp then return end

	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or type(data.PetSlots) ~= "table" or #data.PetSlots == 0 then return end

	local petByUid = {}
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do
		petByUid[pet.Uid] = pet
	end

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
	folder.Parent = rigContainer()
	rigFolders[player] = folder

	-- Where the player's feet are, relative to the HumanoidRootPart's centre. HipHeight is
	-- the gap from the root's BOTTOM face to the ground, so the full drop from its centre
	-- is HipHeight + half the root's height.
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local footDrop = ((hum and hum.HipHeight) or 2) + (hrp.Size.Y * 0.5)

	for i, uid in ipairs(data.PetSlots) do
		if petByUid[uid] then
			local slot = SLOT_OFFSETS[i] or SLOT_OFFSETS[#SLOT_OFFSETS]
			local pet = petByUid[uid]
			local def = pet and PetConfig.Pets[pet.Id]
			local model, root = buildPetModel(def and def.Name, pet.Id)
			if not model then model, root = buildAcorn() end

			-- How far the PrimaryPart sits above the model's own underside, so the slot
			-- height can mean "the pet's feet" instead of "wherever this particular model
			-- happens to keep its PrimaryPart".
			local bbCf, bbSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
			local modelLift = root.Position.Y - (bbCf.Position.Y - bbSize.Y * 0.5)
			local offset = Vector3.new(slot.X, -footDrop + PET_FOOT_CLEARANCE + modelLift, slot.Y)

			-- PivotTo moves the whole welded assembly via its PrimaryPart, so this both
			-- places the rig and keeps its parts together; setting root.CFrame as well
			-- would just be the same write twice.
			model:PivotTo(hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset))
			model.Parent = folder

			local petAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
			petAttach.Name = "PetAttach"
			petAttach.Parent = root

			local hrpAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
			hrpAttach.Name = "PetSlot" .. i
			hrpAttach.Position = offset
			hrpAttach.Parent = hrp

			-- register for the bob; the phase step keeps slots from bobbing in lockstep
			bobbers[player] = bobbers[player] or {}
			table.insert(bobbers[player], {
				att = hrpAttach,
				baseY = offset.Y,
				phase = (i - 1) * PetConfig.BOB_PHASE_STEP,
			})

			local alignPos = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
			alignPos.Attachment0 = petAttach
			alignPos.Attachment1 = hrpAttach
			alignPos.Responsiveness = 15
			alignPos.MaxForce = 4e4
			alignPos.Parent = root

			-- hrpAttach carries no rotation offset, so its WorldCFrame orientation IS the
			-- character's orientation -- AlignOrientation tracking it is enough to make the
			-- rig face the character's LookVector with no extra math.
			local alignOrient = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
			alignOrient.Attachment0 = petAttach
			alignOrient.Attachment1 = hrpAttach
			alignOrient.Parent = root
		end
	end
end

-- === PetEquip remote: uid must be an owned pet, and equipping is capped at slotCap ===
local function onPetEquip(player, uid, equip)
	if typeof(uid) ~= "string" then return end
	equip = equip and true or false

	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or type(data.Pets) ~= "table" then return end

	local owned = false
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.Pets) do
		if pet.Uid == uid then owned = true break end
	end
	if not owned then return end

	data.PetSlots = data.PetSlots or {}
	local idx
	for i, u in ipairs(data.PetSlots) do
		if u == uid then idx = i break end
	end

	if equip then
		if idx then return end -- already equipped: no-op, not an error
		if #data.PetSlots >= slotCap(player) then return end
		table.insert(data.PetSlots, uid)
	else
		if not idx then return end
		table.remove(data.PetSlots, idx)
	end

	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	buildRig(player)
end

local function hookCharacter(player, character)
	local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if hum then
		hum.Died:Connect(function() destroyRig(player) end)
	end
	buildRig(player)
end

-- One shared Heartbeat for every player's every pet, rather than a loop per rig: the
-- work is a sine and a Vector3 write per equipped pet, so a single pass is cheaper than
-- the connection churn of building and tearing one down on every equip.
local function startBob()
	if bobConn then return end
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	bobConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local t = os.clock()
		local w = (2 * math.pi) / math.max(0.05, PetConfig.BOB_PERIOD)
		local amp = PetConfig.BOB_HEIGHT * 0.5
		for player, list in pairs(bobbers) do
			for idx = #list, 1, -1 do
				local b = list[idx]
				if b.att.Parent then
					local p = b.att.Position
					b.att.Position = Vector3.new(p.X, b.baseY + math.sin(t * w + b.phase) * amp, p.Z)
				else
					-- character respawned out from under it; drop the dead entry
					table.remove(list, idx)
				end
			end
			if #list == 0 then bobbers[player] = nil end
		end
	end)
end

function PetHandler.Init()
	petEquipRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(onPetEquip)
	startBob()

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			hookCharacter(player, character)
		end)
	end)

	-- Handle players already in-game (Studio test start) the same way Main does.
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			hookCharacter(player, character)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			hookCharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		destroyRig(player)
		premiumCache[player] = nil
	end)
end

return PetHandler

local PlayerDataManager = {}
PlayerDataManager.cache = {} -- [userId] = data table

-- canonical abbreviator, K through Qi -- see Modules.NumberFormat
local formatShort = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat).Short

local function defaultData()
	return {
		Cash = 0,
		OwnedRocks = { Pebble = true },
		EquippedRock = "Pebble",
		Brainrots = {}, -- array of { Name = string, PadIndex = number?, Mutation = string? }
		UnlockedSpots = BASE_SPOTS,
		-- daily login rewards
		DailyStreak = 0,
		LastClaimDay = 0,
		LastFreezeDay = 0, -- last day the streak-freeze grace was used
		RedeemedCodes = {}, -- [CODE] = true
		-- daily quests
		Quests = {}, -- [questId] = { claimed = bool }
		QuestDay = 0,
		-- Gianluca's Secret Chim questline:
		--   0 = not started  1 = active (searching)  2 = holding the Chim
		--   3 = handed the Chim back to Gianluca and took the Key
		ChimQuest = 0,
		-- Gianluca's Keys. Awarded for handing the Chim back. Counted rather than a
		-- Backpack Tool because Tools in this game are brainrots and only brainrots --
		-- InventoryHandler.SyncBackpack rebuilds that list from data.Brainrots and would
		-- destroy any non-brainrot Tool on the next sync.
		Keys = 0,
		-- One of those Keys is SPENT walking into Elder Tung's cellar, alongside his own
		-- Cellar Key -- see ServerScriptService.CellarDoor. Stamped once and the way down
		-- is free for that player forever after.
		CellarUnlocked = false,
		-- prestige
		Rebirths = 0,
		-- Maxwell the cat's secret questline (see MaxwellQuest):
		--   0 = locked/greeting  1 = collecting 5 Secret catches  2 = reach Rebirth 15
		--   3 = reward ready to claim  4 = done, God Maxwell awarded
		MaxwellQuest = 0,
		MaxwellSecrets = 0,   -- Secret-rarity catches counted while MaxwellQuest == 1

		-- Tung Tung Tung Sahur's questline (see TungQuest): 0 locked / 1 capturing /
		-- 2 quota met / 3 done+portal unlocked. TungCatch = throw-catches by tier while == 1.
		TungQuest = 0,
		TungCatch = { Epic = 0, Legendary = 0, Mythic = 0 },
		TungPortalUnlocked = false,		-- rarity pity: [tierName] = throws-since-last-catch of that tier (see PityConfig)
		Pity = {},
		-- brainrot index: [name] = true once caught
		Discovered = {},
		-- purchased upgrade levels: [id] = level
		Upgrades = {},
		-- first-time onboarding shown?
		TutorialDone = false,
		-- rolling id so each brainrot can own a Backpack tool
		NextUid = 1,
		-- unix time of last save, for offline earnings
		LastSeen = 0,
		-- brainrots burned into the campfire as Offerings (permanent luck, diminishing)
		Offerings = 0,
		-- season pass
		SeasonXP = 0,
		SeasonClaimed = {}, -- [tostring(tier)] = true
		SeasonQuests = {}, -- [questId] = { P = n, D = bool }, resets daily
		SeasonQuestDay = 0,
		-- === camp board (2026-07-24) ===
		TotalEarned = 0,      -- lifetime cash PRODUCED by this player's brainrots; survives rebirth
		PlotLikes = 0,        -- lifetime likes received on this player's camp
		LikedPlayers = {},    -- [tostring(otherUserId)] = true : camps I have already liked
		-- === global leaderboards (2026-07-25) ===
		LifetimeEarned = 0,   -- ALL money ever received, from every source. This is what the
		                      -- leaderboard means by "earned"; TotalEarned above is narrower
		                      -- (production only) and must stay that way, because the camp
		                      -- board and offline earnings are built on it.
		TimePlayed = 0,       -- lifetime seconds in game. Accumulated on a timer rather than
		                      -- measured on leave: Main's PlayerRemoving saves before any
		                      -- later-Init'd handler could flush a session length.
		BrainrotsCaught = 0,  -- lifetime CATCHES. Trades, booth buys and offerings deliberately
		                      -- do not count -- this is meant to measure throwing, not acquiring.
		-- === daily wheel (2026-07-25) ===
		LastSpinAt = 0,       -- os.time() of the last free spin; 0 means never spun
		Boosts = {},          -- ["Luck"|"Power"] = os.time() the boost expires. Real-time, so a
		                      -- 10 minute boost does not pause when the player logs off.
		-- === forest egg shop (2026-07-28) ===
		Darrels = 0,
		DarrelDaily = {},   -- { Day = utcDay, Progress = {kind counters}, Claimed = {questId=true} }
		EggsOpened = {},    -- { [eggId] = count }
		ReceiptLog = {},    -- last 50 Robux PurchaseIds (ProductRegistry dedupe)
		Pets = {},          -- { {Uid, Id, Boost={Type,Amount}} } -- Task 11
		PetSlots = {},      -- equipped pet Uids -- Task 11
		-- === settings panel (2026-07-30 ui-overhaul, Task 10) ===
		Settings = {},      -- [key] = value, whitelisted+validated by SettingsService
		                    -- ONLY: {music, sfx} numbers 0..1, quality one of
		                    -- "Low"|"Medium"|"High", {fastSpin, hideOwnBanners}
		                    -- booleans. Absent keys mean "never set" -- SettingsPanel
		                    -- seeds its own client-side defaults for anything
		                    -- missing, this table is never assumed fully populated.
	}
end

function PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	return PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
end

--============================ ONE CAMP PER WORLD ==========================--
-- Plots 1-6 are in the valley, 7-12 in the Frozen Tundra, and a player claims one in
-- EACH -- so "your camp" is a question that only has an answer once you say which world.
--
-- This does NOT double anyone's income. Cash accrues per brainrot into data.Brainrots
-- (see IncomeLoop), which is player data, not plot data; the camps are two renderings of
-- one collection, and the campfire you happen to be standing at is just where you
-- collect it. That is why the mirroring below is only ever about pad MODELS.
local function worldOf(pos)
	return BoundsGuard.RegionName(pos) or "Valley"
end
PlayerDataManager.WorldOf = worldOf

-- The world a player is currently standing in; nil while they have no character.
function PlayerDataManager.PlayerWorld(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and worldOf(hrp.Position) or nil
end

-- Every plot this player owns, in folder order.
function PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(player)
	local owned = {}
	local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if not plotsFolder then return owned end
	for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			table.insert(owned, plot)
		end
	end
	return owned
end

-- The camp for one world. Passing no world means "the one where the player is standing",
-- falling back to any camp they own -- which is what every pre-existing caller wants:
-- proximity checks (fuse, offer, campfire bank) and the income billboards all mean the
-- camp in front of you.
function PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player, world)
	local owned = PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(player)
	if #owned == 0 then return nil end
	local want = world or PlayerDataManager.PlayerWorld(player)
	if want then
		for _, plot in ipairs(owned) do
			if plot:GetAttribute("World") == want then return plot end
		end
	end
	if world then return nil end   -- an explicit world was asked for and they have none there
	return owned[1]
end

-- Tagged once at startup from the plot's own position, so adding a camp to a third world
-- is a build-time job: drop the model in PlayerBases inside that world's bounds.
do
	local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if plotsFolder then
		for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if plot:IsA("Model") then
				plot:SetAttribute("World", worldOf(plot:GetPivot().Position))
			end
		end
	end
end

function PlayerDataManager.TakeUid(data)
	data.NextUid = data.NextUid or 1
	local id = data.NextUid
	data.NextUid = id + 1
	return id
end

function PlayerDataManager.FindFreePad(data)
	local used = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
		if entry.PadIndex then
			used[entry.PadIndex] = true
		end
	end
	local limit = math.min(data.UnlockedSpots or BASE_SPOTS, MAX_SPOTS)
	for i = 1, limit do
		if not used[i] then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Show/refresh which plot spots are open vs locked (with buy prompts) for the owner.
-- Runs over EVERY camp they own: the spot you bought has to be unlocked in both worlds,
-- or walking through the portal would appear to have taken it back off you.
local refreshSpotsOn   -- defined just below; forward-declared so it stays a local

function PlayerDataManager.RefreshPlotSpots(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return end
	for _, plot in ipairs(PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(player)) do
		refreshSpotsOn(player, data, plot)
	end
end

function refreshSpotsOn(player, data, plot)
	local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if not pads then return end
	local unlocked = data.UnlockedSpots or BASE_SPOTS

	for i = 1, MAX_SPOTS do
		local pad = pads:FindFirstChild("Pad" .. i)
		if pad then
			local oldGui = pad:FindFirstChild("LockGui")
			if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end
			local oldPrompt = pad:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
			if oldPrompt then oldPrompt:Destroy() end

			-- SmoothPlastic, not Metal/Slate: this runs on every refresh and would
			-- otherwise repaint the pads back over the flat-cartoon art pass.
			if i <= unlocked then
				pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 154, 166)
				pad.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				pad.Transparency = 0
			else
				pad.Color = ((i == unlocked + 1) and Color3.fromRGB(214, 164, 78) or Color3.fromRGB(122, 112, 122))
				pad.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				pad.Transparency = ((i == unlocked + 1) and 0 or 0.45)
				local price = SPOT_PRICES[i] or 0
				local isNext = (i == unlocked + 1)

				local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				gui.Name = "LockGui"
				gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 46)
				gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				-- Must be set here: RefreshPlotSpots destroys and rebuilds these on every spot
				-- purchase and on load, so a value authored in Studio would not survive.
				-- 150 to match the campfire BankGui and the pad name tags on the same plot.
				gui.MaxDistance = 150
				gui.Parent = pad
				local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				label.TextColor3 = isNext and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(132, 132, 148)
				label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
				label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				label.TextScaled = true
				label.Text = isNext and ("\u{1F512} Buy Spot\n$" .. formatShort(price)) or ("\u{1F512} $" .. formatShort(price) .. "\nUnlock #" .. (unlocked + 1) .. " first")
				label.Parent = gui

				if isNext then
					local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
					prompt.Name = "BuySpotPrompt"
					prompt.ActionText = "Buy ($" .. formatShort(price) .. ")"
					prompt.ObjectText = "Plot Spot " .. i
					prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
					prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
					prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
					prompt.Parent = pad
					prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggerPlayer)
						if triggerPlayer == player then
							PlayerDataManager.TryBuySpot(player)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function PlayerDataManager.TryBuySpot(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return end
	local unlocked = data.UnlockedSpots or BASE_SPOTS
	local nextSpot = unlocked + 1
	if nextSpot > MAX_SPOTS then return end
	local price = SPOT_PRICES[nextSpot]
	if not price then return end

	local result = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if data.Cash < price then
		if result then
			result:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "Need $" .. formatShort(price) .. " to unlock spot " .. nextSpot })
		end
		return
	end

	data.Cash -= price
	data.UnlockedSpots = nextSpot
	PlayerDataManager.RefreshPlotSpots(player)
	if result then
		result:FireClient(player, { Success = true, Message = "Unlocked plot spot " .. nextSpot .. "!" })
	end
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
end

-- Camp board state lives as attributes on the plot Model; the client renders it.
local function refreshPlotBoard(plot, player)
	if not plot then return end
	if not player then
		plot:SetAttribute("OwnerName", "")
		plot:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", 0)
		plot:SetAttribute("PlotLikes", 0)
		return
	end
	local d = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	plot:SetAttribute("OwnerName", string.sub(player.DisplayName or player.Name, 1, 18))
	plot:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", math.floor((d and d.TotalEarned) or 0))
	plot:SetAttribute("PlotLikes", math.floor((d and d.PlotLikes) or 0))
end

-- EVERY camp, not just the one they are standing in: a player leaving from the tundra
-- would otherwise leave their valley plot claimed and un-reclaimable for the life of the
-- server, which with six of them per world empties the map fast.
local releaseOnePlot   -- defined just below; forward-declared so it stays a local

local function releasePlot(player)
	for _, plot in ipairs(PlayerDataManager.GetPlots(player)) do
		releaseOnePlot(plot)
	end
end

function releaseOnePlot(plot)
	local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if pads then
		for _, child in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
			if not child.Name:match("^Pad%d+$") then
				child:Destroy() -- brainrot models
			else
				local lock = child:FindFirstChild("LockGui")
				if lock then lock:Destroy() end
				local prompt = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
				if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end
	plot:SetAttribute("Claimed", false)
	plot:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)
	refreshPlotBoard(plot, nil)
	local campfire = plot:FindFirstChild("Campfire")
	if campfire then
		campfire:SetAttribute("Banked", 0)
	end
end

function PlayerDataManager.Snapshot(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return nil end
	return {
		Cash = data.Cash,
		OwnedRocks = data.OwnedRocks,
		EquippedRock = data.EquippedRock,
		Brainrots = data.Brainrots,
		UnlockedSpots = data.UnlockedSpots,
		Discovered = data.Discovered,
		Upgrades = data.Upgrades,
		TutorialDone = data.TutorialDone,
		Rebirths = data.Rebirths,
		TotalEarned = data.TotalEarned,
		Offerings = data.Offerings,
		PlotLikes = data.PlotLikes,
		LikedPlayers = data.LikedPlayers,
		Keys = data.Keys,
		-- What those keys have already bought. The Bag's Keys tab renders a key as
		-- SPENT-AND-PERMANENT rather than just counting them, so it needs the unlock
		-- flags too. CellarUnlocked is CellarDoor's own flag, set when the Gianluca key
		-- is spent on the hatch; TungPortalUnlocked is TungQuestConfig.RewardFlag, the
		-- cellar key itself. (Add a locked portal with a new UnlockFlag and add it here
		-- as well -- TeleportService.passesLock still supports them, nothing uses it now.)
		TungPortalUnlocked = data.TungPortalUnlocked,
		CellarUnlocked = data.CellarUnlocked,
		-- Pets/PetSlots are what the bag's Pets tab renders from. Without them in the
		-- snapshot the client cannot see a pet it owns at all, so hatching would write to
		-- data.Pets and appear to do nothing.
		Pets = data.Pets,
		PetSlots = data.PetSlots,
		-- Task 10 (ui-overhaul): seeds SettingsPanel's sliders/segmented-quality/
		-- toggles on join. Absent/partial by design -- see defaultData's own
		-- Settings comment above.
		Settings = data.Settings,
	}
end

function PlayerDataManager.Load(player)
	local data
	-- Claim rather than GetAsync. A plain read cannot tell "nobody else has this" from
	-- "another server loaded it a moment ago", and that gap is exactly where a
	-- cross-place teleport duplicates items.
	local claimed, status = SessionLock.Claim(player.UserId)
	local ok = (status == "ok" or status == "new")
	local result = (status == "ok") and claimed or nil
	if status == "locked" then
		warn(("[PlayerDataManager] %s: profile held by another live server -- read-only session")
			:format(player.Name))
	end
	if ok and result then
		data = result
		if not data.OwnedRocks then data.OwnedRocks = { Pebble = true } end
		if not data.EquippedRock then data.EquippedRock = "Pebble" end
		if not data.Brainrots then data.Brainrots = {} end
		if not data.UnlockedSpots then data.UnlockedSpots = BASE_SPOTS end
		if not data.DailyStreak then data.DailyStreak = 0 end
		if not data.LastClaimDay then data.LastClaimDay = 0 end
		if not data.Quests then data.Quests = {} end
		if data.ChimQuest == nil then data.ChimQuest = 0 end
		if type(data.Keys) ~= "number" then data.Keys = 0 end
		if data.CellarUnlocked == nil then data.CellarUnlocked = false end
		if not data.QuestDay then data.QuestDay = 0 end
		if not data.Rebirths then data.Rebirths = 0 end
		if data.MaxwellQuest == nil then data.MaxwellQuest = 0 end
		if type(data.MaxwellSecrets) ~= "number" then data.MaxwellSecrets = 0 end

		if data.TungQuest == nil then data.TungQuest = 0 end
		if type(data.TungCatch) ~= "table" then data.TungCatch = { Epic = 0, Legendary = 0, Mythic = 0 } end
		if data.TungPortalUnlocked == nil then data.TungPortalUnlocked = false end		if type(data.Pity) ~= "table" then data.Pity = {} end
		if not data.Discovered then data.Discovered = {} end
		if not data.Upgrades then data.Upgrades = {} end
		if data.TutorialDone == nil then data.TutorialDone = false end
		if not data.LastSeen then data.LastSeen = 0 end
		if not data.LastFreezeDay then data.LastFreezeDay = 0 end
		if not data.RedeemedCodes then data.RedeemedCodes = {} end
		if not data.SeasonXP then data.SeasonXP = 0 end
		if not data.SeasonClaimed then data.SeasonClaimed = {} end
		if not data.SeasonQuests then data.SeasonQuests = {} end
		if not data.SeasonQuestDay then data.SeasonQuestDay = 0 end
		if type(data.Offerings) ~= "number" then data.Offerings = 0 end
		if type(data.TotalEarned) ~= "number" then data.TotalEarned = 0 end
		if type(data.PlotLikes) ~= "number" then data.PlotLikes = 0 end
		if type(data.LikedPlayers) ~= "table" then data.LikedPlayers = {} end
		if type(data.LifetimeEarned) ~= "number" then
			-- One-time estimate for saves predating this field. Money already SPENT is not
			-- recoverable from anything stored, so take the best available floor: you have
			-- earned at least what you are holding, and at least what you produced.
			data.LifetimeEarned = math.max(tonumber(data.Cash) or 0, tonumber(data.TotalEarned) or 0)
		end
		if type(data.TimePlayed) ~= "number" then data.TimePlayed = 0 end
		if type(data.BrainrotsCaught) ~= "number" then data.BrainrotsCaught = 0 end
		if type(data.LastSpinAt) ~= "number" then data.LastSpinAt = 0 end
		if type(data.Boosts) ~= "table" then data.Boosts = {} end
		if data.Darrels == nil then data.Darrels = 0 end
		data.DarrelDaily = data.DarrelDaily or {}
		data.EggsOpened = data.EggsOpened or {}
		data.ReceiptLog = data.ReceiptLog or {}
		data.Pets = data.Pets or {}
		data.PetSlots = data.PetSlots or {}
		data.Settings = data.Settings or {} -- Task 10: settings panel
		data.NextUid = data.NextUid or 1
		for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
			if RENAMES[e.Name] then e.Name = RENAMES[e.Name] end
			if not e.Uid then e.Uid = data.NextUid; data.NextUid += 1 end
			-- Discovery backfill: the Discovered flag was never written before
			-- 2026-07-25, so owning a copy is the only proof the catch happened.
			data.Discovered[e.Name] = true
		end
		-- Renames must walk EVERY place a config name is persisted. Ancient saves
		-- carry Discovered keys written by an early build (the writer was later
		-- lost in a refactor), so old names can lurk here even when no owned
		-- record does.
		for oldName, newName in pairs(RENAMES) do
			if data.Discovered[oldName] then
				data.Discovered[oldName] = nil
				data.Discovered[newName] = true
			end
		end
	elseif ok then
		data = defaultData()                 -- genuinely a new player: empty read, no error
	else
		data = defaultData()
		data.__noSave = true                 -- DataStore READ FAILED: never overwrite the real profile
		warn("[PlayerDataManager] load failed for " .. player.Name .. "; session is read-only")
	end
	PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId] = data

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local cashStat = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	cashStat.Name = "Cash"
	cashStat.Value = data.Cash
	cashStat.Parent = leaderstats
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	PlayerDataManager.RefreshPlotSpots(player)

	return data
end

function PlayerDataManager.SyncLeaderstat(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return end
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local cashStat = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
		if cashStat then
			cashStat.Value = data.Cash
		end
	end
end

-- Single funnel for lifetime earnings. Cash grants that are NOT production
-- (trades, booth sales, daily/quest/season/codes, sell) must not call this.
-- Returns the amount actually credited (0 on failure) so callers can verify.
function PlayerDataManager.AddEarnings(player, amount, dataOpt)
	-- `player and` guard: every spec'd caller passes dataOpt so this short-circuits,
	-- but without it a nil player throws instead of returning 0. See DEVIATIONS.
	local data = dataOpt or (player and PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId])
	if not data or type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 then return 0 end
	data.Cash += amount
	data.TotalEarned = (data.TotalEarned or 0) + amount
	data.LifetimeEarned = (data.LifetimeEarned or 0) + amount
	return amount
end

-- The funnel for every NON-production cash grant: sells, booth proceeds, daily rewards,
-- codes, quests, season pass. Exists so LifetimeEarned stays honest without widening
-- AddEarnings, whose narrower meaning other systems depend on.
--
-- Spending must NOT go through here -- subtract from data.Cash directly, the way
-- BoothHandler does for the buyer.
-- Multiplier from a timed wheel boost, or 1 when none is running. Reads os.time() every
-- call rather than caching, so an expiring boost stops mattering mid-session with no
-- tick or cleanup task anywhere.
function PlayerDataManager.BoostMult(data, stat)
	if not data or type(data.Boosts) ~= "table" then return 1 end
	local expiry = tonumber(data.Boosts[stat])
	if not expiry or os.time() >= expiry then return 1 end
	local WheelConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.WheelConfig)
	return WheelConfig.BOOST_MULT
end

-- Seconds left on a boost, or 0. For the HUD.
function PlayerDataManager.BoostRemaining(data, stat)
	if not data or type(data.Boosts) ~= "table" then return 0 end
	local expiry = tonumber(data.Boosts[stat])
	if not expiry then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, expiry - os.time())
end

function PlayerDataManager.GrantCash(data, amount)
	if not data or type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 then return 0 end
	data.Cash += amount
	data.LifetimeEarned = (data.LifetimeEarned or 0) + amount
	return amount
end

-- Drains a brainrot entry's banked Pending into the owner's cash + lifetime
-- earnings. Call this immediately BEFORE removing or unplacing the entry.
function PlayerDataManager.DrainPending(player, entry, dataOpt)
	if not entry then return 0 end
	local pend = math.floor(entry.Pending or 0)
	entry.Pending = 0
	if pend < 1 then return 0 end
	return PlayerDataManager.AddEarnings(player, pend, dataOpt)
end

function PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	PlayerDataManager.SyncLeaderstat(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if data and data.Discovered then
		-- Discovery is recorded HERE because every acquisition path (catch, trade,
		-- booth, fusion, wheel) already ends in a PushUpdate: one merge point
		-- instead of five handler edits. The set only ever grows, so selling or
		-- trading away your last copy can never un-discover a name.
		for _, e in ipairs(data.Brainrots) do
			data.Discovered[e.Name] = true
		end
	end
	local snapshot = PlayerDataManager.Snapshot(player)
	if snapshot then
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.DataUpdated:FireClient(player, snapshot)
	end
end

-- Returns true if the write landed. Callers that move items BETWEEN players
-- (trades, booth sales) must check this: two independent SetAsync calls with no
-- retry meant a failed giver-write plus a successful receiver-write duplicated
-- the item silently, and duped items poison the whole class because nobody can
-- tell an honest copy from a forged one.
function PlayerDataManager.Save(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if not data then return false end
	if data.__noSave then return false end  -- load failed; writing would wipe the real profile
	data.LastSeen = os.time()
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	-- Routed through SessionLock: it re-checks ownership inside the transaction and
	-- refuses if another server has taken the profile, because at that point WE are the
	-- stale session and writing would roll their progress back.
	return SessionLock.Save(player.UserId, data)
end

function PlayerDataManager.Remove(player)
	releasePlot(player)                 -- stop accepting likes BEFORE the SetAsync yield
	-- Release = final write + drop the lock. Leaving is also how a teleport looks from
	-- this server, so the destination must find the profile unlocked and current.
	SessionLock.Release(player.UserId, PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId])
	PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId] = nil
end

-- === Tycoon-style claiming: walk onto a free plot to claim it ===
function PlayerDataManager.ClaimPlotFor(player, plot)
	if not plot or plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") then return false end
	-- One per WORLD, not one per player: owning a valley camp must not stop you taking a
	-- tundra one, but it does stop you taking a second valley one.
	if PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player, plot:GetAttribute("World")) then return false end
	plot:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	refreshPlotBoard(plot, player)
	plot:SetAttribute("Claimed", true)
	PlayerDataManager.RefreshPlotSpots(player)
	local data = PlayerDataManager.cache[player.UserId]
	if data and data.Brainrots then
		BrainrotSpawner.RestoreAll(plot, data.Brainrots)
	end
	if PlayerDataManager.OnPlotClaimed then PlayerDataManager.OnPlotClaimed(player) end
	local result = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if result then
		result:FireClient(player, { Success = true, Message = "Base claimed!" })
	end
	return true
end

local claimCooldown = {}
local function tryClaimByTouch(plot, hit)
	local character = hit and hit.Parent
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then return end
	if plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") then return end
	if PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player, plot:GetAttribute("World")) then return end
	if claimCooldown[player.UserId] then return end
	claimCooldown[player.UserId] = true
	task.delay(1, function() claimCooldown[player.UserId] = nil end)
	PlayerDataManager.ClaimPlotFor(player, plot)
end

do
	local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if plotsFolder then
		for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if plot:IsA("Model") then
				local pad = plot.PrimaryPart or plot:FindFirstChild("Platform")
				if pad then
					pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit) tryClaimByTouch(plot, hit) end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Refresh our locks every 30s; they go stale after 90, so a crashed server's lock is
-- reclaimable instead of permanent.
-- Release locks when the server goes down, so the next server (or the next Studio play
-- session) can claim these profiles immediately instead of waiting out the stale window.
game:BindToClose(function()
	local n = SessionLock.ReleaseAll(function(userId) return PlayerDataManager.cache[userId] end)
	if n > 0 then
		print(("[PlayerDataManager] released %d session lock(s) on shutdown"):format(n))
	end
end)

SessionLock.StartHeartbeat(function(userId) return PlayerDataManager.cache[userId] end)

return PlayerDataManager


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/PlotBoardHandler.lua =====
-- PlotBoardHandler -- Camp Board + like authority (BUILD SPEC v2, 2026-07-24)
--
-- Owns the PHYSICAL camp board: geometry, CampStand, CampNook, the LikePrompt,
-- the three RemoteEvents, and every like decision. The CLIENT owns every pixel
-- (see StarterPlayerScripts.PlotSignClient) -- this module never builds a Gui.
--
-- Dependency direction is one-way: PlotBoardHandler -> PlayerDataManager.
-- PlayerDataManager must never require this file (no circular require).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PlayerDataManager = require(ServerScriptService.Modules.PlayerDataManager)

local PlotBoardHandler = {}

-- USER DECISION U4: build the three CampNook props in the old tent footprint.
local BUILD_CAMP_NOOK = false   -- replaced by CampBed (sleeping bag + lantern); see CampBed builder

-- ===== remotes: idempotent self-heal so a fresh clone of the place works =====
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local function ensureRemote(name)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); r.Name = name; r.Parent = remotes end
	return r
end
local likeRemote   = ensureRemote("LikePlot")
local likeResult   = ensureRemote("LikeResult")
local collectedCue = ensureRemote("CampfireCollected")

-- ===== canonical local frame (spec 0.3) =====
-- NEVER build from Platform.CFrame directly: the cylinder is rolled 90 deg and its
-- RightVector is (0,1,0).
local function plotFrame(plot)
	local plat = plot:FindFirstChild("Platform")
	if not plat then return nil end
	local lv    = plat.CFrame.LookVector
	local fwd   = Vector3.new(-lv.X, 0, -lv.Z).Unit          -- plot-local +Z
	local right = Vector3.new(fwd.Z, 0, -fwd.X)              -- plot-local +X
	local y0    = plat.Position.Y + 0.5                      -- platform TOP
	local origin = Vector3.new(plat.Position.X, y0, plat.Position.Z)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(origin, right, Vector3.yAxis, fwd), y0, plat
end
PlotBoardHandler.PlotFrame = plotFrame

-- ===== per-plot board placement (spec 1.2.1) =====
-- Bearings chosen per plot so the board FACES that plot's measured trail approach
-- while sitting in a pine-clear window with a >=20 deg stand-off. USER DECISION U5:
-- deliberately non-uniform between plot pairs.
local BOARD = {
	Plot1 = {  25, 24.0 }, Plot2 = {  25, 24.0 },
	Plot3 = { 170, 26.5 }, Plot4 = { 170, 26.5 },
	Plot5 = {  97, 24.0 }, Plot6 = {  97, 24.0 },
	BaseTemplate = { 25, 24.0 },
}
PlotBoardHandler.BOARD = BOARD

-- Ground-referenced board base (spec 1.2.2). The platform floats 1.18-2.71 studs
-- above terrain at the sign spots, so the board references TERRAIN, not the platform,
-- or the posts leave a floating stub.
-- NOTE: this is a terrain READ (raycast) only. This build performs zero terrain writes.
local function boardBase(model)
	local F, y0, plat = plotFrame(model)
	if not F then return nil end
	local cfg  = BOARD[model.Name] or BOARD.BaseTemplate
	local a    = math.rad(cfg[1])
	local anch = F * CFrame.new(math.sin(a) * cfg[2], 0, math.cos(a) * cfg[2])
	local out  = (Vector3.new(anch.X, 0, anch.Z) - Vector3.new(plat.Position.X, 0, plat.Position.Z)).Unit
	local right = Vector3.new(out.Z, 0, -out.X)

	local groundY
	if model.Name == "BaseTemplate" then
		groundY = y0 - 2.50            -- no raycast: BaseTemplate sits over GameWorld.ThrowDeck.Deck
	else
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Workspace.Terrain }
		groundY = math.huge
		for _, dx in ipairs({ -6.4, 0, 6.4 }) do
			local sp = Vector3.new(anch.X, 0, anch.Z) + right * dx
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(sp.X, y0 + 50, sp.Z), Vector3.new(0, -140, 0), rp)
			if hit then groundY = math.min(groundY, hit.Position.Y) end
		end
		if groundY == math.huge then groundY = y0 - 2.50 end     -- fallback
		groundY = math.clamp(groundY, y0 - 6.0, y0 + 2.0)        -- sanity clamp
	end

	local o = Vector3.new(anch.X, groundY, anch.Z)
	-- G.LookVector == out, origin at GROUND. Enum.NormalId.Front is the -Z face, so
	-- Face = Front points AT the approaching player. In G, +x is the VIEWER'S LEFT.
	return CFrame.lookAt(o, o + out), groundY, y0
end
PlotBoardHandler.BoardBase = boardBase

-- ===== part table (spec 1.2.3) =====
local C = Color3.fromRGB
local BOARD_PARTS = {
	{ n = "Board",      s = Vector3.new(11, 6, 0.4),      c = CFrame.new(0, 6.00, 0),      m = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,    col = C(112, 76, 46), coll = true },
	{ n = "PostL",      s = Vector3.new(0.7, 10, 0.7),    c = CFrame.new(5.7, 4.00, 0.25), m = Enum.Material.Wood,          col = C(78, 52, 34),  coll = true },
	{ n = "PostR",      s = Vector3.new(0.7, 10, 0.7),    c = CFrame.new(-5.7, 4.00, 0.25),m = Enum.Material.Wood,          col = C(78, 52, 34),  coll = true },
	{ n = "Cap",        s = Vector3.new(12.6, 0.7, 2.2),  c = CFrame.new(0, 9.35, -0.60),  m = Enum.Material.Wood,          col = C(64, 42, 28),  coll = false },
	{ n = "Brace",      s = Vector3.new(11.8, 0.5, 0.5),  c = CFrame.new(0, 2.75, 0.10),   m = Enum.Material.Wood,          col = C(78, 52, 34),  coll = false },
	{ n = "LikePlaque", s = Vector3.new(3.4, 3.4, 0.5),   c = CFrame.new(-3.55, 5.35, -0.40), m = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, col = C(88, 58, 38), coll = false, query = true },
	{ n = "SignLamp",   s = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45),c = CFrame.new(0, 8.70, -1.35),  m = Enum.Material.Neon,          col = C(255, 214, 150), coll = false, noShadow = true },
}

local function buildBoardModel(model)
	if model:FindFirstChild("PlotBoard") then return model.PlotBoard end
	local G = boardBase(model)
	if not G then return nil end

	local board = Instance.new("Model")
	board.Name = "PlotBoard"

	local primary
	for _, d in ipairs(BOARD_PARTS) do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = d.n
		part.Size = d.s
		part.CFrame = G * d.c
		part.Material = d.m
		part.Color = d.col
		part.Anchored = true
		part.Locked = false
		part.CanCollide = d.coll
		part.CastShadow = not d.noShadow
		if d.query ~= nil then part.CanQuery = d.query end
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.Parent = board
		if d.n == "Board" then primary = part end
		if d.n == "SignLamp" then
			local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
			pl.Color = C(255, 198, 138)
			pl.Range = 14
			pl.Brightness = 1.4
			pl.Shadows = false
			pl.Parent = part
		end
	end

	board.PrimaryPart = primary
	board.Parent = model            -- parented INTO the plot Model so a Studio drag carries it
	return board
end

-- Invisible collidable step-up disc so the player stands ON the fire pit instead of
-- sinking 0.65 studs into CampDirt. r 5.60 == CAMPFIRE_RADIUS == CollectRing radius.
local function buildCampStand(model)
	if model:FindFirstChild("CampStand") then return model.CampStand end
	local campfire = model:FindFirstChild("Campfire")
	if not campfire then return nil end
	local cf = campfire.Position

	local stand = Instance.new("Part")
	stand.Name = "CampStand"
	stand.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	stand.Size = Vector3.new(0.40, 11.20, 11.20)              -- r = 5.60
	stand.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.X, cf.Y - 0.95, cf.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	stand.Anchored = true
	stand.CanCollide = true
	stand.Transparency = 1
	stand.CanQuery = false      -- must not eat the verification raycast nor a future mouse target query
	stand.CanTouch = false      -- load-bearing: the plot-claim trigger is Platform.Touched
	stand.CastShadow = false
	stand.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	stand.Locked = false
	stand.Parent = model
	return stand
end

-- USER DECISION U4: three low, CanCollide=false props where the tents used to be.
-- Keeps the warm silhouette at distance without reintroducing a wall.
local NOOK_PARTS = {
	{ n = "Bedroll",  s = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.5, 6.4), bearing = -176, r = 17.0,  y = 0.25, shape = nil,
	  post = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-176), 0), m = Enum.Material.Fabric, col = C(214, 128, 62) },
	{ n = "LogBench", s = Vector3.new(6.0, 1.0, 1.0), bearing = 168,  r = 18.0,  y = 0.5,  shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
	  post = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(78), math.rad(90)), m = Enum.Material.Wood, col = C(104, 72, 44) },
	{ n = "Stump",    s = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.4, 1.6), bearing = -165, r = 19.5,  y = 0.7,  shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
	  post = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), m = Enum.Material.Wood, col = C(88, 62, 38) },
}

local function buildCampNook(model)
	if not BUILD_CAMP_NOOK then return nil end
	if model:FindFirstChild("CampNook") then return model.CampNook end
	local F = plotFrame(model)
	if not F then return nil end

	local nook = Instance.new("Model")
	nook.Name = "CampNook"
	for _, d in ipairs(NOOK_PARTS) do
		local a = math.rad(d.bearing)
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = d.n
		if d.shape then part.Shape = d.shape end
		part.Size = d.s
		part.CFrame = F * CFrame.new(math.sin(a) * d.r, d.y, math.cos(a) * d.r) * d.post
		part.Material = d.m
		part.Color = d.col
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false        -- never a wall, never blocks the entrance
		part.CastShadow = true
		part.Locked = false
		part.Parent = nook
	end
	nook.Parent = model
	return nook
end

local function ensureLikePrompt(model)
	local board = model:FindFirstChild("PlotBoard")
	local plaque = board and board:FindFirstChild("LikePlaque")
	if not plaque then return nil end
	local prompt = plaque:FindFirstChild("LikePrompt")
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.Name = "LikePrompt"
		prompt.Parent = plaque
	end
	prompt.ActionText = "Like"
	prompt.ObjectText = ""
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.35
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.GamepadKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 16     -- reachable from behind the board too
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.UIOffset = Vector2.new(0, -20)
	prompt.Enabled = (model:GetAttribute("Claimed") == true)
	return prompt
end

-- Idempotent. model = any plot Model or ServerStorage.BaseTemplate (needs .Platform).
-- FindFirstChild throughout, never dot-indexing (plot.PlotBoard errors when absent).
function PlotBoardHandler.BuildBoard(model)
	if not model or not model:FindFirstChild("Platform") then return end
	local needNook = BUILD_CAMP_NOOK and not model:FindFirstChild("CampNook")
	if model:FindFirstChild("PlotBoard") and model:FindFirstChild("CampStand") and not needNook then
		ensureLikePrompt(model)
		return
	end
	buildBoardModel(model)
	buildCampStand(model)
	buildCampNook(model)
	ensureLikePrompt(model)
end

function PlotBoardHandler.Targets()
	local t = {}
	local bases = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if bases then
		for _, m in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChild("Platform") then table.insert(t, m) end
		end
	end
	local bt = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("BaseTemplate")
	if bt and bt:FindFirstChild("Platform") then table.insert(t, bt) end
	return t
end

function PlotBoardHandler.BuildAll()
	local n = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(PlotBoardHandler.Targets()) do
		PlotBoardHandler.BuildBoard(m)
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

-- ===== likes =====
local likeCooldown = {}   -- [Player] = os.clock()

function PlotBoardHandler.TryLike(player, plot)
	if not plot or not player then return false, "Something went wrong." end
	local now = os.clock()
	local last = likeCooldown[player]
	if last and (now - last) < 1.0 then return false, "Slow down!" end          -- (5) debounce
	likeCooldown[player] = now                                                 -- stamped BEFORE validation

	if plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") ~= true then return false, "Nobody lives here yet." end   -- (2)
	local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	if type(ownerId) ~= "number" or ownerId == 0 then return false, "Nobody lives here yet." end
	if ownerId == player.UserId then return false, "You can't like your own camp!" end        -- (1)

	local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
	if not owner or owner.Parent == nil then return false, "That camper just left." end       -- (6)

	local board  = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotBoard")
	local plaque = board and board:FindFirstChild("LikePlaque")
	local prompt = plaque and plaque:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	local char   = player.Character
	local hrp    = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (plaque and hrp) then return false, "Stand closer to the sign." end
	local slack = (prompt and prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 16) + 8
	if (plaque.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > slack then                                -- (4)
		return false, "Stand closer to the sign."
	end

	local likerData = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	local ownerData = PlayerDataManager.Get(owner)
	if not likerData or not ownerData then return false, "Something went wrong." end
	likerData.LikedPlayers = likerData.LikedPlayers or {}
	local key = tostring(ownerId)                                                             -- (3)
	if likerData.LikedPlayers[key] then return false, "You already liked this camp!" end

	likerData.LikedPlayers[key] = true
	ownerData.PlotLikes = (ownerData.PlotLikes or 0) + 1
	plot:SetAttribute("PlotLikes", ownerData.PlotLikes)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(owner)
	likeResult:FireClient(owner, {
		Success = true,
		Message = player.DisplayName .. " liked your camp!",
		PlotIndex = plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex"),
	})
	return true, "Liked " .. (plot:GetAttribute("OwnerName") or "camp") .. "!"
end

local function replyLike(who, plot, ok, reason)
	likeResult:FireClient(who, {
		Success = ok == true,
		Message = reason or (ok and "Liked!" or "Can't like that camp."),
		PlotIndex = plot and plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex"),
	})
end

local function plotByIndex(idx)
	local bases = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if not bases then return nil end
	for _, plot in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
		if plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") == idx then return plot end
	end
	return nil
end

local inited = false
function PlotBoardHandler.Init()
	if inited then return end
	inited = true

	PlotBoardHandler.BuildAll()

	local bases = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if bases then
		for _, plot in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
			if plot:IsA("Model") and plot:FindFirstChild("Platform") then
				local prompt = ensureLikePrompt(plot)
				if prompt then
					prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
						local ok, reason = PlotBoardHandler.TryLike(who, plot)
						replyLike(who, plot, ok, reason)
					end)
					-- GetAttributeChangedSignal fires with ZERO arguments: re-read the attribute.
					plot:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Claimed"):Connect(function()
						prompt.Enabled = (plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") == true)
					end)
					prompt.Enabled = (plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") == true)   -- initial state
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Secondary input: a mouse click on the plaque. Payload is a NUMBER only; the plot is
	-- resolved by its PlotIndex attribute. Never accept a client-supplied plot reference.
	likeRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, idx)
		if typeof(idx) ~= "number" or idx ~= idx then return end
		local plot = plotByIndex(idx)
		if not plot then
			replyLike(player, nil, false, "Can't like that camp.")
			return
		end
		local ok, reason = PlotBoardHandler.TryLike(player, plot)
		replyLike(player, plot, ok, reason)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		likeCooldown[p] = nil
	end)
end

return PlotBoardHandler


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/ServerScriptService/Modules/PriceIndex.lua =====
-- PriceIndex
-- Real price discovery for the 12 market stalls.
--
-- Every completed stall sale is a public, timestamped observation of what a
-- player ACTUALLY paid. Collect enough of them and the game can publish its own
-- honest value for an item, instead of leaving players to trust off-platform
-- "value lists" that anyone with a Discord can edit.
--
-- Three rules keep the published number honest:
--   1. MEDIAN, never mean. One whale overpaying 100x drags a mean a long way;
--      it moves a median by exactly one rank.
--   2. MIN_SAMPLES before anything is published at all. One trade is an
--      anecdote, not a price, so Get() returns nil until the sample is real.
--   3. ONE vote per counterparty PAIR. Wash trading is two accounts passing an
--      item back and forth at a fake price to manufacture a "value". The pair
--      key is UNORDERED on purpose: A->B and B->A are the same pair, which is
--      precisely the shape wash trading takes.
--
-- Storage degrades gracefully. Studio has no API access unless it is explicitly
-- enabled, so every DataStore call is pcall-wrapped exactly like the rest of the
-- game; when the store is unavailable the index just runs in memory for the life
-- of the server and nothing errors.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local PriceIndex = {}

local WINDOW = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60  -- 7-day rolling window, in seconds
local MIN_SAMPLES = 5            -- below this, Get() publishes no price at all
local MAX_PRICE = 1e12           -- sanity ceiling; a poisoned entry never lands
local MAX_PER_PAIR = 3           -- stored observations per pair, per item
local MAX_OBS_PER_ITEM = 120     -- hard storage cap per item; oldest dropped
local NUM_SHARDS = 16            -- items bucket into shards: few keys, few requests
local FLUSH_SECONDS = 120        -- write shards that have new observations
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 600      -- re-read every shard, to see other servers' sales
local FAILS_BEFORE_BACKOFF = 3
local BACKOFF_SECONDS = 300

-- read-only, for anything that wants to explain the number to a player
PriceIndex.WindowDays = 7
PriceIndex.MinSamples = MIN_SAMPLES

local store
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BrainrotSkip_PriceIndex_v1")
	end)
	store = ok and result or nil
end

-- index[itemKey] = { { T = unixTime, P = price, B = buyerUserId, S = sellerUserId }, ... }
-- kept sorted by T ascending, so list[1] is always the oldest
local index = {}
-- pending[itemKey] = { obs, ... } -- recorded, not yet written to the store
local pending = {}
local pendingCount = 0

local storeFails = 0
local backoffUntil = 0
local warned = false
local busy = false

-- Mutation is part of the identity: a Golden copy and a plain copy are two
-- different markets and must never share a price.
local function itemKey(name, mutation)
	return name .. "|" .. (mutation or "-")
end

-- UNORDERED. This is the whole anti-wash mechanism: swapping who is buying and
-- who is selling must not buy you a second vote.
local function pairKey(a, b)
	if a <= b then
		return a .. ":" .. b
	end
	return b .. ":" .. a
end

local function shardOf(key)
	local h = 5381
	for i = 1, #key do
		h = (h * 33 + string.byte(key, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return (h % NUM_SHARDS) + 1
end

local function shardName(shard)
	return "Idx_v1_" .. shard
end

local function storeReady()
	return store ~= nil and os.clock() >= backoffUntil
end

local function noteFailure(what, err)
	storeFails += 1
	if storeFails >= FAILS_BEFORE_BACKOFF then
		storeFails = 0
		backoffUntil = os.clock() + BACKOFF_SECONDS
		if not warned then
			warned = true
			warn(("[PriceIndex] DataStore unavailable (%s: %s); running in memory only"):format(what, tostring(err)))
		end
	end
end

local function noteSuccess()
	storeFails = 0
	warned = false -- so a genuine later outage is still reported once
end

-- Rejects anything malformed or out of the window. Stored data is untrusted:
-- it may be from an older schema, or hand-edited, and must never throw here.
local function validObs(o, cutoff, now)
	return type(o) == "table"
		and type(o.T) == "number" and o.T == o.T and o.T >= cutoff and o.T <= now + 86400
		and type(o.P) == "number" and o.P == o.P and o.P > 0 and o.P <= MAX_PRICE
		and type(o.B) == "number" and type(o.S) == "number" and o.B ~= o.S
end

local function countPair(list, key)
	local n = 0
	for _, o in ipairs(list) do
		if pairKey(o.B, o.S) == key then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- Prunes everything outside the 7-day window, folds `adds` in, and enforces the
-- storage caps. Pure and NON-YIELDING: this runs inside UpdateAsync's transform,
-- which Roblox may call more than once when another server writes first. Called
-- with adds = nil it is simply "prune to the window", which is what load does.
local function mergeShard(old, adds)
	local now = os.time()
	local cutoff = now - WINDOW
	local out = {}

	if type(old) == "table" then
		for key, list in pairs(old) do
			if type(key) == "string" and type(list) == "table" then
				local kept = {}
				for _, o in ipairs(list) do
					if validObs(o, cutoff, now) then
						table.insert(kept, o)
					end
				end
				if #kept > 0 then
					out[key] = kept
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if adds then
		for key, list in pairs(adds) do
			local dest = out[key]
			if not dest then
				dest = {}
				out[key] = dest
			end
			for _, o in ipairs(list) do
				local pk = pairKey(o.B, o.S)
				if validObs(o, cutoff, now) and countPair(dest, pk) < MAX_PER_PAIR then
					table.insert(dest, o)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for key, list in pairs(out) do
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.T < b.T end)
		while #list > MAX_OBS_PER_ITEM do
			table.remove(list, 1)
		end
		if #list == 0 then
			out[key] = nil
		end
	end

	return out
end

local function applyPending()
	for key, list in pairs(pending) do
		local dest = index[key]
		if not dest then
			dest = {}
			index[key] = dest
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(list) do
			table.insert(dest, o)
		end
		table.sort(dest, function(a, b) return a.T < b.T end)
	end
end

-- Rebuilds the whole in-memory view from the store, pruning anything older than
-- 7 days as it goes. On ANY failure it abandons the rebuild and keeps whatever
