local TRADE_POS = Vector3.new(8000, 2004.6, 7818) -- arrival deck south of the island (cove rebuild 2026-08-09); player lands off-island and walks in over the causeway
local HUB_POS = Vector3.new(24, 6, -16) -- back in the hub, just west of the trade portal
-- The Frozen Tundra: snowfield at (-8000, 2000, -8000), surface y = 2002, reached from
-- the locked portal on the dungeon's south wall. BoundsGuard has a matching "Tundra"
-- region -- without it a player would be rubber-banded back to spawn about half a
-- second after arriving.
-- Centre of the arrival disc. It used to be -8000, which is now the mouth of the shop's
-- tunnel -- arriving players would have materialised in the doorway.
local TUNDRA_POS = Vector3.new(-8000, 2006, -7975)
local DUNGEON_POS = Vector3.new(-146, -19, 62) -- dungeon floor, a few studs north of the portal
-- The Lush Gardens: World 3, an underground realm at (8000, 1000, -8000), reached
-- from the root-and-stone gate standing in the valley meadow at (160, 4, 60).
-- Arrivals land in the chamber at the far end of the entry gorge and walk north
-- through the slot, which opens into the Verdant Court. BoundsGuard has a matching
-- "Gardens" region -- without it players are rubber-banded home on arrival.
local GARDENS_POS = Vector3.new(8000, 1031, -6676)
local FORWARD = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
local TO_SHOPS = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) -- face -Z toward the back shop counters (ShopStall / SellStall)
local TO_HUB = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) -- face back toward spawn when returning

--=================== THE NAV BUTTONS ARE PER-WORLD ====================--
-- Skip / Shops / Plot used to be three fixed valley coordinates, so pressing any of them
-- in the Frozen Tundra silently threw the player 8000 studs back to World 1 -- which read
-- as the tundra ejecting you rather than as a teleport working.
--
-- Keyed on BoundsGuard's region names (via PlayerDataManager.PlayerWorld) so there is one
-- definition of where each world is. A world with no entry for a destination falls back
-- to the valley's, which is what the trading island wants: it has no dock or stalls of
-- its own, and "Skip" there should mean "take me somewhere I can skip".
local NAV = {
	Valley = {
		Throw = { pos = THROW_POS, look = FORWARD },
		Shops = { pos = SHOPS_POS, look = TO_SHOPS },
	},
	Tundra = {
		-- on the ice dock, facing up the lake past the SKIP HERE sign
		Throw = { pos = Vector3.new(-8000, 2004, -7800), look = FORWARD },
		-- middle of the ice hall, facing the back counters the same way the lodge does
		Shops = { pos = Vector3.new(-8000, 2005, -8090), look = TO_SHOPS },
	},
}

local function navTarget(player, destination)
	local world = PlayerDataManager.PlayerWorld(player)
	local here = world and NAV[world]
	return (here and here[destination]) or NAV.Valley[destination]
end

-- Which world's CAMP the player should be dealing with. Only two worlds have plots, so
-- the trading island resolves to the valley -- pressing Plot out there has always meant
-- "take me home", and it still should.
local function campWorld(player)
	return PlayerDataManager.PlayerWorld(player) == "Tundra" and "Tundra" or "Valley"
end

-- 2026-08-05 glitch pass: this place runs with workspace.StreamingEnabled =
-- true, and every teleport here was a bare PivotTo. That drops the character
-- into a region the client has not been sent yet, so the player watches the
-- world pop in around them for a second after arriving -- worst on the
-- valley <-> tundra hop, which is 8000 studs and guarantees a cold region.
--
-- RequestStreamAroundAsync asks the client to page that area in FIRST. It
-- yields, so it is pcall'd with a short timeout: a slow client should arrive
-- to a half-loaded world (what happened before) rather than not arrive at all.
-- Every call site is already inside its own event thread, so the yield costs
-- nothing else.
local STREAM_WAIT = 3

local function teleportCharacter(player, pos, lookDir)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	pcall(function()
		player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(pos, STREAM_WAIT)
	end)

	-- Re-check: the yield above means the character can have died, respawned or
	-- the player left while we waited.
	character = player.Character
	if not character or character ~= hrp.Parent then return end

	character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + lookDir))
	-- Carried momentum survives a PivotTo, so a player who was sprinting or
	-- falling arrives still moving and skids off the pad.
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Base-less player: drop them onto the first open plot. Touching it claims the base
-- (PlayerDataManager binds Touched on each plot's Platform).
--
-- Extracted into a function because it is needed from TWO destinations. The "Plot" tab
-- used to `if plot then ... end` with no else, so pressing it with no base did NOTHING --
-- no teleport, no message, no error. The open-plot logic existed but only "OpenPlot"
-- reached it, and only the throw button ever sends that.
-- IN THE WORLD THEY ARE STANDING IN. A camp is per-world now, so sending a tundra player
-- to a free valley plot would both teleport them out of the world they were in and use up
-- the wrong one of their two claims.
local function teleportToOpenPlot(player)
	local world = campWorld(player)
	if PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player, world) then return false end   -- already has one here
	local plotsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	local target
	if plotsFolder then
		-- iterate the folder rather than Plot1..Plot6 by name: the count is not guaranteed
		-- and a renamed or added plot would be silently skipped by a hardcoded range.
		for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if plot:IsA("Model") and not plot:GetAttribute("Claimed")
				and plot:GetAttribute("World") == world then
				target = plot
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if target then
		-- Land OFF-CENTRE. The plot pivot sits directly above the Campfire, so the old
		-- `pivot + (0,6,0)` dropped the player onto the fire and they never contacted the
		-- Platform at all -- which is what the claim listens to. Verified by raycast:
		-- offset 0 hits Campfire, -10 hits Pad1, -14 hits Platform cleanly.
		local pivot = target:GetPivot().Position
		teleportCharacter(player, pivot + Vector3.new(0, 6, -14), FORWARD)
		-- Then claim it OUTRIGHT rather than waiting for Platform.Touched to fire. A
		-- teleport is not a reliable touch -- the character can settle on a pad, a pit
		-- stone or the campfire and silently never claim, which is exactly the dead end
		-- this button had. Walking on still works via Touched; this just makes the
		-- button deterministic. ClaimPlotFor already refuses if the plot is taken or the
		-- player owns one, so it cannot double-claim.
		PlayerDataManager.ClaimPlotFor(player, target)
		return true
	end
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if r then r:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = "All camps in this world are taken right now!" }) end
	return false
end

-- Assigned further down, once portalDests AND notify both exist. Forward-declared
-- here because the handler below is written before either of them.
local travelToWorld

remotes.TeleportTo.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, destination)
	if typeof(destination) ~= "string" then return end

	if destination == "Throw" or destination == "Shops" then
		local t = navTarget(player, destination)
		teleportCharacter(player, t.pos, t.look)
	elseif destination == "Trade" then
		teleportCharacter(player, TRADE_POS, FORWARD)
	elseif destination == "Plot" then
		-- THE CAMP IN THIS WORLD, explicitly. GetPlot with no world falls back to any camp
		-- they own, which is right for proximity checks and wrong here: in the tundra with
		-- only a valley camp, that fallback would fling them out of the world they are in
		-- instead of handing them a tundra camp.
		local plot = PlayerDataManager.GetPlot(player, campWorld(player))
		if plot then
			local pivot = plot:GetPivot()
			-- stand near the front edge of the plot, looking across the pads
			local pos = pivot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, -22)
			teleportCharacter(player, pos, FORWARD)
		else
			-- THE FIX: no base yet, so send them somewhere they can get one rather than
			-- doing nothing. This is the whole point of the button for a new player.
			teleportToOpenPlot(player)
		end
	elseif destination == "OpenPlot" then
		teleportToOpenPlot(player)
	elseif travelToWorld then
		-- WORLD FAST TRAVEL (the Worlds tab). Anything not matched above is treated as
		-- a world id and validated in there: an id that is not on the board, or a world
		-- this player has never stood in, is refused. So reaching this branch cannot
		-- become a way to name arbitrary coordinates.
		travelToWorld(player, destination)
	end
end)

-- === Walk-through portals (Pet Sim style) ===
-- A player who touches a portal's PortalTouch part is teleported to the
-- destination named in its Dest attribute.
local portalDests = {
	Trade = { pos = TRADE_POS, look = FORWARD },
	Hub = { pos = HUB_POS, look = TO_HUB },
	Tundra = { pos = TUNDRA_POS, look = FORWARD },
	Dungeon = { pos = DUNGEON_POS, look = FORWARD },
	-- facing -Z, up the gorge toward the hub
	Gardens = { pos = GARDENS_POS, look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) },
}

--=================== CROSS-PLACE PORTALS ===================--
-- World 2 runs on its own Place in this universe so tundra servers are separate from
-- valley servers. Same universe means the same DataStore, so profiles carry for free --
-- but two servers can then hold one profile, which is what SessionLock exists to stop.
--
-- TUNDRA_PLACE_ID = 0 means "not split out yet": every portal falls back to the in-place
-- jump below and nothing changes. Fill it in once the Place exists and the portals
-- become real teleports with no other edit.
local MAIN_PLACE_ID = 78783087742939
local TUNDRA_PLACE_ID = 0

-- Resolved per place, so ONE script is correct in both.
--
-- WHY BOTH PLACES CONTAIN BOTH WORLDS. 22 scripts reach for valley-only objects and 5
-- of them use a bare WaitForChild -- ClientMain waits on ShopStall at line ~423, so in a
-- tundra-only place the core client would hang there and never finish initialising.
-- Rather than guard 22 files (and every future one), the tundra Place is a full copy of
-- this one. The valley geometry simply goes unvisited there.
--
-- That leaves one hazard: the valley is still physically present on a tundra server, so
-- every portal that leads INTO the valley has to become a cross-place teleport, or the
-- population quietly splits across two copies of the same world.
local PLACE_IDS = {}
if TUNDRA_PLACE_ID > 0 then
	if game.PlaceId == MAIN_PLACE_ID then
		PLACE_IDS.Tundra = TUNDRA_PLACE_ID          -- leaving for World 2
	elseif game.PlaceId == TUNDRA_PLACE_ID then
		-- On a tundra server EVERY valley-bound portal goes home to the main place.
		PLACE_IDS.Dungeon = MAIN_PLACE_ID
		PLACE_IDS.Hub = MAIN_PLACE_ID
		PLACE_IDS.Trade = MAIN_PLACE_ID
	end
end

local teleporting = {}   -- [player] = true; a second touch must not fire a second teleport

local function sendToPlace(player, placeId, destName)
	if teleporting[player] then return end
	teleporting[player] = true

	-- Release BEFORE leaving, and await it. The destination server claims the SAME
	-- profile key; if our lock is still held it refuses and the player lands in a
	-- read-only session, losing everything they do there.
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if data then data.LastSeen = os.time() end
	SessionLock.Release(player.UserId, data)

	local opts = Instance.new("TeleportOptions")
	opts:SetTeleportData({ fromPlace = game.PlaceId, dest = destName })

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		RbxTeleport:TeleportAsync(placeId, { player }, opts)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- We already gave up the lock, so take it back or this session saves nothing.
		SessionLock.Claim(player.UserId)
		teleporting[player] = nil
		notify(player, "Could not reach that world right now \u{2014} try again in a moment.")
		warn(("[TeleportService] TeleportAsync failed for %s -> place %d: %s")
			:format(player.Name, placeId, tostring(err)))
	end
end

-- Roblox fires this when the teleport itself fails after being accepted. Same recovery:
-- reclaim the profile, because the player is still on this server.
RbxTeleport.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, result, message)
	SessionLock.Claim(player.UserId)
	teleporting[player] = nil
	notify(player, "That world is not reachable at the moment. Please try again.")
	warn(("[TeleportService] TeleportInitFailed %s: %s (%s)")
		:format(player.Name, tostring(result), tostring(message)))
end)

-- LOCKED PORTALS. A portal whose PortalTouch carries a RequiresKey attribute costs that
-- many of Gianluca's keys (data.Keys -- the same counter GianlucaQuest and TungQuest pay
-- out) the FIRST time it is used. After that the UnlockFlag is stamped on the profile and
-- it is free forever: the key buys the destination, it is not a toll on every trip.
--
-- Declared as attributes on the part rather than a table in here, so adding a locked
-- portal later is a build-time change with no script edit.
local function notify(player, message)
	local r = remotes:FindFirstChild("PurchaseResult")
	if r then r:FireClient(player, { Success = false, Message = message }) end
end

-- Returns true if the player may pass. Consumes the key on the unlocking trip.
local function passesLock(player, touchPart)
	local cost = touchPart:GetAttribute("RequiresKey")
	if not cost or cost <= 0 then return true end

	local flag = touchPart:GetAttribute("UnlockFlag")
	local place = touchPart:GetAttribute("PlaceName") or "this place"
	local data = PlayerDataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return false end

	if flag and data[flag] then return true end -- already paid, walk straight through

	local held = tonumber(data.Keys) or 0
	if held < cost then
		notify(player, ("\u{1F512} The way to %s is locked \u{2014} you need %d of Gianluca's keys (you have %d).")
			:format(place, cost, held))
		return false
	end

	data.Keys = held - cost
	if flag then data[flag] = true end
	PlayerDataManager.PushUpdate(player)
	notify(player, ("\u{1F513} You unlocked %s with Gianluca's key!"):format(place))
	return true
end

-- Fills the forward declaration above. Deliberately down here: it needs both
-- portalDests (the arrival points) and notify (the refusal toast).
--
-- REUSES THE PORTAL'S OWN ARRIVAL POINT rather than carrying coordinates of its
-- own, so the Worlds tab and the walk-through portal can never disagree about
-- where a world begins -- and fast travel inherits teleportCharacter's
-- RequestStreamAroundAsync wait, which is what stops an 8,000-stud hop dropping
-- the player into a world that has not been sent to them yet.
travelToWorld = function(player, id)
	local dest = WorldTravelConfig.ById[id]
	if not dest then return end   -- not a world id at all; silently ignore

	local ok, why = WorldTravelService.CanTravel(player, id)
	if not ok then
		notify(player, why or "You cannot travel there yet.")
		return
	end

	local target = portalDests[dest.Dest]
	if not target then
		warn(("[TeleportService] world %q names portal dest %q, which does not exist")
			:format(id, tostring(dest.Dest)))
		return
	end
	teleportCharacter(player, target.pos, target.look)
	-- teleportCharacter yields until the character has actually moved, so by here the
	-- player IS in the new world -- refresh rather than waiting out the sampler, or
	-- reopening the board straight after arriving shows the world you just left as
	-- YOU ARE HERE.
	pcall(WorldTravelService.Refresh, player)
end

local lastPortalUse = {} -- [player] = os.clock(); debounce so one pass = one teleport

-- Walking through a portal is the OTHER way to change world, and the board has to
-- follow it just as closely as it follows fast travel -- a portal is in fact how a
-- world gets discovered in the first place.
local function refreshTravelBoard(player)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(0.35)   -- let the arrival settle before reading the region back
		pcall(WorldTravelService.Refresh, player)
	end)
end

local function setupPortal(touchPart)
	local dest = touchPart:GetAttribute("Dest")
	local target = dest and portalDests[dest]
	if not target then return end
	touchPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		if not player then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastPortalUse[player] and now - lastPortalUse[player] < 1.5 then return end
		-- debounce BEFORE the lock check too, or a player standing in a locked portal
		-- gets the "you need a key" message every physics frame
		lastPortalUse[player] = now
		if not passesLock(player, touchPart) then return end
		-- A destination with a Place behind it leaves this server entirely; everything
		-- else is the in-place jump this game has always used.
		local placeId = PLACE_IDS[dest]
		if placeId and placeId > 0 then
			sendToPlace(player, placeId, dest)
		else
			teleportCharacter(player, target.pos, target.look)
			-- a portal is how a world gets DISCOVERED, so the board has to hear about
			-- this arrival as promptly as it hears about a fast travel
			refreshTravelBoard(player)
		end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local portals = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld"):WaitForChild("Portals")
	for _, model in ipairs(portals:GetChildren()) do
		local touch = model:FindFirstChild("PortalTouch")
		if touch then setupPortal(touch) end
	end
	portals.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
		local touch = model:FindFirstChild("PortalTouch") or model:WaitForChild("PortalTouch", 5)
		if touch then setupPortal(touch) end
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastPortalUse[player] = nil
	teleporting[player] = nil
end)

print(("TeleportService online (place %d; cross-place portals %s)")
	:format(game.PlaceId, TUNDRA_PLACE_ID > 0 and "ENABLED" or "off -- TUNDRA_PLACE_ID not set"))


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterGui/ScreenGui/Model/Model/Script.server.lua =====
print("Hello world!")


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BackpackClient.client.lua =====
-- BackpackClient: a real inventory panel for your uncollected brainrots.
--
-- WHY THIS EXISTS: every unplaced brainrot is a Roblox Tool, and the default
-- hotbar only shows ten. A player holding 100+ simply cannot reach most of
-- their collection. This groups identical copies into one card with a count,
-- so a hundred items become a readable dozen rows.
--
-- Clicking a card EQUIPS that brainrot, which makes the character hold it out
-- (see InventoryHandler.buildHeld on the server). Clicking again puts it away.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MainUI")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local RarityConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RarityConfig)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)
local UITheme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UITheme)
local SideRail = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SideRail)
local shorten = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat).Short
local BrainrotThumb = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotThumb)
local RarityFX = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RarityFX)
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetConfig)

local CF = UITheme.Camp
local FONT = UITheme.Font

local infoByName, tierByName = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do infoByName[e.Name] = e end
for _, t in ipairs(RarityConfig) do tierByName[t.Name] = t end

---------------------------------------------------------------- open button
-- The bag sits WITH the hotbar now rather than on the side rail. The bottom of
-- the screen is the inventory: six brainrot slots, and this is the door to the
-- rest of the collection.
local openBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
openBtn.Name = "BackpackOpen"

-- Short-viewport guard: shrink and push the panel down so it never covers the
-- top TabBar band (146px) and keeps a 40px bottom margin. Anchor stays (0.5, 0.5).
local FRAME_H = 604
local hudScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
hudScale.Name = "HudFixScale"
hudScale.Parent = frame
local function relayout()
	local vh = gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if vh <= 0 then return end
	local s = math.min(1, (vh - 146 - 40) / FRAME_H)
	hudScale.Scale = s
	-- clamp so the panel's top edge sits at or below the 146px band
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, math.max(0, 146 + FRAME_H * s / 2 - vh / 2))
end
gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
relayout()

---------------------------------------------------------------- state
local owned = {}        -- array of { Name, Mutation, Uid }
local equippedUid = nil
local pets = {}         -- array of { Uid, Id } straight from the snapshot
local petSlots = {}     -- equipped pet Uids, server-authoritative
local selectedPetUid = nil   -- which pet's stat sheet is open, nil = the grid

local function isPetEquipped(uid)
	for _, u in ipairs(petSlots) do
		if u == uid then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function findTool(uid)
	for _, container in ipairs({ player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), player.Character }) do
		if container then
			for _, t in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("Uid") == uid then return t end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function toggleHold(uid)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	local tool = findTool(uid)
	if not tool then
		-- Only six brainrots have a Tool at any moment (InventoryHandler caps the
		-- hotbar). Anything else has no Tool to equip, so ask the server to swap it
		-- into a slot -- it evicts the oldest and equips this one.
		remotes.EquipBrainrot:FireServer(uid)
		equippedUid = uid
		return
	end
	if tool.Parent == char then
		hum:UnequipTools()
		equippedUid = nil
	else
		hum:EquipTool(tool)
		equippedUid = uid
	end
end

local build   -- forward: the sheet's buttons rebuild the grid behind them

-- Trims 2.00 -> "2" and 1.50 -> "1.5" WITHOUT eating the zero in a whole number:
-- the naive tostring(v):gsub("%.?0+$", "") turns "10" into "1", which quietly
-- advertised the Secret pet's 10x money boost as 1x. Format to 2dp first so there is
-- always a decimal point, then only strip zeros behind it.
local function trimNum(v)
	local s = string.format("%.2f", v)
	s = s:gsub("0+$", "")
	s = s:gsub("%.$", "")
	return s
end

local function petRecord(uid)
	for _, p in ipairs(pets) do
		if p.Uid == uid then return p end
	end
	return nil
end

local function showSheet(uid)
	local rec = petRecord(uid)
	local def = rec and PetConfig.Pets[rec.Id]
	if not def then
		selectedPetUid = nil
		sheet.Visible = false
		return
	end
	selectedPetUid = uid

	local luck, income = PetConfig.BoostsFor(rec.Id)
	local accent = PetConfig.RARITY_COLOUR[def.Rarity] or CF.wood1
	sheetName.Text = def.Name
	sheetRarity.Text = def.Rarity:upper()
	sheetRarity.TextColor3 = accent
	sheetLuck.Text = ("\u{1F340}  LUCK  %sx"):format(trimNum(luck))
	sheetMoney.Text = ("\u{1F4B0}  MONEY  %sx"):format(trimNum(income))

	local cap = PetConfig.SLOTS_FREE
	sheetSlots.Text = ("equipped %d / %d  \u{2022}  boosts stack while equipped"):format(#petSlots, cap)

	local equipped = isPetEquipped(uid)
	-- a full slot bar must not look clickable when it cannot do anything
	local blocked = (not equipped) and #petSlots >= cap
	if blocked then
		equipLabel.Text = ("SLOTS FULL (%d/%d)"):format(#petSlots, cap)
		UITheme.setColors(equipBtn, Color3.fromRGB(150, 154, 164), Color3.fromRGB(110, 114, 124))
	else
		equipLabel.Text = equipped and "UNEQUIP" or "EQUIP"
		UITheme.setColors(equipBtn, equipped and CF.wood1 or CF.pine1, equipped and CF.wood2 or CF.pine2)
	end
	equipBtn:SetAttribute("Blocked", blocked)

	-- 3D render of the creature, rebuilt each time so it matches the selection
	for _, c in ipairs(sheetThumb:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
	local vp = BrainrotThumb.add(sheetThumb, def.Name, {
		size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		zIndex = 27,
	})
	if not vp then
		local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
		sw.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		sw.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		sw.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
		sw.BorderSizePixel = 0
		sw.ZIndex = 27
		sw.Parent = sheetThumb
		UITheme.corner(sw, 10)
	end
	sheet.Visible = true
end

local function hideSheet()
	selectedPetUid = nil
	sheet.Visible = false
end

backBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(hideSheet)
equipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not selectedPetUid then return end
	if equipBtn:GetAttribute("Blocked") then return end
	-- Server decides. petSlots is only ever written from the snapshot the server pushes
	-- back, so the tick and the slot count can never claim something it refused.
	remotes.PetEquip:FireServer(selectedPetUid, not isPetEquipped(selectedPetUid))
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- pet grid
local function buildPets()
	counter.Text = ("%d PETS  \u{00B7}  %d / %d EQUIPPED"):format(#pets, #petSlots, PetConfig.SLOTS_FREE)
	hint.Text = "click a pet to see its stats \u{2022} equip it and it follows you around"

	if #pets == 0 then
		local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		empty.Name = "EmptyNote"
		empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60)
		empty.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -30)
		empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		empty.Font = FONT
		empty.TextSize = 16
		empty.TextColor3 = CF.muted
		empty.Text = "no pets yet \u{2014} hatch an egg at the Egg Stall"
		empty.ZIndex = 14
		empty.Parent = frame
		return
	end

	-- rarest first, then name, so the best pet is the first thing you see
	local rank = {}
	for i, r in ipairs(PetConfig.RARITY_ORDER) do rank[r] = i end
	local order = table.clone(pets)
	table.sort(order, function(a, b)
		local da, db = PetConfig.Pets[a.Id], PetConfig.Pets[b.Id]
		local ra = da and rank[da.Rarity] or 99
		local rb = db and rank[db.Rarity] or 99
		if ra ~= rb then return ra < rb end
		local na = da and da.Name or a.Id
		local nb = db and db.Name or b.Id
		if na ~= nb then return na < nb end
		return tostring(a.Uid) < tostring(b.Uid)
	end)

	for i, p in ipairs(order) do
		local def = PetConfig.Pets[p.Id]
		if def then
			local accent = PetConfig.RARITY_COLOUR[def.Rarity] or CF.wood1
			local luck, income = PetConfig.BoostsFor(p.Id)
			local card, outer = UITheme.accentCard(list, accent, 12)
			outer.LayoutOrder = i
			outer.ZIndex = 12
			card.ZIndex = 13
			RarityFX.attach(outer, card, def.Rarity, accent, i * 0.37)

			local vp = BrainrotThumb.add(card, def.Name, {
				size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 84),
				position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4),
				zIndex = 14,
			})
			if not vp then
				local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
				sw.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 84)
				sw.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
				sw.BackgroundColor3 = accent
				sw.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
				sw.BorderSizePixel = 0
				sw.ZIndex = 14
				sw.Parent = card
				UITheme.corner(sw, 8)
			end

			local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			val.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
			val.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 90)
			val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			val.Font = FONT
			val.TextSize = 13
			val.TextColor3 = CF.ink
			val.Text = ("%sx \u{1F340}  %sx \u{1F4B0}"):format(trimNum(luck), trimNum(income))
			val.ZIndex = 16
			val.Parent = card
			UITheme.inkText(val, 1.8)

			local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
			nm.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 110)
			nm.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			nm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			nm.TextSize = 11
			nm.TextColor3 = CF.muted
			nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			nm.Text = def.Name
			nm.ZIndex = 16
			nm.Parent = card

			if isPetEquipped(p.Uid) then
				local tick = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
				tick.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
				tick.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				tick.BorderSizePixel = 0
				tick.Font = FONT
				tick.TextSize = 15
				tick.TextColor3 = CF.onDark
				tick.Text = "\u{2713}"
				tick.ZIndex = 17
				tick.Parent = card
				UITheme.corner(tick, 12)
				UITheme.gradient(tick, CF.pine1, CF.pine2, 90)
				UITheme.ink(tick, 2)
				UITheme.inkText(tick, 2)
			end

			local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
			hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			hit.Text = ""
			hit.ZIndex = 18
			hit.Parent = card
			hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showSheet(p.Uid) end)
		end
	end
end

local function buildBrainrots()
	buildKeyTile()
	hint.Text = "click a brainrot to hold it \u{2022} then aim at an empty spot on your base and click to place"

	-- group identical copies: a hundred items becomes a readable dozen rows
	local groups, order = {}, {}
	for _, item in ipairs(owned) do
		local key = (item.Mutation or "") .. "|" .. item.Name
		local g = groups[key]
		if not g then
			g = { Name = item.Name, Mutation = item.Mutation, count = 0, uids = {} }
			groups[key] = g
			order[#order + 1] = g
		end
		g.count += 1
		g.uids[#g.uids + 1] = item.Uid
	end

	-- richest first, so the best thing you own is always the first thing you see
	table.sort(order, function(a, b)
		local ia = infoByName[a.Name]
		local ib = infoByName[b.Name]
		local va = (ia and ia.CashPerSecond or 0) * Mutations.Mult(a.Mutation)
		local vb = (ib and ib.CashPerSecond or 0) * Mutations.Mult(b.Mutation)
		if va ~= vb then return va > vb end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)

	counter.Text = ("%d BRAINROTS  \u{00B7}  %d KINDS"):format(#owned, #order)

	if #order == 0 then
		local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		empty.Name = "EmptyNote"
		empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60)
		empty.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -30)
		empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		empty.Font = FONT
		empty.TextSize = 16
		empty.TextColor3 = CF.muted
		empty.Text = "nothing here yet \u{2014} go skip some rocks"
		empty.ZIndex = 14
		empty.Parent = frame
		return
	end

	for i, g in ipairs(order) do
		local info = infoByName[g.Name]
		local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
		local accent = tier and tier.Color or CF.wood1
		local each = (info and info.CashPerSecond or 0) * Mutations.Mult(g.Mutation)

		local isHeld = false
		for _, uid in ipairs(g.uids) do if uid == equippedUid then isHeld = true end end

		-- the rarity colour IS the border: across a grid this dense that is what
		-- carries the tier read, where a text label would be unreadable
		local card, outer = UITheme.accentCard(list, accent, 12)
		outer.LayoutOrder = i
		outer.ZIndex = 12
		card.ZIndex = 13

		-- Rare and up get glow / shimmer / sparkles / a cycling border. Common and
		-- Uncommon deliberately get nothing, which is what makes the rest read as
		-- special. The phase offset stops the whole grid pulsing in lockstep.
		RarityFX.attach(outer, card, info and info.Rarity, accent, i * 0.37)

		-- the actual 3D brainrot, which is the whole point of the grid
		local vp = BrainrotThumb.add(card, g.Name, {
			size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 84),
			position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4),
			zIndex = 14,
		})
		if not vp then
			-- no model for this name: a flat rarity swatch keeps the tile
			-- readable instead of leaving a hole
			local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
			sw.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 84)
			sw.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
			sw.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			sw.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
			sw.BorderSizePixel = 0
			sw.ZIndex = 14
			sw.Parent = card
			UITheme.corner(sw, 8)
		end

		local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		val.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
		val.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 90)
		val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		val.Font = FONT
		val.TextSize = 15
		val.TextColor3 = CF.ink
		val.Text = "$" .. shorten(each) .. "/s"
		val.ZIndex = 16
		val.Parent = card
		UITheme.inkText(val, 1.8)

		local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
		nm.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 110)
		nm.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		nm.TextSize = 11
		nm.TextColor3 = CF.muted
		nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nm.Text = (g.Mutation and (g.Mutation .. " ") or "") .. g.Name
		nm.ZIndex = 16
		nm.Parent = card

		-- stack count, only when you own more than one
		if g.count > 1 then
			local chip = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 20)
			chip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
			chip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
			chip.Font = FONT
			chip.TextSize = 13
			chip.TextColor3 = CF.onDark
			chip.Text = "\u{00D7}" .. g.count
			chip.ZIndex = 17
			chip.Parent = card
			UITheme.corner(chip, 7)
			UITheme.gradient(chip, CF.wood1, CF.wood2, 90)
			UITheme.ink(chip, 2)
			UITheme.inkText(chip, 2)
		end

		-- green tick on the one you are holding, same read as the reference grid
		if isHeld then
			local tick = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
			tick.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
			tick.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			tick.BorderSizePixel = 0
			tick.Font = FONT
			tick.TextSize = 15
			tick.TextColor3 = CF.onDark
			tick.Text = "\u{2713}"
			tick.ZIndex = 17
			tick.Parent = card
			UITheme.corner(tick, 12)
			UITheme.gradient(tick, CF.pine1, CF.pine2, 90)
			UITheme.ink(tick, 2)
			UITheme.inkText(tick, 2)
		end

		-- whole tile is the button: a grid cell is a big, forgiving hit target
		local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
		hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hit.Text = ""
		hit.ZIndex = 18
		hit.Parent = card
		hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			toggleHold(g.uids[1])
			build()
		end)
	end
end

-- Shared teardown + dispatch. `build` was forward-declared above so the stat sheet's
-- buttons could call it before it existed.
function build()
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIGridLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	RarityFX.reset()
	local note = frame:FindFirstChild("EmptyNote")
	if note then note:Destroy() end

	if mode == MODE_PETS then
		buildPets()
	else
		buildBrainrots()
	end
end

local function setMode(which)
	mode = which
	hideSheet()
	for id, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
		local on = (id == which)
		UITheme.setColors(btn, on and CF.pine1 or CF.wood1, on and CF.pine2 or CF.wood2)
	end
	build()
	list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
end
for id, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode(id) end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
local function applySnapshot(snap)
	if typeof(snap) ~= "table" or not snap.Brainrots then return end
	keyCount = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(snap.Keys) or 0))

	-- Pets are server-authoritative: both the roster and what is equipped come straight
	-- from the snapshot, so an equip the server refused never renders as equipped here.
	pets = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(snap.Pets or {}) do
		if p.Uid and p.Id then pets[#pets + 1] = { Uid = p.Uid, Id = p.Id } end
	end
	petSlots = {}
	for _, u in ipairs(snap.PetSlots or {}) do petSlots[#petSlots + 1] = u end

	owned = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(snap.Brainrots) do
		-- only UNPLACED copies live in the backpack; placed ones are on the base
		if not e.PadIndex and e.Uid then
			owned[#owned + 1] = { Name = e.Name, Mutation = e.Mutation, Uid = e.Uid }
		end
	end
	if frame.Visible then
		build()
		-- keep an open stat sheet honest after an equip round-trip
		if selectedPetUid then showSheet(selectedPetUid) end
	end
end

local function setOpen(open)
	frame.Visible = open
	if open then
		-- setMode does the tab recolour, the rebuild, AND the scroll reset that
		-- AutomaticCanvasSize would otherwise carry over between openings (which used to
		-- open the grid already scrolled with the top row cut in half).
		setMode(mode)
	end
end

openBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setOpen(not frame.Visible) end)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setOpen(false) end)

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function() return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok then applySnapshot(snap) end
end)
remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(applySnapshot)

-- keep the HOLDING state honest if the player unequips with the hotbar or dies
local function watchCharacter(char)
	char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
		if c:IsA("Tool") and c:GetAttribute("Uid") == equippedUid then
			equippedUid = nil
			if frame.Visible then build() end
		end
	end)
end
if player.Character then watchCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	equippedUid = nil
	watchCharacter(char)
end)

-- "1.5k" / "2m" style price entry, because prices here run into the millions
local SUFFIX = { k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 }
local function parsePrice(text)
	text = string.gsub(string.lower(text or ""), "[%s,$]", "")
	local num, suffix = string.match(text, "^(%d+%.?%d*)(%a?)$")
	if not num then return nil end
	local mult = suffix == "" and 1 or SUFFIX[suffix]
	if not mult then return nil end
	return math.floor(tonumber(num) * mult)
end

	if not snapshot then return end
	myCounts = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(snapshot.Brainrots or {}) do
		myCounts[entry.Name] = (myCounts[entry.Name] or 0) + 1
	end
	if renderStand then renderStand() end
	if renderPicker then renderPicker() end
end

	if not camera then return end
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize
	canvasScale.Scale = math.min(vp.X / T.size.canvas.X, vp.Y / T.size.canvas.Y)
end

-- panel scaffold: an invisible SHELL (the visibility handle) holding the panel
-- surface. UI.panel's hard shadow is a sibling that does NOT track Visible, so
-- hiding a bare panel strands its black shadow on screen; inside a shell, the
-- shadow hides with everything else. Returns shell, panel, title, close.
local function makePanel(name, w, h, titleText)
	local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
	shell.Name = name
	shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shell.Visible = false
	shell.ZIndex = 10
	shell.Parent = root
	local p = UI.panel(shell, UDim2.fromOffset(w, h))
	p.Name = "Surface"
	local title = UI.label(p, titleText, "panelTitle")
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0)
	local close = UI.button(p, "X", "red", UDim2.fromOffset(T.size.closeButton.X, T.size.closeButton.Y), "buttonL")
	close.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w - 2 * T.pad.panel - T.size.closeButton.X, -2)
	return shell, p, title, close
end

-- track-styled TextBox (search bars, price box)
local function makeTextBox(parent, size, placeholder)
	local shell = UI.surface(parent, size, "track", T.radius.inner, T.stroke.hairline)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
	box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
	box.Text = ""
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.color.textMuted
	box.TextColor3 = T.color.white
	box.FontFace = T.font.ui
	box.TextSize = 18
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.ClipsDescendants = true
	box.ZIndex = (shell.ZIndex or 1) + 1
	box.Parent = shell
	return shell, box
end

-- item art: real 3D thumb, or tier-coloured swatch fallback
local function addArt(parent, name, size, position)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = size
	holder.Position = position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = (parent.ZIndex or 1) + 1
	holder.Parent = parent
	if not Thumb.add(holder, name, { size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) }) then
		local info = infoByName[name]
		local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
		local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
		sw.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.6)
		sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		sw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		sw.BackgroundColor3 = tier and tier.Color or T.color.white
		sw.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
		sw.Parent = holder
		UI.corner(sw, T.radius.art)
		UI.stroke(sw, T.stroke.hairline)
	end
	return holder
end

local function tierStroke(card, name)
	local info = infoByName[name]
	local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.ZIndex = (card.ZIndex or 1) + 2
	f.Parent = card
	UI.corner(f, T.radius.slot)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = 4
	s.Color = tier and tier.Color or T.color.rarityCommon
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = f
	return f
end

local function clearChildren(container)
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
	end
end

-- =====================================================================
-- rendering
-- =====================================================================
renderStand = function()
	if not standShell.Visible then return end
	standTitle.Text = ("MY STAND  (%d/%d)"):format(#myListings, maxListings)
	clearChildren(standGrid)

	local shown = {}
	for _, listing in ipairs(myListings) do
		if standSearch == "" or string.find(string.lower(listing.Name), standSearch, 1, true) then
			table.insert(shown, listing)
		end
	end
	if standSort == "PRICE" then
		table.sort(shown, function(a, b) return a.Price > b.Price end)
	else
		table.sort(shown, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	end

	for order, listing in ipairs(shown) do
		local card = UI.surface(standGrid, UDim2.fromOffset(160, 200), "slot", T.radius.slot, T.stroke.hairline)
		card.LayoutOrder = order
		card.ZIndex = standGrid.ZIndex + 1
		tierStroke(card, listing.Name)
		addArt(card, listing.Name, UDim2.fromOffset(120, 104), UDim2.fromOffset(20, 10))
		local nameL = UI.label(card, listing.Name, "chip")
		nameL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		nameL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 118)
		nameL.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		nameL.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18)
		nameL.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		nameL.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

		priceL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)

	-- UI.button's HardShadow is a SIBLING frame, and loose in a UIGridLayout it

	createL.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	createL.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 60)
	createL.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	createL.TextWrapped = true

		create.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			standShell.Visible = false
			pickerShell.Visible = true
			renderPicker()
			refreshScrim()
		end)
	end
end

renderPicker = function()
	if not pickerShell.Visible then return end
	clearChildren(pickerGrid)

	-- owned minus already-listed
	local listedOf = {}
	for _, listing in ipairs(myListings) do
		listedOf[listing.Name] = (listedOf[listing.Name] or 0) + 1
	end
	local names = {}
	for name, count in pairs(myCounts) do
		local available = count - (listedOf[name] or 0)
		if available > 0 and (pickerSearch == "" or string.find(string.lower(name), pickerSearch, 1, true)) then
			table.insert(names, { name = name, count = available })
		end
	end
	if pickerSort == "NAME" then
		table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
	elseif pickerSort == "RARITY" then
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			local ia, ib = infoByName[a.name], infoByName[b.name]
			local ra = ia and tierOrder[ia.Rarity] or 0
			local rb = ib and tierOrder[ib.Rarity] or 0
			if ra ~= rb then return ra > rb end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
	else -- VALUE (income per second)
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			local ca = infoByName[a.name] and infoByName[a.name].CashPerSecond or 0
			local cb = infoByName[b.name] and infoByName[b.name].CashPerSecond or 0
			if ca ~= cb then return ca > cb end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
	end

	pickerEmpty.Visible = #names == 0
	if selectedName and not (myCounts[selectedName] and (myCounts[selectedName] - (listedOf[selectedName] or 0)) > 0) then
		selectedName = nil
	end

	for order, item in ipairs(names) do
		local isSelected = selectedName == item.name
		-- holder cell for the same HardShadow-vs-UIGridLayout reason as the stand grid
		local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
		cell.Name = "Cell"
		cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 168)
		cell.LayoutOrder = order
		cell.ZIndex = pickerGrid.ZIndex + 1
		cell.Parent = pickerGrid
		local card = UI.button(cell, "", "tab", UDim2.fromOffset(140, 168), "chip")
		tierStroke(card, item.name)
		if isSelected then
			local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			ring.Thickness = 5
			ring.Color = T.color.activeRing
			ring.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
			ring.Parent = card
		end
		addArt(card, item.name, UDim2.fromOffset(104, 88), UDim2.fromOffset(18, 8))
		local nameL = UI.label(card, item.name, "chip")
		nameL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		nameL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 102)
		nameL.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		nameL.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18)
		nameL.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		nameL.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nameL.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		local countL = UI.label(card, "x" .. item.count, "cardLabel", T.color.textAccent)
		countL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		countL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 126)
		countL.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			selectedName = item.name
			renderPicker()
		end)
	end

	-- detail column
	for _, child in ipairs(detailArtHolder:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
	if selectedName then
		addArt(detailArtHolder, selectedName, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))
		detailName.Text = selectedName
		local info = infoByName[selectedName]
		local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
		detailMeta.Text = (info and info.Rarity or "?") .. "  ·  $" .. formatNumber(info and info.CashPerSecond or 0) .. "/s"
		if tier then detailMeta.TextColor3 = tier.Color end
	else
		detailName.Text = "Pick an item"
		detailMeta.Text = ""
	end
end
