===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BrainrotHoldClient.client.lua =====
-- Swings the player's arms FORWARD while a brainrot Tool is equipped, so the
-- creature (carried out in front by the server -- see InventoryHandler.buildHeld)
-- reads as being lugged along in both arms rather than floating on its own.
--
-- The pose is a runtime-registered KeyframeSequence, so no uploaded animation
-- asset is needed. Only the two upper arms are driven (Action priority); the
-- torso/root poses carry Weight 0 so walking and idle sway are left untouched.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Both arms swung forward to just below horizontal, as if bracing something
-- heavy against the body. 155 was the old overhead "holding it up" pose.
local ARM_PITCH = math.rad(72)

local function pose(name, cf, weight)
	local p = Instance.new("Pose")
	p.Name = name
	p.CFrame = cf or CFrame.new()
	p.Weight = weight or 1
	return p
end

-- One static hold pose. Two identical keyframes give the track a non-zero
-- length; a lone keyframe at t=0 evaluates to nothing and never applies.
local function buildHoldId()
	local function keyframe(t)
		local kf = Instance.new("Keyframe")
		kf.Time = t
		-- torso chain is only here to reach the arms in the rig hierarchy;
		-- Weight 0 means it does not override the running walk/idle animation
		local root  = pose("HumanoidRootPart", nil, 0)

		-- R15 chain
		local lower = pose("LowerTorso", nil, 0)
		local upper = pose("UpperTorso", nil, 0)
		upper:AddSubPose(pose("RightUpperArm", CFrame.Angles(ARM_PITCH, 0, 0)))
		upper:AddSubPose(pose("LeftUpperArm",  CFrame.Angles(ARM_PITCH, 0, 0)))
		lower:AddSubPose(upper)
		root:AddSubPose(lower)

		-- R6 chain. Poses for parts the active rig does not have are simply
		-- ignored, so carrying both costs nothing and means the carry works
		-- whichever rig the place is set to.
		local torso = pose("Torso", nil, 0)
		torso:AddSubPose(pose("Right Arm", CFrame.Angles(ARM_PITCH, 0, 0)))
		torso:AddSubPose(pose("Left Arm",  CFrame.Angles(ARM_PITCH, 0, 0)))
		root:AddSubPose(torso)

		kf:AddPose(root)
		return kf
	end
	local seq = Instance.new("KeyframeSequence")
	seq.Loop = true
	seq:AddKeyframe(keyframe(0))
	seq:AddKeyframe(keyframe(1))
	return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(seq)
end

local function brainrotEquipped(char)
	for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Tool") and c:GetAttribute("BrainrotTool") then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function setup(char)
	local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
	if not animator then return end

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = buildHoldId()
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	track.Looped = true

	local function refresh()
		if brainrotEquipped(char) then
			if not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(0.15) end
		else
			if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.15) end
		end
	end

	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Tool") then refresh() end end)
	char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Tool") then refresh() end end)
	refresh()
end

if player.Character then task.spawn(setup, player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BrainrotIdleClient.client.lua =====
-- BrainrotIdleClient: idle motion for every body Model tagged "BrainrotBody".
-- Bodies are server-anchored primitives, so every CFrame write below is
-- client-local and never replicates back -- the server pays nothing for any
-- of this. Everything runs off ONE Heartbeat: per-model connections at
-- full-plot scale would be hundreds of callbacks a frame doing identical work.
-- The look must be identical for every player on every server, so nothing in
-- here calls math.random -- phases come from a hash (see phaseFor).
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local TAG = "BrainrotBody"

local RANGE = 120          -- studs; a body further than this from the camera sits still that frame
local BUDGET = 80          -- most bodies moved per frame; past this only the nearest move
local AMPLITUDE = 0.15     -- studs of vertical travel for bob/hover
local SWAY_ANGLE = math.rad(3.5)
local HOVER_YAW = 0.6      -- rad/s
local SPIN_YAW = 1.1       -- rad/s; about one lazy turn every six seconds
local SHIVER_AMP = 0.05    -- studs; shiver should read as tension, not travel
-- Tolerance for deciding the SERVER re-seated a body. The drift check
-- compares against the exact pivot WE last wrote (lastPos), so the presets'
-- own offsets can never trip it, whatever their amplitude -- this is purely
-- replication-jitter headroom.
local RESEAT = 0.5

-- Phase must be stable across sessions and identical on every client, so it
-- is hashed, never rolled. The name alone is not enough: plots can hold
-- duplicates of the SAME brainrot, and same-name bodies would move in
-- lockstep -- so the spawn position salts the hash. The spawn pivot is fixed
-- per pad, which makes the salt exactly as stable as the name.
local function phaseFor(model, base)
	local name = model.Name
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #name do
		-- keep h small: Luau numbers are doubles, and unbounded growth would
		-- discard the low bits that carry all of the stagger
		h = (h * 33 + string.byte(name, i)) % 8192
	end
	local p = base.Position
	h = h + math.floor(p.X + 0.5) * 5 + math.floor(p.Z + 0.5) * 13
	return (h % 628) * 0.01   -- 0 .. ~2*pi
end

-- Each preset maps (t, phase) to an offset CFrame layered onto the spawn
-- pivot. Offsets compose in PIVOT space, so yaw always turns a body around
-- its own up axis no matter how the pad oriented it.
local MOTIONS = {}

function MOTIONS.bob(t, phase)
	-- remapped to 0..AMPLITUDE rather than a centered sine: a body that dips
	-- BELOW its spawn pivot sinks its feet into the pad it is seated on
	return CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(t * 2.1 + phase) * 0.5 + 0.5) * AMPLITUDE, 0)
end

function MOTIONS.sway(t, phase)
	-- rotation, not translation: sliding a seated body sideways would shear
	-- its feet across the pad, while a small roll reads as rocking in place
	return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(t * 1.7 + phase) * SWAY_ANGLE)
end

function MOTIONS.hover(t, phase)
	return CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(t * 2.1 + phase) * 0.5 + 0.5) * AMPLITUDE, 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(0, t * HOVER_YAW + phase, 0)
end

function MOTIONS.spin(t, phase)
	return CFrame.Angles(0, t * SPIN_YAW + phase, 0)
end

function MOTIONS.shiver(t, phase)
	-- two prime frequencies so the jitter never settles into a visible cycle;
	-- the phase multiplier keeps the axes from tracing a diagonal line
	return CFrame.new(
		math.sin(t * 41 + phase) * SHIVER_AMP,
		0,
		math.sin(t * 53 + phase * 1.7) * SHIVER_AMP)
end

-- bodies[model] = { model, animBase, rel, lastPos, phase, offset, dist, conn }
local bodies = {}

local function drop(model)
	local entry = bodies[model]
	if not entry then return end
	bodies[model] = nil
	entry.conn:Disconnect()
	-- a body that survives untagged parks exactly where the server thinks it
	-- is, so nothing is left frozen mid-bob above its pad
	if model.Parent and entry.animBase then
		model:PivotTo(entry.animBase * entry.rel)
	end
end

local function adopt(model)
	if bodies[model] ~= nil or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	local offset = MOTIONS[model:GetAttribute("Motion")]
	-- "none" and anything unrecognized cost zero from here on: never tracked,
	-- never iterated, never pivoted
	if not offset then return end
	-- Capture NOTHING here. The tag signal fires mid-replication-burst, and a
	-- capture taken then can see a half-arrived model: PrimaryPart may not
	-- have replicated yet, so GetPivot falls back near the box centre and
	-- `rel` bakes in as identity -- then the real (limb) pivot arrives a
	-- frame later and the body yaws about the limb again, which is exactly
	-- the orbit the animBase rework removes. Observed live: pivot pinned dead
	-- still, body orbiting it. The Heartbeat captures on the body's first
	-- animated frame instead, after replication has settled.
	bodies[model] = {
		model = model,
		offset = offset,
		dist = 0,
		conn = model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if not model:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
				drop(model)
			end
		end),
	}
end

-- a player can join with plots already full, so sweep what exists first
for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG)) do
	adopt(model)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(adopt)
CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(TAG):Connect(drop)

-- scratch list reused every frame so the loop allocates nothing at steady state
local candidates = {}

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
	local t = os.clock()

	table.clear(candidates)
	for _, entry in pairs(bodies) do
		-- Deferred capture (see adopt): animate about an UPRIGHT frame at the
		-- bounding-box centre, NOT the raw pivot -- on the pack models the
		-- pivot is an arbitrary limb (CatchReveal measured 3.75 studs off),
		-- and yawing about a limb makes the body ORBIT across neighbouring
		-- pads. `rel` carries the offset pivot along, so PivotTo lands the
		-- body exactly where it stood; on a centred pivot (BrainrotSpawner
		-- now centres them at spawn) rel is identity. One-time cost per body.
		if not entry.animBase then
			local pivot = entry.model:GetPivot()
			local boxCF = entry.model:GetBoundingBox()
			entry.animBase = CFrame.new(boxCF.Position)
			entry.rel = entry.animBase:ToObjectSpace(pivot)
			entry.lastPos = pivot.Position
			entry.phase = phaseFor(entry.model, entry.animBase)
		end
		-- gate on the cached box centre: one Vector3 subtraction per body,
		-- where GetPivot here would touch every part of every body every frame
		entry.dist = (entry.animBase.Position - camPos).Magnitude
		if entry.dist <= RANGE then
			candidates[#candidates + 1] = entry
		end
	end

	local count = #candidates
	if count > BUDGET then
		-- sort only once over budget, so the common case never pays for it
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
			return a.dist < b.dist
		end)
		count = BUDGET
	end

	for i = 1, count do
		local entry = candidates[i]
		local model = entry.model
		-- the server can re-seat a body (mover, pad shuffle) and its writes
		-- land on the anchored parts over ours. We know exactly where WE left
		-- the pivot (lastPos), so any real difference is a server move --
		-- recapture both frames from the new pose, or the body would snap
		-- back to wherever it spawned
		local current = model:GetPivot()
		if (current.Position - entry.lastPos).Magnitude > RESEAT then
			local boxCF = model:GetBoundingBox()
			entry.animBase = CFrame.new(boxCF.Position)
			entry.rel = entry.animBase:ToObjectSpace(current)
		end
		local target = entry.animBase * entry.offset(t, entry.phase) * entry.rel
		model:PivotTo(target)
		entry.lastPos = target.Position
	end
end)
-- ============================ IDLE VOICE LINES ============================
-- The creature occasionally says its own line while sitting on a pad. This is
-- the most annoying thing in the game if it is wrong, so every number here is
-- deliberately conservative and every one is a named constant.
--
-- Runs on its OWN slow timer, never the Heartbeat above: this fires about once
-- a minute, and putting it on a per-frame loop to do nothing 3599 times out of
-- 3600 would be waste. Client-side and positional -- your camp should sound
-- alive when you are standing in it, and silent from across the valley.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundKit = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SoundKit"))
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("BrainrotConfig"))

local VOICE_INTERVAL   = 45     -- seconds between attempts (base)
local VOICE_JITTER     = 15     -- +/- seconds, so a plot never speaks in chorus
local VOICE_RANGE      = 60     -- studs; HALF the 120 visual range -- audio intrudes more
local VOICE_COOLDOWN   = 90     -- seconds before the SAME body may speak again
local VOICE_MIN_GAP    = 8      -- seconds between ANY two voices, anywhere
local VOICE_VOLUME     = 0.18   -- under the splash register

-- name -> VoiceId, built once. Empty today: no entry in BrainrotConfig has a
-- VoiceId yet, so this whole system is inert until one is authored.
local voiceByName = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	if type(e.VoiceId) == "string" and e.VoiceId ~= "" then
		voiceByName[e.Name] = e.VoiceId
	end
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local lastSpoke = {}          -- [model] = os.clock() of its last line
local lastAnyVoice = 0        -- global gap, the real anti-noise guard

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(VOICE_INTERVAL + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * VOICE_JITTER)

		-- Nothing authored -> nothing to do. Costs one table lookup a minute.
		if next(voiceByName) ~= nil then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastAnyVoice >= VOICE_MIN_GAP then
				local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
				local origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
				if origin then
					-- Collect every eligible body, then pick ONE. Picking one and
					-- playing it is the concurrency cap: there is no path here
					-- that starts a second voice in the same pass.
					local eligible = {}
					for _, model in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG)) do
						local id = voiceByName[model.Name]
						if id and model.Parent then
							local ok, pivot = pcall(function() return model:GetPivot().Position end)
							if ok and (pivot - origin).Magnitude <= VOICE_RANGE then
								local last = lastSpoke[model]
								if not last or now - last >= VOICE_COOLDOWN then
									eligible[#eligible + 1] = { model = model, id = id, part = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") }
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if #eligible > 0 then
						local pick = eligible[math.random(1, #eligible)]
						if pick.part then
							SoundKit.playId(pick.id, pick.part, { volume = VOICE_VOLUME, range = VOICE_RANGE })
							lastSpoke[pick.model] = now
							lastAnyVoice = now
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- prune bodies that have been despawned, so lastSpoke cannot grow forever
		for model in pairs(lastSpoke) do
			if not model.Parent then lastSpoke[model] = nil end
		end
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BrainrotPlaceClient.client.lua =====
-- Choose-your-spot placement. While a brainrot Tool is equipped, every empty pad
-- on your own base lights up; clicking one places the brainrot there. The server
-- re-validates the pad, so this is presentation + aim only.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local FREE = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150)
local AIM  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 120)

local held           -- the equipped brainrot Tool
local highlights = {} -- [padPart] = SelectionBox
local aimed          -- pad currently under the cursor

local function padIndexOf(part)
	if not part then return nil end
	local n = part.Name:match("^Pad(%d+)$")
	return n and tonumber(n) or nil
end

-- our own base = the plot whose Pads hold models we own, else the nearest plot.
-- Ownership is enforced server-side; this only decides what to light up.
local function myPlot()
	local bases = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if not bases then return nil end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return nil end
	local best, bestD
	for _, plot in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
		if plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then return plot end
		local ok, cf = pcall(function() return plot:GetPivot() end)
		if ok then
			local d = (cf.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
			if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = plot, d end
		end
	end
	return (bestD and bestD < 90) and best or nil
end

local function clearHighlights()
	for _, box in pairs(highlights) do box:Destroy() end
	table.clear(highlights)
	aimed = nil
end

local function refreshHighlights()
	clearHighlights()
	local plot = myPlot()
	local pads = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if not pads then return end

	-- a pad is taken if a placed brainrot model sits on it
	local taken = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
		if m:GetAttribute("Uid") then
			local idx = m:GetAttribute("PadIndex") or padIndexOf(m)
			if idx then taken[idx] = true end
			-- models are usually parented at the pad's position; match by proximity too
			for _, p in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
				local pi = padIndexOf(p)
				if pi and p:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok, cf = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot() end)
					if ok and (Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, 0, cf.Position.Z)
						- Vector3.new(p.Position.X, 0, p.Position.Z)).Magnitude < 3 then
						taken[pi] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
		local idx = padIndexOf(p)
		if idx and p:IsA("BasePart") and not taken[idx] then
			local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
			box.Adornee = p
			box.LineThickness = 0.06
			box.Color3 = FREE
			box.SurfaceColor3 = FREE
			box.SurfaceTransparency = 0.78
			box.Transparency = 0.25
			box.Parent = p
			highlights[p] = box
		end
	end
end

local function setAim(part)
	if aimed == part then return end
	if aimed and highlights[aimed] then
		highlights[aimed].Color3 = FREE
		highlights[aimed].SurfaceColor3 = FREE
		highlights[aimed].SurfaceTransparency = 0.78
	end
	aimed = (part and highlights[part]) and part or nil
	if aimed then
		highlights[aimed].Color3 = AIM
		highlights[aimed].SurfaceColor3 = AIM
		highlights[aimed].SurfaceTransparency = 0.45
	end
end

local function onActivated()
	if not held then return end
	local uid = held:GetAttribute("Uid")
	if not uid then return end
	local target = aimed or mouse.Target
	local idx = padIndexOf(target)
	remotes.PlaceBrainrot:FireServer(uid, idx)   -- idx nil -> server picks a free pad
end

local function bind(tool)
	held = tool
	refreshHighlights()
	tool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
	tool.Unequipped:Once(function()
		if held == tool then held = nil end
		clearHighlights()
	end)
end

local function watch(char)
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c:IsA("Tool") and c:GetAttribute("BrainrotTool") then bind(c) end
	end)
	for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Tool") and c:GetAttribute("BrainrotTool") then bind(c) end
	end
end
if player.Character then watch(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) held = nil; clearHighlights(); watch(c) end)

-- keep the aim highlight following the cursor
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if held then setAim(mouse.Target) end
end)

-- a successful placement frees/consumes a pad, so re-light the base
remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	if held then task.defer(refreshHighlights) end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CampfireBankClient.client.lua =====
-- CampfireBankClient -- the entire campfire visual + feedback layer. (BUILD SPEC v2 §7.2 / §8.2)
--
-- The SERVER publishes ONE number (Campfire.Banked); every client builds the pile locally.
-- With StreamingEnabled and ~16.5k BaseParts, server-created coins would cost replication,
-- streaming bandwidth and instance churn on every resize. Client-built coins cost nothing, get
-- per-client LOD, and other players STILL see your hoard (they run this same script off the
-- same replicated attribute) -- the flex is preserved.
--
-- Everything lives in a client-created Workspace.CampfireBankVFX folder -- NEVER parented into
-- the replicated plot Model, or streaming will destroy it.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local cueRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("CampfireCollected", 10)

local C = Color3.fromRGB

local vfxFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CampfireBankVFX")
if not vfxFolder then
	vfxFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	vfxFolder.Name = "CampfireBankVFX"
	vfxFolder.Parent = Workspace
end

-- canonical abbreviator, K through Qi -- see Modules.NumberFormat
local formatShort = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat).Short

-- ===== pile maths (spec 7.2.2) =====
local TIER_MAX = 24
local function tierFor(banked)
	if banked < 1 then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(math.log10(banked) * 3.5) + 1, 1, TIER_MAX)
end

-- Apron ring on the CLEAR dirt between the stones (outer face 3.45) and the collect ring (5.60).
-- Never inside the flame or the logs.
local R_IN, R_OUT_MIN, R_OUT_MAX = 3.60, 4.10, 5.30
local GOLDEN = 2.39996323
local function hash01(i) local v = math.sin(i * 12.9898 + 78.233) * 43758.5453 return v - math.floor(v) end

local function coinCFrame(i, n, tier, centre, baseY)
	local f    = tier / TIER_MAX
	local rOut = R_OUT_MIN + (R_OUT_MAX - R_OUT_MIN) * f
	local t    = (i - 0.5) / n
	local r    = math.sqrt(R_IN * R_IN + t * (rOut * rOut - R_IN * R_IN))   -- even area density
	local ang  = i * GOLDEN
	local u    = (r - R_IN) / math.max(rOut - R_IN, 0.01)
	local y    = baseY + 0.06 + (0.10 + 0.55 * f) * (1 - u) ^ 2             -- banked against the stones
	local tilt = (hash01(i) - 0.5) * 0.55                                  -- deterministic, no per-coin state
	return CFrame.new(centre.X + math.cos(ang) * r, y, centre.Z + math.sin(ang) * r)
	     * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90) + tilt)
end

-- Magnitude reads as MATERIAL, not size: income spans ~384,000x, which no radius change can encode.
local COIN_BANDS = {
	{ min = 0,        mat = Enum.Material.Metal, a = C(196, 118, 68),  b = C(168, 94, 54),  refl = 0.08 }, -- Copper
	{ min = 1000,     mat = Enum.Material.Metal, a = C(214, 220, 228), b = C(178, 186, 196), refl = 0.22 }, -- Silver
	{ min = 100000,   mat = Enum.Material.Metal, a = C(255, 205, 70),  b = C(240, 168, 40),  refl = 0.14 }, -- Gold
	{ min = 10000000, mat = Enum.Material.Neon,  a = C(150, 235, 255), b = C(196, 150, 255), refl = 0.00 }, -- Gem
}
local function bandFor(banked)
	local idx = 1
	for i, b in ipairs(COIN_BANDS) do
		if banked >= b.min then idx = i end
	end
	return idx
end

local MAX_COINS_TOTAL = 90
local ctl = {}      -- [CampfirePart] = controller

-- ===== controller =====
local function newController(cf, plot)
	local dirtTop = cf.Position.Y - 0.75

	local c = {
		cf = cf, plot = plot, dirtTop = dirtTop,
		folder = Instance.new("Folder"),
		ring = {}, coins = {},
		tier = -1, band = -1, lastRebuild = 0, lowSince = nil, ringArmed = nil,
		banked = 0, lastSampleAt = os.clock(), rate = 0, lastBanked = 0, lastBankedAt = os.clock(),
		lod = 3,
	}
	c.folder.Name = "VFX_" .. plot.Name
	c.folder.Parent = vfxFolder

	-- remember the untouched baseline so teardown can restore it exactly
	local fire = cf:FindFirstChildOfClass("Fire")
	local light = cf:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
	c.fire, c.light = fire, light
	if fire then c.fireSize0, c.fireSec0 = fire.Size, fire.SecondaryColor end
	if light then c.lightB0, c.lightR0 = light.Brightness, light.Range end

	-- one-shot spark emitter (Rate 0; the burst calls :Emit)
	local att = cf:FindFirstChild("CollectSparksAtt")
	if not att then
		att = Instance.new("Attachment")
		att.Name = "CollectSparksAtt"
		att.Parent = cf
	end
	c.att = att
	local sparks = att:FindFirstChild("CollectSparks")
	if not sparks then
		sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		sparks.Name = "CollectSparks"
		sparks.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		sparks.Rate = 0
		sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9)
		sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12)
		sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(36, 36)
		sparks.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
		sparks.LightEmission = 0.8
		sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
		sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(C(255, 214, 90))
		sparks.Parent = att
	end
	c.sparks = sparks

	-- Collect sound: a cash register. Cloned per play, because Sound:Play() rewinds the
	-- SAME instance, so a second cue landing mid-tail would cut the first one off.
	--
	-- WHY THIS ASSET: the cue can fire every COLLECT_INTERVAL (2 s) while the owner stands
	-- in the fire, so the clip has to finish inside that window or it overlaps itself. Most
	-- "cash register" uploads are 2-4 s and are therefore unusable here regardless of how
	-- good they sound. This one is 0.89 s and comfortably clears the cadence.
	-- Verified with ContentProvider:PreloadAsync in this place: AssetFetchStatus.Success.
	-- Alternates that also load, if this is not the right character (drop-in swap; the only
	-- hard constraint is staying under ~1.5 s):
	--   87219676100463  Cash Register Sound Effect     1.22 s
	--   131886985       cash register (classic ching)  0.69 s  -- pre-2022 upload
	local REGISTER_SOUND = "rbxassetid://18264787819"   -- "Cash Register Ding", 0.89 s
	-- Sound.Volume is a LINEAR scalar, not decibels, so a dB trim has to be converted:
	-- gain = 10^(dB/20). This is 0.42 taken down -0.5 dB -> 0.42 * 0.9441 = 0.3965.
	-- The repeat-gulp voice multiplies this by 0.72 below, so it scales with it.
	local REGISTER_VOLUME = 0.3965
	local ping = cf:FindFirstChild("BankPing")
	if not ping then
		ping = Instance.new("Sound")
		ping.Name = "BankPing"
		ping.RollOffMaxDistance = 60
		ping.Parent = cf
	end
	-- Set unconditionally rather than only on create: reconcile() reuses an existing
	-- BankPing, so find-and-keep would leave a stale SoundId behind after this change.
	ping.SoundId = REGISTER_SOUND
	ping.Volume = REGISTER_VOLUME
	c.ping = ping

	-- BankGui
	local gui = cf:FindFirstChild("BankGui")
	if not gui then
		gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "BankGui"
		gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 66)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
		gui.LightInfluence = 0
		gui.MaxDistance = 150
		gui.Parent = cf

		local amount = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		amount.Name = "Amount"
		amount.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
		amount.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		amount.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		amount.TextScaled = true
		amount.TextColor3 = C(255, 214, 90)
		amount.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
		amount.Text = ""        -- never flash Roblox's default "Label" before the first 10 Hz pass
		amount.Parent = gui

		local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		hint.Name = "Hint"
		hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 44)
		hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hint.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		hint.TextSize = 22
		hint.TextColor3 = C(230, 235, 240)
		hint.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		hint.Text = "STAND ON THE FIRE TO COLLECT"
		hint.Parent = gui
	end
	c.gui = gui
	c.amount = gui:FindFirstChild("Amount")
	c.hint = gui:FindFirstChild("Hint")

	return c
end

local function clearCoins(c)
	for _, p in ipairs(c.coins) do p:Destroy() end
	c.coins = {}
end

local function teardown(c)
	-- restore the flame exactly as we found it; these were LOCAL writes on replicated parts
	if c.fire and c.fire.Parent then
		c.fire.Size = c.fireSize0
		c.fire.SecondaryColor = c.fireSec0
	end
	if c.light and c.light.Parent then
		c.light.Brightness = c.lightB0
		c.light.Range = c.lightR0
	end
	if c.gui then c.gui:Destroy() end
	if c.embers then c.embers:Destroy() end
	if c.folder then c.folder:Destroy() end
end

-- ===== collect ring: the affordance. r 5.60 EXACTLY matches CAMPFIRE_RADIUS and CampStand =====
local function buildRing(c)
	if #c.ring > 0 then return end
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local a = math.rad(k * 22.5)
		local seg = Instance.new("Part")
		seg.Name = "RingSeg"
		seg.Size = Vector3.new(1.75, 0.10, 0.30)
		seg.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.cf.Position.X + math.cos(a) * 5.60, c.dirtTop + 0.06, c.cf.Position.Z + math.sin(a) * 5.60)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, -a, 0)
		seg.Anchored = true
		seg.CanCollide = false
		seg.CanQuery = false
		seg.CanTouch = false
		seg.CastShadow = false
		seg.Locked = true
		seg.Parent = c.folder
		table.insert(c.ring, seg)
	end
	c.ringArmed = nil
end

local function clearRing(c)
	for _, s in ipairs(c.ring) do s:Destroy() end
	c.ring = {}
	c.ringArmed = nil
end

local function setRingState(c, armed)
	if c.ringArmed == armed then return end
	c.ringArmed = armed
	for _, s in ipairs(c.ring) do
		if armed then
			s.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; s.Color = C(255, 200, 80); s.Transparency = 0.10
		else
			s.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic; s.Color = C(146, 118, 74); s.Transparency = 0.45
		end
	end
end

local function buildPile(c, tier, bandIdx, budget, animate)
	clearCoins(c)
	if tier <= 0 or budget <= 0 then return end
	local band = COIN_BANDS[bandIdx]
	local n = budget
	for i = 1, n do
		local coin = Instance.new("Part")
		coin.Name = "Coin"
		coin.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder     -- Roblox cylinder axis is local +X, hence the roll
		coin.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 1.05, 1.05)
		coin.CFrame = coinCFrame(i, n, tier, c.cf.Position, c.dirtTop)
		coin.Material = band.mat
		coin.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and band.a or band.b
		coin.Reflectance = band.refl
		coin.Anchored = true
		coin.CanCollide = false
		coin.CanQuery = false
		coin.CanTouch = false
		coin.CastShadow = false
		coin.Locked = true
		coin.Parent = c.folder
		table.insert(c.coins, coin)
		if animate then
			local target = coin.CFrame
			coin.CFrame = target + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
			coin.Transparency = 1
			TweenService:Create(coin, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ CFrame = target, Transparency = 0 }):Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Flame banks up -- CAPPED. Fire.Heat is NEVER written (stays 0) and Fire.Color is unchanged.
local function applyFlame(c, f)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if c.fire and c.fire.Parent then
		TweenService:Create(c.fire, info, {
			Size = 7 + 2.0 * f,
			SecondaryColor = C(228, 88, 28):Lerp(C(255, 196, 60), f),
		}):Play()
	end
	if c.light and c.light.Parent then
		TweenService:Create(c.light, info, {
			Brightness = 2.8 + 1.2 * f,
			Range = 26 + 5.0 * f,
		}):Play()
	end
end

local function applyEmbers(c, bandIdx, f)
	if bandIdx >= 3 then
		if not c.embers or not c.embers.Parent then
			local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			e.Name = "GoldEmbers"          -- the existing `Embers` emitter is left untouched
			e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
			e.LightEmission = 0.7
			e.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
			e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
			e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6)
			e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(22, 22)
			e.Size = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.28), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
			e.Parent = c.cf
			c.embers = e
		end
		c.embers.Rate = 2 + 8 * f
		c.embers.Color = ColorSequence.new(COIN_BANDS[bandIdx].a)
	elseif c.embers then
		c.embers:Destroy()
		c.embers = nil
	end
end

-- ===== 10 Hz update pass (NOT RenderStepped) =====
local function updateController(c, budget, now)
	local cf = c.cf
	local banked = cf:GetAttribute("Banked") or 0

	-- client-side rate derivation from consecutive Banked samples (EMA, negative deltas ignored).
	-- No server-side rate publication -> zero coupling to the income formula.
	if banked ~= c.lastBanked then
		local dt = now - c.lastBankedAt
		if dt > 0.05 then
			local d = banked - c.lastBanked
			if d > 0 then
				c.rate = c.rate * (2 / 3) + (d / dt) * (1 / 3)
			end
		end
		c.lastBanked = banked
		c.lastBankedAt = now
		c.lastSampleAt = now
		c.banked = banked
	end
	c.banked = banked

	local dist = (camera.CFrame.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude
	local lod = (dist <= 60) and 0 or ((dist <= 140) and 1 or 2)

	local tier = tierFor(banked)
	local bandIdx = bandFor(banked)

	-- hysteresis: tier may RISE immediately; it may only FALL after the lower value has held 0.6 s
	local effTier = tier
	if tier < c.tier then
		if not c.lowSince then c.lowSince = now end
		if (now - c.lowSince) < 0.6 then effTier = c.tier end
	else
		c.lowSince = nil
	end

	-- ring: built at LOD 0 and 1 regardless of Banked, so the mechanic is always legible
	if lod <= 1 then
		buildRing(c)
		setRingState(c, banked >= 1)
	else
		clearRing(c)
	end

	local lod0 = math.min(6 + math.floor(effTier * 1.6), 44)
	local want
	if lod == 0 then want = lod0
	elseif lod == 1 then want = math.min(math.ceil(lod0 * 0.3), 14)
	else want = 0 end
	if effTier <= 0 then want = 0 end
	want = math.min(want, budget)

	local changed = (effTier ~= c.tier) or (bandIdx ~= c.band) or (lod ~= c.lod)
	if changed and (now - c.lastRebuild) >= 0.4 then
		buildPile(c, effTier, bandIdx, want, lod == 0 and c.tier >= 0)
		c.tier, c.band, c.lod, c.lastRebuild = effTier, bandIdx, lod, now
		c.rebuilds = (c.rebuilds or 0) + 1
		local f = effTier / TIER_MAX
		applyFlame(c, f)
		applyEmbers(c, bandIdx, f)
	end

	-- BankGui
	local isOwner = (c.plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0) == player.UserId
	local visible = (lod <= 1) and (isOwner or banked >= 1)
	c.gui.Enabled = visible
	if visible then
		local shown = math.max(banked + c.rate * (now - c.lastSampleAt), banked)
		c.amount.Text = "$" .. formatShort(shown)     -- no fire emoji: FusionPrompt already shows one
		c.hint.Visible = isOwner
		local f = math.max(effTier, 0) / TIER_MAX
		c.gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 7.6 + 1.2 * f, 0)   -- always clears the 9-stud flame cap
	end

	return #c.coins
end

-- ===== collect feedback (spec 8.2) =====
local cashFrame = nil
local coinFly = Instance.new("ScreenGui")     -- created ONCE at script scope, never per burst
coinFly.Name = "CoinFlyGui"
coinFly.DisplayOrder = 50
coinFly.ResetOnSpawn = false
coinFly.Parent = playerGui

task.spawn(function()
	local mainUI = playerGui:WaitForChild("MainUI", 20)
	if not mainUI then return end
	cashFrame = mainUI:WaitForChild("CashFrame", 20)
	-- AbsolutePosition is reported in the OWNING ScreenGui's inset space; a mismatch lands
	-- every coin ~36 px off.
	local host = cashFrame and cashFrame:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
	coinFly.IgnoreGuiInset = (host and host.IgnoreGuiInset) or false
end)

local function punchCash()
	if not cashFrame then return end
	local scale = cashFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not scale then
		scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Parent = cashFrame
	end
	scale.Scale = 1
	TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.12 }):Play()
	task.delay(0.09, function()
		if scale.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end)
end

local function flyCoins(c, amount)
	if not cashFrame then return end
	local target = cashFrame.AbsolutePosition + cashFrame.AbsoluteSize / 2
	local sp, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(c.cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
	if not onScreen then return end            -- fire behind the camera: skip the fly entirely
	local n = math.clamp(4 + math.floor(math.log10(math.max(amount, 1)) * 2), 4, 14)
	for k = 1, n do
		local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
		dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
		dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X - 11, sp.Y - 11)
		dot.BackgroundColor3 = C(255, 205, 70)
		dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
		dot.Parent = coinFly
		local cor = Instance.new("UICorner"); cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); cor.Parent = dot
		local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color = C(190, 130, 20); st.Thickness = 2; st.Parent = dot
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		lbl.TextSize = 14
		lbl.TextColor3 = C(90, 60, 10)
		lbl.Text = "$"
		lbl.Parent = dot

		local ang = (k / n) * math.pi * 2
		local burst = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X - 11 + math.cos(ang) * 70, sp.Y - 11 + math.sin(ang) * 70)
		TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = burst }):Play()
		task.delay(0.18, function()
			if not dot.Parent then return end
			local t2 = TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.40 + k * 0.03, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
				{ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(target.X - 11, target.Y - 11), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10) })
			t2:Play()
			t2.Completed:Connect(punchCash)
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(dot, 1.4)
	end
end

local function playCollect(c, amount, isEntry)
	-- 1. burst
	if isEntry then
		local ball = Instance.new("Part")
		ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		ball.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
		ball.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ball.Color = C(255, 205, 70)
		ball.Transparency = 0.15
		ball.Anchored = true; ball.CanCollide = false; ball.CanQuery = false
		ball.CanTouch = false; ball.CastShadow = false; ball.Locked = true
		ball.Parent = c.folder
		TweenService:Create(ball, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(ball, 0.8)
	else
		-- repeat gulps get a flat expanding RING, not another sphere
		local ring = Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 3, 3)
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.cf.Position.X, c.dirtTop + 0.12, c.cf.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.Color = C(255, 205, 70)
		ring.Transparency = 0.3
		ring.Anchored = true; ring.CanCollide = false; ring.CanQuery = false
		ring.CanTouch = false; ring.CastShadow = false; ring.Locked = true
		ring.Parent = c.folder
		TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 12, 12), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.6)
	end
	if c.sparks then c.sparks:Emit(isEntry and 34 or 8) end

	-- 2. collect sound -- ONE register hit, cloned so overlapping cues cannot rewind
	-- each other.
	--
	-- Deliberately a SINGLE voice now. The old asset was a 0.2 s electronic ping, so it was
	-- fired as a 5-voice rising arpeggio 0.055 s apart to build a flourish out of almost
	-- nothing. A cash register is already the whole gesture -- five of them 55 ms apart is
	-- mush, not a flourish. Entry gets it clean at full volume; repeat gulps come in
	-- quieter and slightly detuned so a long stay in the fire is not machine-gunned.
	if c.ping and c.ping.Parent then
		local s = c.ping:Clone()
		s.Volume = c.ping.Volume * (isEntry and 1 or 0.72)
		s.PlaybackSpeed = isEntry and 1 or (0.97 + math.random() * 0.06)
		s.Parent = c.cf
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 3)
	end

	-- 3. +$X popup
	local holder = Instance.new("Part")
	holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
	holder.Transparency = 1
	holder.Anchored = true; holder.CanCollide = false; holder.CanQuery = false
	holder.CanTouch = false; holder.CastShadow = false; holder.Locked = true
	holder.Parent = c.folder
	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 52)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = false
	bg.LightInfluence = 0
	-- the floating "+$X" on collect. Same 150 as the BankGui it pops out of, so a distant
	-- plot cannot flash cash numbers at you from across the map.
	bg.MaxDistance = 150
	bg.Parent = holder
	local pl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	pl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	pl.TextScaled = true
	pl.TextColor3 = C(140, 255, 160)
	pl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	pl.Text = "+$" .. formatShort(amount)
	pl.Parent = bg
	TweenService:Create(holder, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ CFrame = holder.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) }):Play()
	task.delay(0.45, function()
		if pl.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(pl, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(holder, 1.1)

	-- 4. coins fly to the HUD
	flyCoins(c, amount)

	-- 5. pile teardown is driven by THIS cue, not by tier hitting 0. Bystanders (who get no cue)
	-- tear down via the hysteresis rule instead, so they still see the hoard vanish.
	local coins = c.coins
	c.coins = {}
	for i, coin in ipairs(coins) do
		task.delay(i * 0.012, function()
			if not coin.Parent then return end
			TweenService:Create(coin, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				CFrame = coin.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0),
				Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(coin, 0.35)
		end)
	end
	c.tier = -1        -- force the next pass to rebuild from scratch
end

if cueRemote then
	cueRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(amount, isEntry)
		if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount <= 0 then return end
		for _, c in pairs(ctl) do
			if (c.plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0) == player.UserId then
				playCollect(c, amount, isEntry == true)
				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- ===== reconcile (0.5 s) + 10 Hz update =====
local function reconcile()
	local bases = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if not bases then return end
	for _, plot in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
		local cf = plot:FindFirstChild("Campfire")     -- FindFirstChild, never WaitForChild
		if cf and not ctl[cf] then ctl[cf] = newController(cf, plot) end
	end
	for cf, c in pairs(ctl) do
		if cf.Parent == nil or c.plot.Parent == nil then
			teardown(c)
			ctl[cf] = nil
		end
	end
end

reconcile()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		reconcile()
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)                     -- 10 Hz, NOT RenderStepped
		local now = os.clock()
		-- global cap allocated greedily NEAREST-FIRST
		local order = {}
		for cf, c in pairs(ctl) do
			table.insert(order, { c = c, d = (camera.CFrame.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude })
		end
		table.sort(order, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
		local left = MAX_COINS_TOTAL
		for _, o in ipairs(order) do
			local used = updateController(o.c, math.max(left, 0), now)
			left -= used
		end
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CatDialogueClient.client.lua =====
-- Maxwell the cat: hold E to pet/talk to him. He runs a secret questline driven by
-- MaxwellQuest (server) -- that module is the state machine and the authority. This
-- client just renders his dialogue in the SAME box the merchants use (MerchantDialog)
-- and fires MaxwellTalk to accept the quest / claim the reward. Below Rebirth 3 he
-- only meows; the quest text and progress numbers all come from MaxwellState.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local MerchantDialog = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MerchantDialog)
local UITheme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UITheme)
local CF = UITheme.Camp

-- Latest quest snapshot pushed by MaxwellQuest. Stored and read on trigger so the
-- dialogue always shows the real, server-authoritative state and progress.
local latest = { State = 0, Secrets = 0, SecretsNeeded = 5, Rebirths = 0, RebirthsNeeded = 15, Unlock = 3 }
remotes:WaitForChild("MaxwellState").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
	if typeof(s) == "table" then latest = s end
end)
local talk = remotes:WaitForChild("MaxwellTalk")

local ACCENT = { CF.berry1, CF.berry2 }   -- purple "secret" plate, matching the tracker card

-- Wait for the cat and its prompt (added in Edit; may stream in a touch late).
local cat = Workspace:WaitForChild("Maxwell", 60)
if not cat then return end
local body = cat:WaitForChild("maxwell", 30)
local prompt = body and body:WaitForChild("PetPrompt", 30)
if not prompt then return end

-- Lines + final-button label + talk action for the current quest state. Maxwell is
-- a cat: unimpressed, self-important, entirely food-motivated.
local function dialogueFor(s)
	local state = tonumber(s.State) or 0
	local secrets, need = s.Secrets or 0, s.SecretsNeeded or 5
	local reb, rebNeed = s.Rebirths or 0, s.RebirthsNeeded or 15
	local unlock = s.Unlock or 3

	if state == 0 then
		if reb < unlock then
			return { "meow." }, "BYE", nil   -- locked: he can't be bothered with you yet
		end
		return {
			"meow. *slow blink* ...oh. it's you. the one who keeps throwing rocks.",
			"i am Maxwell. i do not chase string. i chase GREATNESS. and snacks.",
			("bring me ONE of every Secret in the index \u{2014} all %d of them. yes, ALL. cats don't do half-measures."):format(need),
		}, "ACCEPT (meow) \u{25B6}", "accept"
	elseif state == 1 then
		return {
			("%d of %d Secrets in the index. chop chop, human \u{2014} i haven't got all nine lives."):format(math.min(secrets, need), need),
			"...well. i do. but hustle anyway. meow.",
		}, "BYE", nil
	elseif state == 2 then
		return {
			"the secrets? adequate. *licks paw*",
			("now suffer for me: reach Rebirth %d. you're at %d. devotion is measured in rebirths."):format(rebNeed, math.min(reb, rebNeed)),
		}, "BYE", nil
	elseif state == 3 then
		return {
			"you actually did it. the secrets AND the rebirths. i am... mildly impressed.",
			"here. a piece of me: the GOD Maxwell. do NOT pet it without written permission.",
		}, "TAKE IT (meow) \u{25B6}", "claim"
	else   -- 4: done
		return {
			"we're square, human. now shoo.",
			"...and bring the good snacks next time. meow.",
		}, "BYE", nil
	end
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
	if who ~= player then return end
	local lines, finalLabel, action = dialogueFor(latest)
	local onDone = action and function() talk:FireServer(action) end or nil
	MerchantDialog.Show("Maxwell", lines, ACCENT, onDone, body, finalLabel)
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CatchRevealClient.client.lua =====
-- CatchRevealClient: turns a catch into a reveal.
--
-- Deliberately thin. All the presentation lives in CatchReveal (the screen-space card)
-- and CatchFX (the burst around the player); this only decides WHETHER to show one,
-- which is exactly the decision the phase-2 Robux upgrade needs to change.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CatchReveal = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("CatchReveal"))
local PullCeremony = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("PullCeremony"))
-- Size-mutated catches get a cutscene of the creature rising out of the water BEFORE the
-- ordinary ceremony. Storyboard beats B1-B3, which the Catch Ceremony plan specified but
-- never built. It returns false and costs nothing on an ordinary catch.
local MassiveEmergence = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("MassiveEmergence"))
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("BrainrotConfig"))
-- within-tier odds for the ceremony: weights sum to 100,000 per tier, so
-- "1 in N of its tier" with N = 100000/Weight is HONEST, not theater
local weightByName, voiceByName = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	weightByName[e.Name] = e.Weight
	-- optional per-creature voice line; nil for every entry today
	if type(e.VoiceId) == "string" and e.VoiceId ~= "" then voiceByName[e.Name] = e.VoiceId end
end
local CatchFX = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("CatchFX"))
local SoundKit = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SoundKit"))

-- The Massive catch cinematic, required FAIL-SOFT -- the same shape ThrowHandler uses
-- for this folder on the server, and for the same reason: deleting or breaking
-- CatchCinematic must not take the ordinary reveal chain down with it. Both stay nil if
-- anything here throws, and every use below is guarded, so a missing folder leaves this
-- script behaving exactly as it did before the cinematic existed. Bounded WaitForChild
-- rather than an unbounded one: Modules is already resolved by the requires above, so
-- five seconds is generous, and a timeout costs a nil, never a hang.
local CinBridge, CinConfig
do
	local ok, bridge, cfg = pcall(function()
		local folder = ReplicatedStorage.Modules:WaitForChild("CatchCinematic", 5)
		return require(folder:WaitForChild("Bridge", 5)), require(folder:WaitForChild("Config", 5))
	end)
	if ok and type(bridge) == "table" then
		CinBridge = bridge
		CinConfig = cfg
	else
		warn("[CatchRevealClient] CatchCinematic unavailable (" .. tostring(bridge) .. ") -- ordinary reveals only")
	end
end

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local throwResult = remotes:WaitForChild("ThrowResult")

-- REMOVED: the Legendary "ping". It was a raw Sound instance created here with a
-- hardcoded asset id, played through SoundService:PlayLocalSound at volume 0.65 --
-- outside SoundKit entirely, and roughly double the level of the tuned catch ladder
-- (0.13 to 0.54), which is why it stuck out. Legendary now gets its rung of that
-- ladder like every other tier.

-- The catcher's own cue, per tier. Mirrors the ladder in RareCatchClient because
-- these are the tiers that ladder never reaches: RareCatch is only broadcast for
-- Secret / God / Rainbow / Glitched (see ThrowHandler.revealCatch, ~line 890), so
-- Common through Mythic previously landed in total silence for the catcher.
local TIER_SFX = {
	Common    = { { sound = "catchCommon",   volume = 0.13 } },
	Uncommon  = { { sound = "catchUncommon", volume = 0.17 } },
	Rare      = { { sound = "catchRare",     volume = 0.21 } },
	Epic      = { { sound = "catchEpic",     volume = 0.25 } },
	Legendary = { { sound = "catchLegend",   volume = 0.30 },
	              { sound = "catchSparkle",  volume = 0.14, delay = 0.07 } },
	Mythic    = { { sound = "catchMythic",   volume = 0.34 },
	              { sound = "catchSparkle",  volume = 0.18, delay = 0.06 } },
}

-- IN SYNC WITH THE SERVER. ThrowHandler broadcasts RareCatch for exactly these, and
-- RareCatchClient plays the ladder for them at full level. Playing here as well would
-- stack two copies of the same sting on the biggest catches in the game.
local function isBroadcast(result)
	return result.Rarity == "Secret" or result.Rarity == "God"
		or result.Mutation == "Rainbow" or result.Mutation == "Glitched"
end

local function playTierCue(result)
	local layers = TIER_SFX[result.Rarity]
	if not layers then return end
	for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
		if (layer.delay or 0) <= 0 then
			SoundKit.play(layer.sound, nil, { volume = layer.volume })
		else
			task.delay(layer.delay, function()
				SoundKit.play(layer.sound, nil, { volume = layer.volume })
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- PHASE 2 SEAM, filled (2026-08-04 v2): Settings > Skip Catch Animation --
-- the free per-rarity version of the phase-2 plan ("the player's chosen
-- rarities", exactly as this comment always said). SettingsPanel writes one
-- boolean attribute per tier (SkipRevealCommon .. SkipRevealGod); read at
-- time of use, so a mid-session change covers the very next catch. The
-- burst + tier cue above the gate still play, and ClientMain shows its
-- ThrowResult text card for skipped rarities, so every catch is still
-- announced -- picked rarities just take ~3s of corner text instead of an
-- up-to-9s takeover.
--
-- Skipping an ANIMATION is a pure presentation choice, so the client may own it
-- -- a client that lies about it gains nothing. The auto-sell half of that
-- upgrade is NOT the same and must never live here: a client that can say "sell
-- this catch" can say it about anything. Auto-sell belongs server-side in
-- ThrowHandler.revealCatch behind a verified MarketplaceService check.
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local function shouldReveal(result)
	return player:GetAttribute("SkipReveal" .. tostring(result.Rarity)) ~= true
end

-- Extracted VERBATIM from the OnClientEvent handler below, so the cinematic's
-- after-flow can build the same ceremony payload without replaying the burst and the
-- tier cue. tierCuePlayed defaults to false, which is the truth on the cinematic path:
-- nothing above the gate ran, by design -- no burst or tier cue may pollute the bonk.
local function buildPayload(result, tierCuePlayed)
	local weight = weightByName[result.BrainrotName]
	return {
		Name = result.BrainrotName,
		Rarity = result.Rarity,
		RarityColor = result.RarityColor,
		Mutation = result.Mutation,
		Size = result.Size,
		SplashPos = result.SplashPos,
		Serial = result.Serial,
		Exists = result.Exists,
		OddsN = weight and math.max(2, math.floor(100000 / weight + 0.5)) or nil,
		TierCuePlayed = tierCuePlayed == true,
		VoiceId = voiceByName[result.BrainrotName],   -- nil unless authored
	}
end

-- The whole ordinary chain, extracted unchanged from the handler so the cinematic can
-- DEFER it (and rerun it wholesale if the cinematic dies). Same order, same pcalls,
-- same comments.
local function ordinaryReveal(result)
	-- Burst first: it reads as the catch LANDING, so it should not wait on the card.
	-- pcall for the same reason as the reveal -- an effect must never break a catch.
	pcall(CatchFX.play, {
		Rarity = result.Rarity,
		Color = result.RarityColor,
		Mutation = result.Mutation,
	})

	-- Recorded so PullCeremony does not play the SAME tier cue a second time.
	-- TIER_SFX has no Secret/God rungs, and broadcasts are skipped anyway, so on
	-- those tiers this stays false and the ceremony carries the lead itself.
	local tierCuePlayed = false
	if not isBroadcast(result) then
		pcall(playTierCue, result)
		tierCuePlayed = TIER_SFX[result.Rarity] ~= nil
	end

	if not shouldReveal(result) then return end

	-- pcall: a broken reveal must never break the catch that produced it.
	local payload = buildPayload(result, tierCuePlayed)
	-- A Huge/Massive rises out of the lake first. Deliberately BEFORE the takeover: the
	-- creature has to come out of the water the player actually threw into, and the
	-- takeover blacks the world out. pcall + fail-soft, so a broken cutscene still lets
	-- the ordinary reveal through.
	pcall(MassiveEmergence.play, payload)

	-- Epic+ gets the full Pull ceremony (takeover / odds climb / burst / stamp);
	-- lower tiers keep the fast reveal untouched -- respect the grind.
	pcall(PullCeremony.play, payload)
end

throwResult.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result)
	if type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.BrainrotName) ~= "string" then return end

	-- A cinematic-owned catch: the takeover IS the reveal. Adopt hands the
	-- authoritative result to the sequencer (covers reveal-time fallback swaps)
	-- and defers/replaces the ordinary chain. Fail-soft: if the cinematic dies,
	-- onDone(false) reruns this exact ordinary path. pcall'd end to end -- a
	-- broken bridge must cost this catch nothing at all.
	local adopted = false
	if CinBridge then
		local okAdopt, res = pcall(CinBridge.tryAdopt, result)
		if not okAdopt then
			warn("[CatchRevealClient] cinematic adopt errored: " .. tostring(res))
		end
		adopted = okAdopt and res == true
	end
	if adopted then
		local okHook = pcall(CinBridge.onDone, function(ok)
			if not ok then ordinaryReveal(result) return end
			local after = workspace:GetAttribute("CinematicCeremonyAfter")
			if after == nil then after = CinConfig and CinConfig.RUN_PULL_CEREMONY_AFTER end
			if after then pcall(PullCeremony.play, buildPayload(result)) end
		end)
		-- Registering the callback is the only thing that can ever un-defer this
		-- reveal. If even that failed, the catch would be silently eaten -- so fall
		-- straight through to the ordinary chain instead.
		if okHook then return end
	end

	ordinaryReveal(result)
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/CinematicClient.client.lua =====
--!strict
-- CinematicClient -- the client end of ThrowHandler's MassiveCinematic broadcast.
--
-- The server fires this to EVERYONE at flight start, with the arc's timing attached
-- (TotalTime/NContacts/SegTime) exactly as StoneThrown already does. Clients tick
-- their own clock from receipt, so the send latency cancels and everybody's bonk
-- lands on the same real-world instant as the server's final skip contact.
--
-- Three outcomes per broadcast, and EXACTLY one of them always happens:
--   1. thrower, size wants a cinematic   -> Bridge.arm + Sequencer.play (full takeover)
--   2. bystander within SPECTATOR_RADIUS -> Sequencer.play(spectator) (world FX only)
--   3. anyone else, or a declined/errored play -> stockLanding() below
--
-- (3) IS NOT OPTIONAL. The server suppresses the final splash and destroys its own
-- stone for EVERY client on a cinematic throw (ThrowHandler: "clients stage it
-- themselves"), so a client that runs no cinematic and stages no landing sees a
-- Massive throw as a rock silently ceasing to exist over open water. This file is
-- the only thing standing between that and the player.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local cinFolder = modules:WaitForChild("CatchCinematic")
local Config = require(cinFolder:WaitForChild("Config"))

-- Fail-soft, because of the header: this file is the ONLY thing that stages a
-- landing for a Massive throw. A broken or missing cinematic module at the top of
-- the file would kill the whole script, and every Massive rock in the game would
-- silently cease to exist over open water. So the two cinematic-stack requires
-- degrade to nil and the file falls back to stockLanding for everything.
-- The wait is BOUNDED on purpose: an unbounded WaitForChild for a module that will
-- never arrive hangs this script forever, which is the exact outcome being guarded
-- against. Typed `any` so --!strict stays happy with the optional shape.
local function softRequire(name: string): any
	local inst = cinFolder:WaitForChild(name, 5)
	if not inst then
		warn("[CinematicClient] " .. name .. " missing -- Massive throws take the stock landing")
		return nil
	end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, inst)
	if not ok then
		warn("[CinematicClient] " .. name .. " failed to load (" .. tostring(mod) .. ") -- Massive throws take the stock landing")
		return nil
	end
	return mod
end

local Sequencer = softRequire("Sequencer")
local Bridge = softRequire("Bridge")
local SoundKit = require(modules:WaitForChild("SoundKit"))
local MassiveEmergence = require(modules:WaitForChild("MassiveEmergence"))

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local cinematicRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("MassiveCinematic")

-- ============================ stock landing ============================

-- ThrowHandler's own big-landing numbers, matched on purpose: this has to be
-- indistinguishable from the splash the server would have played if the throw had
-- not been a cinematic one. Ring recipe is ThrowHandler.ripple()'s verbatim (thin
-- Neon cylinder rotated flat, Quad-EaseOut on Size + Transparency); sound is
-- playSplashSound()'s `big` branch (splashBig at 0.68, pitched to 0.95).
local RING_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(226, 244, 255)

local function stockLanding(endPos: Vector3, surfaceY: number)
	local surf = Vector3.new(endPos.X, surfaceY, endPos.Z)

	local ok = pcall(function()
		local ring = Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Name = "CinematicFallbackRipple"
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 1.6, 1.6)
		ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.Color = RING_COLOR
		ring.Transparency = 0.35
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(surf.X, surf.Y + 0.04, surf.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		ring.Anchored = true
		ring.CanCollide = false
		ring.CanQuery = false
		ring.CanTouch = false
		ring.CastShadow = false
		ring.Locked = true
		ring.Parent = Workspace

		TweenService:Create(
			ring,
			TweenInfo.new(1.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 40, 40), Transparency = 1 }
		):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(ring, 1.6)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[CinematicClient] stock landing ring failed")
	end

	pcall(SoundKit.play, "splashBig", surf, { volume = 0.68, speed = 0.95 })
end

-- ============================== preload ==============================

-- Fire-and-forget on its own thread: PreloadAsync YIELDS (potentially for seconds
-- on a cold client) and the bonk is on a hard clock. Worst case a texture pops in
-- late; the timeline never waits.
local SOUND_SLOTS = {
	"bonkClonk", "rumbleLoop", "bassDrop", "waterExplosion",
	"roar", "plink", "memeAudio", "cardWhoosh",
}

local function preload(brainrotName: string)
	local list: { Instance } = {}
	local temps: { Instance } = {}

	local models = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainrotModels")
	local template = models and models:FindFirstChild(brainrotName)
	if template then
		table.insert(list, template)
	end

	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, slot in ipairs(SOUND_SLOTS) do
		local ref = (Config.ASSETS :: any)[slot]
		local id: any = nil
		if type(ref) == "string" then
			if string.sub(ref, 1, 4) == "kit:" then
				id = (SoundKit :: any).Ids[string.sub(ref, 5)]
			else
				id = ref
			end
		end
		if type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" and not seen[id] then
			seen[id] = true
			-- Parentless throwaways purely as PreloadAsync handles; AudioBus makes
			-- the real Sound instances through SoundKit when the beat asks for them.
			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = id
			table.insert(list, s)
			table.insert(temps, s)
		end
	end

	if #list > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list)
		end)
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(temps) do
		s:Destroy()
	end
end

-- ============================== handler ==============================

local function onCinematic(payload: { [string]: any })
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if typeof(payload.EndPos) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end
	local receipt = os.clock()
	local endPos = payload.EndPos :: Vector3
	local surfaceY = tonumber(payload.SurfaceY) or endPos.Y
	local totalTime = math.max(tonumber(payload.TotalTime) or 0, 0)

	-- ============================ Studio debug seam ============================
	-- __variantOverride is NEVER sent by the real server -- ThrowHandler only ever
	-- builds {UserId,BrainrotName,Rarity,RarityColor,Mutation,Size,RockId,RockColor,
	-- Seed} plus the arc fields (see its own comment at the cinematicRemote build).
	-- Only ServerScriptService.CinematicCommand's /cinematic debug command sets it,
	-- gated identically server-side. Gated AGAIN here (field presence + IsStudio())
	-- as defence in depth, matching every other test seam in this build (Sequencer.
	-- debugHold, the TestHook below): the payload arrives over a real RemoteEvent, so
	-- a non-Studio client must never honour it even if an upstream gate were ever
	-- weakened. "hugeold" is the side-by-side comparator against the Sequencer cut --
	-- it bypasses the Sequencer ENTIRELY and hands off to the pre-cinematic cutscene
	-- directly, so it returns before any of the wants/bridge machinery below runs.
	if RunService:IsStudio() and payload.__variantOverride == "hugeold" then
		local wait = math.max(totalTime - (os.clock() - receipt), 0)
		task.delay(wait, function()
			local ok, err = pcall(MassiveEmergence.play, {
				Size = "Huge",
				SplashPos = endPos,
				Name = payload.BrainrotName,
				RarityColor = payload.RarityColor,
			})
			if not ok then
				warn("[CinematicClient] debug hugeold MassiveEmergence.play errored: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)
		return
	end

	-- The server only broadcasts for sizes Config says are cinematic, but the client
	-- re-reads Config anyway: a mid-session Config edit (or an older server) must
	-- never leave a client running a variant it has no beats for, and this is also
	-- what picks full vs trimmed.
	local variant = (Config.SIZES :: any)[payload.Size]
	if RunService:IsStudio() and (payload.__variantOverride == "trimmed" or payload.__variantOverride == "full") then
		-- Demo override: forces a variant regardless of Config.SIZES' current tuning
		-- (e.g. Huge is "none" pending the owner's pick) -- see CinematicCommand's
		-- /cinematic massive|huge.
		variant = payload.__variantOverride
	end
	-- Sequencer == nil is the fail-soft above: no cut is possible, so every branch
	-- below collapses to the stock landing rather than touching a nil module.
	local wants = (variant == "full" or variant == "trimmed") and Sequencer ~= nil

	local isThrower = payload.UserId == player.UserId
	local spectator = not isThrower

	if wants and spectator then
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then
			wants = false
		elseif ((hrp :: BasePart).Position - endPos).Magnitude > Config.SPECTATOR_RADIUS then
			wants = false
		end
	end

	if wants and Sequencer.isActive() then
		-- Never stack rigs. The Sequencer would refuse anyway; checking here means
		-- the fallback is scheduled from the start instead of discovered late.
		wants = false
	end

	local bridgeGen: number? = nil
	-- Debug fabricated payloads have no ThrowResult behind them (CinematicCommand
	-- grants nothing, touches no data), so arming the Bridge would just wait out
	-- Config.CANCEL_TIMEOUT and cancel the run a few seconds in -- exactly the
	-- outcome a demo command must not have. Studio-only, same gate as above.
	local skipBridge = RunService:IsStudio() and payload.__debugNoBridge == true
	if wants and isThrower and not skipBridge and Bridge == nil then
		-- Bridge failed the fail-soft require: the reveal could be neither adopted nor
		-- suppressed, so a thrower cut would run over the top of an ordinary catch
		-- popup. Stock landing instead. Spectator runs never arm it, so they are fine.
		wants = false
	end
	if wants and isThrower and not skipBridge then
		-- Armed NOW, not at the bonk: ThrowResult can (just) beat our scheduled play()
		-- to the client, and CatchRevealClient has to be able to adopt it. The expiry
		-- covers the flight plus the cancel window; the Sequencer's markRunning extends
		-- it to cover the cutscene itself once the run commits.
		bridgeGen = Bridge.arm(payload, totalTime + Config.CANCEL_TIMEOUT + 3)
		if bridgeGen == nil then
			-- An EARLIER catch's cinematic still owns the bridge, and the Bridge refuses
			-- to be clobbered (its rule R2). Flights really do overlap: the 1.05s throw
			-- cooldown is shorter than a 1.15-4.2s flight and far shorter than a 10.7s
			-- cutscene. So this throw takes the stock landing and its ordinary reveal --
			-- vastly better than stranding the running catch's reveal.
			wants = false
		end
	end
	if wants then
		task.spawn(preload, payload.BrainrotName)
	end

	-- ============== handing the camera over cleanly at the bonk ==============
	-- ClientMain's stone-tracking camera (any throw past TRACK_MIN_DISTANCE, which a
	-- Massive always is) holds CameraType = Scriptable for flightTime + 1.4s -- i.e.
	-- straight THROUGH the bonk. CameraRig:takeover() snapshots whatever CameraType
	-- and CFrame it finds so it can hand them back at the end, so without this flag it
	-- snapshots the tracking camera's Scriptable pose out at the landing point and
	-- "restores" the player into it -- camera frozen 900 studs away, permanently, on
	-- every real Massive catch. This tells ClientMain to release the camera a beat
	-- before the final contact so the snapshot is the player's real camera.
	-- Only a THROWER run takes the camera; spectator runs are world FX only.
	local takesCamera = wants and isThrower
	if takesCamera then
		player:SetAttribute("CinematicCameraInbound", true)
	end

	local wait = math.max(totalTime - (os.clock() - receipt), 0)
	task.delay(wait, function()
		-- Served its purpose: ClientMain released the camera CINEMATIC_CAM_LEAD seconds
		-- ago and takeover() is about to run (or not) on this very line.
		if takesCamera then
			player:SetAttribute("CinematicCameraInbound", nil)
		end
		if not wants then
			stockLanding(endPos, surfaceY)
			return
		end

		-- Sequencer.play BLOCKS for the whole cinematic, but the accept/decline answer
		-- is needed NOW so the fallback lands ON the bonk rather than ten seconds after
		-- it. opts.onCommit fires synchronously the instant play commits, and task.spawn
		-- runs the thread up to its first yield -- which play only reaches after
		-- committing. So by the line below the answer already exists, with no reliance
		-- on a "play must not yield before returning" comment invariant and no
		-- isActive() guess (which can be true for somebody else's spectator run).
		local committed = false
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(Sequencer.play, payload, {
				spectator = spectator,
				variant = variant,
				bridgeGen = bridgeGen,
				onCommit = function()
					committed = true
				end,
			})
			if not ok then
				warn("[CinematicClient] Sequencer.play errored: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)

		if not committed then
			-- Declined (debounced / bad payload / no model) or errored before it ever
			-- took over. Generation-scoped release: a debounced play must never tear
			-- down the LIVE arm of the earlier throw whose cinematic is the very thing
			-- debouncing it -- that bug eats a catch.
			if bridgeGen ~= nil then
				Bridge.markFailedFor(bridgeGen)
			end
			stockLanding(endPos, surfaceY)
		end
	end)
end

cinematicRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	local ok, err = pcall(onCinematic, payload)
	if not ok then
		warn("[CinematicClient] handler errored: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)

-- ============================== test seam ==============================

-- Studio only. The OnClientEvent path above can only be driven from a server, so the
-- harness needs a door into these functions with fabricated payloads and no real
-- throw (a real throw would GRANT, and Studio play sessions write the live
-- datastore). Never created in a published server.
if RunService:IsStudio() then
	local hook = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	hook.Name = "TestHook"
	hook.OnInvoke = function(action: string, arg: any): any
		if action == "cinematic" then
			onCinematic(arg)
			return true
		elseif action == "stock" then
			stockLanding(arg.EndPos, arg.SurfaceY or arg.EndPos.Y)
			return true
		elseif action == "preload" then
			preload(arg)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	hook.Parent = script
end

-- Repaint the Border strokes an authored instance already carries; adding a new
-- one would double the outline.
local function blackRim(o, thick)
	for _, s in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then
			s.Color = CF.ink; s.Thickness = thick or 3; s.Transparency = 0
		end
	end
end

-- Black glyph outline, reusing an existing Contextual stroke when there is one.
local function inkTextOnce(o, thick)
	for _, s in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode == Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then
			s.Color = CF.ink; s.Thickness = thick or 2.4; s.Transparency = 0
			return s
		end
	end
	return UITheme.inkText(o, thick)
end

local function styleMenus()
	for _, spec in ipairs({
		{ frame = shopFrame, list = shopList, close = shopCloseButton, title = "Rock Shop", icon = "\u{1FAA8}", accent1 = BZ.rockHeader1, accent2 = BZ.rockHeader2 },
		{ frame = sellFrame, list = sellList, close = sellCloseButton, title = "Sell Rocks", icon = "\u{1F4B0}", accent1 = BZ.sellHeader1, accent2 = BZ.sellHeader2 },
	}) do
		spec.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 400)
		-- MainUI is Global ZIndexBehavior: lift the panel, then every child with it.
		spec.frame.ZIndex = 10
		UITheme.bazaarPanel(spec.frame)

		UITheme.bazaarHeader(spec.frame, spec.title, spec.icon, spec.accent1, spec.accent2)
		spec.frame.TextLabel.Visible = false   -- kept, not destroyed

		UITheme.bazaarClose(spec.close)
		spec.close.ZIndex = 20

		spec.list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 64)
		spec.list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -80)
		spec.list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		spec.list.BorderSizePixel = 0
		spec.list.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		spec.list.ZIndex = 11
		spec.list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		spec.list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		local ll = spec.list:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		if ll then ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10); ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; ll.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center end
	end
	sellEmptyLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 74)
	sellEmptyLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	sellEmptyLabel.TextSize = 15
	sellEmptyLabel.TextColor3 = BZ.muted
	sellEmptyLabel.ZIndex = 12
	-- shop + sell join the single-open registry: opening either closes any rail
	-- panel and folds the rail away, and vice versa
	SideRail.registerPanel(shopFrame)
	SideRail.registerPanel(sellFrame)
end
