	local function buildClaimPill(card: Frame)
		-- CLAIM protrudes below the card; height 44 = the touch minimum. The
		-- mock's 1.4s pulse rides Size (AnchorPoint 0.5,1: width grows about
		-- the centre, height grows upward -- no position compensation) because
		-- UIScale tweens do not run in this place.
		local pill = UI.button(card, "CLAIM", "green", UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 44), "buttonM")
		pill.Name = "ClaimPill"
		pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		pill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 16)
		pill.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 6
		TweenService:Create(pill,
			TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
			{ Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 47) }):Play()
		-- The ONE DailyClaim:FireServer call site in this module, fired with
		-- NO ARGUMENTS. No local state mutation -- the card only re-renders
		-- CLAIMED once the server pushes a fresh DailyState.
		pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ctx.remotes.DailyClaim:FireServer()
		end)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- day card builder (mock 1e state-coloured cards)
	local function buildDayCard(slot: Frame, slotDay: number, rewardIdx: number, isGrand: boolean)
		local w = isGrand and CARD_W_GRAND or CARD_W_NORMAL

		-- kit adaptation of the mock states -- see module header note
		local isClaimed = slotDay < state.NextDay or (slotDay == state.NextDay and not state.Claimable)
		local isToday = slotDay == state.NextDay and state.Claimable

		-- TODAY's gold glow: a static halo frame behind the card (the mock's
		-- box-shadow ring; layered-frame convention, no blur primitives here)
		if isToday then
			local halo = Instance.new("Frame")
			halo.Name = "TodayHalo"
			halo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			halo.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
			halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w + 12, CARD_H + 12)
			halo.BackgroundColor3 = TODAY_GLOW
			halo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
			halo.BorderSizePixel = 0
			halo.ZIndex = 14
			halo.Parent = slot
			UI.corner(halo, T.radius.control + 4)
		end

		local card = Instance.new("Frame")
		card.Name = "DayCard" .. rewardIdx
		card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, CARD_H)
		card.BorderSizePixel = 0
		card.ZIndex = 15
		card.Parent = slot
		UI.corner(card, T.radius.control)

		-- state colouring (mock 1e)
		local textColor: Color3
		if isToday then
			card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			grad.Rotation = 90
			grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(TODAY_TOP, TODAY_BOT)
			grad.Parent = card
			UI.stroke(card, 3.5) -- ink border
			textColor = TODAY_TEXT
		elseif isClaimed then
			card.BackgroundColor3 = CLAIMED_BG
			local st = UI.stroke(card, 3)
			st.Color = CLAIMED_BORDER
			textColor = CLAIMED_TEXT
		elseif isGrand then
			card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			UI.stroke(card, 3)
			textColor = MEGA_TEXT
		else
			card.BackgroundColor3 = LOCKED_BG
			local st = UI.stroke(card, 3)
			st.Color = LOCKED_BORDER
			textColor = LOCKED_TEXT
		end
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.Parent = card

		local dayLabel = UI.label(card, "DAY " .. tostring(rewardIdx), "cardLabel", textColor)
		dayLabel.Name = "DayLabel"
		dayLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		dayLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		dayLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		dayLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		dayLabel.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2

		-- coin art (kit icon, not emoji); dimmed for claimed/locked per mock.
		-- UI.artSlot returns the ImageLabel ITSELF, not a container.
		local art = UI.artSlot(card, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(24 + 6 + 20 + 6)), T.icons.coin)
		art.Name = "ArtSlot"
		art.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24 + 6)
		art.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		if isClaimed then
			art.ImageTransparency = 0.5
		elseif not isToday and not isGrand then
			art.ImageTransparency = 0.55
		end

		local rewardLabel = UI.label(card, shortCash(state.Rewards[rewardIdx] or 0), "chip", textColor)
		rewardLabel.Name = "RewardLabel"
		rewardLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		rewardLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		rewardLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
		rewardLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		rewardLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		rewardLabel.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2

		cardFrames[rewardIdx] = card

		if isClaimed then
			buildCornerBadge(card, CHECK_GREEN, "\u{2713}")
		elseif isToday then
			buildTodayTag(card)
			buildClaimPill(card)
			rewardLabel.Visible = false
		elseif not isGrand then
			-- mock's day-7 card wears no lock badge -- the rainbow treatment
			-- IS its locked look
			buildCornerBadge(card, LOCK_BADGE, "\u{1F512}")
		end

		if isGrand then
			-- mock day-7 MEGA GIFT: rainbow border (shared-Heartbeat ring) +
			-- purple lettering; the gift art replaces the coin. Ring rides the
			-- slot (unpadded, same bounds) per the furniture note above.
			UI.rainbowRing(slot, T.radius.control + 2)
			art.Image = T.icons.daily
			local mega = UI.label(card, "MEGA GIFT", "chip", MEGA_TEXT)
			mega.Name = "MegaLabel"
			mega.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			mega.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20)
			mega.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
			mega.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			mega.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			mega.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2
			-- a milestone that is ALSO the claimable TODAY: the breathing CLAIM
			-- pill owns the card's foot -- hide the lettering rather than let
			-- the pill slice it (review catch; same convention as rewardLabel)
			mega.Visible = not isToday
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- card row render (rolling weekly window -- see module header note)
	local function renderCards()
		for _, c in ipairs(cardsRow:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Frame") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		table.clear(cardFrames)

		local cycleLen = math.max(#state.Rewards, 1)
		local function wrapDay(d: number): number
			return ((d - 1) % cycleLen) + 1
		end
		local weekBase = math.floor((state.NextDay - 1) / 7) * 7

		for i = 1, 7 do
			local slotDay = weekBase + i
			local rewardIdx = wrapDay(slotDay)
			-- milestone-true MEGA GIFT, not positional -- gated on the SAME
			-- wrapped reward index the reward lookup uses
			local isGrand = MILESTONES[rewardIdx] == true

			local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
			slot.Name = "DaySlot" .. i
			slot.LayoutOrder = i
			slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(isGrand and CARD_W_GRAND or CARD_W_NORMAL, CARD_H)
			slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			slot.ZIndex = 15
			slot.Parent = cardsRow

			buildDayCard(slot, slotDay, rewardIdx, isGrand)
		end
	end

	local function render()
		if state.Streak and state.Streak > 0 then
			hintLabel.Text = tostring(state.Streak) .. " day streak!"
		else
			hintLabel.Text = ""
		end
		renderCards()
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- claim-resolve motion (unchanged through the restyle -- see module header note)
	local function playClaimResolveMotion(claimedDayIdx: number)
		local card = cardFrames[claimedDayIdx]
		if not card then
			return -- window scrolled off this day; render() already shows the true state
		end

		claimMotionGen += 1
		local myGen = claimMotionGen
		local myInstances: { Instance } = {}
		motionInstancesByGen[myGen] = myInstances

		local scrim = Instance.new("Frame")
		scrim.Name = "ClaimMotionScrim"
		scrim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		scrim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 6)
		scrim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		scrim.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scrim.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 10
		scrim.Parent = card
		table.insert(myInstances, scrim)
		UI.corner(scrim, T.radius.control)
		TweenService:Create(scrim, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		}):Play()

		task.delay(0.12, function()
			if myGen ~= claimMotionGen or not card.Parent then
				return
			end

			local check = Instance.new("Frame")
			check.Name = "ClaimMotionCheck"
			check.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			check.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			check.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
			check.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
			check.BorderSizePixel = 0
			check.ZIndex = scrim.ZIndex + 1
			check.Parent = card
			table.insert(myInstances, check)
			UI.corner(check, 28)
			UI.gradient(check, T.gradient.green)
			UI.stroke(check, T.stroke.control)
			local checkScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			checkScale.Scale = 0.4
			checkScale.Parent = check
			local mark = UI.label(check, "\u{2713}", "buttonL", T.color.white)
			mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			mark.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			mark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			mark.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			mark.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			mark.TextSize = 30
			mark.ZIndex = check.ZIndex + 1

			TweenService:Create(checkScale, T.tween.pop, { Scale = 1 }):Play()

			task.delay(T.tween.pop.Time, function()
				if myGen ~= claimMotionGen or not card.Parent then
					return
				end

				-- fly the coin to the pill (parented to the ScreenGui so raw
				-- AbsolutePosition maps 1:1; FIX F6 inset compensation)
				local screenGui = ctx.host:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
				if screenGui then
					local insetY = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
					local fromCenter = card.AbsolutePosition + card.AbsoluteSize / 2
					local coin = UI.artSlot(screenGui, UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), T.icons.coin)
					coin.Name = "DailyClaimFlyCoin"
					coin.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
					coin.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(fromCenter.X, fromCenter.Y + insetY)
					coin.ZIndex = T.zindex.toast
					coin.Parent = screenGui
					table.insert(myInstances, coin)
					local target = ctx.pillAnchor("coin")
					local flyTween = TweenService:Create(coin, T.tween.fly, {
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(target.X, target.Y + insetY),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
					})
					flyTween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if coin and coin.Parent then
							coin:Destroy()
						end
						motionInstancesByGen[myGen] = nil
					end)
					flyTween:Play()
				else
					motionInstancesByGen[myGen] = nil
				end

				TweenService:Create(scrim, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				}):Play()
				task.delay(0.12, function()
					if scrim and scrim.Parent then
						scrim:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				if check and check.Parent then
					check:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- data wiring (server-confirmed only)
	local function applyServerState(s, allowMotion: boolean)
		if typeof(s) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		state.Streak = s.Streak or 0
		state.NextDay = s.NextDay or 1
		state.Rewards = s.Rewards or state.Rewards
		state.Claimable = s.Claimable == true
		state.FreezeAvailable = s.FreezeAvailable == true

		ctx.state.daily.streakDay = state.NextDay
		ctx.state.daily.claimedToday = not state.Claimable

		render()

		if allowMotion and s.JustClaimed then
			playClaimResolveMotion(state.NextDay)
		end
	end

	if capturedState then
		applyServerState(capturedState, false)
	end
	table.insert(liveCallbacks, function(s)
		applyServerState(s, true)
	end)

	----------------------------------------------------------- refresh countdown (1s loop, gated on wrapper.Visible)
	local countdownRunning = false
	local function tickCountdown()
		timerValue.Text = formatHMS(nextMidnightRemaining(os.time()))
	end
	local function startCountdown()
		if countdownRunning then
			return
		end
		countdownRunning = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while countdownRunning and wrapper.Visible do
				tickCountdown()
				task.wait(1)
			end
			countdownRunning = false
		end)
	end
	local function stopCountdown()
		countdownRunning = false
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- backdrop blur (mock 1d/1e: dim + blur(3px) behind the panel)
	-- The shell owns the dim scrim; the blur is per-panel. Created/destroyed
	-- on Visible (covers close, force-close and ESC alike). Size is SET, not
	-- tweened -- BlurEffect.Size is not on the proven tween whitelist here.
	local BLUR_NAME = "DailyPanelBlur"
	local function setBlur(on: boolean)
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BLUR_NAME)
		if on and not existing then
			local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
			blur.Name = BLUR_NAME
			blur.Size = 8
			blur.Parent = Lighting
		elseif not on and existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- wiring
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)

	-- No refresh request to make on open: the server never listens for one
	-- (see module header). Visibility drives the countdown, the blur, and
	-- in-flight claim-motion cleanup.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			startCountdown()
			setBlur(true)
		else
			stopCountdown()
			setBlur(false)
			-- force-destroy any in-flight claim flourish (the coin lives
			-- OUTSIDE wrapper's hierarchy and would keep flying otherwise)
			claimMotionGen += 1
			for gen, instances in pairs(motionInstancesByGen) do
				for _, inst in ipairs(instances) do
					if inst and inst.Parent then
						inst:Destroy()
					end
				end
				motionInstancesByGen[gen] = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Belt-and-braces for the blur/countdown teardown (review catch): the
	-- shell's openPanel now hides every other panel unconditionally, but any
	-- path that hides the HOST while this wrapper stays Visible (legacy
	-- single-open force-closes, future shell changes) must still kill the
	-- global BlurEffect -- it post-processes the whole screen regardless of
	-- GUI visibility.
	ctx.host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not ctx.host.Visible then
			setBlur(false)
			stopCountdown()
		elseif wrapper.Visible then
			setBlur(true)
			startCountdown()
		end
	end)

	render() -- initial paint (zero/seeded state) before openPanel shows the frame

	return wrapper
end

return DailyPanel

-- this pass mostly DELETES the cream sweep's per-surface overrides rather
-- than retargeting them -- the surfaces inherit the guide by just being
-- UI.surface/UI.button calls again. Only the header pair and the two
-- hand-built pieces of header furniture still need literals.
-- KEPT AS-IS (identity, not chrome): the soft-green Claimed pill, the gold
-- active-tab ring, green Claim / blue VIEW / disabled In-progress buttons,
-- the dark inset progress tracks and reward chips with their white in-chip
-- labels, and the per-panel backdrop BlurEffect ("GoalsPanelBlur"). EVERY
-- remote, state table, tab switch, bob driver and countdown wire below is
-- untouched: this was a recolour pass, zero wiring changes.
--
-- (Historical, so the diff reads: the 1d/1e sweep this replaced put a GREEN
-- header #7be04e -> #3fae1f on a cream body with white cards, the tan
-- #e5d3ac card border and #4a3416 body ink.)
--
-- Contract (kit README section: ctx from GameHUDClient):
--   return { Id = "goals", Build = function(ctx) -> Frame }
-- Build is called ONCE lazily on first open; the shell parents the returned
-- Frame into ctx.host and owns Visible toggling on every open/close after
-- that -- this module never sets its own Parent or drives its own open/close
-- animation (same contract PassPanel documents/follows).
--
-- This panel consolidates THREE independent quest systems behind one set of
-- tabs (Daily / Goals / Season). Each system was read FULLY before writing
-- anything below; their shapes differ enough that no single data model can
-- represent all three -- each tab has its own fetch + render path, feeding
-- a shared row-builder. Recorded verbatim (see task-6-report.md for the
-- full trace):
--
--   DAILY  -- ServerScriptService.Modules.DarrelService + remotes.DarrelUpdate
--            (RemoteEvent, server->client push) / remotes.DarrelState
--            (RemoteFunction, client->server pull, self-healing).
--     Both deliver the SAME shape: { Darrels = number, Daily = DailyState? }
--     DailyState = { Day = number, Quests = { { Id, Text, Reward, Target,
--       Progress, Claimed }, ... } }  (exactly 3 entries; DarrelService
--     .slateFor(day) picks 3 from a 6-quest pool, same slate for everyone)
--     `Daily` is nil until the player's profile has loaded server-side --
--     DarrelState's OnServerInvoke returns { Darrels = M.Get(player) (which
--     is 0 for an unloaded profile), Daily = M.GetDailyState(player) (which
--     is nil for an unloaded profile) }. A pull landing before the profile
--     loads is therefore a PLACEHOLDER, not real data -- GameHUDClient's own
--     startup-pull loop treats `typeof(res.Daily) == "table"` as the
--     loaded/not-loaded discriminator and keeps retrying until it sees a
--     table (see GameHUDClient ~line 374, "Bug C3 fix", and
--     task-4-report.md). This module reuses the exact same discriminator.
--     Server AUTO-CLAIMS (DarrelService.Notify claims + awards the instant
--     Progress reaches Target, before ever pushing state) -- so the client
--     NEVER sees Progress>=Target with Claimed==false, and there is no
--     Daily claim remote at all. Reward currency is Darrels (the gem
--     pill's currency).
--
--   GOALS (one-time milestones) -- ServerScriptService.Modules.QuestHandler
--            + remotes.QuestState (RemoteEvent, server->client push only --
--            no client-fire request exists; server pushes on join and again
--            every 3s for every player) / remotes.QuestClaim (RemoteEvent,
--            client->server, fire with the quest id string).
--     QuestState's payload is the quest LIST ITSELF (not wrapped in a
--     table field): array of { Id, Desc, Reward, Met, Claimed }. There is
--     no Progress/Target pair -- QuestHandler's `met(data)` predicates are
--     opaque booleans (e.g. "own 5 brainrots"), so this tab's progress bar
--     synthesizes Target=1/Progress=(Met and 1 or 0) and labels the meta
--     text COMPLETE/LOCKED rather than inventing a fake "x / 1" counter.
--     Reward currency is Cash (the coin pill's currency). Full Claim flow:
--     QuestClaim:FireServer(q.Id) -> server validates -> re-sends
--     QuestState -> row re-renders CLAIMED. Never claimed locally.
--
--   SEASON -- ServerScriptService.Modules.SeasonPassHandler + remotes.
--            SeasonState (RemoteEvent, bidirectional: FireServer() with no
--            args requests a refresh; FireClient pushes state) -- same
--            remote PassPanel already reads.
--     SeasonState payload: { XP, Claimed = {[tostring(tier)]=true,...},
--       QuestIds = {string,...}, Progress = {[id]={P=number,D=boolean}},
--       Day }. Quest DEFINITIONS (display name, icon, target, XP reward)
--     are NOT in that payload -- only ids + raw progress numbers. The
--     definitions live in ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SeasonConfig.PoolById
--     (Id, Name, Icon [emoji glyph, not an image], Event, Target, XP),
--     shared/public exactly like PassPanel already requires SeasonConfig
--     for tier data. Season quests have NO separate claim step: XP is
--     granted automatically the instant a quest's progress hits its target
--     (SeasonPassHandler.Notify sets q.D=true and adds def.XP to
--     data.SeasonXP in the same call, before ever pushing state) --
--     the thing a player DOES claim is a Pass reward TIER (SeasonClaim,
--     Cash), which is PassPanel's job, not this row's. Per the task brief,
--     every Season row's action is therefore a "VIEW" button that opens the
--     Pass panel (ctx.openPanel("pass")) -- there is no SeasonQuestClaim
--     remote to invent, and inventing local claim state here would violate
--     the server-confirmed-only rule for no benefit (the reward already
--     landed the moment SeasonState reported it).
--
-- Kit-token gaps (documented, not fabricated): §3.6 names two colours with
-- no matching ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UIKit.Tokens entry -- the header
-- icon-slot backing (#F0D2FF -> #DDB2F6) and the refresh chip
-- (#5B1D8C -> #3A0F5C bg, #E7C8FF label). The 1d/1e sweep retinted both to

local function shortCash(n: number): string
	n = math.floor(n or 0)
	if n >= 1e9 then
		return string.format("$%.1fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif n >= 1e6 then
		return string.format("$%.1fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif n >= 1e3 then
		return string.format("$%.0fK", n / 1e3)
	end
	return "$" .. tostring(n)
end

local function formatHMS(totalSeconds: number): string
	totalSeconds = math.max(0, math.floor(totalSeconds))
	local h = totalSeconds // 3600
	local m = (totalSeconds % 3600) // 60
	local s = totalSeconds % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
end

-- Pure so it's trivially probeable against a known epoch: nextMidnightRemaining(t)
-- for any t returns seconds until the next UTC day boundary. os.time() is
-- UTC-based in Roblox (server + client agree), matching DarrelService.utcDay
-- / SeasonPassHandler.currentDay's own `math.floor(os.time() / 86400)` day
-- math. The outer `% 86400` matters: a naive `86400 - (t % 86400)` reads
-- 86400 ("24:00:00") at the exact instant t lands ON a day boundary instead
-- of 0 ("00:00:00") -- caught live by probing t = a known day boundary
-- (e.g. 86400*5) before this wrap was added.
local function nextMidnightRemaining(t: number): number
	return (86400 - (t % 86400)) % 86400
end

	local body = UI.surface(panelCol, UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, BODY_H), "cream", T.radius.panel, T.stroke.panel)
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BODY_TOP)
	body.ZIndex = 12
	UI.hardShadow(body, T.shadowOffset.panel, T.radius.panel)
	local bodyPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	bodyPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.Parent = body

	----------------------------------------------------------- tabs
	local TAB_DEFS = { "Daily", "Goals", "Season" }
	local tabsRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	tabsRow.Name = "Tabs"
	tabsRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	tabsRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TAB_H)
	tabsRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tabsRow.ZIndex = 14
	tabsRow.Parent = body

	local tabButtons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
	local tabRings: { [string]: Frame } = {}

	local BODY_INNER_W = PANEL_W - T.pad.panel * 2
	local TAB_W = (BODY_INNER_W - TAB_GAP * 2) / 3

	for i, id in ipairs(TAB_DEFS) do
		local btn = UI.button(tabsRow, id, "tab", UDim2.fromOffset(TAB_W, TAB_H), "buttonM")
		btn.Name = "Tab" .. id
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * (TAB_W + TAB_GAP), 0)
		btn.ZIndex = 14
		btn.Parent = tabsRow
		tabButtons[id] = btn

		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): the olive "tab" chip goes white-card on
		-- the cream body -- recolored IN PLACE, zero wiring. NOTE the target:
		-- FindFirstChildOfClass on the BUTTON hits its border UIStroke; the
		-- label's contextual text stroke lives on the TextLabel child and
		-- stays ink (the same brown-ink-with-ink-stroke combo Daily's tinted
		-- card labels ship). Gloss/Shade strips stay: white gloss on white is
		-- invisible and the 0.82-transparency shade reads as a subtle bottom
		-- bevel. The gold active ring below is untouched -- it pops harder on
		-- white than it ever did on olive.
		local tabGrad = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if tabGrad then
			tabGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		local tabStroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if tabStroke then
			tabStroke.Color = CARD_BORDER
			tabStroke.Thickness = 3
		end
		local tabLabel = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if tabLabel then
			tabLabel.TextColor3 = BODY_INK
		end

		-- static active-state ring (kit README §3.6 "active gold ring") --
		-- same inset/radius convention as UIKit.Builders.claimRing, but NO
		-- pulse tween: this is a persistent selection indicator, not a
		-- claimable-now affordance.
		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "ActiveRing"
		ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8)
		ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, -4)
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.Visible = false
		ring.ZIndex = btn.ZIndex + 3
		ring.Parent = btn
		UI.corner(ring, T.radius.control + 3)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Thickness = 4
		ringStroke.Color = T.color.activeRing
		ringStroke.Parent = ring
		tabRings[id] = ring
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- rows scroll region

	-- cream; #c9b585 is the tan card-border's darker sibling. Cosmetic only.
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#c9b585")

	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

	rowsList.Parent = scroll

	----------------------------------------------------------- idle-bob driver (ONE Heartbeat, shared by every rendered Claim button)
	local bobActive: { { frame: Frame, base: UDim2 } } = {}
	local bobConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

	local function stopBobDriver()
		if bobConn then
			bobConn:Disconnect()
			bobConn = nil
		end
		-- Park every live button back on its base position. The driver writes
		-- Position every frame, so whatever offset the final frame happened to
		-- write would otherwise stay frozen there -- a Claim button sitting a
		-- few px out of line with its neighbours from the moment the panel
		-- closes until the driver's next tick after it reopens.
		for i = #bobActive, 1, -1 do
			local e = bobActive[i]
			if e.frame.Parent then
				e.frame.Position = e.base
			else
				table.remove(bobActive, i)
			end
		end
	end

	local function ensureBobDriver()
		if bobConn or not wrapper.Visible then
			return
		end
		local clock = 0
		bobConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			if not wrapper.Visible then
				stopBobDriver()
				return
			end
			clock += dt
			for i = #bobActive, 1, -1 do
				local e = bobActive[i]
				if not e.frame.Parent then
					table.remove(bobActive, i) -- pruned: row rebuilt/destroyed since this entry registered
				else
					local off = math.sin(clock / T.tween.bobPeriod * (2 * math.pi)) * 5
					e.frame.Position = UDim2.new(e.base.X.Scale, e.base.X.Offset, e.base.Y.Scale, e.base.Y.Offset + off)
				end
			end
			if #bobActive == 0 then
				stopBobDriver()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function registerBob(frame: Frame)
		table.insert(bobActive, { frame = frame, base = frame.Position })
		ensureBobDriver()
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- reward chip + icon slot + action button builders
	local function measureChipWidth(text: string): number
		local spec = T.text.cardLabel
		local textW = TextService:GetTextSize(text, spec[1], Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Vector2.new(1000, spec[1] + 24)).X
		return CHIP_PAD_L + CHIP_ICON_W + CHIP_GAP + textW + CHIP_PAD_R
	end

	-- widthOverride: every row on a tab is built at the SAME chip width (the
	-- widest that tab needs -- see the renderers), so the progress tracks to
	-- their left all end on one vertical line instead of stepping in and out
	-- row by row with the length of the reward text.
	local function buildRewardChip(parent: Frame, iconKey: string, text: string, widthOverride: number?): (Frame, number)
		local w = math.max(measureChipWidth(text), widthOverride or 0)
		local chip = UI.surface(parent, UDim2.fromOffset(w, CHIP_H), "track", T.radius.small, T.stroke.control)
		chip.Name = "RewardChip"
		chip.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1

		-- "darrel" has no Tokens.icons entry (he is not part of the kit), so an
		-- artSlot would render an empty box here. Fall back to the drawn version
		-- the HUD pill and egg shop already use, keeping one face for the currency
		-- everywhere it is shown.
		local icon: GuiObject
		local iconId = T.icons[iconKey]
		if (iconId and iconId ~= "") or not (IconArt and IconArt.has(iconKey)) then
			icon = UI.artSlot(chip, UDim2.fromOffset(CHIP_ICON_W, CHIP_ICON_W), iconId)
		else
			local host = Instance.new("Frame")
			host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CHIP_ICON_W, CHIP_ICON_W)
			host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			host.Parent = chip
			IconArt.draw(host, iconKey, CHIP_ICON_W, chip.ZIndex + 1)
			icon = host
		end
		icon.Name = "CurrencyIcon"
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, CHIP_PAD_L, 0.5, 0)
		icon.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 1

		local value = UI.label(chip, text, "cardLabel", T.color.white)
		value.Name = "Value"
		value.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		value.Position = UDim2.new(0, CHIP_PAD_L + CHIP_ICON_W + CHIP_GAP, 0.5, 0)
		value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(CHIP_PAD_L + CHIP_ICON_W + CHIP_GAP + CHIP_PAD_R), 0, 24)
		value.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		value.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 1

		return chip, w
	end

	local function buildIconSlot(parent: Frame, imageId: string?, emoji: string?): Frame
		local slot = UI.surface(parent, UDim2.fromOffset(ICON_W, ICON_W), "slot", T.radius.small, T.stroke.control)
		slot.Name = "IconSlot"
		slot.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): dark "slot" backing -> white mini-card.
		-- This is card-internal BACKING, not a currency chip (those stay dark
		-- below) -- and the very same goals icon already reads fine on the
		-- header's light plate. Season's full-colour emoji glyphs read fine on
		-- white too. Recolored in place; art/emoji structure untouched.
		local slotGrad = slot:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if slotGrad then
			slotGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		local slotStroke = slot:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if slotStroke then
			slotStroke.Color = CARD_BORDER
			slotStroke.Thickness = 3
		end
		if emoji then
			local glyph = UI.label(slot, emoji, "buttonL", T.color.white)
			glyph.Name = "Glyph"
			glyph.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			glyph.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			glyph.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			glyph.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			glyph.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			glyph.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 1
		else
			local art = UI.artSlot(slot, UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8), imageId)
			art.Name = "Art"
			art.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			art.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			art.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 1
		end
		return slot
	end

	-- "claimed" is built by hand (not UI.button) because UI.button forces
	-- white label text for every non-"disabled" variant, and a Claimed state
	-- needs a muted label -- unreachable through UI.button's variant map.
	-- That reason predates the restyle and survives it. 1d/1e sweep
	-- (2026-08-04): the old dark subPanel chip (#4A5840->#2E3825 + #9FAE8B
	-- text) is now DailyPanel's claimed-card palette VERBATIM (#e9f7e4 bg /
	-- #bfe3b1 border / #6da35e text) so "claimed = soft green" is one
	-- language across every cream panel. Flat colour, so the old gradient is
	-- simply not created; still exactly ONE UI.stroke call on this Frame.
	local function buildClaimedButton(parent: Frame): Frame
		local b = Instance.new("Frame")
		b.Name = "ClaimedButton"
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W, ACTION_H)
		b.BackgroundColor3 = CLAIMED_BG
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		b.Parent = parent
		UI.corner(b, T.radius.control)
		local st = UI.stroke(b, 3)
		st.Color = CLAIMED_BORDER
		local l = UI.label(b, "Claimed \u{2713}", "cardLabel", CLAIMED_TEXT)
		l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		l.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 1
		return b
	end

	-- kind: "claim" | "inprogress" | "claimed" | "view"
	local function buildActionButton(parent: Frame, kind: string, onClaim: (() -> ())?, onView: (() -> ())?): Frame
		if kind == "claim" then
			-- Bob offset is applied to this wrapper Frame's Position, NEVER
			-- to the button's own Position -- UI.button's hover/press tweens
			-- already animate the button's Position relative to (0,0) inside
			-- this wrapper, and driving both the wrapper AND the button off
			-- the same property every frame would make the two animations
			-- fight each other. Splitting them onto two different Instances'
			-- Position properties keeps hover/press and idle-bob independent.
			local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
			slot.Name = "ClaimBobSlot"
			slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W, ACTION_H)
			slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			slot.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
			slot.Parent = parent
			local btn = UI.button(slot, "Claim", "green", UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W, ACTION_H), "buttonM")
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
			btn.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 1
			-- The ONE QuestClaim:FireServer call site in this module. No
			-- local state mutation -- the row only re-renders CLAIMED once
			-- the server pushes a fresh QuestState with Claimed == true.
			if onClaim then
				btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClaim)
			end
			-- NOT registered here: the caller has not positioned this slot yet.
			-- registerBob snapshots frame.Position as the bob's base, so
			-- registering now captures the default (0, 0) and the driver then
			-- overwrites the real position every frame -- which is exactly what
			-- shot every Claim button clean out of its row and left it bobbing
			-- off the left edge of the panel. Handed back to buildQuestRow,
			-- which registers it once it is in place.
			return slot, slot
		elseif kind == "claimed" then
			return buildClaimedButton(parent)
		elseif kind == "view" then
			local btn = UI.button(parent, "VIEW", "blue", UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W, ACTION_H), "buttonM")
			btn.Name = "ViewButton"
			btn.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
			if onView then
				btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onView)
			end
			return btn
		else -- "inprogress"
			local btn = UI.button(parent, "In progress", "disabled", UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W, ACTION_H), "cardLabel")
			btn.Name = "InProgressButton"
			btn.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
			return btn
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- quest row (shared by all 3 tabs)
	type RowVM = {
		Icon: string?,
		Emoji: string?,
		Title: string,
		Progress: number,
		Target: number,
		MetaOverride: string?,
		RewardIconKey: string,
		RewardText: string,
		Action: string, -- "claim" | "inprogress" | "claimed" | "view"
		ChipW: number?, -- shared reward-chip width for the whole tab
		OnClaim: (() -> ())?,
	}

	local function buildQuestRow(order: number, vm: RowVM)
		-- RowSlot wrapper (PassPanel report bug 3's HardShadow-in-UIListLayout
		-- trap): KEPT through the 1d/1e sweep even though the card's hard
		-- shadow is now gone -- the wrapper is the rows list's one-child-per-
		-- quest contract, and the only safe place to hang shadow-like or
		-- overhang siblings should any come back.
		local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
		slot.Name = "RowSlot" .. order
		slot.LayoutOrder = order
		slot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_H)
		slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		slot.ZIndex = 15
		slot.Parent = scroll

		local card = UI.surface(slot, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), "row", T.radius.control, T.stroke.control)
		card.Name = "Card"
		card.ZIndex = 15
		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): olive "row" card -> white card with the
		-- tan border, recolored IN PLACE (the surface's own gradient/stroke;
		-- one of each exists). The UI.hardShadow call is DROPPED -- never
		-- created, not destroyed post-hoc (hardShadow wires Position/
		-- Destroying connections that must not be half-torn) -- matching
		-- Daily's flat-on-cream card language.
		local cardGrad = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if cardGrad then
			cardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		local cardStroke = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if cardStroke then
			cardStroke.Color = CARD_BORDER
			cardStroke.Thickness = 3
		end

		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.Parent = card

		local icon = buildIconSlot(card, vm.Icon, vm.Emoji)
		icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)

		local reward, chipW = buildRewardChip(card, vm.RewardIconKey, vm.RewardText, vm.ChipW)
		reward.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		reward.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(ACTION_W + ROW_GAP_INNER), 0.5, 0)

		local action, bobFrame = buildActionButton(card, vm.Action, vm.OnClaim, vm.OnClaim)
		action.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		action.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		-- Only now that AnchorPoint/Position are final -- see buildActionButton.
		if bobFrame then
			registerBob(bobFrame)
		end

		local centerX = ICON_W + ROW_GAP_INNER
		local centerW = ROW_CONTENT_W - ICON_W - ROW_GAP_INNER - chipW - ROW_GAP_INNER - ACTION_W - ROW_GAP_INNER
		local centerCol = Instance.new("Frame")
		centerCol.Name = "CenterColumn"
		centerCol.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		centerCol.Position = UDim2.new(0, centerX, 0.5, 0)
		centerCol.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(centerW, 40), 52) -- title 24 + 4 gap + track 24, so the pair sits dead centre in the row
		centerCol.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		centerCol.ZIndex = 15
		centerCol.Parent = card

		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): the title reads against the white card
		-- now -- body ink, not white (its ink contextual text stroke stays,
		-- same as Daily's tinted card labels). The meta label further down
		-- stays WHITE: it sits on the dark/green progress track, a colored
		-- sub-surface, exactly like the reward chip's white value text.
		local title = UI.label(centerCol, vm.Title, "cardLabel", BODY_INK)
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		title.ZIndex = 16

		local track, fill = UI.track(centerCol, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), "green", T.radius.pill)
		track.Name = "ProgressTrack"
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28)
		track.ZIndex = 16
		local pct = vm.Target > 0 and (vm.Progress / vm.Target) or 0
		UI.setFill(fill, pct, false)

		local metaText = vm.MetaOverride or string.format("%d / %d", vm.Progress, vm.Target)
		local meta = UI.label(track, metaText, "meta", T.color.white)
		meta.Name = "MetaLabel"
		meta.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		meta.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		meta.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		meta.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		meta.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		meta.ZIndex = track.ZIndex + 3
	end

	local function clearRows()
		for _, c in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Frame") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		-- Every registered bob belonged to a row that just went away. The
		-- driver prunes destroyed frames on its own next tick, but clearing
		-- here means a re-render never carries a frame's worth of dead entries
		-- and a tab switch off Goals lets the driver stop immediately.
		table.clear(bobActive)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- per-tab renderers
	local function renderDaily()
		clearRows()
		-- One chip width for the whole tab: the widest reward it has to show.
		local chipW = 0
		for _, q in ipairs(dailyQuests) do
			chipW = math.max(chipW, measureChipWidth("+" .. tostring(q.Reward or 0)))
		end
		for i, q in ipairs(dailyQuests) do
			buildQuestRow(i, {
				ChipW = chipW,
				Icon = T.icons.goals,
				Title = q.Text or "",
				Progress = q.Progress or 0,
				Target = q.Target or 1,
				RewardIconKey = "darrel", -- daily egg-quests pay darrels, not a generic gem
				RewardText = "+" .. tostring(q.Reward or 0),
				Action = q.Claimed and "claimed" or "inprogress",
			})
		end
	end

	local function renderGoals()
		clearRows()
		local chipW = 0
		for _, q in ipairs(goalsQuests) do
			chipW = math.max(chipW, measureChipWidth(shortCash(q.Reward or 0)))
		end
		for i, q in ipairs(goalsQuests) do
			local met = q.Met == true
			local claimed = q.Claimed == true
			buildQuestRow(i, {
				ChipW = chipW,
				Icon = T.icons.goals,
				Title = q.Desc or "",
				Progress = met and 1 or 0,
				Target = 1,
				MetaOverride = claimed and "CLAIMED" or (met and "COMPLETE" or "LOCKED"),
				RewardIconKey = "coin",
				RewardText = shortCash(q.Reward or 0),
				Action = claimed and "claimed" or (met and "claim" or "inprogress"),
				OnClaim = (met and not claimed) and function()
					ctx.remotes.QuestClaim:FireServer(q.Id)
				end or nil,
			})
		end
	end

	local function renderSeason()
		clearRows()
		local chipW = 0
		for _, qid in ipairs(seasonIds) do
			local d = SeasonConfig.PoolById[qid]
			if d then
				chipW = math.max(chipW, measureChipWidth("+" .. tostring(d.XP) .. " XP"))
			end
		end
		local order = 0
		for _, qid in ipairs(seasonIds) do
			local def = SeasonConfig.PoolById[qid]
			if def then
				order += 1
				local pr = seasonProgress[qid] or { P = 0, D = false }
				buildQuestRow(order, {
					ChipW = chipW,
					Emoji = def.Icon,
					Title = def.Name,
					Progress = pr.P or 0,
					Target = def.Target,
					MetaOverride = pr.D and "DONE" or nil,
					RewardIconKey = "pass",
					RewardText = "+" .. tostring(def.XP) .. " XP",
					Action = "view",
					OnClaim = function()
						ctx.openPanel("pass")
					end,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	local RENDERERS = { Daily = renderDaily, Goals = renderGoals, Season = renderSeason }

	local function updateTabVisuals()
		for id, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
			tabRings[id].Visible = (id == activeTab)
			btn.ZIndex = (id == activeTab) and 15 or 14
		end
	end

	local function switchTab(id: string)
		if not RENDERERS[id] then
			return
		end
		activeTab = id
		ctx.state.goals.tab = id
		updateTabVisuals()
		RENDERERS[id]() -- instant content swap (kit README §4)
	end

	for id, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			switchTab(id)
		end)
	end
	updateTabVisuals()

	----------------------------------------------------------- refresh countdown (1s loop, STRICTLY gated on wrapper.Visible)
	local countdownRunning = false
	local function tickCountdown()
		refreshValue.Text = formatHMS(nextMidnightRemaining(os.time()))
	end
	local function startCountdown()
		if countdownRunning then
			return
		end
		countdownRunning = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while countdownRunning and wrapper.Visible do
				tickCountdown()
				task.wait(1)
			end
			countdownRunning = false
		end)
	end
	local function stopCountdown()
		countdownRunning = false -- loop above checks this + wrapper.Visible every iteration and exits on its own
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- backdrop blur (1d/1e sweep 2026-08-04: dim + blur behind the panel)
	-- Copied from DailyPanel: the shell owns the dim scrim; the blur is
	-- per-panel and UNIQUELY NAMED -- Pass's Quests button opens THIS panel
	-- over Pass's close, so a shared BlurEffect name would let one panel's
	-- teardown destroy the other's live blur (setBlur finds by name). Size is
	-- SET, never tweened -- BlurEffect.Size is not on the proven tween
	-- whitelist in this place.
	local BLUR_NAME = "GoalsPanelBlur"
	local function setBlur(on: boolean)
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BLUR_NAME)
		if on and not existing then
			local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
			blur.Name = BLUR_NAME
			blur.Size = 8
			blur.Parent = Lighting
		elseif not on and existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- data wiring (server-confirmed only)
	local function applyDaily(daily)
		if typeof(daily) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		dailyQuests = daily.Quests or {}
		if activeTab == "Daily" then
			renderDaily()
		end
	end

	ctx.remotes.DarrelUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if typeof(payload) == "table" then
			applyDaily(payload.Daily)
		end
	end)

	-- Pull once per open, same load-discriminator pattern GameHUDClient's own
	-- startup loop uses (task-4-report.md): DarrelState:InvokeServer() before
	-- the player's profile has loaded returns a real table whose `Daily`
	-- field is nil (a placeholder, not real data) -- keep retrying until
	-- `Daily` comes back as a table instead of trusting the first response.
	local function pullDarrelDaily()
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 20 do
				if not wrapper.Visible then
					return
				end
				local ok, res = pcall(function()
					return ctx.remotes.DarrelState:InvokeServer()
				end)
				if ok and typeof(res) == "table" and typeof(res.Daily) == "table" then
					applyDaily(res.Daily)
					return
				end
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
	end

	ctx.remotes.QuestState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(quests)
		if typeof(quests) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		goalsQuests = quests
		if activeTab == "Goals" then
			renderGoals()
		end
	end)

	-- Server-confirmed only: `seasonIds`/`seasonProgress` are only ever
	-- replaced wholesale from a SeasonState push, mirroring PassPanel's own
	-- state-writing discipline for the same remote.
	ctx.remotes.SeasonState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
		if typeof(s) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		seasonIds = s.QuestIds or {}
		seasonProgress = s.Progress or {}
		if activeTab == "Season" then
			renderSeason()
		end
	end)

	----------------------------------------------------------- wiring
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)

	-- Fires every time the panel becomes visible: refreshes Season (mirrors
	-- SeasonClient/PassPanel's own open-time refresh), pulls a fresh Daily
	-- snapshot, starts the bob driver + countdown, and (1d/1e sweep
	-- 2026-08-04) raises/kills the backdrop blur. QuestState has no
	-- client-fire request path (QuestHandler only pushes on join + its own
	-- 3s poll) so Goals milestones rely on that passive push alone.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			ctx.remotes.SeasonState:FireServer()
			pullDarrelDaily()
			ensureBobDriver()
			startCountdown()
			setBlur(true)
		else
			stopBobDriver()
			stopCountdown()
			setBlur(false)
		end
	end)

	-- Belt-and-braces blur teardown (1d/1e sweep 2026-08-04; same review
	-- catch DailyPanel carries): any path that hides the HOST while this
	-- wrapper stays Visible (legacy single-open force-closes, future shell
	-- changes) must still kill the BlurEffect -- it post-processes the WHOLE
	-- screen regardless of GUI visibility. Blur only: the bob/countdown
	-- loops predate this watcher and keep their own wrapper.Visible gating.
	ctx.host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not ctx.host.Visible then
			setBlur(false)
		elseif wrapper.Visible then
			setBlur(true)
		end
	end)

	switchTab(activeTab) -- initial paint (zero/stale state) before the first server response lands

	return wrapper
end

return GoalsPanel

----------------------------------------------------------- availability (IndexClient lines 64-83, verbatim)
local AV_LIVE, AV_SOON, AV_VAULTED = 1, 2, 3

local function availabilityOf(name: string): (number, string?, number?)
	if Waves.QUEST_ONLY and Waves.QUEST_ONLY[name] then
		return AV_VAULTED, "quest", nil
	end
	if Waves.VAULTED and Waves.VAULTED[name] then
		return AV_VAULTED, "vaulted", nil
	end
	if Waves.FORCE_ON and Waves.FORCE_ON[name] then
		return AV_LIVE, (SupplySchedule.CAPPED[name] and "capped" or "live"), nil
	end
	local status, ts = SupplySchedule.StatusOf(name)
	if status == "vaulted" then
		return AV_VAULTED, status, ts
	end
	if status == "away" or status == "unreleased" then
		return AV_SOON, status, ts
	end
	return AV_LIVE, status or "live", ts
end

----------------------------------------------------------- deltaText (IndexClient lines 88-96, verbatim)
local function deltaText(ts: number): string
	local left = math.max(0, math.floor(ts - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
	local d = math.floor(left / 86400)
	local h = math.floor(left % 86400 / 3600)
	if d > 0 then
		return d .. "d " .. h .. "h"
	end
	local m = math.floor(left % 3600 / 60)
	if h > 0 then
		return h .. "h " .. m .. "m"
	end
	return m .. "m"
end

----------------------------------------------------------- roster flatten (IndexClient lines 57-129, ported as a pure fn)
-- Pure: takes BOTH arrays explicitly instead of closing over the module's
-- own requires, so a probe can hand it a small fabricated config + rarity
-- list and check `#result == #fabConfig` without touching the real
-- 213-entry roster (probed: "tile count == config count on fabricated
-- data"). This IS the function that produces the real `ordered` list below
-- -- not a parallel duplicate of its logic.
local function flattenRoster(config: { any }, rarityConfig: { any }): { any }
	local out = {}
	local byRarity = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(config) do
		byRarity[e.Rarity] = byRarity[e.Rarity] or {}
		table.insert(byRarity[e.Rarity], e)
	end
	for _, tier in ipairs(rarityConfig) do
		local entries = byRarity[tier.Name]
		if entries then
			for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
				out[#out + 1] = { E = e, Tier = tier }
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local ordered = flattenRoster(BrainrotConfig, RarityConfig)
local TOTAL_COUNT = #ordered

local tierRank = {}
for i, t in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
	tierRank[t.Name] = i
end

----------------------------------------------------------- catchable-only availability (IndexClient lines 131-152, verbatim)
local orderedLive = {}
local LIVE_COUNT = 0
local lastPeriodKey = nil
local function refreshAvailability()
	local key = SupplySchedule.PeriodKey() .. "#" .. Waves.OverrideKey()
	if key == lastPeriodKey then
		return
	end
	lastPeriodKey = key
	table.clear(orderedLive)
	for _, rec in ipairs(ordered) do
		if availabilityOf(rec.E.Name) == AV_LIVE then
			orderedLive[#orderedLive + 1] = rec
		end
	end
	LIVE_COUNT = Waves.Counts()
end
refreshAvailability()

----------------------------------------------------------- ribbon priority (task-9-brief spec extension)
-- Pure. vm: { Known: boolean, JustSeen: boolean, AvStatus: string?,
-- AvTs: number?, IsEggSourced: boolean }. Returns (text, kind) or (nil, nil)
-- when no ribbon applies. `kind` selects the visual treatment the tile
-- builder uses: "new" goes through UI.ribbon's kit-native NEW=red variant;
-- the other three have no kit-defined ribbon colour (kit's own §3.5 ribbon
-- vocabulary is "NEW" only) so the tile builder hand-builds them from the
-- nearest token family per task-9-brief's colours (gold/muted/gold).
--
-- Priority, exactly per task-9-brief: NEW > LAST CHANCE > BACK IN >
-- FOREST EGG. The AvTs-and-not-IsEggSourced guard and the "retiring"/"away"
-- text are IndexClient lines 772-778, verbatim; the isEggSourced short
-- circuit is IndexClient line 686+772's "and not isEggSourced" carried
-- through so egg-sourced creatures never read a tide status at all, exactly
-- as before.
local function ribbonFor(vm): (string?, string?)
	if vm.Known and not vm.JustSeen then
		return "NEW", "new"
	end
	if vm.AvTs and not vm.IsEggSourced then
		if vm.AvStatus == "retiring" then
			return "LAST CHANCE " .. deltaText(vm.AvTs), "lastchance"
		elseif vm.AvStatus == "away" then
			return "BACK IN " .. deltaText(vm.AvTs), "backin"
		end
	end
	if vm.IsEggSourced then
		return "FOREST EGG", "forestegg"
	end
	return nil, nil
end

----------------------------------------------------------- discovery data (require-time wiring, correctly outside Build)
-- `discovered` is the ONLY piece of server-confirmed state this module needs
-- before the panel has ever been opened (for the NEW-ribbon seen/seed logic
-- to have real data to seed from -- see Build below), so it alone is wired
-- at true module top-level / require time, matching GameHUDPanels' own
-- documented contract ("required at startup"). `onDiscoveredChanged` is
-- forward-declared and assigned inside Build once ctx/wrapper exist -- same
-- forward-declare-then-assign idiom GameHUDClient itself uses for
-- openPanel/closePanel (see GameHUDClient.lua "assigned below, exposed via
-- ctx"). This is deliberately NOT the same shape as BackpackPanel's own
-- "module-top-level capture race fix" comment, which describes this exact
-- pattern but (checked against the live script) actually wires its listener
-- INSIDE Build -- i.e. it only takes effect after first open regardless, the
-- same as if it had never tried. That mismatch is out of scope to fix here
-- (BackpackPanel is a different task's file); this module just implements
-- the intent correctly.
local discovered = {}
local onDiscoveredChanged: (() -> ())? = nil

local function applyDiscovered(snap)
	if typeof(snap) ~= "table" or typeof(snap.Discovered) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	discovered = snap.Discovered -- wholesale replace ONLY -- see probe "zero local mutation of discovery data"
	if onDiscoveredChanged then
		onDiscoveredChanged()
	end
end

remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(applyDiscovered)
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function()
		return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if ok then
		applyDiscovered(snap)
	end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------- Build
function IndexPanel.Build(ctx)
	local T = ctx.Tokens
	local UI = ctx.Builders

	-- STYLE REPLACEMENT REPAIR (2026-08-04): see the note in PassPanel -- the
	-- cream constants were deleted but several call sites survived, turning
	-- into nil globals that crashed Build behind openPanel's pcall (the panel
	-- just never opened). Re-declared as their guide successors:
	--   borders -> the guide's 4px #202020 outline. NOTE the tile-stroke site
	--     lerps tier.Color TOWARD this, so unknown tiles now mute toward the
	--     dark outline instead of toward tan -- which is what the guide's dark
	--     chrome wants anyway.
	--   ink     -> white, because these chips/tiles are dark slots now
	local CARD_BORDER = T.color.outline
	local CREAM_INK = T.color.white

	----------------------------------------------------------- geometry (kit README §3.5, exact where tokenised)
	local PANEL_W = T.size.panelWidth.index -- 940
	local HEADER_H = T.size.headerHeight -- 92
	local BODY_TOP = HEADER_H + 12
	local BODY_INNER_W = PANEL_W - T.pad.panel * 2 -- 908

	local DISC_H = 48 -- kit "Discovery bar height 48"

	----------------------------------------------------------- custom ribbon builder (kit only defines NEW=red; the other 3 kinds are task-9-brief spec extensions)
	local RIBBON_GRADIENT = {
		lastchance = "goldSmall",
		backin = "tab", -- "muted" per task-9-brief -- T.gradient.tab is the tabTop/tabBottom family, the nearest muted token
		forestegg = "goldSmall",

	local function buildCustomRibbon(parent: Frame, text: string, kind: string): Frame
		local r = Instance.new("Frame")
		r.Name = "Ribbon"
		r.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24)
		r.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
		r.BorderSizePixel = 0
		r.Parent = parent
		UI.corner(r, T.radius.chip)
		UI.gradient(r, T.gradient[RIBBON_GRADIENT[kind] or "tab"])
		UI.stroke(r, T.stroke.chip)

		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
		pad.Parent = r

		local l = UI.label(r, text, "chip", T.color.white)
		l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		return r
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- MINTED chip (capped names, server snapshot only, bottom-right per task-9-brief)
	local function buildMintChip(tile: Frame, minted: number, cap: number)
		local chip = Instance.new("Frame")
		chip.Name = "MintChip"
		chip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		chip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
		chip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
		chip.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.outline
		chip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chip.ZIndex = tile.ZIndex + 4
		chip.Parent = tile
		UI.corner(chip, 6)
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
		pad.Parent = chip

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Name = "Value"
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.FontFace = T.font.ui
		lbl.TextSize = 11
		lbl.TextColor3 = T.color.textAccent
		lbl.Text = string.format("%d/%d MINTED", minted, cap)
		lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
		lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		lbl.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 1
		lbl.Parent = chip
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- tile grid (virtualised viewports, IndexClient lines 494-648 simplified for a fixed 6-col layout)
	local VIS_MARGIN = 0.6
	local tiles: { any } = {} -- [i] = { holder: Frame?, name: string, live: boolean }

	local function fillTile(t)
		if t.live or not t.holder then
			return
		end
		local opts = {
			size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
			zIndex = t.holder.ZIndex + 1,
		}
		-- undiscovered tiles render the same master model, blacked out (see the
		-- SILHOUETTE_INK note): the virtualiser treats both states identically,
		-- so scrolling costs the same either way
		if t.silhouette then
			opts.silhouette = SILHOUETTE_INK
		end
		local vp = BrainrotThumb.add(t.holder, t.name, opts)
		if vp then
			if t.silhouette then
				vp.Ambient = NO_LIGHT
				vp.LightColor = NO_LIGHT
			end
			t.live = true
		end
	end

	local function clearTile(t)
		if not t.live then
			return
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(t.holder:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		t.live = false
	end

	local function updateVisible()
		if #tiles == 0 then
			return
		end
		local viewH = grid.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if viewH <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local top = grid.CanvasPosition.Y - viewH * VIS_MARGIN
		local bottom = grid.CanvasPosition.Y + viewH * (1 + VIS_MARGIN)
		for i, t in ipairs(tiles) do
			local row = math.floor((i - 1) / GRID_COLS)
			local y0 = row * ROW_H
			if y0 + CELL_H >= top and y0 <= bottom then
				fillTile(t)
			else
				clearTile(t)
			end
		end
	end
	grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(updateVisible)

	local function buildTile(parent: Instance, order: number, rec)
		local e, tier = rec.E, rec.Tier
		local known = discovered[e.Name] == true

		local tile = UI.surface(parent, UDim2.fromOffset(SLOT_W, CELL_H), "subPanel", T.radius.inner, T.stroke.control)
		tile.Name = "Tile" .. order
		tile.LayoutOrder = order
		tile.ClipsDescendants = true
		tile.ZIndex = 15
		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): tiles are white cards with the soft tan
		-- border on the cream body -- recolor the surface's OWN gradient and
		-- stroke in place (never a second UI.stroke; the surface's children
		-- are exactly one UICorner/UIGradient/UIStroke so FindFirstChildOfClass
		-- is unambiguous). The old per-tile hardShadow is DROPPED, not just
		-- restyled: Daily's cream cards are shadowless, and tiles rebuild
		-- wholesale every render() -- the shadow churned up to ~42 extra
		-- Frames plus three property connections each per paint.
		local tileGrad = tile:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if tileGrad then
			tileGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		-- SILHOUETTE INDEX: the border carries the RARITY colour (reference
		-- video) rather than the flat tan -- it is what makes a wall of unknown
		-- black shapes still readable as a rarity ladder at a glance. Unknown
		-- entries wear it muted so the discovered ones still pop.
		local tileStroke = tile:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if tileStroke then
			tileStroke.Color = known and tier.Color or tier.Color:Lerp(CARD_BORDER, 0.55)
			tileStroke.Thickness = 3
		end

		local reg = { holder = nil, name = e.Name, live = false, silhouette = not known }

		do
			local artHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
			artHolder.Name = "Art"
			artHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TILE_PAD, TILE_PAD)
			artHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -TILE_PAD * 2, 0, CELL_H - NAME_H - TILE_PAD * 2)
			artHolder.BackgroundColor3 = tier.Color -- tier-tinted backdrop doubles as the fallback swatch when no model/off-screen (IndexClient's own "wash" convention)
			-- Discovered keeps the readable tier wash; an unknown entry's wash is
			-- pushed almost to white so the BLACK silhouette on top has maximum
			-- contrast (the reference video silhouettes sit on a dark tile and
			-- rely on near-black-on-dark; on our cream cards the same shape reads
			-- far better as ink-on-paper, which is the pokedex language anyway)
			artHolder.BackgroundTransparency = known and 0.4 or 0.86
			artHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
			artHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
			artHolder.ZIndex = tile.ZIndex + 1
			artHolder.Parent = tile
			UI.corner(artHolder, T.radius.art)

			-- Known -> the creature's NAME. Unknown -> its RARITY word in the
			-- rarity colour (reference video): the one fact the index is willing
			-- to give away about something you have never caught, and what makes
			-- an unknown tile still worth reading.
			-- NoPolish is REQUIRED here, not decoration: the game-wide UIPolish
			-- sweep forces every unopted TextLabel to pure white, and its own
			-- header names "rarity tiers and similar colour-coded text" as the
			-- intended users of this escape hatch. Without it the rarity word
			-- rendered white (verified live) and the 1d/1e sweep's dark tile-name
			-- ink was being silently overridden too. Colours are therefore stated
			-- explicitly for both states rather than assumed:
			--   known   -> WHITE + ink stroke, which is also what the reference
			--              video does, and what reads on the tier wash
			--   unknown -> the RARITY colour, the whole point of the label
			local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			nameLbl.Name = known and "Name" or "RarityWord"
			nameLbl:SetAttribute("NoPolish", true)
			nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			nameLbl.FontFace = T.font.display
			nameLbl.TextSize = 14 -- kit "name 14"
			nameLbl.TextColor3 = known and T.color.white or tier.Color
			nameLbl.Text = known and e.Name or string.upper(tier.Name)
			nameLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, TILE_PAD, 1, -TILE_PAD - NAME_H)
			nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -TILE_PAD * 2, 0, NAME_H)
			nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			nameLbl.ZIndex = tile.ZIndex + 2
			nameLbl.Parent = tile
			local nameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			nameStroke.Thickness = 2.5
			nameStroke.Color = T.color.outline
			nameStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
			nameStroke.Parent = nameLbl

			reg.holder = artHolder
		end
		-- RETIRED 2026-08-04 (user reference video): the kit's flat "?" cover
		-- (a rgba(8,12,5,.72) overlay + a 40px "?") lived here. Undiscovered
		-- entries now render the REAL model as a black silhouette instead --
		-- the treatment the legacy IndexClient always used and the kit-faithful
		-- rebuild had deliberately dropped. Both states now share ONE art path
		-- (the `do` block above), which is why the branch is gone rather than
		-- rewritten: the only differences are the wash, the label and the
		-- silhouette flag.

		-- ribbon slot: NEW > LAST CHANCE > BACK IN > FOREST EGG (see ribbonFor)
		local _, avStatus, avTs = availabilityOf(e.Name)
		local isEggSourced = e.Source == "ForestEgg"
		local justSeen = seen[e.Name] == true
		local rtext, rkind = ribbonFor({
			Known = known,
			JustSeen = justSeen,
			AvStatus = avStatus,
			AvTs = avTs,
			IsEggSourced = isEggSourced,
		})
		if rtext and rkind then
			local rb
			if rkind == "new" then
				rb = UI.ribbon(tile, rtext, "NEW")
			else
				rb = buildCustomRibbon(tile, rtext, rkind)
			end
			rb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			rb.Position = UDim2.new(0, -6, 0, -8) -- kit §3.5 "top -8 / left -6"
			rb.ZIndex = tile.ZIndex + 5
		end

		-- MINTED chip, independent of the ribbon slot (server snapshot only)
		local snapRow = supplySnap and supplySnap[e.Name]
		if snapRow and type(snapRow.minted) == "number" and type(snapRow.cap) == "number" then
			buildMintChip(tile, snapRow.minted, snapRow.cap)
		end

		tiles[order] = reg
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- filter -> source list
	local function sourceFor(filter: string)
		if filter == "Catchable" then
			refreshAvailability()
			return orderedLive
		end
		if filter == "CR" or filter == "EL" or filter == "Mplus" then
			local out = {}
			for _, rec in ipairs(ordered) do
				local rank = tierRank[rec.Tier.Name] or 0
				local pass = (filter == "CR" and rank >= 1 and rank <= 3)
					or (filter == "EL" and rank >= 4 and rank <= 5)
					or (filter == "Mplus" and rank >= 6)
				if pass then
					out[#out + 1] = rec
				end
			end
			return out
		end
		return ordered -- "All"
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- seen/NEW bookkeeping (task-9-brief spec extension, see module header note)
	local function ensureSeenSeeded()
		if ctx.state.index.seenSeeded then
			return
		end
		ctx.state.index.seenSeeded = true
		for name, v in pairs(discovered) do
			if v then
				seen[name] = true
			end
		end
	end

	local function markAllSeen()
		for name, v in pairs(discovered) do
			if v then
				seen[name] = true
			end
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- render
	local function render()
		ensureSeenSeeded()
		refreshAvailability()

		for _, c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
		tiles = {}

		local found = 0
		for _, rec in ipairs(ordered) do
			if discovered[rec.E.Name] then
				found += 1
			end
		end
		discLabel.Text = string.format("%d / %d discovered", found, TOTAL_COUNT)
		UI.setFill(discFill, TOTAL_COUNT > 0 and found / TOTAL_COUNT or 0, false)

		tideValue.Text = deltaText(SupplySchedule.NextChange())

		updateFilterVisuals()

		local source = sourceFor(activeFilter)
		for i, rec in ipairs(source) do
			buildTile(grid, i, rec)
		end

		grid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) -- CanvasPosition reset gotcha (also done on open below)
		task.defer(updateVisible)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- filter chip wiring
	for i, def in ipairs(FILTER_DEFS) do
		local chip = UI.surface(filterRow, UDim2.fromOffset(FILTER_W, FILTER_H), "tab", T.radius.small, T.stroke.control)
		chip.Name = "Filter" .. def.id
		chip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * (FILTER_W + FILTER_GAP), 0)
		chip.ZIndex = 14
		chip.Parent = filterRow
		-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): the olive "tab" chips flip to white cards
		-- on the cream body -- same in-place gradient/stroke recolor as the
		-- grid tiles, and the hardShadow is dropped to match Daily's
		-- flat-on-cream card language. The gold ActiveRing below is untouched
		-- (a colored accent -- and it pops harder against white).
		local chipGrad = chip:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		if chipGrad then
			chipGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		local chipStroke = chip:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if chipStroke then
			chipStroke.Color = CARD_BORDER
			chipStroke.Thickness = 3
		end

		-- kit "label 18" -- no exact token, documented gap (matches BackpackPanel precedent)
		-- 1d/1e sweep: label sits on a white chip now -> brown body ink (the
		-- cardLabel style's contextual ink text-stroke stays, Daily precedent)
		local label = UI.label(chip, def.label, "cardLabel", CREAM_INK)
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 1

		-- kit §3.5 "active = #FFD84D ring inset -4"
		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "ActiveRing"
		ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8)
		ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, -4)
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.Visible = false
		ring.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 2
		ring.Parent = chip
		UI.corner(ring, T.radius.small + 3)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Thickness = 4
		ringStroke.Color = T.color.activeRing
		ringStroke.Parent = ring

		local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
		hit.Name = "Hit"
		hit.Text = ""
		hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hit.ZIndex = chip.ZIndex + 3
		hit.Parent = chip
		hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			activeFilter = def.id
			ctx.state.index.filter = def.id
			render()
		end)

		filterFrames[def.id] = chip
		filterRings[def.id] = ring
	end
	updateFilterVisuals()

	----------------------------------------------------------- supply snapshot (IndexClient lines 98-111, verbatim throttle)
	local function refreshSupplySnap()
		if os.clock() - supplySnapAt < 60 then
			return
		end
		supplySnapAt = os.clock()
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, snap = pcall(function()
				return remotes.GetSupplySnapshot:InvokeServer()
			end)
			if ok and type(snap) == "table" then
				supplySnap = snap
				if wrapper.Visible then
					render() -- MINTED badges pick up the first-arrival answer without waiting for the next open
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- backdrop blur (1d/1e sweep 2026-08-04: dim + blur behind the panel)
	-- The shell owns the dim scrim; the blur is per-panel, created/destroyed
	-- on Visible. The name is UNIQUE per panel (panels can transition into
	-- each other, and setBlur finds by name -- a shared name would let one
	-- panel's close destroy another's live blur). Size is SET, not tweened --
	-- BlurEffect.Size is not on the proven tween whitelist here (DailyPanel's
	-- own note; TweenService is GuiObject-only in this place).
	local BLUR_NAME = "IndexPanelBlur"
	local function setBlur(on: boolean)
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BLUR_NAME)
		if on and not existing then
			local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
			blur.Name = BLUR_NAME
			blur.Size = 8
			blur.Parent = Lighting
		elseif not on and existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- wiring
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)

	onDiscoveredChanged = function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			render()
		end
	end

	-- 1d/1e sweep (2026-08-04): setBlur wired ADDITIVELY into the existing
	-- watcher -- the open-time refresh trio (refreshSupplySnap/render/
	-- CanvasPosition reset) and the close-time markAllSeen() are the panel's
	-- data contract (the NEW-ribbon lifecycle depends on markAllSeen firing
	-- on close) and survive untouched.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			refreshSupplySnap()
			render()
			grid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) -- CanvasPosition reset gotcha
			setBlur(true)
		else
			setBlur(false)
			markAllSeen()
		end
	end)

	-- Belt-and-braces blur teardown (ported from DailyPanel's review catch):
	-- any path that hides the HOST while this wrapper stays Visible (legacy
	-- single-open force-closes, future shell changes) must still kill the
	-- global BlurEffect -- it post-processes the whole screen regardless of
	-- GUI visibility.
	ctx.host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not ctx.host.Visible then
			setBlur(false)
		elseif wrapper.Visible then
			setBlur(true)
		end
	end)

	render() -- initial paint (zero/stale state) before the first server response lands

	return wrapper
end

----------------------------------------------------------- test hooks (probes)
-- Private, non-contractual exports -- same convention BackpackPanel's
-- _groupBrainrots / GoalsPanel's nextMidnightRemaining document: lets a probe
-- call the exact functions this module renders from, on fabricated inputs,
-- without needing a live player/character/UI context.
IndexPanel._ribbonFor = ribbonFor
IndexPanel._flattenRoster = flattenRoster
IndexPanel._deltaText = deltaText
IndexPanel._availabilityOf = availabilityOf

return IndexPanel

--!strict
-- PassPanel: the SEASON PASS panel -- a GameHUDPanels consumer module
-- (StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.GameHUDPanels.PassPanel).
--
-- REFORMAT 2026-08-07 (design: docs/design-handoff/season-pass/). This was a
-- HORIZONTAL filmstrip: three stacked rows -- free cards / tier badges / gold pass
-- cards -- scrolling sideways, plus a "Max Rewards" column floating outside the
-- body. It is now the design's LADDER: three columns, FREE TRACK | TIER | PREMIUM
-- TRACK, scrolling VERTICALLY through all 50 tiers, so a player reads one tier
-- ACROSS (what do I get here, free vs premium) instead of one track ALONG.
--
-- Two real bugs died with the old layout:
--
--   * THE PANEL IS FINALLY 960 WIDE. T.size.panelWidth.pass has always said 960,
--     but the old build was 960 + 14 gap + 196 side column = 1170 and hung 90px off
--     a 4:3 tablet. The side column is gone -- the MILESTONE row shows the top
--     reward of BOTH tracks, which is the only thing those two preview cards were
--     for -- so the token is true for the first time and GameHUDClient's panelFitW
--     floor (960, see GameHUDClient:165-180) fits it exactly, with zero effect on
--     any other panel's scale.
--
--   * FREE REWARD TEXT WAS INVISIBLE. The old card flipped its own gradient to flat
--     white, then coloured its text with CARD_TEXT -- an undefined global left
--     behind by the 2026-08-04 style repair, which re-declared CARD_BORDER and
--     BODY_INK but missed that one. UI.label falls back to T.color.white when its
--     colour argument is nil, so every free reward name was white on white. That
--     whole code path is deleted; state now picks the surface kind UP FRONT rather
--     than recolouring a built card's gradient afterwards.
--
-- Contract (kit README section: ctx from GameHUDClient):
--   return { Id = "pass", Build = function(ctx) -> Frame }
-- Build is called ONCE lazily on first open; the shell parents the returned Frame
-- into ctx.host and owns Visible toggling on every open/close after that -- this
-- module never sets its own Parent and never drives its own open/close animation.
--
-- Data contract (read StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.SeasonClient +
-- ServerScriptService.Modules.SeasonPassHandler FULLY before writing this):
--   remotes.SeasonState  -- RemoteEvent, bidirectional
--     client -> server: SeasonState:FireServer()  (no args; requests a refresh)
--     server -> client: SeasonState:FireClient(player, {
--         XP = number,             -- cumulative season XP
--         Claimed = { [tostring(tier)] = true, ... },
--         QuestIds = { string, ... },   -- not consumed by this panel (Goals' job)
--         Progress = { [id] = { P = number, D = boolean }, ... }, -- ditto
--         Day = number,
--     })
--   remotes.SeasonClaim  -- RemoteEvent
--     client -> server: SeasonClaim:FireServer(tier, track)
--     Server validates level/ownership and, on success, re-sends SeasonState with
--     the new Claimed table. NEVER flip Claimed locally -- only the next
--     SeasonState push may change what a card renders as.
--
-- BOTH TRACKS ARE REAL DATA NOW. The header this replaces said SeasonConfig was
-- "free track only for now" and shipped "one Cash reward per tier (no separate
-- free/pass reward items)". Both went stale on 2026-08-07 when the track was
-- extended to 50 tiers: SeasonConfig.Tiers and .PassTiers are 50 entries each,
-- TierFor(track, i) reads either without the caller branching, and
-- DescribeReward(def) is the ONE place that turns a tier into something
-- displayable. Every reward string on this panel comes from it.
--
-- WHAT IS DELIBERATELY INERT, and why. All three follow the precedent set by the
-- egg shop's BUY DARRELS and the Charm Codex's EQUIP: draw the control in full,
-- wire nothing, let it come alive on its own when the missing id appears.
--   * UNLOCK PREMIUM -- GamepassConfig's SeasonPass entry is still GamepassId = 0,
--     so GamepassService.Owns is false for everyone and SeasonPassHandler refuses
--     track == "pass" server-side anyway. The premium column therefore renders
--     LOCKED for every player and unlocks by itself the moment a real id is pasted
--     in. The price on the button is READ FROM GamepassConfig, not hardcoded, so
--     the button cannot drift from what the pass actually costs. (The design says
--     799 R$; the catalog says 399. The catalog wins -- it is the thing players
--     are actually charged.)
--   * SKIP TIER -- no tier-skip dev product exists anywhere in this game, so its
--     price is the design's 79 R$ with nothing behind it.
--   * The countdown chip and the footer end-date -- SeasonConfig.SEASON.Ends is
--     nil. They are OMITTED rather than faked; see the note in SeasonConfig.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting") -- the backdrop BlurEffect lives here
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local SeasonConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("SeasonConfig"))
-- Egg tiers show the REAL egg model in a ViewportFrame rather than a flat icon.
-- Same helper the Index and Backpack grids use for brainrots/pets.
local BrainrotThumb = require(modules:WaitForChild("BrainrotThumb"))
-- Darrel tiers draw the DARREL icon, which is a vector drawing rather than an
-- image id. pcall'd like ClientMain does: a missing icon module must cost the
-- icon, not the whole panel.
local okIconArt, IconArt = pcall(function()
	return require(modules:WaitForChild("UIKit"):WaitForChild("IconArt"))
end)
if not okIconArt then IconArt = nil end
-- Same treatment: the premium button's price comes from the live catalog, but a
-- missing catalog must not take the panel down with it.
local okPasses, GamepassConfig = pcall(function()
	return require(modules:WaitForChild("GamepassConfig"))
end)
if not okPasses then GamepassConfig = nil end

-- Id is "passInner", NOT "pass": since 2026-08-07 the season pass is a TAB inside
-- ProgressPanel rather than its own rail tile. See the matching note in GoalsPanel.
local PassPanel = { Id = "passInner" }

local function shortCash(n: number): string
	n = math.floor(n or 0)
	if n >= 1e9 then
		return string.format("$%.1fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif n >= 1e6 then
		return string.format("$%.1fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif n >= 1e3 then
		return string.format("$%.0fK", n / 1e3)
	end
	return "$" .. tostring(n)
end

-- 1240 -> "1,240". The progress readout is the one place the design shows a raw
-- XP number rather than shortCash's compact form.
local function comma(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n or 0))
	local out = (s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,")):reverse()
	if out:sub(1, 1) == "," then
		out = out:sub(2)
	end
	return out
end

-- The design's subtitle under each reward name. Derived from the reward KIND, so
-- it cannot drift from what the tier actually hands over.
local function subtitleFor(rw, seasonNumber: number): string
	if rw.kind == "Cash" then
		return "INSTANT PAYOUT"
	elseif rw.kind == "Darrels" then
		return "PREMIUM CURRENCY"
	elseif rw.kind == "Egg" then
		return "HATCHERY"
	elseif rw.kind == "Boost" then
		return string.format("%d MINUTES", rw.minutes or 0)
	elseif rw.kind == "Tag" then
		return string.format("SEASON %02d TITLE", seasonNumber)
	end
	return ""
end

-- opts.embedded -- see the note on GoalsPanel.Build; same contract, same reason.

function PassPanel.Build(ctx, opts)

	----------------------------------------------------------- geometry (960 x 700)

	-- Embedded, the header's 102px comes off the GROUP rather than out of the body:
	-- BODY_H below is PANEL_H - BODY_TOP - footer, so shrinking both together leaves

	local PANEL_H = 700
	local PAD = T.pad.panel -- 16

	if EMBEDDED then PANEL_H = PANEL_H - (HEADER_H + 10) end
	local FOOTER_H = 30
	local FOOTER_GAP = 8
