	----------------------------------------------------------- reward card
	-- The state machine (kit README section 5) picks the surface kind BEFORE the
	-- card is built. The old file built a card and then reached back in for its
	-- UIGradient and UIStroke to recolour them, which is how the free column ended
	-- up flat white with white text. Nothing here mutates a built card.
	local function buildRewardCard(row: Frame, tier: number, track: string)
		local isPass = track == "pass"

		local claimMap = (isPass and state.PassClaimed or state.Claimed) or {}
		local trackOpen = (not isPass) or state.PassOwned == true
		local reached = state.XP >= SeasonConfig.ThresholdFor(tier)
		local claimed = trackOpen and (claimMap[tostring(tier)] == true)
		-- Premium is gated on the gamepass ON TOP of the XP threshold, so a player
		-- who has passed tier 30 still sees the premium column locked until they
		-- own it -- and then sees all 30 waiting, which is the "RETROACTIVE"
		-- promise in the column heading.
		local locked = (not trackOpen) or (not reached)
		local claimable = trackOpen and reached and not claimed

		-- sheet ramps: free track green, open premium gold, locked inert.
		-- CLAIMED keeps its track's ramp -- the state is a WORD, not a colour.
		local ramp
		if locked then
			ramp = S.Action.Inert
		elseif isPass then
			ramp = S.Action.Gold
		else
			ramp = S.Action.GreenFill
		end

		local card = PC.plate({
			name = (isPass and "Pass" or "Free") .. "Card" .. tier,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, ROW_H),
			position = UDim2.fromOffset(isPass and PASS_X or FREE_X, 0),
			colors = ramp,
			radius = 24,
			outline = 6,
			zIndex = 15,
			parent = row,
			gloss = false,
		})
		if locked then
			-- sheet: the row drops to 90% opacity; do NOT desaturate the whole
			-- row (that loses the reward) -- the ART alone goes grey below
			card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		end

		local ink = locked and Color3.fromHex("B7C6D8") or S.Surface.ReadInk

		if claimable then
			UI.claimRing(card)
		end

		local tierDef = SeasonConfig.TierFor(track, tier)
		local rw = SeasonConfig.DescribeReward(tierDef)

		----------------------------------------------------- art plate
		local plate = PC.plate({
			name = "ArtPlate",
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(PLATE, PLATE),
			position = UDim2.new(0, PLATE_X, 0.5, 0),
			anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			colors = locked and S.Action.Inert or { Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromHex("FFF4D9") }, -- LemonPop light card (was #E4EDF7)
			radius = 18,
			outline = 5,
			zIndex = card.ZIndex + 1,
			parent = card,
		})

		local art
		local eggMaster = (rw.kind == "Egg") and rw.model and BrainrotThumb.eggMaster(rw.model) or nil
		if eggMaster then
			art = BrainrotThumb.addMaster(plate, eggMaster, {
				size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8),
				position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4),
				zIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1,
			})
		end
		if not art and rw.kind == "Darrels" and IconArt and IconArt.has("darrel") then
			-- The darrel has its OWN drawn icon -- the one on the HUD currency pill.
			-- T.icons.gem is a generic purple gem and is not the same thing, so
			-- these tiers would otherwise advertise the wrong currency.
			local box = PLATE - 12
			local host = Instance.new("Frame")
			host.Name = "DarrelIcon"
			host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			host.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(box, box)
			host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			host.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
			host.Parent = plate
			IconArt.draw(host, "darrel", box, host.ZIndex + 1)
			art = host
		end
		if not art and rw.glyph then
			-- Boost and tag tiers have no model and no icon art, so they get a
			-- centred glyph.
			local g = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			g.Name = "Glyph"
			g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			g.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			g.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
			g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			g.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
			g.TextScaled = true
			g.Text = rw.glyph
			g.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
			g:SetAttribute("NoPolish", true) -- emoji must not be recoloured/outlined
			g.Parent = plate
			art = g
		end
		if not art then
			art = UI.artSlot(plate, UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12), T.icons[rw.icon] or T.icons.coin)
			art.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			art.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			art.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
		end
		art.Name = "ArtSlot"
		if locked then
			-- sheet: locked premium art at 40% grayscale (approximated with a
			-- grey tint -- ImageColor3 is the only lever an ImageLabel has)
			if art:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				art.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
			elseif art:IsA("TextLabel") then
				art.TextTransparency = 0.4
			end
		end

		----------------------------------------------------- name + subtitle
		local rewardText
		if rw.kind == "Cash" then
			rewardText = shortCash(rw.amount) .. " Cash"
		elseif rw.kind == "Egg" then
			-- An egg tier can hand over more than one; pass tier 50 gives twelve.
			-- "x" not the multiplication sign: this game has been bitten by
			-- glyphs the shipped fonts cannot render.
			rewardText = rw.text .. "  x" .. tostring(rw.qty or 1)
		else
			rewardText = rw.text
		end

		local name = UI.label(card, rewardText, "cardLabel", ink)
		name.Name = "NameLabel"
		name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_X, 16)
		name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_W, 22)
		name.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		name.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2

		local sub = UI.label(card, subtitleFor(rw, SEASON.Number), "meta", locked and T.color.textDisabled or Color3.fromHex("2E5A38")) -- LemonPop: warm disabled taupe (was slate #8FA2B6)
		sub.Name = "SubLabel"
		sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_X, 43)
		sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_W, 18)
		sub.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		sub.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2

		----------------------------------------------------- action
		if claimable then
			-- white plate on the coloured row: the one pressable thing on it
			local pill = PC.pill({
				name = "ClaimPill",
				text = "CLAIM",
				colors = { Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromHex("FFF4D9") }, -- LemonPop light card (was #DCE6F0)
				size = UDim2.fromOffset(ACTION_W + 20, 54),
				position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
				anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				textSize = 24,
				zIndex = card.ZIndex + 6,
				parent = card,
			})
			local pl = pill:FindFirstChild("Label")
			if pl then pl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("1F8B34") end
			-- The ONE SeasonClaim:FireServer call site in this module. No local
			-- state mutation here -- the card only re-renders CLAIMED once the
			-- server pushes a fresh SeasonState with Claimed[tier] == true.
			pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				-- track tells the server WHICH column; it re-checks gamepass
				-- ownership itself, so a spoofed "pass" here still cannot claim
				-- the paid track.
				ctx.remotes.SeasonClaim:FireServer(tier, track)
			end)
		elseif claimed then
			-- sheet: claimed is the WORD
			local done = PC.shout({
				name = "ClaimedMark", text = "CLAIMED", size = 22,
				anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
				frameSize = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 26),
				zIndex = card.ZIndex + 2, parent = card,
			})
			done.TextTransparency = 0.1
		else
			-- The design's greyed "TIER 46" marker: what you must reach, said
			-- plainly, instead of a dead button.
			local marker = PC.shout({
				name = "LockMarker",
				text = (not trackOpen) and "LOCKED" or ("TIER " .. tier),
				size = 20,
				anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
				frameSize = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 24),
				zIndex = card.ZIndex + 2, parent = card,
			})
			marker.TextTransparency = 0.25
		end
	end

	local function buildTierPill(row: Frame, tier: number)
		-- sheet: the tier spine -- a gold plate column, 88 tall per row, the
		-- one vertical rhythm holding both tracks together
		local badge = PC.plate({
			name = "TierBadge" .. tier,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(TIER_COL_W, 88),
			position = UDim2.new(0, TIER_X + TIER_COL_W / 2, 0.5, 0),
			anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			colors = S.Action.Gold,
			radius = 22,
			outline = 5,
			zIndex = 15,
			parent = row,
		})
		PC.shout({
			name = "TierNumber", text = tostring(tier), size = 30,
			zIndex = badge.ZIndex + 2, parent = badge,
		})
	end

	-- Full-width divider that announces the final tier, per the design.
	local function buildMilestone(order: number, tier: number)
		local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
		strip.Name = "Milestone" .. tier
		strip.LayoutOrder = order
		strip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LADDER_W, MILESTONE_H)
		strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		strip.ZIndex = 15
		strip.Parent = scroll

		local label = UI.label(strip, "MILESTONE \u{00B7} TIER " .. tier, "chip", Color3.fromHex("B8860B"))
		label.Name = "MilestoneLabel"
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.ZIndex = strip.ZIndex + 2
	end

	local function clearLadder()
		for _, c in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	-- Row count is driven by SeasonConfig.Tiers, never a literal, so a config
	-- change resizes the ladder on its own.
	local function renderLadder(): (number, number)
		clearLadder()
		local tierCount = #SeasonConfig.Tiers
		local readyCount, claimedCount = 0, 0
		for tier = 1, tierCount do
			if tier == tierCount then
				buildMilestone(tier * 10 - 5, tier)
			end

			local row = Instance.new("Frame")
			row.Name = "TierRow" .. tier
			row.LayoutOrder = tier * 10
			row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LADDER_W, ROW_H)
			row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			row.ZIndex = 15
			row.Parent = scroll

			buildRewardCard(row, tier, "free")
			buildTierPill(row, tier)
			buildRewardCard(row, tier, "pass")

			local reached = state.XP >= SeasonConfig.ThresholdFor(tier)
			if state.Claimed[tostring(tier)] == true then
				claimedCount += 1
			elseif reached then
				readyCount += 1
			end
			if state.PassOwned then
				if state.PassClaimed[tostring(tier)] == true then
					claimedCount += 1
				elseif reached then
					readyCount += 1
				end
			end
		end
		return readyCount, claimedCount
	end

	-- Gate for the rail-badge write below: render() also runs once at Build time
	-- with the all-zero placeholder state, and that zero used to DESTROY the
	-- correct join-time badge SeasonClient had already painted.
	local hasServerState = false

	local function render()
		local xpPerTier = SeasonConfig.XP_PER_TIER
		local tierCount = #SeasonConfig.Tiers
		local tierNow = math.min(math.floor(state.XP / xpPerTier), tierCount)
		local intoTier = state.XP - tierNow * xpPerTier

		kicker.Text = string.format("SEASON %02d   %s   %d TIERS", SEASON.Number, string.upper(SEASON.Name), tierCount)
		tierValue.Text = string.format("%d / %d", tierNow, tierCount)
		if tierNow >= tierCount then
			-- At the cap intoTier is 0, so the arithmetically-correct
			-- "0 / 250 to tier 50" renders an EMPTY bar and reads like no
			-- progress at the exact moment the track is finished.
			xpCaption.Text = string.format("SEASON XP   %s / %s   TRACK COMPLETE", comma(state.XP), comma(tierCount * xpPerTier))
			xpLabel.Text = "MAX"
			UI.setFill(xpFill, 1, true)
		else
			xpCaption.Text = string.format("SEASON XP   %s / %s to tier %d", comma(intoTier), comma(xpPerTier), tierNow + 1)
			xpLabel.Text = string.format("%d / %d", intoTier, xpPerTier)
			UI.setFill(xpFill, xpPerTier > 0 and (intoTier / xpPerTier) or 0, true)
		end

		if daysLabel then
			local left = math.max(0, math.ceil(((SEASON.Ends :: number) - os.time()) / 86400))
			daysLabel.Text = string.format("%d DAYS LEFT", left)
		end

		local readyCount, claimedCount = renderLadder()
		claimStatus.Text = string.format("%d CLAIMED   %d READY", claimedCount, readyCount)

		-- Kit README section 5 client state shape -- keep the shared ctx.state.pass
		-- table current for any other consumer.
		ctx.state.pass.level = tierNow
		ctx.state.pass.xp = intoTier
		ctx.state.pass.xpNeed = xpPerTier
		ctx.state.pass.claimedFree = state.Claimed
		if hasServerState then
			ctx.setBadge("pass", readyCount)
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- footer
	local footer = Instance.new("Frame")
	footer.Name = "Footer"
	footer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BODY_TOP + BODY_H + FOOTER_GAP)
	footer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, FOOTER_H)
	footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	footer.ZIndex = 12
	footer.Parent = group

	local footerNote = UI.label(footer, "Buying premium unlocks every tier you have already passed -- nothing is missed.", "meta", T.color.white)
	footerNote.Name = "FooterNote"
	footerNote.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	footerNote.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
	footerNote.TextTransparency = 0.25
	footerNote.ZIndex = 13

	local footerId = SEASON.Id
	if type(SEASON.Ends) == "number" then
		footerId = footerId .. "   ENDS " .. string.upper(os.date("!%d %b", SEASON.Ends :: number))
	end
	local footerTag = UI.label(footer, footerId, "meta", T.color.white)
	footerTag.Name = "FooterTag"
	footerTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	footerTag.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0)
	footerTag.TextTransparency = 0.35
	footerTag.ZIndex = 13

	----------------------------------------------------------- backdrop blur
	-- DailyPanel's setBlur block with a UNIQUE name -- questsBtn transitions Pass
	-- -> Goals, and setBlur destroys by NAME in Lighting, so a shared name would
	-- let one panel's close kill the other's live blur. The shell owns the dim
	-- scrim; the blur is per-panel. Size is SET, not tweened -- BlurEffect.Size is
	-- not on the proven tween whitelist in this place.
	local BLUR_NAME = "PassPanelBlur"
	local function setBlur(on: boolean)
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BLUR_NAME)
		if on and not existing then
			local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
			blur.Name = BLUR_NAME
			blur.Size = 8
			blur.Parent = Lighting
		elseif not on and existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- wiring
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)
	questsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.openPanel("goals")
	end)
	-- skipBtn and premiumBtn are deliberately unwired -- see the module header.

	-- Server-confirmed only: the ONLY place `state` is written is here, from a
	-- SeasonState push. No click handler in this module ever assigns into
	-- state.Claimed / state.XP.
	--
	-- PassOwned / PassClaimed are read DEFENSIVELY: SendState does not send them
	-- today, so they stay false/empty and the premium column stays locked. The
	-- day SeasonPassHandler starts sending them -- which is what pasting a real
	-- gamepass id will require -- this panel already understands them.
	ctx.remotes.SeasonState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(s)
		if typeof(s) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		hasServerState = true
		state.XP = s.XP or 0
		state.Claimed = s.Claimed or {}
		state.PassClaimed = s.PassClaimed or {}
		state.PassOwned = s.PassOwned == true
		render()
	end)

	-- Request a fresh state every time this panel becomes visible (mirrors
	-- SeasonClient's own open-time refresh) -- covers both the very first open
	-- (Build is lazy, called from inside openPanel) and every reopen. Visibility
	-- also drives the backdrop blur, additively.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			ctx.remotes.SeasonState:FireServer()
			setBlur(true)
		else
			setBlur(false)
		end
	end)

	-- Belt-and-braces for the blur teardown: any path that hides the HOST while
	-- this wrapper stays Visible must still kill the global BlurEffect -- it
	-- post-processes the whole screen regardless of GUI visibility -- and restore
	-- it when the host returns with this panel still the visible one.
	ctx.host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not ctx.host.Visible then
			setBlur(false)
		elseif wrapper.Visible then
			setBlur(true)
		end
	end)

	render() -- initial paint (zero state) before the first server response lands

	return wrapper
end

return PassPanel


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameHUDPanels/SettingsPanel.lua =====
--!strict
-- SettingsPanel: kit README §3.3 Settings panel -- a GameHUDPanels consumer
-- module (StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.GameHUDPanels.SettingsPanel).
--
-- Contract (same as every other panel in this family -- see GoalsPanel):
--   return { Id = "settings", Build = function(ctx) -> Frame }
-- Build is called ONCE lazily on first open; the shell (GameHUDClient) parents
-- the returned Frame into ctx.host and owns Visible toggling on every
-- open/close after that -- this module never sets its own Parent or drives
-- its own open/close animation.
--
-- 2026-08-04 RESTYLE (1d/1e sweep): visual-only pass to the shipped cream
-- recipe -- orange header, cream body, white row cards with #e5d3ac borders
-- and #4a3416 ink labels, plus a per-panel backdrop BlurEffect
-- ("SettingsPanelBlur"). SUPERSEDED the same day by the style replacement
-- below; noted rather than deleted because two things it established are
-- still load-bearing and NOT part of the replacement: the blur block, and
-- the body padding warning (EXACTLY T.pad.panel 16 per side -- the
-- BODY_H/BODY_INNER_W math below depends on it, do NOT copy DailyPanel's
-- panelWide 18).
--
-- 2026-08-04 STYLE REPLACEMENT (Pet-Sim guide, "Roblox Simulator UI Style
-- Guide"): the cream look is gone game-wide. Three changes land in THIS file
-- and nothing else does:
--   1. header  -- per-panel accents are dead; Settings' orange #ffb02e ->
--                 #ff7d00 becomes the guide's one red bar (T.gradient.header)
--   2. body    -- UI.surface kind "cream" -> "window": same shared token
--                 (cream is now a legacy alias for it), honest name, and the
--                 colour underneath is the guide's light gray
--   3. rows    -- the three row cards (slider / toggle / skip-reveal) stop
--                 being white+tan and go back to being a plain dark kit "row"
--                 surface, which IS the guide's dark slot; their labels, the
--                 value readouts and the section headers return to white.
-- Everything else here is inherited, not edited: T.radius / T.stroke /
-- T.font all moved in the shared Tokens pass, so the slider tracks + knobs,
-- the quality tab buttons, the toggle switches, the 8 per-rarity chips, the
-- footer buttons and the dark redeem box pick up the new numbers for free
-- and are untouched below. The ONE label that still deliberately reads dark
-- is the redeem message, because it floats directly on the light-gray window
-- instead of on a card (T.color.textOnWindow). ALL wiring -- saves, seams,
-- applySettings, the drag machine, the blur watchers -- is byte-identical.
--
-- ============================================================================
-- SCOPE (task-10-brief, kit README §3.3 MINUS Reset Data):
--   AUDIO    -- Music / Sound FX sliders. Live SoundKit.SetCategoryVolume
--              during drag, SettingsSave:FireServer on release (click-to-set
--              behaves the same way: InputBegan sets + previews once,
--              InputEnded fires the save even with zero movement).
--   GRAPHICS -- Low/Medium/High segmented quality control. Client-local only
--              (kit gives it no server-authoritative effect beyond
--              persistence): toggles Lighting.Bloom/SunRays Enabled,
--              nil-guarded (see applyQuality below).
--   GAMEPLAY -- two real toggles, each bridged into an EXISTING mechanism
--              rather than invented fresh -- see "REAL SEAM" 1/2 below:
--                fastSpin        -> WheelClient's own `fastSpin` local
--                hideOwnBanners  -> RareCatchClient's own-catch banner
--   FOOTER   -- Redeem Code only (Reset Data intentionally absent, per
--              brief). See REDEEM CODE DEVIATION below -- this reuses a
--              REAL, already-live remote instead of the stub the brief's
--              literal text describes.
--
-- ============================================================================
-- REDEEM CODE DEVIATION (read before touching this section again):
-- The task brief asks for a brand-new stub RemoteFunction named "RedeemCode"
-- under ReplicatedStorage.Remotes that always answers `false, "Invalid
-- code"`. That name is NOT free: ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode
-- already exists, as a RemoteEvent, wired end-to-end to a REAL promo-code
-- system --
--   ServerScriptService.Modules.DailyRewardHandler.redeemCode(player, code)
--   ServerScriptService.Modules.CodeConfig (4 live codes: WELCOME, BRAINROT,
--     LAKETAHOE, SKIPMASTER)
--   StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.DailyRewardClient (the legacy Daily
--     HUD's own REDEEM box, still live)
-- Two problems with following the brief literally: (1) Roblox allows two
-- sibling instances with the same Name, so creating a SECOND "RedeemCode"
-- (a RemoteFunction) next to the real one makes every future
-- `remotes.RedeemCode` / `remotes:WaitForChild("RedeemCode")` lookup in the
-- game ambiguous by insertion order; (2) a stub that always fails would be a
-- real functional regression the instant a player types a genuine code
-- (e.g. "WELCOME") into this NEW panel instead of the old Daily UI and gets
-- told it's invalid. So this panel's footer fires the EXISTING RedeemCode
-- RemoteEvent directly (remotes.RedeemCode:FireServer(code) /
-- .OnClientEvent for the {Success, Message} reply) -- nothing new was
-- created server-side for redemption. Documented in task-10-report.md.
--
-- QUALITY ENUM DEVIATION: the brief spells the quality whitelist
-- {"Low","Med","High"}, but StarterPlayerScripts.GameHUDClient's own
-- ctx.state.settings default (shipped Task 3, already live) is
-- `quality = "Medium"`, and the kit's own settings.png capture labels the
-- middle button "Medium" in full. SettingsService validates "Medium" (not
-- "Med") for the same reason -- see that module's own header comment.
-- ============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") -- FIX F4 (2026-07-30 fix wave): shared slider-release watcher, see buildSliderRow

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local SoundKit = require(modules:WaitForChild("SoundKit"))
-- tier names + colours for the per-rarity Skip Catch Animation chips
local RarityConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("RarityConfig"))

-- Bounded wait (matches ToastClient's own `WaitForChild(name, 10)` -- see
-- StarterPlayerScripts.ToastClient): SettingsSave is SELF-HEAL created by
-- SettingsService.Init() server-side, which only runs during Play. A bare
-- unbounded WaitForChild here would hang forever if this module is ever
-- require()'d outside Play (e.g. an Edit-mode compile probe), since nothing
-- will ever create the remote in that context.
local settingsSaveRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("SettingsSave", 5)
if not settingsSaveRemote then
	warn("[SettingsPanel] SettingsSave remote missing (no server this session?) -- saves will no-op")
end
local function fireSave(tbl)
	if settingsSaveRemote then
		settingsSaveRemote:FireServer(tbl)
	end
end

local SettingsPanel = { Id = "settings" }

local QUALITY_OPTIONS = { "Low", "Medium", "High" }
local QUALITY_SET = { Low = true, Medium = true, High = true }

----------------------------------------------------------- local palette (style replacement 2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide)
-- Four of the six 1d/1e constants are DELETED, not repointed, because the
-- guide's values for them all live in Tokens now and the file reaches them
-- through T inside Build: HEADER_TOP/HEADER_BOT (-> T.gradient.header),
-- CARD_BORDER #e5d3ac (-> UI.stroke's own T.color.outline), BODY_INK #4a3416
-- (-> T.color.white on the dark row slots, T.color.textOnWindow for the one
-- label on the window). Only the two redeem-feedback inks stay local -- they
-- are semantic status colours with no token, re-pointed from the cream-era
-- pair to the guide's accent green/red bottom stops.
local MSG_GREEN = Color3.fromHex("#4FB42E") -- redeem success -- guide accent green (was #3fae1f, tuned for cream)
local MSG_RED = Color3.fromHex("#D83E3E") -- redeem failure -- guide accent red (was #A8140F, the kit red gradient's bottom stop)

----------------------------------------------------------- GRAPHICS: client-local Lighting toggles, nil-guarded
-- Confirmed live before writing this: game.Lighting currently has NEITHER a
-- BloomEffect NOR a SunRaysEffect instance (only ColorCorrectionEffect +
-- Sky) -- so today every quality level below is a no-op in practice, on
-- purpose: FindFirstChildOfClass returns nil and both branches skip. The
-- moment a lighting artist adds those effects to Lighting, this starts
-- working with no code change. Low = both off, Medium = Bloom on/SunRays
-- off, High = both on (task brief).
local function applyQuality(quality)
	local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
	local sunRays = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("SunRaysEffect")
	local bloomOn = quality == "Medium" or quality == "High"
	local sunRaysOn = quality == "High"
	if bloom then
		bloom.Enabled = bloomOn
	end
	if sunRays then
		sunRays.Enabled = sunRaysOn
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------- REAL SEAM 1: fastSpin -> WheelClient
-- WheelClient (StarterPlayerScripts.WheelClient) is a LocalScript, not a
-- ModuleScript -- it returns nothing, so nothing can require() it or reach
-- into its module-local `fastSpin` variable directly. Bridged instead
-- through a client-local Instance Attribute on the player (no server round
-- trip needed for the RUNTIME effect, matching WheelClient's own
-- "client-local comfort setting... no server call" comment for what the
-- attribute drives). WheelClient was given a matching edit (see its own
-- "fast spin" section) to read/listen on this SAME attribute instead of
-- only its in-wheel toggle button, so both controls stay in sync no matter
-- which one the player uses. `player` is nil-guarded here since this
-- function can run in a probe/Edit-mode context where LocalPlayer is nil.
local function applyFastSpin(on)
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("FastSpinPref", on == true)
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------- REAL SEAM 2: hideOwnBanners -> RareCatchClient
-- RareCatchClient's rareCatch.OnClientEvent handler now checks this SAME
-- attribute before enqueueing a banner for a catch that was YOURS (see its
-- own "UIKIT (Task 10)" comment) -- other players' banners are completely
-- unaffected, this only ever suppresses your own. Cheap seam: one added
-- guard clause there, no restructuring of its sound/queue logic.
local function applyHideOwnBanners(on)
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("HideOwnBanners", on == true)
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------- REAL SEAM 2b/2c: cinematic prefs -> CatchCinematic (Sequencer/Config)
-- Same bridge shape as REAL SEAM 1/2 above: a client-local Instance Attribute,
-- read at the moment it matters rather than pushed through a bespoke remote.
-- CatchCinematic.Sequencer reads CinematicReducedMotion at the START of every
-- run (mid-run changes take effect on the NEXT catch, same "read at time of
-- use" contract skipReveal already keeps); Config.qualityFor reads
-- CinematicLowQuality on every run too. Task 8 brief: one Reduced Motion row
-- plus a second Low Quality Cinematics row (cheap while already in here -- the
-- plan's quality tier needed a non-touch opt-in).
local function applyCinematicReducedMotion(on)
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("CinematicReducedMotion", on == true)
	end
end

local function applyCinematicLowQuality(on)
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("CinematicLowQuality", on == true)
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------- REAL SEAM 3: skipReveal -> CatchRevealClient / ClientMain
-- Per-rarity catch-animation skip (user request 2026-08-04, v2 -- "just
-- skip the actual catch animation... for whatever rarity they desire"):
-- the Pull ceremony is skipped only for the rarities the player picked;
-- ClientMain's text card announces those catches instead. One boolean
-- attribute per tier (SkipRevealCommon .. SkipRevealGod), read at time of
-- use, so a mid-session change covers the very next catch. The v1 camera
-- skip is gone on purpose -- the tracking camera always flies again.
local function applySkipReveal(t)
	if not player then return end
	t = type(t) == "table" and t or {}
	for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
		player:SetAttribute("SkipReveal" .. tier.Name, t[tier.Name] == true)
	end
end

----------------------------------------------------------- top-level settings apply (require-time wiring, correctly outside Build -- same pattern IndexPanel's `discovered` uses)
-- Applied the instant a Settings payload is known, whether or not this panel
-- has EVER been opened -- audio volume / quality / the two gameplay seams
-- above all need to take effect on join, not only after a player happens to
-- visit Settings. `applied` also seeds the panel's own controls on first
-- Build (see below), and `onAppliedChanged` (assigned inside Build once the
-- widgets exist) keeps them in sync if a payload lands again afterward.
local applied = { music = 0.7, sfx = 1, quality = "Medium", fastSpin = false, hideOwnBanners = false, cinematicReducedMotion = false, cinematicLowQuality = false, skipReveal = {} }
local onAppliedChanged = nil

local function applySettings(s)
	if typeof(s) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if typeof(s.music) == "number" then
		applied.music = math.clamp(s.music, 0, 1)
		SoundKit.SetCategoryVolume("music", applied.music)
	end
	if typeof(s.sfx) == "number" then
		applied.sfx = math.clamp(s.sfx, 0, 1)
		SoundKit.SetCategoryVolume("sfx", applied.sfx)
	end
	if typeof(s.quality) == "string" and QUALITY_SET[s.quality] then
		applied.quality = s.quality
		applyQuality(applied.quality)
	end
	if typeof(s.fastSpin) == "boolean" then
		applied.fastSpin = s.fastSpin
		applyFastSpin(applied.fastSpin)
	end
	if typeof(s.hideOwnBanners) == "boolean" then
		applied.hideOwnBanners = s.hideOwnBanners
		applyHideOwnBanners(applied.hideOwnBanners)
	end
	if typeof(s.cinematicReducedMotion) == "boolean" then
		applied.cinematicReducedMotion = s.cinematicReducedMotion
		applyCinematicReducedMotion(applied.cinematicReducedMotion)
	end
	if typeof(s.cinematicLowQuality) == "boolean" then
		applied.cinematicLowQuality = s.cinematicLowQuality
		applyCinematicLowQuality(applied.cinematicLowQuality)
	end
	if typeof(s.skipReveal) == "table" then
		applied.skipReveal = s.skipReveal
		applySkipReveal(applied.skipReveal)
	elseif s.skipAnimations == true and next(applied.skipReveal) == nil then
		-- v1 migration: the short-lived single Skip Animations toggle becomes
		-- "skip every rarity", so a player who had it ON keeps the behavior
		-- until they touch the chips (which then persists the new shape)
		local all = {}
		for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do all[tier.Name] = true end
		applied.skipReveal = all
		applySkipReveal(all)
	end
	if onAppliedChanged then
		onAppliedChanged()
	end
end

remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snap)
	if typeof(snap) == "table" then
		applySettings(snap.Settings)
	end
end)
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function()
		return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if ok and typeof(snap) == "table" then
		applySettings(snap.Settings)
	end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------- Build
function SettingsPanel.Build(ctx)
	local T = ctx.Tokens
	local UI = ctx.Builders

	-- STYLE REPLACEMENT REPAIR (2026-08-04): see the note in PassPanel. This
	-- panel's two survivors sit in code Build does NOT reach (the redeem-code
	-- result handler), so it built fine and would have crashed later, in the
	-- player's hands, instead of at open time -- the worse failure. Re-declared
	-- as their guide successors.
	local CARD_BORDER = T.color.outline
	local BODY_INK = T.color.white

	----------------------------------------------------------- geometry (kit README §3.3, exact where tokenised)
	local PANEL_W = T.size.panelWidth.settings -- 700
	local HEADER_H = T.size.headerHeight -- 92
	local BODY_TOP = HEADER_H + 12
	local BODY_INNER_W = PANEL_W - T.pad.panel * 2 -- 668

	local SECTION_HEADER_H = 24
	local SLIDER_ROW_H = 54 -- kit "Slider row height 54"
	local SEGMENT_ROW_H = 54 -- kit "three equal buttons height 54"
	local TOGGLE_ROW_H = 52 -- kit "Toggle row height 52"
	local SKIPREV_ROW_H = 86 -- label line + 8 rarity chips (no kit spec; two-line row)
	local FOOTER_H = 58 -- kit "Redeem Code... height 58"
	local GAP = T.pad.gapTight -- 8, kit "Body padding 16, gap 8"
	local ITEM_COUNT = 12 -- 3 section headers + 2 sliders + 1 segmented + 4 toggles + 1 rarity row + 1 footer
	local BODY_CONTENT_H = (SECTION_HEADER_H + SLIDER_ROW_H * 2) -- AUDIO
		+ (SECTION_HEADER_H + SEGMENT_ROW_H) -- GRAPHICS
		+ (SECTION_HEADER_H + TOGGLE_ROW_H * 4 + SKIPREV_ROW_H) -- GAMEPLAY
		+ FOOTER_H
		+ GAP * (ITEM_COUNT - 1)
	local BODY_H = T.pad.panel * 2 + BODY_CONTENT_H
	local GROUP_H = BODY_TOP + BODY_H

	----------------------------------------------------------- root
	local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
	wrapper.Name = "SettingsPanel"
	wrapper.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wrapper.ZIndex = 10

	local panelCol = Instance.new("Frame")
	panelCol.Name = "PanelColumn"
	panelCol.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panelCol.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panelCol.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, GROUP_H)
	panelCol.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	panelCol.ZIndex = 10
	panelCol.Parent = wrapper

	----------------------------------------------------------- header (common shell, README §3 -- kit gold shell, guide RED since the style replacement)
	local header = UI.surface(panelCol, UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, HEADER_H), "gold", T.radius.panel, T.stroke.panel)
	header.Name = "Header"
	header.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	header.ZIndex = 12
	-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): per-panel accents are
	-- dead. §3.3 never gave Settings a colour of its own; 1d/1e invented one
	-- (neutral orange #ffb02e -> #ff7d00) and the guide takes it back -- EVERY
	-- panel wears the same red bar (#F96B57 -> #C84535 = T.gradient.header).
	-- The "gold" seed above stays exactly as it was: UI.surface just needs a
	-- T.gradient key to construct with, and the shell's corner/gloss/shadow/
	-- stroke are all colour-independent, so this remains a single in-place
	-- gradient swap on the surface's OWN UIGradient -- nothing is added.
	local headerGrad = header:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
	if headerGrad then
		headerGrad.Color = T.gradient.header
	end
	UI.gloss(header, T.radius.panel)
	UI.hardShadow(header, T.shadowOffset.panel, T.radius.panel)

	local headerIcon = UI.artSlot(header, UDim2.fromOffset(62, 62), T.icons.settings)
	headerIcon.Name = "SectionIcon"
	headerIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	headerIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0)
	headerIcon.ZIndex = header.ZIndex + 1

	local headerTitle = UI.label(header, "Settings", "panelTitle", T.color.white)
	headerTitle.Name = "Title"
	headerTitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	headerTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12 + 62 + 14, 0.5, 0)
	headerTitle.ZIndex = header.ZIndex + 2

	local closeBtn = UI.button(header, "X", "red", UDim2.fromOffset(T.size.closeButton.X, T.size.closeButton.Y), "buttonL")
	closeBtn.Name = "CloseButton"
	closeBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = header.ZIndex + 2
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)

	----------------------------------------------------------- body (common shell, README §3 -- the guide's light-gray WINDOW since the style replacement)
	-- UI.panel bundled THREE things -- the kit "panel" surface, its hardShadow
	-- and a baked-in 16px UIPadding -- so opting out of it (1d/1e did, to get a
	-- non-panel body colour) means recreating all three explicitly, which is
	-- why they are spelled out below. The padding is EXACTLY T.pad.panel (16)
	-- per side, NOT DailyPanel's panelWide (18): BODY_H above is
	-- `T.pad.panel * 2 + BODY_CONTENT_H` and BODY_INNER_W is
	-- `PANEL_W - T.pad.panel * 2`, so a copied 18 would overflow the 10-item
	-- list stack by 4px and desync every row's width math.
	-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): kind "cream" -> "window".
	-- Zero visual delta at the call site -- the shared Tokens pass repointed
	-- cream at the window gray and kept it as a legacy alias -- this is purely
	-- the honest name for what the surface now is (#D6D6D6 -> #A9A9A9).
	local body = UI.surface(panelCol, UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, BODY_H), "window", T.radius.panel, T.stroke.panel)
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BODY_TOP)
	body.ZIndex = 12
	UI.hardShadow(body, T.shadowOffset.panel, T.radius.panel)
	local bodyPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	bodyPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, T.pad.panel)
	bodyPad.Parent = body

	local bodyList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	bodyList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	bodyList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	bodyList.Padding = UDim.new(0, GAP)
	bodyList.Parent = body

	----------------------------------------------------------- shared list-slot helper
	-- HardShadow-in-UIListLayout trap (see GoalsPanel/PassPanel reports):
	-- UI.hardShadow / UI.button both parent a shadow sibling to the VISUAL
	-- element's OWN parent, not to any wrapper -- if that parent is
	-- `body` itself (list-managed), the shadow becomes an extra, untracked
	-- list item and throws off the vertical stack. Every row below is built
	-- inside its own non-list-managed "slot" Frame (the actual list item),
	-- exactly like every other panel in this family does.
	local order = 0
	local function listSlot(h)
		order += 1
		local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
		slot.Name = "Slot" .. order
		slot.LayoutOrder = order
		slot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
		slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		slot.ZIndex = 14
		slot.Parent = body
		return slot
	end

	local function sectionHeader(text)
		local slot = listSlot(SECTION_HEADER_H)
		-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): WHITE. History here is
		-- gold (kit, tuned for the old dark panel) -> #4a3416 ink (1d/1e, for
		-- cream) -> white. These three words are the one bit of card-less text
		-- that still wants a light fill: they sit on the light-gray window, so
		-- the cardLabel ink stroke does the legibility work, and white-inside-
		-- #202020 is exactly the guide's all-caps section treatment. (The other
		-- on-window label, the redeem message, goes the other way -- see it.)
		local l = UI.label(slot, text, "cardLabel", T.color.white)
		l.Name = "SectionHeader"
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		-- kit wants 18/stroke3; cardLabel is 20/stroke3 (closest tokenised
		-- style, same class of kit-vs-Builders gap other panels document) --
		-- only TextSize is overridden, the stroke already matches exactly.
		l.TextSize = 18
		l.ZIndex = 15
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- row cards: NO recolour helper any more (style replacement 2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide)
	-- 1d/1e carried a `whiteCard(card)` helper that the three row builders
	-- each called: it DESTROYED the row surface's UIGradient (exposing
	-- Builders' flat white base underneath) and repainted the surface's own
	-- UIStroke #e5d3ac. Both halves are now wrong, and both are simply gone
	-- rather than re-pointed -- the guide's card IS a dark slot (#4A4A4A ->
	-- #363636), which is precisely what T.gradient.row became in the shared
	-- Tokens pass, and UI.stroke already paints T.color.outline (#202020).
	-- So each row below is a bare `UI.surface(..., "row", ...)` that inherits
	-- the whole look: one gradient, ONE stroke (never a second UI.stroke call
	-- on top), no post-hoc repaint pass to keep in sync. Controls ON the
	-- cards -- tracks, knobs, switches, the 8 rarity chips -- are untouched;
	-- they were always kit-coloured and read against a dark card by design.

	----------------------------------------------------------- FIX F4 shared drag-end watcher
	-- (2026-07-30 fix wave) track.InputEnded (used inside buildSliderRow below)
	-- only fires while the release happens over the track itself -- releasing
	-- off-track (drag the knob out past the row's edge, then let go) never
	-- fires it, leaving that row's local `dragging` stuck true and the slider
	-- visually "stuck" to the mouse/touch forever after. ONE shared
	-- UserInputService.InputEnded connection (preferred over a connection per
	-- row -- a global-service connection per row would leak across Build()
	-- calls with nothing to unwind) watches for the release everywhere; each
	-- row registers/unregisters its own end-drag closure in
	-- `activeDragEnders` for exactly as long as it's the one being dragged.
	-- Disconnected via the panel wrapper's Destroying -- `wrapper` is this
	-- module's one root Instance (per its own header comment, "this module
	-- never sets its own Parent"), created above.
	local activeDragEnders = {} -- row key -> function() ends that row's drag + fires the save
	local uisInputEndedConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		for _, endDrag in pairs(activeDragEnders) do
			endDrag()
		end
	end)
	wrapper.Destroying:Connect(function()
		uisInputEndedConn:Disconnect()
	end)

	----------------------------------------------------------- slider row (AUDIO)
	local function buildSliderRow(labelText, key, initialValue)
		local slot = listSlot(SLIDER_ROW_H)
		-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): plain dark row slot,
		-- no recolour call after it. The literal 3 that 1d/1e hardcoded here
		-- (to soften the tan border away from T.stroke.control's then-4) goes
		-- back to the token -- the shared pass retuned control to 3, so this is
		-- the same pixel today but tracks the token from here on. The card
		-- still gets no hardShadow: `slot` isn't list-managed so a drop
		-- couldn't disturb the stack, the guide just doesn't shadow rows (the
		-- knob keeps ITS shadow -- that's a control, not chrome).
		local card = UI.surface(slot, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), "row", T.radius.inner, T.stroke.control)
		card.Name = "SliderRow_" .. key
		card.ZIndex = 15

		local ROW_PAD_X = 14 -- kit gives no explicit slider-row padding; spacing-scale token, same class of ad hoc gap other panels document
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.Parent = card

		local CONTENT_W = BODY_INNER_W - ROW_PAD_X * 2
		local LABEL_W, VALUE_W, INNER_GAP = 150, 56, T.pad.gap -- kit "label column 150" / "value column 56"
		local TRACK_W = CONTENT_W - LABEL_W - VALUE_W - INNER_GAP * 2

		local label = UI.label(card, labelText, "cardLabel", T.color.white) -- style replacement (2026-08-04): white again -- the card is a dark slot now
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_W, 0, 24)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.ZIndex = 16

		local track, fill = UI.track(card, UDim2.new(0, TRACK_W, 0, 26), "green", T.radius.pill)
		track.Name = "Track"
		track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_W + INNER_GAP, 0.5, 0)
		track.ZIndex = 16

		-- Knob is parented to `card`, NOT `track` -- UI.track sets
		-- ClipsDescendants=true on the track (for the fill's rounded-corner
		-- mask), so a knob living inside it would get visually clipped in
		-- half at both 0% and 100% (it's meant to overlap the track's rounded
		-- ends, per the capture). Positioned in card-local offset space
		-- instead, computed from the SAME track geometry.
		local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
		knob.Name = "Knob"
		knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34) -- kit "knob 34x34 circle"
		knob.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
		knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
		knob.ZIndex = 17
		knob.Parent = card
		UI.corner(knob, 17)
		UI.gradient(knob, T.gradient.knob) -- kit "#FFF0A8->#FFC531"
		UI.stroke(knob, T.stroke.control)
		UI.hardShadow(knob, 3, 17) -- kit "hard shadow 0 3" -- knob's parent (`card`) isn't list-managed, so no wrapper trap here

		local valueLabel = UI.label(card, "0%", "cardLabel", T.color.white) -- style replacement (2026-08-04): white on the dark row slot, matching Label above
		valueLabel.Name = "Value"
		valueLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		valueLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, VALUE_W, 0, 24)
		valueLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		valueLabel.ZIndex = 16

		local dragging = false
		local pct = math.clamp(initialValue or 0, 0, 1)

		local function render()
			UI.setFill(fill, pct, false)
			knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_W + INNER_GAP + pct * TRACK_W, 0.5, 0)
			valueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(pct * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
		end
		render()

		local function updateFromInput(input)
			local size = track.AbsoluteSize.X
			if size <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local rel = (input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / size
			pct = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
			render()
			SoundKit.SetCategoryVolume(key, pct) -- live preview during drag/click
		end

		-- Click-to-set + drag, per kit §3.3 ("Click-to-set on the track; drag =
		-- same math on InputChanged"): InputBegan both starts the drag AND
		-- previews the click position; InputEnded fires the save even with
		-- zero movement (a plain click). endDrag is shared between the on-track
		-- InputEnded below and the module-level shared UIS.InputEnded watcher
		-- (FIX F4) that catches an off-track release this row's own track would
		-- otherwise never see.
		local function endDrag()
			if not dragging then
				return
			end
			dragging = false
			activeDragEnders[key] = nil
			fireSave({ [key] = pct })
		end

		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				activeDragEnders[key] = endDrag
				updateFromInput(input)
			end
		end)
		track.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				updateFromInput(input)
			end
		end)
		track.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				endDrag()
			end
		end)

		return {
			setValue = function(v)
				if dragging then
					return -- don't fight a live drag with a server echo
				end
				pct = math.clamp(v or 0, 0, 1)
				render()
			end,
		}
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- segmented quality row (GRAPHICS)
	local function buildSegmentedRow()
		local slot = listSlot(SEGMENT_ROW_H)
		local SEG_GAP = T.pad.gapTight -- 8; kit gives no explicit segment gap
		local segW = (BODY_INNER_W - SEG_GAP * 2) / 3

		local buttons, rings, glows = {}, {}, {}
		for i, q in ipairs(QUALITY_OPTIONS) do
			-- kit-token gap (same class Task 6/7 already logged, deferred): UI.button
			-- hardcodes T.radius.control (16), kit wants 14 here -- not fixed, per
			-- the already-deferred "Builders radius-param follow-up".
			local btn = UI.button(slot, q, "tab", UDim2.fromOffset(segW, SEGMENT_ROW_H), "buttonM")
			btn.Name = "Quality" .. q
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * (segW + SEG_GAP), 0)
			btn.ZIndex = 15
			buttons[q] = btn

			-- glow (kit "+ 12px glow"): one soft rounded-rect halo, 12px outset
			-- each side, behind the button.
			local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
			glow.Name = "Glow"
			glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 24, 1, 24)
			glow.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.activeGlow
			glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
			glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
			glow.Visible = false
			glow.ZIndex = btn.ZIndex - 1
			glow.Parent = btn
			UI.corner(glow, T.radius.control + 12)
			glows[q] = glow

			-- active ring: kit "4 px #FFD84D ring inset -4 (radius 16)" -- same
			-- static-selection convention GoalsPanel's own tab ring uses.
			local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
			ring.Name = "ActiveRing"
			ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8)
			ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, -4)
			ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ring.Visible = false
			ring.ZIndex = btn.ZIndex + 3
			ring.Parent = btn
			UI.corner(ring, 16)
			local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			ringStroke.Thickness = 4
			ringStroke.Color = T.color.activeRing
			ringStroke.Parent = ring
			rings[q] = ring
		end

		local current = "Medium"
		local function render()
			for q in pairs(buttons) do
				rings[q].Visible = (q == current)
				glows[q].Visible = (q == current)
			end
		end
		render()

		for q, btn in pairs(buttons) do
			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if current == q then
					return
				end
				current = q
				render()
				applyQuality(current) -- immediate client-local preview
				fireSave({ quality = current })
			end)
		end

		return {
			setValue = function(q)
				if QUALITY_SET[q] and q ~= current then
					current = q
					render()
				end
			end,
		}
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- toggle row (GAMEPLAY)
	local function buildToggleRow(labelText, initialOn, onToggle)
		local slot = listSlot(TOGGLE_ROW_H)
		-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): dark row slot, fully
		-- inherited, no recolour call -- see buildSliderRow's note for the
		-- strokeW/hardShadow reasoning. The switch keeps its full kit look.
		local card = UI.surface(slot, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), "row", T.radius.inner, T.stroke.control)
		card.Name = "ToggleRow"
		card.ZIndex = 15

		local ROW_PAD_X = 14
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.Parent = card

		local SWITCH_W, SWITCH_H = 86, 38 -- kit "switch 86x38"

		local label = UI.label(card, labelText, "cardLabel", T.color.white) -- style replacement (2026-08-04): white again -- the card is a dark slot now
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SWITCH_W + T.pad.gap), 0, 24)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.ZIndex = 16

		local switch = Instance.new("TextButton")
		switch.Name = "Switch"
		switch.Text = ""
		switch.AutoButtonColor = false
		switch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		switch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SWITCH_W, SWITCH_H)
		switch.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
		switch.BorderSizePixel = 0
		switch.ZIndex = 16
		switch.Parent = card
		UI.corner(switch, T.radius.pill)
		local switchGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		switchGradient.Rotation = 90
		switchGradient.Parent = switch
		UI.stroke(switch, T.stroke.control)

		-- OFF inset shadow (kit "OFF... with inset shadow") -- same trick
		-- UI.track uses for its own inset shadow; only shown in the OFF state.
		local inset = Instance.new("Frame")
		inset.Name = "InsetShadow"
		inset.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
		inset.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		inset.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
		inset.BorderSizePixel = 0
		inset.ZIndex = switch.ZIndex + 1
		inset.Parent = switch
		UI.corner(inset, T.radius.pill)

		-- "ON"/"OFF" chip label. FontFace, never the legacy .Font property with
		-- a Font-struct value (T.font.* are Font structs, not Enum.Font -- the
		-- exact crash class Task 8/9 logged and fixed elsewhere in this family).
		local switchLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		switchLabel.Name = "StateLabel"
		switchLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		switchLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
		switchLabel.FontFace = T.font.display
		switchLabel.TextSize = T.text.chip[1]
		switchLabel.RichText = false
		switchLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		switchLabel.ZIndex = switch.ZIndex + 2
		switchLabel.Parent = switch
		local switchLabelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		switchLabelStroke.Thickness = T.text.chip[2]
		switchLabelStroke.Color = T.color.outline
		switchLabelStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
		switchLabelStroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
		switchLabelStroke.Parent = switchLabel

		local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
		knob.Name = "Knob"
		knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36) -- kit "36 px white knob" (ON); OFF reuses the same size, colour only differs
		knob.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
		knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
		knob.ZIndex = switch.ZIndex + 2
		knob.Parent = switch
		UI.corner(knob, 18)
		local knobGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		knobGradient.Rotation = 90
		knobGradient.Parent = knob
		UI.stroke(knob, T.stroke.hairline)

		-- kit-token gap (same class GoalsPanel's own header-plate colours
		-- document): no T.gradient entry matches these two OFF-state pairs.
		local OFF_TOP, OFF_BOT = T.hex("#5A6748"), T.hex("#3A452C")
		local KNOB_OFF_TOP, KNOB_OFF_BOT = T.hex("#C9CCC2"), T.hex("#9AA28E")

		local on = initialOn == true
		local function render()
			inset.Visible = not on
			if on then
				switchGradient.Color = T.gradient.green
				knobGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(T.color.white)
				knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -1, 0.5, 0)
				switchLabel.Text = "ON"
				switchLabel.TextColor3 = T.color.white
				switchLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				switchLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, 0)
				switchLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			else
				switchGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(OFF_TOP, OFF_BOT)
				knobGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(KNOB_OFF_TOP, KNOB_OFF_BOT)
				knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0.5, 0)
				switchLabel.Text = "OFF"
				switchLabel.TextColor3 = T.color.textMuted
				switchLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				switchLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
				switchLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
			end
		end
		render()

		switch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			on = not on
			render()
			if onToggle then
				onToggle(on)
			end
		end)

		return {
			setValue = function(v)
				on = v == true
				render()
			end,
		}
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- skip-catch-animation row (GAMEPLAY): 8 per-rarity chips
	-- A filled chip = that rarity's Pull ceremony is skipped (the fast text
	-- card shows instead). Chips wear their tier colour when ON and the
	-- toggle family's OFF greens when not, so the row reads with the same
	-- vocabulary as the switches above it.
	local function buildSkipRevealRow()
		local slot = listSlot(SKIPREV_ROW_H)
		-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): dark row slot, fully
		-- inherited, no recolour call -- see buildSliderRow's note. All 8 chips
		-- keep their tier/OFF looks: those are rarity DATA, not chrome.
		local card = UI.surface(slot, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), "row", T.radius.inner, T.stroke.control)
		card.Name = "SkipRevealRow"
		card.ZIndex = 15

		local ROW_PAD_X = 14
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, ROW_PAD_X)
		pad.Parent = card

		local label = UI.label(card, "Skip Catch Animation", "cardLabel", T.color.white) -- style replacement (2026-08-04): white again -- the card is a dark slot now
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 8)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.ZIndex = 16

		local chipRow = Instance.new("Frame")
		chipRow.Name = "Chips"
		chipRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chipRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
		chipRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		chipRow.ZIndex = 16
		chipRow.Parent = card
		local chipList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		chipList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		chipList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		chipList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		chipList.Parent = chipRow

		local CHIP_W = math.floor((BODY_INNER_W - ROW_PAD_X * 2 - 6 * (#RarityConfig - 1)) / #RarityConfig)
		local SHORT = { Common = "COM", Uncommon = "UNC", Rare = "RARE", Epic = "EPIC",
			Legendary = "LEG", Mythic = "MYTH", Secret = "SEC", God = "GOD" }
		local OFF_TOP, OFF_BOT = T.hex("#5A6748"), T.hex("#3A452C")

		-- Trailing save: SettingsService silently drops saves within 0.5s of the
		-- last one, and chip-picking is exactly the rapid-click case -- so the
		-- attribute applies instantly per click, and ONE save (the full table)
		-- fires 0.6s after the last click. Token pattern, newest wins.
		local saveToken = 0
		local function queueSave()
			saveToken += 1
			local my = saveToken
			task.delay(0.6, function()
				if my ~= saveToken then return end
				local copy = {}
				for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do copy[tier.Name] = applied.skipReveal[tier.Name] == true end
				fireSave({ skipReveal = copy })
			end)
		end

		local chips = {}
		local function paintChip(tierName)
			local c = chips[tierName]
			if not c then return end
			local on = applied.skipReveal[tierName] == true
			if on then
				c.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(c.color, c.color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35))
				c.label.TextColor3 = T.color.white
			else
				c.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(OFF_TOP, OFF_BOT)
				c.label.TextColor3 = T.color.textMuted
			end
			c.inset.Visible = not on
		end

		for i, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
			local chip = Instance.new("TextButton")
			chip.Name = tier.Name .. "Chip"
			chip.Text = ""
			chip.AutoButtonColor = false
			chip.LayoutOrder = i
			chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CHIP_W, 34)
			chip.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
			chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
			chip.ZIndex = 17
			chip.Parent = chipRow
			UI.corner(chip, T.radius.control)
			local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			grad.Rotation = 90
			grad.Parent = chip
			UI.stroke(chip, T.stroke.hairline)

			local inset = Instance.new("Frame")
			inset.Name = "InsetShadow"
			inset.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
			inset.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			inset.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
			inset.BorderSizePixel = 0
			inset.ZIndex = 18
			inset.Parent = chip
			UI.corner(inset, T.radius.control)

			local chipLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			chipLabel.Name = "Word"
			chipLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			chipLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, 0)
			chipLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 0)
			chipLabel.FontFace = T.font.display
			chipLabel.TextScaled = true
			chipLabel.RichText = false
			chipLabel.Text = SHORT[tier.Name] or string.upper(tier.Name)
			chipLabel.ZIndex = 19
			chipLabel.Parent = chip
			local cap = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
			cap.MaxTextSize = T.text.chip[1]
			cap.Parent = chipLabel
			local ink = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			ink.Thickness = T.text.chip[2]
			ink.Color = T.color.outline
			ink.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
			ink.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
			ink.Parent = chipLabel

			chips[tier.Name] = { gradient = grad, label = chipLabel, inset = inset, color = tier.Color }
			paintChip(tier.Name)

			chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				applied.skipReveal[tier.Name] = not (applied.skipReveal[tier.Name] == true)
				paintChip(tier.Name)
				applySkipReveal(applied.skipReveal)
				queueSave()
			end)
		end

		return {
			setValue = function()
				for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do paintChip(tier.Name) end
			end,
		}
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- footer: Redeem Code (Reset Data intentionally absent -- see module header)
	local function buildFooter()
		local slot = listSlot(FOOTER_H)
		local btn = UI.button(slot, "Redeem Code", "blue", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), "buttonM")
		btn.Name = "RedeemCodeButton"
		btn.ZIndex = 15

		-- Inline input row (kit: "opening an inline TextBox row"), hidden until
		-- the button is pressed. Reuses this SAME slot rather than growing the
		-- panel -- the button hides while the row is open, so the footer never
		-- changes height and nothing above it has to relayout.
		local inputRow = Instance.new("Frame")
		inputRow.Name = "RedeemInputRow"
		inputRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		inputRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		inputRow.Visible = false
		inputRow.ZIndex = 15
		inputRow.Parent = slot

		local GO_W = 84
		local BOX_W = BODY_INNER_W - GO_W - T.pad.gapTight

		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = "CodeBox"
		box.Size = UDim2.new(0, BOX_W, 1, 0)
		box.BackgroundColor3 = T.color.white
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.Text = ""
		box.PlaceholderText = "Enter code\u{2026}"
		box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.color.textMuted
		box.TextColor3 = T.color.white
		box.FontFace = T.font.ui -- FontFace, not .Font (Font-struct crash class -- see Switch label comment above)
		box.TextSize = 16
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		box.ZIndex = 15
		box.Parent = inputRow
		UI.corner(box, T.radius.inner)
		UI.gradient(box, T.gradient.track)
		UI.stroke(box, T.stroke.control)
		local boxPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		boxPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
		boxPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
		boxPad.Parent = box

		local goBtn = UI.button(inputRow, "GO", "green", UDim2.fromOffset(GO_W, FOOTER_H), "buttonM")
		goBtn.Name = "GoButton"
		goBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(BOX_W + T.pad.gapTight, 0)
		goBtn.ZIndex = 15

		-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): msg floats on the
		-- transparent inputRow, i.e. directly on the light-gray WINDOW and not
		-- on any card -- so it is the ONE label in this panel that stays dark,
		-- and it uses the token minted for exactly that case
		-- (T.color.textOnWindow) rather than 1d/1e's cream ink or the kit's
		-- textMuted, which was a dark-panel pick to begin with.
		local msg = UI.label(inputRow, "", "meta", T.color.textOnWindow)
		msg.Name = "Message"
		msg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		msg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, -4)
		msg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 16)
		msg.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		msg.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		msg.ZIndex = 16

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			btn.Visible = false
			inputRow.Visible = true
		end)

		-- REAL, existing remote -- see module header REDEEM CODE DEVIATION.
		-- Nothing new was created server-side; this fires the SAME RemoteEvent
		-- the legacy DailyRewardClient's own REDEEM box already uses.
		local function submit()
			local code = box.Text
			if typeof(code) ~= "string" or #code:gsub("%s+", "") == 0 then
				return
			end
			remotes.RedeemCode:FireServer(code)
		end
		goBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(submit)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			if enterPressed then
				submit()
			end
		end)

		remotes.RedeemCode.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(r)
			if typeof(r) ~= "table" or typeof(r.Message) ~= "string" then
				return
			end
			msg.Text = r.Message
			-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): third pass on this
			-- one line. Kit shipped light-on-dark picks (claimRing #7CE04A /
			-- salmon #FF8A7A), 1d/1e darkened them for cream, and the guide's
			-- own accent green/red bottoms now hold the middle ground the
			-- light-gray window needs. Colours ONLY -- the Success/Message
			-- handling and the box clear below are untouched.
			msg.TextColor3 = r.Success == true and MSG_GREEN or MSG_RED
			if r.Success == true then
				box.Text = ""
			end
		end)
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- assemble
	sectionHeader("AUDIO")
	local musicCtl = buildSliderRow("Music", "music", applied.music)
	local sfxCtl = buildSliderRow("Sound FX", "sfx", applied.sfx)

	sectionHeader("GRAPHICS")
	local qualityCtl = buildSegmentedRow()
	qualityCtl.setValue(applied.quality)

	sectionHeader("GAMEPLAY")
	local fastSpinCtl = buildToggleRow("Fast Spin", applied.fastSpin, function(on)
		applied.fastSpin = on
		applyFastSpin(on)
		fireSave({ fastSpin = on })
	end)
	local hideBannersCtl = buildToggleRow("Hide My Catch Banners", applied.hideOwnBanners, function(on)
		applied.hideOwnBanners = on
		applyHideOwnBanners(on)
		fireSave({ hideOwnBanners = on })
	end)
	local reducedMotionCtl = buildToggleRow("Reduced Motion (Cinematics)", applied.cinematicReducedMotion, function(on)
		applied.cinematicReducedMotion = on
		applyCinematicReducedMotion(on)
		fireSave({ cinematicReducedMotion = on })
	end)
	local lowQualityCtl = buildToggleRow("Low Quality Cinematics", applied.cinematicLowQuality, function(on)
		applied.cinematicLowQuality = on
		applyCinematicLowQuality(on)
		fireSave({ cinematicLowQuality = on })
	end)
	local skipRevealCtl = buildSkipRevealRow()

	buildFooter()

	----------------------------------------------------------- kit README §5 client state shape -- kept in sync for parity with every other panel's own ctx.state.<id> writes, even though nothing else currently reads it
	local function syncState()
		if ctx.state and ctx.state.settings then
			ctx.state.settings.music = applied.music
			ctx.state.settings.sfx = applied.sfx
			ctx.state.settings.quality = applied.quality
			ctx.state.settings.toggles = ctx.state.settings.toggles or {}
			ctx.state.settings.toggles.fastSpin = applied.fastSpin
			ctx.state.settings.toggles.hideOwnBanners = applied.hideOwnBanners
			ctx.state.settings.toggles.cinematicReducedMotion = applied.cinematicReducedMotion
			ctx.state.settings.toggles.cinematicLowQuality = applied.cinematicLowQuality
			ctx.state.settings.toggles.skipReveal = applied.skipReveal
		end
	end
	syncState()

	----------------------------------------------------------- re-sync every control if a settings payload lands again after Build (e.g. loaded late, or a re-push)
	onAppliedChanged = function()
		musicCtl.setValue(applied.music)
		sfxCtl.setValue(applied.sfx)
		qualityCtl.setValue(applied.quality)
		fastSpinCtl.setValue(applied.fastSpin)
		hideBannersCtl.setValue(applied.hideOwnBanners)
		reducedMotionCtl.setValue(applied.cinematicReducedMotion)
		lowQualityCtl.setValue(applied.cinematicLowQuality)
		skipRevealCtl.setValue()
		syncState()
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- backdrop blur (1d/1e sweep 2026-08-04: dim + blur behind the panel)
	-- Same per-panel BlurEffect recipe as DailyPanel: the shell owns the dim
	-- scrim, the blur is per-panel, created/destroyed on Visible. The NAME is
	-- unique per panel -- setBlur create/destroys by name in Lighting, so a
	-- shared name would let one panel's close destroy another's live blur.
	-- Size is SET, never tweened (BlurEffect.Size is not on the proven tween
	-- whitelist here). Lighting is already imported at module top for
	-- applyQuality; this block only ever touches its OWN named BlurEffect, so
	-- it cannot interact with the Bloom/SunRays lookups (different classes).
	local BLUR_NAME = "SettingsPanelBlur"
	local function setBlur(on: boolean)
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BLUR_NAME)
		if on and not existing then
			local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
			blur.Name = BLUR_NAME
			blur.Size = 8
			blur.Parent = Lighting
		elseif not on and existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Settings has no per-open refresh, countdown or motion to drive, so this
	-- watcher is minimal AND NEW (the panel previously had no Visible watcher
	-- at all) -- view-only, additive; the closeBtn/Destroying wiring above is
	-- untouched.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		setBlur(wrapper.Visible)
	end)

	-- Belt-and-braces (same review catch DailyPanel carries): any path that
	-- hides the HOST while this wrapper stays Visible (legacy single-open
	-- force-closes, future shell changes) must still kill the global
	-- BlurEffect -- it post-processes the whole screen regardless of GUI
	-- visibility. Restore it when the host returns and we're still the
	-- visible panel.
	ctx.host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not ctx.host.Visible then
			setBlur(false)
		elseif wrapper.Visible then
			setBlur(true)
		end
	end)

	return wrapper
end

return SettingsPanel


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameHUDPanels/ShopPanel.lua =====
--!strict
-- ShopPanel: Robux purchase panel -- a GameHUDPanels consumer module
-- (StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.GameHUDPanels.ShopPanel).
--
-- Contract (identical to PassPanel/DailyPanel/GoalsPanel -- the family
-- template, read those headers first):
--   return { Id = "shop", Build = function(ctx) -> Frame }
-- Build is called ONCE lazily on first open; the shell (GameHUDClient) parents
-- the returned Frame into ctx.host and owns Visible toggling on every
-- open/close after that -- this module never sets its own Parent or drives
-- its own open/close animation. GameHUDClient's startup loop auto-registers
-- any ModuleScript in this folder (GameHUDClient.client.lua ~:1415), so this
-- file needs NO registration edit -- only a rail button to be reachable (see
-- docs/monetization/shop-panel-remotes.md for that proposed one-liner).
--
-- ============================================================================
-- DATA CONTRACT (read ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GamepassConfig,
-- ServerScriptService.Modules.GamepassService and
-- ServerScriptService.Modules.ProductRegistry FULLY before touching this):
--
--   Pass catalog -- GamepassConfig.List (SHARED on purpose: its own header
--     says "SHARED so a future shop UI can read names / icons / prices
--     straight from here"). Key/GamepassId/Name/Icon/Desc/RobuxPrice consumed
--     verbatim. GamepassId == 0 means "not created yet" (GamepassService
--     convention) -> the card renders COMING SOON and NEVER carries a click
--     connection. Double-guarded: the disabled-variant button is Active=false
--     AND no handler is ever connected to it; live buy handlers ALSO re-check
--     id > 0 and not-owned at click time.
--
--   Darrel packs -- ProductRegistry.Init's PACK_AMOUNTS { 80, 180, 400, 1000 }
--     with PACK_IDS all 0. Those tables are LOCALS inside a server module the
--     client cannot require, so this panel carries a mirror (PACK_FALLBACK
--     below) that MUST be kept in sync by hand until the optional ShopState
--     remote exists. ProductId == 0 -> COMING SOON, same no-connection rule.
--
--   remotes.ShopState -- OPTIONAL RemoteFunction, does not exist in this
--     build (documented + proposed server patch in
--     docs/monetization/shop-panel-remotes.md):
--       client -> server: ShopState:InvokeServer()   (no args)
--       returns: { Owned = { [PassKey: string]: true },
--                  Packs = { { Amount: number, ProductId: number }, ... } }
--     Resolved with a BOUNDED WaitForChild (5s, ToastClient/SettingsPanel
--     convention) inside a spawned thread so the lazy Build never stalls
--     openPanel. Absent (today) -> permanent client-only fallback:
--       - ownership: MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync per pass with a
--         REAL id (zero calls while everything is 0), pcall'd like
--         GamepassService.refresh does server-side;
--       - packs: the PACK_FALLBACK mirror.
--
--   Purchases -- client-side MarketplaceService prompts, per task spec:
--     PromptGamePassPurchase(player, GamepassId) for passes,
--     PromptProductPurchase(player, ProductId) for Darrel packs. No new
--     purchase remotes: grants already land server-side via GamepassService's
--     PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished cache listener (passes) and
--     ProductRegistry.ProcessReceipt (products -- the game's single
--     ProcessReceipt assignment; see that file's header).
--
--   Ownership state -- server-confirmed only, with ONE deliberate exception
--     mirroring the server's own convention: the client's
--     PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished(wasPurchased=true) flips owned[Key]
--     locally, exactly like GamepassService.Init's listener flips its cache.
--     No other click handler ever writes into `owned`.
--
-- Pack prices are NOT in ProductRegistry (dev-product prices live on the
-- dashboard), so live packs fetch theirs via GetProductInfo(id, Product) --
-- pcall'd, cached, async; the button says "BUY" until the price lands. Pass
-- prices come straight from GamepassConfig.RobuxPrice (display only; Roblox
-- charges the dashboard price at prompt time regardless).
--
-- Emoji note: pass Icon glyphs render on the default face (FredokaOne has no
-- emoji -- GameHUDClient's glyphFallback comment), with NoPolish set so the
-- UIPolish sweep leaves them alone. GamepassConfig's 1F9F2 (magnet) is not
-- yet render-proven in this build's emoji font -- flagged in the companion
-- doc, swap the Icon string in GamepassConfig if it shows tofu.
-- ============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local GamepassConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("GamepassConfig"))

local ShopPanel = { Id = "shop" }

function ShopPanel.Build(ctx)
	local T = ctx.Tokens
	local UI = ctx.Builders

	-- Darrel's drawn face + the kit's shop art, pcall'd (GoalsPanel
	-- convention): a missing or broken IconArt must not take the panel down.
	local okIconArt, IconArt = pcall(function()
		return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.UIKit.IconArt)
	end)
	if not okIconArt then IconArt = nil end

	----------------------------------------------------------- geometry
	-- No `shop` key exists in T.size.panelWidth yet (Tokens is not edited by
	-- this task); 900 matches Daily's slot in the width family and clears the
	-- 2-column left rail with room to spare. Forward-compatible read: paste a
	-- shop key into Tokens later and this line starts honouring it.
	local PANEL_W = T.size.panelWidth.shop or 900
	local HEADER_H = T.size.headerHeight -- 92
	local BODY_TOP = HEADER_H + 12
	local TAB_H = 56 -- GoalsPanel's tab bar height, verbatim
	local TAB_GAP = T.pad.gap -- 12 (same token GoalsPanel's tabs reuse)
	local CONTENT_GAP = 12
	local CONTENT_H = 480 -- GoalsPanel's rows viewport, verbatim (5x88 + 4x10)
	local BODY_CONTENT_H = TAB_H + CONTENT_GAP + CONTENT_H -- 548
	local BODY_H = T.pad.panel * 2 + BODY_CONTENT_H -- 580
	local GROUP_H = BODY_TOP + BODY_H -- 684, fits the 775 canvas
	local BODY_INNER_W = PANEL_W - T.pad.panel * 2 -- 868
	local TAB_W = (BODY_INNER_W - TAB_GAP) / 2 -- two tabs, not Goals' three

	-- pass rows (GoalsPanel quest-row family)
	local ROW_H = T.size.questRow -- 88
	local ROW_GAP = T.pad.rowGap -- 10
	local ROW_PAD_X = 12
	local ICON_W = 60
	local TEXT_X = ROW_PAD_X + ICON_W + 10
	local ACTION_W, ACTION_H = 190, 60 -- 190: "COMING SOON" at buttonM needs it

	-- darrel pack cards (PassPanel reward-card family, taller for a buy button)
	local CARD_W, CARD_H = 196, 300
	local CARD_GAP = T.pad.gridGap -- 11
	local CARDS_Y = 66

	----------------------------------------------------------- module-local state
	-- `owned` is server-confirmed only (plus the PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished
	-- exception documented in the header). `packs` starts as the hand-kept

	local PACK_FALLBACK = {
		{ Amount = 80, ProductId = 0 },
		{ Amount = 180, ProductId = 0 },
		{ Amount = 400, ProductId = 0 },
		{ Amount = 1000, ProductId = 0 },
	}

	local productPrice: { [number]: number } = {} -- GetProductInfo cache
	local shopStateRemote: RemoteFunction? = nil

	-- remember the open tab across close/reopen, mirroring goals.tab; the key
	-- is created here because the shell's state table predates this panel.
	ctx.state.shop = ctx.state.shop or { tab = "Passes" }
	local activeTab: string = (ctx.state.shop.tab == "Darrels") and "Darrels" or "Passes"

	----------------------------------------------------------- root
	local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
	wrapper.Name = "ShopPanel"
	wrapper.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wrapper.ZIndex = 10

	----------------------------------------------------------- header (common shell, README §3) -- gold, money surface
	local header = UI.surface(panelCol, UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, HEADER_H), "gold", T.radius.panel, T.stroke.panel)
	header.Name = "Header"

	header.ZIndex = 12
	UI.gloss(header, T.radius.panel)
	UI.hardShadow(header, T.shadowOffset.panel, T.radius.panel)

	local iconPlate = UI.surface(header, UDim2.fromOffset(62, 62), "goldSmall", T.radius.small, T.stroke.control)
	iconPlate.Name = "SectionIconPlate"
	iconPlate.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	iconPlate.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0)
	iconPlate.ZIndex = header.ZIndex + 1
	UI.gloss(iconPlate, T.radius.small)

	-- the kit's own "shops" vector art; money-bag glyph (render-proven, see
	-- GameHUDClient's GLYPH table) only if IconArt is missing entirely

		headerArt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	else
		local glyph = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		glyph.TextSize = 34
		glyph.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		glyph.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center

		glyph:SetAttribute("NoPolish", true)

	local headerTitle = UI.label(header, "Shop", "panelTitle", T.color.white)

	closeBtn.Name = "CloseButton"

	body.Name = "Body"

	body.ZIndex = 12

	----------------------------------------------------------- tabs (GoalsPanel pattern, two-wide)

	passScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
