	passScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	passScroll.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never
	passScroll.ZIndex = 14
	passScroll.Parent = body

	local passList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	passList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	passList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	passList.Padding = UDim.new(0, ROW_GAP)
	passList.Parent = passScroll

	local darrelContent = Instance.new("Frame")
	darrelContent.Name = "DarrelCards"
	darrelContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TAB_H + CONTENT_GAP)
	darrelContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CONTENT_H)
	darrelContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	darrelContent.ZIndex = 14
	darrelContent.Parent = body

	----------------------------------------------------------- shared bits
	local function clearGui(container: Instance)
		-- rows/cards (and their hardShadow siblings) are all GuiObjects; the
		-- UIListLayout survives, PassPanel's clearRow convention
		for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
				c:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local function centreLabel(l: TextLabel, parentZ: number)
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		l.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	----------------------------------------------------------- Darrels tab
	local function renderPacks()
		clearGui(darrelContent)
		local totalW = #packs * CARD_W + math.max(#packs - 1, 0) * CARD_GAP

			-- comment for the failure mode this sidesteps

			card.Name = "PackCard" .. tostring(pack.Amount)

	----------------------------------------------------------- tab switching
	local function applyTab()
		passScroll.Visible = (activeTab == "Passes")
		darrelContent.Visible = (activeTab == "Darrels")
		for id, ring in pairs(tabRings) do
			ring.Visible = (id == activeTab)
		end
	end

	local function setTab(id: string)
		if activeTab == id then
			return
		end
		activeTab = id
		ctx.state.shop.tab = id
		applyTab()
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- data refresh
	-- ShopState if it exists (server truth for ownership + real pack ids);
	-- otherwise the documented client-only fallback. Yields -- always called
	-- from a spawned thread, single-flighted so an open-spam can't stack
	-- invokes.
	local refreshing = false
	local function refresh()
		if refreshing then
			return
		end
		refreshing = true
		local remote = shopStateRemote
		if remote then
			local ok, res = pcall(function()
				return remote:InvokeServer()
			end)
			if ok and typeof(res) == "table" then
				if typeof(res.Owned) == "table" then
					local set: { [string]: boolean } = {}
					for k, v in pairs(res.Owned) do
						if typeof(k) == "string" and v == true then
							set[k] = true
						end
					end
					owned = set
				end
				if typeof(res.Packs) == "table" then
					local list = {}
					for _, p in ipairs(res.Packs) do
						if typeof(p) == "table" and typeof(p.Amount) == "number" and typeof(p.ProductId) == "number" then
							table.insert(list, { Amount = p.Amount, ProductId = p.ProductId })
						end
					end
					if #list > 0 then
						packs = list
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- fallback: ask Roblox directly, but only about passes that exist
			-- (GamepassId > 0 -- zero calls in today's all-zero build), pcall'd
			-- exactly like GamepassService.refresh server-side
			for _, g in ipairs(GamepassConfig.List) do
				if g.GamepassId > 0 and not owned[g.Key] then
					local ok, has = pcall(function()
						return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, g.GamepassId)
					end)
					if ok and has == true then
						owned[g.Key] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
		refreshing = false
		renderPasses()
		renderPacks()
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------- wiring
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctx.closePanel()
	end)
	for id, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			setTab(id)
		end)
	end

	-- Mid-session purchase: flip owned locally on the client's own
	-- wasPurchased signal -- the one sanctioned non-server write, mirroring
	-- GamepassService.Init's identical cache update. (ByGamepassId can only
	-- match a REAL id here: the event never fires with 0, and 0-id configs
	-- are additionally excluded by the > 0 guard.)
	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(plr, gamepassId, wasPurchased)
		if plr ~= player or not wasPurchased then
			return
		end
		local g = GamepassConfig.ByGamepassId(gamepassId)
		if g and g.GamepassId > 0 then
			owned[g.Key] = true
			renderPasses()
		end
	end)

	-- Bounded remote resolution (SettingsPanel/ToastClient convention), in its
	-- own thread so the lazy Build -- which runs inside openPanel -- never
	-- stalls the first open. ShopState does not exist in this build; when the
	-- proposed server patch lands, this picks it up with no client edit.
	task.spawn(function()
		local inst = ctx.remotes:WaitForChild("ShopState", 5)
		if inst and inst:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
			shopStateRemote = inst
			refresh()
		end
	end)

	-- Re-check ownership/packs every time the panel becomes visible (mirrors
	-- PassPanel's open-time SeasonState refresh) -- covers the very first open
	-- and every reopen after a purchase elsewhere.
	wrapper:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if wrapper.Visible then
			task.spawn(refresh)
		end
	end)

	applyTab()
	renderPasses() -- initial paint from GamepassConfig + the pack mirror:
	renderPacks() -- correct TODAY (everything id-0 -> COMING SOON) with no server round trip

	return wrapper
end

return ShopPanel


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GianlucaClient.client.lua =====
-- GianlucaClient: "find the Secret Chim" questline. Hold E at Gianluca to talk;
-- he sends you to find the Chim hidden in the map; taking it grants the Chim; then
-- you bring it BACK to him and he trades you a Key for it.
-- Quest stages mirror data.ChimQuest: 0 not started, 1 searching, 2 holding the Chim,
-- 3 handed over and Key claimed.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local MerchantDialog = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MerchantDialog)

local talkRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("GianlucaTalk")
local stateRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("GianlucaState")
local GOLD = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 216, 96), Color3.fromRGB(238, 148, 24) }

local questState = 0

-- Whether an UNPLACED Chim is in the inventory right now. Read from the data
-- snapshot rather than inferred from questState: a Chim can arrive by routes the
-- quest never sees (trade, test grant), and the server gates the handover on
-- possession too, so this keeps the dialogue honest about what he'll accept.
local hasChim = false
local dataRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("DataUpdated")
dataRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot)
	if typeof(snapshot) ~= "table" or typeof(snapshot.Brainrots) ~= "table" then return end
	local found = false
	for _, e in ipairs(snapshot.Brainrots) do
		if e.Name == "Chim" and e.PadIndex == nil then found = true break end
	end
	hasChim = found
end)

-- talk prompt on Gianluca
task.spawn(function()
	local gw = Workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
	local gia = gw:WaitForChild("StupidGianluca", 30)
	local hrp = gia and gia:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 30)
	local prompt = hrp and hrp:WaitForChild("TalkPrompt", 30)
	if not prompt then return end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		if hasChim then
			-- holding it: offer the trade whatever the stage says. The server
			-- re-checks possession, so this button can only ever ask.
			MerchantDialog.Show("Gianluca", {
				"MY CHIM!! You found it!! Give it back and I give you something better \u{2014} a KEY!",
			}, GOLD, function()
				talkRemote:FireServer("handover")
			end, hrp, "HAND OVER THE CHIM \u{25B6}")
		elseif questState >= 3 then
			MerchantDialog.Show("Gianluca", { "You found my Chim AND gave it back! GRAZIE, bambino!! Use that key well." }, GOLD, nil, hrp, "OK \u{25B6}")
		elseif questState == 1 then
			MerchantDialog.Show("Gianluca", { "Have you found my Chim yet?! It's out there somewhere!" }, GOLD, nil, hrp, "KEEP LOOKING \u{25B6}")
		else
			MerchantDialog.Show("Gianluca", { "ARRRGGGGHHHH!!!!! IM SO STUPID!! I CANT FIND MY SECRET CHIM!!" }, GOLD, function()
				talkRemote:FireServer()
			end, hrp, "HELP HIM FIND IT \u{25B6}")
		end
	end)
end)

-- quest state + reward feedback
stateRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return end
	questState = payload.State or questState
	if payload.Note == "key" then
		hasChim = false
		MerchantDialog.Show("Gianluca", {
			"MY CHIM!! GRAZIE, bambino!! Thank you thank you THANK YOU!!",
			"Here \u{2014} you take this KEY. Is heavy, is old, is yours now. It opens something, I forget what. \u{1F511}",
		}, GOLD, nil, nil, "TAKE THE KEY \u{25B6}")
	elseif payload.Note == "found" then
		MerchantDialog.Show("\u{2728} SECRET CHIM \u{2728}", {
			"You got the SECRET CHIM! A Mythic brainrot, and the only one of its kind. Take it back to Gianluca \u{2014} he'll trade you a KEY for it.",
		}, GOLD, nil, nil, "AWESOME! \u{25B6}")
		local chim = Workspace.GameWorld:FindFirstChild("SecretChim")
		if chim then
			chim.Transparency = 1
			for _, d in ipairs(chim:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then d.Enabled = false
				elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then d.Enabled = false
				elseif d:IsA("PointLight") then d.Enabled = false end
			end
		end
	elseif payload.Note == "hint" then
		MerchantDialog.Show("\u{2728} Secret Chim", {
			"Someone must be looking for this shiny thing... maybe ask around the camp?",
		}, GOLD, nil, nil, "OK \u{25B6}")
	end
end)

-- gentle bob + spin so the chim reads as a collectible
task.spawn(function()
	local chim = Workspace.GameWorld:WaitForChild("SecretChim", 30)
	if not chim then return end
	local base = chim.Position
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not chim.Parent or chim.Transparency >= 1 then return end
		local t = os.clock()
		chim.CFrame = CFrame.new(base.X, base.Y + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.35, base.Z) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), t * 0.8, 0)
	end)
end)

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/IndexClient.client.lua =====
-- Brainrot Index: browse every brainrot grouped by rarity; locked until you catch one.
--
-- This panel is now the game's honesty surface for VALUE. Three things it must
-- never fudge:
--   1. AVAILABILITY. 214 names are authored, ~67 are catchable this wave. An
--      entry you simply have not caught yet and an entry the game has not
--      released look completely different, because only the first is something
--      the player can go and do.
--   2. SUPPLY. Exists counts and mint serials come from the server's MintRegistry
--      and are shown ONLY when it actually answered -- a cold registry hides the
--      line rather than printing a confident "0 exist".
--   3. PRICE. The camp price is the median of what players ACTUALLY PAID at the
--      stalls in the last 7 days, carries its sample count, and is never dressed
--      up as an official value.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MainUI")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local BrainrotConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotConfig)
local RarityConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RarityConfig)
local Waves = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotWaves)
local SupplySchedule = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SupplySchedule)
local Mutations = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.MutationConfig)
local UITheme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UITheme)
local SideRail = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SideRail)
local BrainrotLooks = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotLooks)
local BodyBuilder = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.BrainrotBodyBuilder)

local P = UITheme.Palette
local CF = UITheme.Camp
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
local FONT = UITheme.Font
local discovered = {}
-- [name] = { Mult, Mutation, Serial } for the single copy of that name worth
-- quoting: rarest mutation you own, ties broken by the lowest (earliest) serial.
local ownedByName = {}

-- was capped at M, so a Secret earning 9.99B/s rendered as "10000.0M/s"
local shorten = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat).Short
local function blackRim(o, thick)
	for _, s in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then
			s.Color = BLACK; s.Thickness = thick or 3; s.Transparency = 0
		end
	end
end
local function inkText(o, thick)
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	st.Color = BLACK; st.Thickness = thick or 2; st.Transparency = 0.05
	st.Parent = o
	return st
end

-- ======================= the roster, flattened once =======================
-- The list is flattened at require time in RarityConfig order, so paging is a
-- pair of indices rather than a re-scan, and the per-tier tallies never have to
-- be recounted while the player flicks through pages.
local ordered = {}                 -- { { E = entry, Tier = tier }, ... }
local tierTotal, tierLive = {}, {}

local AV_LIVE, AV_SOON, AV_VAULTED = 1, 2, 3

-- Supply status comes from SupplySchedule (clock-pure: the same answer the
-- server computes), refined into the three visual buckets. "away this week"
-- and "retired forever" mean OPPOSITE things to a player -- one is a schedule,
-- the other makes an owned copy worth MORE -- so the manual VAULTED override
-- is still read directly and never conflated with the tide.
local function availabilityOf(name)
	-- quest-reward-only items (e.g. Maxwell) are never catchable via a throw -- their only
	-- source is the quest grant. Never show them as "live" or count them as CATCHABLE.
	if Waves.QUEST_ONLY and Waves.QUEST_ONLY[name] then return AV_VAULTED, "quest", nil end
	if Waves.VAULTED and Waves.VAULTED[name] then return AV_VAULTED, "vaulted", nil end
	if Waves.FORCE_ON and Waves.FORCE_ON[name] then
		return AV_LIVE, SupplySchedule.CAPPED[name] and "capped" or "live", nil
	end
	local status, ts = SupplySchedule.StatusOf(name)
	if status == "vaulted" then return AV_VAULTED, status, ts end
	if status == "away" or status == "unreleased" then return AV_SOON, status, ts end
	return AV_LIVE, status or "live", ts
end

-- "3d 4h" / "5h 12m" / "42m" -- countdowns, never weekday names: every flip is
-- a Monday-00:00-UTC instant, so a weekday label would read "MON" forever and
-- actively mislead on Mondays. Server-synced clock, immune to device skew.
local function deltaText(ts)
	local left = math.max(0, math.floor(ts - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
	local d = math.floor(left / 86400)
	local h = math.floor(left % 86400 / 3600)
	if d > 0 then return d .. "d " .. h .. "h" end
	local m = math.floor(left % 3600 / 60)
	if h > 0 then return h .. "h " .. m .. "m" end
	return m .. "m"
end

-- Sold-out counts for capped names: server truth (LimitedStock), fetched
-- lazily on Index open and at most once a minute. nil until the first answer
-- arrives -- the copy below never does arithmetic on an unknown count.
local supplySnap, supplySnapAt = nil, 0
local function refreshSupplySnap()
	if os.clock() - supplySnapAt < 60 then return end
	supplySnapAt = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, snap = pcall(function()
			return remotes.GetSupplySnapshot:InvokeServer()
		end)
		if ok and type(snap) == "table" then supplySnap = snap end
	end)
end

do
	local byRarity = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
		byRarity[e.Rarity] = byRarity[e.Rarity] or {}
		table.insert(byRarity[e.Rarity], e)
	end
	for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
		local entries = byRarity[tier.Name]
		tierTotal[tier.Name] = entries and #entries or 0
		tierLive[tier.Name] = 0
		if entries then
			for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
				ordered[#ordered + 1] = { E = e, Tier = tier }
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Availability is TIME-VARYING now (weekly tide, seasonal vault), so the live
-- tallies and the "catchable only" view refresh whenever the schedule period
-- turns -- keyed, so the common case (same week) costs one string compare.
-- orderedLive keeps its table identity: it is captured by the pager handlers.
local orderedLive = {}
local LIVE_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT = 0, #ordered
local lastPeriodKey = nil
local function refreshAvailability()
	local key = SupplySchedule.PeriodKey() .. "#" .. Waves.OverrideKey()
	if key == lastPeriodKey then return end
	lastPeriodKey = key
	table.clear(orderedLive)
	for _, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do tierLive[tier.Name] = 0 end
	for _, rec in ipairs(ordered) do
		if availabilityOf(rec.E.Name) == AV_LIVE then
			orderedLive[#orderedLive + 1] = rec
			tierLive[rec.Tier.Name] += 1
		end
	end
	LIVE_COUNT = Waves.Counts()
end
refreshAvailability()

---------------------------------------------------------------- supply + price
-- Exists counts (MintRegistry) and camp prices (PriceIndex) are server-side, so
-- they arrive over ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.GetItemStats. Two rules keep that
-- from becoming a firehose:
--   * ONE batched invoke per rendered page, never one call per row;
--   * a client cache, so paging back to a page you have already seen -- or just
--     scrolling it -- asks the server for nothing at all.
local statsRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("GetItemStats")
local statsCache = {}      -- [key] = { At = os.clock(), D = payload }
local statsMeta = { WindowDays = 7, MinSamples = 5 }   -- replaced by the server's real tuning
local POS_TTL = 90         -- the server answered with real numbers
local NEG_TTL = 15         -- it answered, but the mint registry was still cold
local inFlight = false
local pageRows = {}        -- rows of the CURRENT render, for in-place patching
local buildGen = 0         -- bumped per render, so a late reply cannot patch dead rows

local function statKey(name, mutation)
	return name .. "|" .. (mutation or "")
end

local function cacheFresh(key)
	local c = statsCache[key]
	if not c then return false end
	-- a tracked class that came back without numbers means the registry was cold and
	-- has now kicked off its own read, so it is worth asking again sooner
	local ttl = (c.D and c.D.Tracked and c.D.Minted == nil) and NEG_TTL or POS_TTL
	return (os.clock() - c.At) < ttl
end

local function hex(c)
	return ("#%02X%02X%02X"):format(
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255),
		math.clamp(math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255))
end
local function tint(color, s)
	return '<font color="' .. hex(color) .. '">' .. s .. '</font>'
end
local SEP = '<font color="#8A7A6C">   \u{00B7}   </font>'

-- One line of hard numbers per row. EVERY piece is optional: when the server has
-- not answered, or the class genuinely has no data, the piece is omitted rather
-- than printed as a zero. "0 EXIST" and "PAID $0" are far worse than silence.
local function statsText(key, owned)
	local parts = {}

	if owned and type(owned.Serial) == "number" then
		local col = (owned.Mutation and Mutations.Color(owned.Mutation)) or CF.amber1
		local tag = owned.Mutation
			and ("%s #%d"):format(string.upper(owned.Mutation), owned.Serial)
			or ("#%d"):format(owned.Serial)
		parts[#parts + 1] = tint(col, tag)
	end

	local cached = statsCache[key]
	local d = cached and cached.D
	if d then
		if d.Tracked and type(d.Exists) == "number" then
			parts[#parts + 1] = tint(CF.lake1, ("%s EXIST"):format(shorten(d.Exists)))
		end
		if type(d.Price) == "number" then
			-- PAID, never "value": the sample count travels with the number so a
			-- player can argue with it instead of trusting it.
			parts[#parts + 1] = tint(CF.pine1, ("PAID $%s (%d sales/%dd)"):format(
				shorten(d.Price), d.Samples or 0, statsMeta.WindowDays))
		elseif (d.Samples or 0) > 0 then
			parts[#parts + 1] = tint(CF.muted, ("PAID: %d of %d sales needed"):format(
				d.Samples, statsMeta.MinSamples))
		end
	end

	return table.concat(parts, SEP)
end

local function applyStats()
	for _, row in ipairs(pageRows) do
		if row.Label.Parent then
			local txt = statsText(row.Key, row.Owned)
			row.Label.Text = txt
			row.Label.Visible = txt ~= ""
		end
	end
	footnote.Text = ("PAID = %d-day median of what players really paid \u{00B7} EXIST = copies still alive")
		:format(statsMeta.WindowDays)
end

local function fetchStats()
	if inFlight or not frame.Visible then return end
	local reqs, seen = {}, {}
	for _, row in ipairs(pageRows) do
		if not seen[row.Key] and not cacheFresh(row.Key) then
			seen[row.Key] = true
			reqs[#reqs + 1] = { Name = row.Name, Mutation = row.Mutation }
		end
	end
	if #reqs == 0 then return end

	inFlight = true
	local gen = buildGen
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, map, meta = pcall(function()
			return statsRemote:InvokeServer(reqs)
		end)
		inFlight = false
		-- A throttled call still succeeds and returns nil, which must NOT be cached as
		-- "no data" -- it just means ask again later.
		if not ok or typeof(map) ~= "table" then return end
		if typeof(meta) == "table" then
			statsMeta.WindowDays = tonumber(meta.WindowDays) or statsMeta.WindowDays
			statsMeta.MinSamples = tonumber(meta.MinSamples) or statsMeta.MinSamples
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		for key, payload in pairs(map) do
			if typeof(payload) == "table" then
				statsCache[key] = { At = now, D = payload }
			end
		end
		-- the cache is always updated; only the LABELS need the generation guard
		if gen == buildGen then applyStats() end
	end)
end

-- The rarest copy you own is the one worth quoting, and among equals the earliest
-- mint is. Recomputed whole rather than patched, because a trade or a fusion can
-- remove the copy that was previously the best.
local function recomputeOwned(brainrots)
	ownedByName = {}
	if typeof(brainrots) ~= "table" then return end
	for _, b in ipairs(brainrots) do
		if type(b) == "table" and type(b.Name) == "string" then
			local mult = Mutations.Mult(b.Mutation)
			local cur = ownedByName[b.Name]
			local better
			if not cur then
				better = true
			elseif mult > cur.Mult then
				better = true
			elseif mult == cur.Mult and type(b.Serial) == "number" then
				better = (type(cur.Serial) ~= "number") or (b.Serial < cur.Serial)
			end
			if better then
				ownedByName[b.Name] = { Mult = mult, Mutation = b.Mutation, Serial = b.Serial }
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- thumbnails
-- One master model per name per session: Build() assembles a few dozen
-- primitives, and paging back to a page you have already seen must not pay
-- that again. Masters stay UNPARENTED; every viewport gets a CLONE, because a
-- card dies with its page render and would take a shared model down with it.
local SILHOUETTE = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
-- front-quarter, slightly above; bodies stand on Y=0 facing -Z
local THUMB_DIR = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.45, -1).Unit
local thumbCache = {}   -- [name] = master Model, or false for "no recipe"

-- Viewports only draw BaseParts, but a real model also carries emitters, prompts,
-- billboards and sounds. Those render nothing and just make every clone heavier, so the
-- master is stripped once and all clones inherit the saving.
local KEEP = { BasePart = true, Model = true, Folder = true }
local function stripForViewport(model)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		local keep = d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("Folder")
			or d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("Decal")
		if not keep then d:Destroy() end
	end
	return model
end

-- Prefer the REAL model over a recipe.
--
-- BrainrotLooks was generated for an older roster and matches none of the current names,
-- so the recipe path silently produced nothing and every entry fell back to the flat
-- swatch -- which is why no silhouettes were showing. ReplicatedStorage.BrainrotModels
-- holds a real model for 149 of the 150 entries, and a real model is a truer silhouette
-- than a preset body anyway. The recipe stays as a fallback for anything without a model.
local modelFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BrainrotModels")

local function thumbModel(name)
	if thumbCache[name] == nil then
		local built
		local real = modelFolder and modelFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if real then
			built = stripForViewport(real:Clone())
		else
			local recipe = BrainrotLooks[name]
			built = recipe and BodyBuilder.Build(name, recipe) or nil
		end
		-- false, not nil: a name with neither a model nor a recipe must not re-run
		-- the lookup on every render
		thumbCache[name] = built or false
	end
	return thumbCache[name] or nil
end

-- Returns true only when a viewport was actually added, so the caller can keep
-- the old flat swatch as the fallback for names without a recipe yet.
local function addThumb(parent, name, silhouette)
	local master = thumbModel(name)
	if not master then return false end

	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1   -- the sunburst behind stays the tier read
	-- locked: sit UNDER the state glyph (16); known: take the dot's old slot
	vp.ZIndex = silhouette and 15 or 16
	vp.Parent = parent

	local m = master:Clone()
	if silhouette then
		-- EVERY part goes near-black, eyes included: a locked entry may tease
		-- its shape but never its colours, and white eyes would light up the
		-- shadow and half-reveal the face
		for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Color = SILHOUETTE end
		end
	end
	m.Parent = vp

	-- distance from the real bounding box, not a constant: the recipe Size
	-- field scales bodies far apart and a fixed distance would crop the big
	-- ones and shrink the small ones to a dot
	local cf, ext = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(ext.X, ext.Y, ext.Z) / (2 * math.tan(math.rad(15))) + ext.Z * 0.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 30
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + THUMB_DIR * dist, cf.Position)
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam

	return true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- build rows
-- PAGING IS NOT COSMETIC. The roster is 214 entries, and one card is an
-- accentCard (2 frames, gradient, 2 strokes) plus a sunburst icon and four
-- labels -- call it ~4,000 Instances if the whole roster is built in one frame,
-- which visibly hitches on a phone. A page is ~20 cards, built on demand.
local PAGE_SIZE = 20
local page = 1
local catchableOnly = false

local DIM_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(120, 108, 98)
local COLD_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(118, 126, 142)

---------------------------------------------------------------- tile grid
-- One scrolling sheet of tiles, no pages: the tile IS the entry, so name, rarity
-- and silhouette live on the tile and nothing else is drawn beside it.
--
-- VIEWPORTS ARE VIRTUALISED. 150 tiles is cheap (a frame and two labels each), but
-- 150 live ViewportFrames is not -- each renders its own scene, and the models
-- average 12.5 parts. So every tile gets a shell up front and only tiles inside the
-- scroll window (plus a margin) are given a viewport; ones that scroll away have
-- theirs destroyed. Live viewports stay bounded no matter how long the roster gets.
local VIS_MARGIN = 0.6          -- extra screens of tiles kept alive above and below

local tiles = {}                -- [i] = { frame, holder, name, live }
local gridCols = 1

local function fillTile(t, rec)
	if t.live then return end
	local e = rec.E
	local known = discovered[e.Name] == true
	if addThumb(t.holder, e.Name, not known) then t.live = true end
end

local function clearTile(t)
	if not t.live then return end
	for _, c in ipairs(t.holder:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	t.live = false
end

local function updateVisible()
	if #tiles == 0 then return end
	local viewH = list.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if viewH <= 0 then return end
	local top = list.CanvasPosition.Y - viewH * VIS_MARGIN
	local bottom = list.CanvasPosition.Y + viewH * (1 + VIS_MARGIN)
	local rowH = CELL_H + CELL_PAD
	for i, t in ipairs(tiles) do
		local row = math.floor((i - 1) / gridCols)
		local y0 = row * rowH
		if y0 + CELL_H >= top and y0 <= bottom then
			fillTile(t, t.rec)
		else
			clearTile(t)
		end
	end
end

-- Scrolling is the whole point of virtualising, so listen for it. Resizes matter too:
-- a narrower window changes the column count, which changes every tile's row.
list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(updateVisible)
list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
	local cols = math.max(1, math.floor((list.AbsoluteSize.X + CELL_PAD) / (CELL_W + CELL_PAD)))
	if cols ~= gridCols then gridCols = cols end
	updateVisible()
end)

local function buildList()
	buildGen += 1
	pageRows = {}
	tiles = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end

	refreshAvailability()
	local found = 0
	for _, rec in ipairs(ordered) do
		if discovered[rec.E.Name] then found += 1 end
	end

	local source = catchableOnly and orderedLive or ordered

	counter.Text = ("%d CATCHABLE  /  %d KNOWN      \u{00B7}      %d FOUND")
		:format(LIVE_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT, found)
	-- [index-badges] header tide countdown
	tideLbl.Text = "TIDE CHANGES IN " .. deltaText(SupplySchedule.NextChange())
	pageLabel.Text = ("%d SHOWN"):format(#source)
	filterLabel.Text = catchableOnly
		and ("CATCHABLE ONLY (%d)"):format(LIVE_COUNT)
		or ("SHOWING ALL (%d)"):format(TOTAL_COUNT)
	UITheme.setColors(filterBtn,
		catchableOnly and CF.pine1 or CF.wood1,
		catchableOnly and CF.pine2 or CF.wood2)

	list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	gridCols = math.max(1, math.floor((list.AbsoluteSize.X + CELL_PAD) / (CELL_W + CELL_PAD)))

	for i, rec in ipairs(source) do
		local tier, e = rec.Tier, rec.E
		local known = discovered[e.Name] == true
		local av, avStatus, avTs = availabilityOf(e.Name)
		-- [egg-badge] egg-sourced creatures carry no tide state; the FOREST EGG
		-- badge below stands in for the availability badge for them.
		local isEggSourced = e.Source == "ForestEgg"

		-- rarity colour still carries availability: warm = catchable, cold = unreleased,
		-- berry = vaulted and never coming back
		local accent
		if known then
			accent = (av == AV_VAULTED) and tier.Color:Lerp(CF.berry1, 0.45) or tier.Color
		elseif av == AV_LIVE then
			accent = tier.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(104, 92, 82), 0.5)
		elseif av == AV_VAULTED then
			accent = tier.Color:Lerp(CF.berry2, 0.6)
		else
			accent = tier.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(66, 74, 88), 0.78)
		end

		local tile = Instance.new("Frame")
		tile.Name = "Tile" .. i
		tile.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CELL_W, CELL_H)
		tile.LayoutOrder = i
		tile.BackgroundColor3 = known and Color3.fromRGB(46, 44, 52) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 29, 35)
		tile.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tile.ClipsDescendants = true
		tile.ZIndex = 11
		tile.Parent = list
		UITheme.corner(tile, 12)
		UITheme.ink(tile, 3)

		-- tier wash behind the silhouette, so the grid still reads by rarity at a glance
		local wash = Instance.new("Frame")
		wash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		wash.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		wash.BackgroundTransparency = known and 0.72 or 0.86
		wash.BorderSizePixel = 0
		wash.ZIndex = 11
		wash.Parent = tile

		nameCap.Parent = nameLbl

		rarLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
		rarLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -22)
		rarLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rarLbl.Font = FONT
		rarLbl.TextSize = 14
		rarLbl.TextScaled = true
		rarLbl.TextColor3 = accent
		rarLbl.Text = string.upper(tier.Name)
		local rarCap = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		rarCap.MaxTextSize = 14
		rarCap.Parent = rarLbl

		if avTs and not isEggSourced then

			end

		tiles[i] = { frame = tile, holder = holder, rec = rec, live = false }
	end

	-- populate whatever is on screen right now
	task.defer(updateVisible)
end

local function setOpen(open)
	frame.Visible = open
	if open then
		local shop = gui:FindFirstChild("ShopFrame")
		local sell = gui:FindFirstChild("SellFrame")
		if shop then shop.Visible = false end
		if sell then sell.Visible = false end
		refreshSupplySnap()   -- cap badges: lazy, throttled to one fetch a minute
		buildList()
	end
end

openBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setOpen(not frame.Visible) end)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setOpen(false) end)

prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if page > 1 then
		page -= 1
		buildList()
	end
end)

nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local source = catchableOnly and orderedLive or ordered
	if page < math.max(1, math.ceil(#source / PAGE_SIZE)) then
		page += 1
		buildList()
	end
end)

filterBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	page = 1   -- page 4 of the full roster is nowhere near page 4 of the live one
	buildList()
end)

local function applySnapshot(snap)
	if typeof(snap) ~= "table" then return end
	local changed = false
	if snap.Discovered then
		discovered = snap.Discovered
		changed = true
	end
	if snap.Brainrots then
		-- serials live on the player's own copies, so the value line needs the
		-- inventory as well as the discovery set
		recomputeOwned(snap.Brainrots)
		changed = true
	end
	if changed and frame.Visible then buildList() end
end

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function() return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok then applySnapshot(snap) end
end)
remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(applySnapshot)

-- [index-badges] the supply snapshot is fetched async on first open, landing
-- just AFTER that open's render; re-render once on first arrival so capped
-- tiles pick up their MINTED badge without waiting for the next data push.
task.spawn(function()
	while supplySnap == nil do
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	if frame.Visible then buildList() end
end)

-- Exists counts and camp prices move while the panel is open, and a class whose
-- registry was cold on the first ask usually answers on the second. This poll is
-- a no-op whenever the panel is shut or the page is fully cached, so it costs
-- nothing in the common case.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(12)
		if frame.Visible then fetchStats() end
	end
end)

buildList()

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/LakeAmbience.client.lua =====
-- LakeAmbience: one always-on water bed at the valley lake.
--
-- POSITIONAL, not global (2D), and that is a deliberate split from WeatherClient,
-- whose beds ARE global. Weather is global -- rain falls on the whole map -- but
-- water is a PLACE. Two reasons this has to fall off with distance:
--   1. The playable world is three islands ~8000 studs apart (valley lake, the
--      trading island, the frozen tundra). A 2D bed would follow the player to
--      the tundra and play lake water over a snowfield.
--   2. Inside the valley, the camps sit at z ~ -113 and the dock at z ~ 22. Your
--      campfire should not sound like you are standing on the shoreline.
--
-- Client-side: it is per-player furniture, nothing replicates, and it costs the
-- server nothing. SoundKit owns the id; the SFX slider drives the level through
-- OnSfxVolume, because a long-lived loop is not an M.play clone and would
-- otherwise ignore the slider completely.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundKit = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SoundKit"))

local VOLUME = 0.10   -- under the 0.15 music bed: furniture beneath furniture
local FADE   = 2.0    -- slightly faster than music's 3.0 so arrival is not silent
local RANGE  = 150    -- dock (z~22) to camp (z~-113) is ~135 studs: present on the
                      -- shore, gone at the campfire

local gameWorld = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")

-- Anchor on the dock if it is there, else the throw zone, else the lake centre.
-- Never errors out of existence: a missing dock costs the bed its position, not
-- its life.
local function anchorPosition()
	local dock = gameWorld:FindFirstChild("SkipDock")
	if dock then
		local ok, cf = pcall(function() return dock:GetPivot() end)
		if ok and cf then return cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 40) end
	end
	local zone = gameWorld:FindFirstChild("ThrowZone")
	if zone then return zone.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 40) end
	return Vector3.new(0, 2, 120)   -- open water up the lake
end

local host = Instance.new("Part")
host.Name = "LakeAmbienceHost"
host.Anchored = true
host.CanCollide = false
host.CanQuery = false
host.CanTouch = false
host.Transparency = 1
host.Size = Vector3.one
host.CFrame = CFrame.new(anchorPosition())
host.Parent = workspace

local bed = Instance.new("Sound")
bed.Name = "LakeBed"
bed.SoundId = SoundKit.Ids.ambienceShore1   -- water on a beach, 8.53s loop
bed.Looped = true
bed.Volume = 0
bed.RollOffMaxDistance = RANGE
bed.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
bed:SetAttribute("BaseVolume", VOLUME)
bed.Parent = host
bed:Play()

-- Level is written DIRECTLY, never tweened. The fade is a short stepped loop
-- instead: one authority over this Sound's Volume means a slider moving mid-fade
-- simply retargets the loop rather than racing a tween that would finish later
-- and overwrite it.
local scale = SoundKit.SfxScale and SoundKit.SfxScale() or 1
local target = VOLUME * scale
local fadeToken = 0

local function setLevel(v, fadeSeconds)
	target = v
	fadeToken += 1
	local myToken = fadeToken
	if not fadeSeconds or fadeSeconds <= 0 then
		bed.Volume = target
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local from = bed.Volume
		local steps = math.max(1, math.floor(fadeSeconds / 0.05))
		for i = 1, steps do
			if myToken ~= fadeToken or not bed.Parent then return end
			bed.Volume = from + (target - from) * (i / steps)
			task.wait(fadeSeconds / steps)
		end
		if myToken == fadeToken and bed.Parent then bed.Volume = target end
	end)
end

setLevel(VOLUME * scale, FADE)

-- Live slider control. Fires once on registration too, so a level restored from a
-- saved profile lands even if it arrives after this script has already faded in.
SoundKit.OnSfxVolume(function(v)
	scale = v
	setLevel(VOLUME * v, 0.15)
end)

-- Transparent Luck HUD: shows total luck multiplier; tap to expand the source breakdown

local RebirthConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local OfferingConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("OfferingConfig"))
local BrainrotConfig = require(modules:WaitForChild("BrainrotConfig"))

local CF = UITheme.Camp

local rockById = {}
for _, rock in ipairs(RockConfig) do rockById[rock.Id] = rock end

-- Pets that buff throw luck while PLACED (BrainrotConfig.LuckMult). Same rule as
-- ThrowHandler's petLuckByName -- keep the two in sync or this panel starts lying.
local petLuckByName = {}
for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do
	if e.LuckMult then petLuckByName[e.Name] = e.LuckMult end
end

local state = { EquippedRock = "Pebble", Upgrades = {}, Rebirths = 0, Offerings = 0, Brainrots = {} }

-- =====================================================================
-- LUCK IS TWO SEPARATE SYSTEMS NOW (ServerScriptService.Modules.ThrowHandler).
-- This panel used to show one "TOTAL" that multiplied all four sources together,
-- which is no longer true of anything the server does:
--
--   RARITY luck  -- shifts WHICH BRAINROT you catch.
--     accessLuck = rock x Lucky Charm x Offerings x placed-pets x (perfect ? 1.075 : 1)
--     Distance UNLOCKS higher tiers and weights the odds; accessLuck shifts the
--     RarityCurve toward the top. Nothing is guaranteed. REBIRTH LUCK IS NOT IN THIS.
--
--   MUTATION luck -- decides whether it comes out Golden / Diamond.
--     boost = WeatherMut x clamp(rebirthLuck x weatherLuck, 1, 6)
--     passed straight into Mutations.Roll(boost, weatherName).
--
-- Rebirth luck moved from the first to the second. Showing it as "luck" next to
-- the rock would tell a player their rebirths buy tier access; they do not.
-- =====================================================================

-- Mirrors of ThrowHandler's constants. Duplicated rather than shared because a
-- LocalScript cannot require ServerScriptService -- if ThrowHandler retunes these,
-- this panel starts lying, so they are listed together and named identically.
local PERFECT_DISTANCE_MULT = 1.1
local PERFECT_LUCK_MULT = 1.075
local MAX_TOTAL_DISTANCE = 900
local PROMO_DIVISOR = 4.0     -- promoChance = clamp((accessLuck - 1) / this, 0, cap)
local PROMO_MAX = 0.90
local PROMO_DECAY = 0.45      -- each further promotion is this much likelier to fail
local MAX_PROMOTIONS = 3
local MUT_BOOST_CAP = 6       -- clamp(rebirthLuck * weatherLuck, 1, 6)

-- same descending scan as RarityRoll.TierIndexForDistance: the HIGHEST tier whose
-- MinDistance your raw throw clears. (Kept as a scan, not a table, so a retuned
-- RarityConfig needs no change here.)
local function tierIndexForDistance(distance)
	for i = #RarityConfig, 1, -1 do
		if distance >= RarityConfig[i].MinDistance then return i end
	end
	return 1
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "LuckHUD"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 7
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local chip = Instance.new("TextButton")

local chipLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

local function clearRows()
	for _, child in ipairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	rowCount = 0
end

local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(128, 110, 94)

local function spacerRow()
	local sp = addRow("", "")
	sp.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 6)
	return sp
end

-- a short muted caption under a section heading
local function noteRow(text)
	local r = addRow(text, "", CF.muted, CF.muted)
	r.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 15)
	return r
end

local function refresh()
	local rock = rockById[state.EquippedRock] or rockById["Pebble"]
	local upgradeLuck = UpgradeConfig.Mult(state.Upgrades, "Luck")
	local offeringLuck = OfferingConfig.LuckMult(state.Offerings or 0)
	local petLuck = 1
	for _, e in ipairs(state.Brainrots or {}) do
		if e.PadIndex and petLuckByName[e.Name] then petLuck *= petLuckByName[e.Name] end
	end
	local rebirthLuck = RebirthConfig.LuckMult(state.Rebirths or 0)
	local weatherLuck = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("WeatherLuck") or 1
	local weatherMut = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("WeatherMut") or 1

	-- RARITY luck == ThrowHandler's accessLuck, minus the perfect bonus (which is
	-- per-throw, so it gets its own row instead of being folded into the headline).
	local rarityLuck = rock.Luck * upgradeLuck * offeringLuck * petLuck
	-- MUTATION luck == the boost ThrowHandler hands Mutations.Roll.
	local rebirthWeather = math.clamp(rebirthLuck * weatherLuck, 1, MUT_BOOST_CAP)
	local mutBoost = weatherMut * rebirthWeather

	-- The chip shows RARITY luck: it is the number that decides what you catch, and
	-- multiplying it by the mutation boost would produce a figure the server never
	-- computes. (Chip styling is deliberately untouched -- see the note above.)
	chipLabel.Text = ("\u{1F340} Luck \u{00D7}%.2f"):format(rarityLuck)
	local boosted = rarityLuck > 1.0001 or mutBoost > 1.0001
	chipLabel.TextColor3 = boosted and P.cashText or P.text

	if not panel.Visible then return end
	clearRows()

	--=================== 1. what you catch ==============================--
	addRow("RARITY LUCK", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(rarityLuck), CF.amber1, CF.amber1, true)
	noteRow("which brainrot you catch")
	addRow("Rock (" .. rock.Id .. ")", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(rock.Luck))
	addRow("Lucky Charm upgrade", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(upgradeLuck))
	addRow("Offerings (" .. tostring(math.floor(state.Offerings or 0)) .. ")",
		("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(offeringLuck),
		offeringLuck > 1.0001 and CF.ember1 or nil,
		offeringLuck > 1.0001 and CF.ember1 or nil)
	if petLuck > 1.0001 then
		addRow("Pets on base", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(petLuck), CF.pine1, CF.pine1)
	end
	addRow("Perfect throw", ("\u{00D7}%.3f"):format(PERFECT_LUCK_MULT), CF.muted, CF.muted)

	spacerRow()

	--=================== 2. what it comes out as ========================--
	addRow("MUTATION LUCK", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(mutBoost), CF.berry1, CF.berry1, true)
	noteRow("golden / diamond odds")
	addRow("Rebirths (" .. tostring(math.floor(state.Rebirths or 0)) .. ")",
		("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(rebirthLuck),
		rebirthLuck > 1.0001 and CF.berry1 or nil,
		rebirthLuck > 1.0001 and CF.berry1 or nil)
	local weatherName = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("WeatherName")
	local wLabel = (weatherName and weatherName ~= "" and weatherName ~= "Clear") and ("Weather (" .. weatherName .. ")") or "Weather"
	addRow(wLabel, ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(weatherLuck), weatherLuck > 1 and CF.lake1 or nil, weatherLuck > 1 and CF.lake1 or nil)
	if weatherMut > 1.0001 then
		addRow("Event mutation", ("\u{00D7}%.2f"):format(weatherMut), CF.lake1, CF.lake1)
	end
	if rebirthLuck * weatherLuck > MUT_BOOST_CAP + 0.0001 then
		noteRow(("capped at \u{00D7}%d"):format(MUT_BOOST_CAP))
	end

	spacerRow()

	--=================== 3. your best throw's odds =====================--
	-- Distance = power x rock.MaxDistance x Power upgrade x rebirth power x (perfect 1.1),
	-- clamped to MAX_TOTAL_DISTANCE. At that best throw, RarityCurve turns distance + luck
	-- into a probability per tier -- the SAME curve the server rolls (RarityCurve).
	local bestDist = math.min(
		rock.MaxDistance
			* UpgradeConfig.Mult(state.Upgrades, "Power")
			* RebirthConfig.PowerMult(state.Rebirths or 0)
			* PERFECT_DISTANCE_MULT,
		MAX_TOTAL_DISTANCE)
	local bestLuck = rarityLuck * PERFECT_LUCK_MULT
	local probs = RarityCurve.Probabilities(bestDist, bestLuck)

	addRow("BEST THROW", ("%dm odds"):format(math.floor(bestDist)), CF.amber1, CF.amber1, true)
	noteRow("chance per catch at full power")
	for i, tier in ipairs(RarityConfig) do
		local pct = (probs[i] or 0) * 100
		local rightTxt, rightCol
		if tier.MaxDistance == math.huge then
			-- God is off the curve: Pete is an independent 1-in-a-million on top throws
			rightTxt, rightCol = "1 in a million", DIM
		elseif pct <= 0 then
			-- not unlocked yet -- you must throw at least this far for any chance
			rightTxt, rightCol = ("%dm \u{1F512}"):format(math.ceil(tier.MinDistance)), DIM
		elseif pct >= 1 then
			rightTxt, rightCol = ("%.1f%%"):format(pct), CF.pine1
		elseif pct >= 0.01 then
			rightTxt, rightCol = ("%.2f%%"):format(pct), CF.pine1
		else
			rightTxt, rightCol = "<0.01%", DIM
		end
		addRow(tier.Name, rightTxt, tier.Color, rightCol)
	end
end

chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
	refresh()
end)

remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if typeof(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.EquippedRock then state.EquippedRock = data.EquippedRock end
	if data.Upgrades then state.Upgrades = data.Upgrades end
	if data.Rebirths ~= nil then state.Rebirths = data.Rebirths end
	if data.Offerings ~= nil then state.Offerings = data.Offerings end
	if data.Brainrots then state.Brainrots = data.Brainrots end
	refresh()
end)

ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WeatherLuck"):Connect(refresh)
ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WeatherName"):Connect(refresh)
-- WeatherMut is the event's own mutation boost and moves independently of
-- WeatherLuck, so it needs its own listener or the MUTATION LUCK total goes stale.
ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WeatherMut"):Connect(refresh)

	local ok, snapshot = pcall(function()
		return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if ok and typeof(snapshot) == "table" then
		state.EquippedRock = snapshot.EquippedRock or state.EquippedRock
		state.Upgrades = snapshot.Upgrades or state.Upgrades
		state.Rebirths = snapshot.Rebirths or state.Rebirths
		state.Offerings = snapshot.Offerings or state.Offerings
		state.Brainrots = snapshot.Brainrots or state.Brainrots
	end
	refresh()
end)

local function short(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", n/1e9)
	elseif n >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", n/1e6)
	elseif n >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", n/1e3) end
	return tostring(n)
end
-- display-only: MerchantConfig titles carry a leading emoji ("\u{1F48E} ROCK
-- SHOP"); the style guide bans emoji icons, so strip anything before the
-- first A-Z for the header wordmark. Config itself is untouched.
local function titleWord(s)
	return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^[^%a]+", ""))
end

-- Mutates an EXISTING button into a Bazaar price/action pill -- same pattern
-- as ClientMain's styleActionPill (green->yellow "cash" look, or any other
-- gradient pair the caller passes), since these buttons are authored once
-- per card and just get restyled in place as state changes across rebuild()s.
local function stylePill(btn, c1, c2, textColor)
	UITheme.bazaarRestylePill(btn, c1, c2, textColor)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- rock previews (3D)
local spinParts = {}
-- Rock previews come from ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RockDesign, the same builder
-- the thrown rock and Rocco's shelf use -- one source of truth for rock looks.
local function makeRockViewport(med, rock)
	local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	vp.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	vp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("#FFF4D9") -- LemonPop light art well (was dark 26,30,40)
	vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170)
	vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 224)
	vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.6, -1, -0.4)
	vp.ZIndex = med.ZIndex + 1
	vp.Parent = med
	UITheme.corner(vp, 8)   -- guide: art 8, matched to the display case it fills

	local model = RockDesign.Build(rock.Id, rock.Color)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0))
	model.Parent = vp

	-- frame the camera off the rock's TRUE size so every rock fills the tile
	-- equally, whatever its proportions
	local size = RockDesign.Extents(model)
	local reach = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 38
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0.42, 0.30, 1) * reach * 2.55, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam

	table.insert(spinParts, model)
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local a = os.clock() * 0.8
	-- backwards + prune: every rebuild destroys the page's viewports, and a
	-- table that only ever grows would pin every dead Model for the session
	-- and walk them all each frame (review catch; same convention as
	-- UIKit.Builders' ringActive driver)
	for i = #spinParts, 1, -1 do
		local mdl = spinParts[i]
		if mdl.Parent then
			mdl:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0))
		else
			table.remove(spinParts, i)
		end
	end
end)

-- Viewport fit, CENTRED.
--
-- This used to reserve a 146px band at the top so the panel never covered the
-- TabBar, and pushed itself down below it. That cost a quarter of the height on a
-- short window: measured at 940x568 the panel was forced to 0.616 scale and sat
-- 53px below centre, which is what "the shop is low on the screen and the text is
-- tiny" was -- 16px body text rendering at ~10px.
--
-- A shop is a MODAL. Covering the nav band while it is open is fine and is what
-- every other panel in the game does; what is not fine is shrinking the whole
-- panel to dodge it. Fit the full viewport with an even margin and sit dead centre.
-- THE SIZE KNOB. Fraction of the viewport the panel is allowed to occupy.
-- 1.0 fits it to the screen edge-to-edge (too big -- it read as full-screen);
-- the old behaviour was effectively ~0.6 with a 146px band reserved on top
-- (too small -- 16px body text rendered at ~10px). Turn this one number.
local FILL = 0.76
local hudScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
hudScale.Name = "HudFixScale"
hudScale.Parent = frame

-- Centre on the MEASURED rect, not a predicted one. Two things make the position
-- hard to predict here: layout positions the frame from its UNSCALED size while
-- UIScale draws it scaled, and this ScreenGui carries ScreenInsets, so the canvas
-- is not always the screen. Reading back what actually rendered sidesteps both.
local function recentre()
	-- Retries across frames and ignores a zero-size read: at script load the frame
	-- has not been laid out yet, and an early pass saw a delta of ~0, returned, and
	-- left the panel 58px high for the whole session.
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local h = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if h > 0 then
			local vpY = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y
			local delta = vpY / 2 - (frame.AbsolutePosition.Y + h / 2)
			if math.abs(delta) < 1 then return end
			frame.Position = frame.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, delta)
		end
		task.wait()
	end
end

local function relayout()
	local vh, vw = gui.AbsoluteSize.Y, gui.AbsoluteSize.X
	if vh <= 0 or vw <= 0 then return end
	-- capped at 1: the panel is authored at its true pixel size, and upscaling
	-- magnifies the ink strokes along with the text
	local s = math.min(1, (vh * FILL) / FRAME_H, (vw * FILL) / FRAME_W)
	hudScale.Scale = s
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	task.defer(recentre)
end
gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayout)
relayout()
-- Re-centre whenever the panel is actually shown. Startup layout is the unreliable
-- moment; the instant it becomes visible, the rect is real.
frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if frame.Visible then task.defer(recentre) end
end)

local function renderPageChips(totalPages)
	for _, c in ipairs(chipRow:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	chipRow.Visible = totalPages > 1
	if totalPages <= 1 then return end
	for n = 1, totalPages do
		local active = n == page
		local chip = Instance.new("TextButton")
		chip.Name = "PageChip" .. n
		chip.LayoutOrder = n
		chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 34)
		chip.AutoButtonColor = false
		chip.Text = "PAGE " .. n
		chip.TextSize = 14
		chip.Font = FONT
		chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chip.ZIndex = 15
		chip.Parent = chipRow
		UITheme.corner(chip, 10)
		if active then
			-- gold selected tab: identity, kept through the Bazaar restyle
			chip.BackgroundColor3 = TAB_GOLD_TOP
			UITheme.gradient(chip, TAB_GOLD_TOP, TAB_GOLD_BOT, 90)
			chip.TextColor3 = BZ.white
			local ink = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			ink.Color = BZ.ink; ink.Thickness = 2
			ink.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
			ink.Parent = chip
		else
			-- unselected tab: Bazaar's dark card gradient, so the gold active
			-- chip still pops off the row
			chip.BackgroundColor3 = BZ.cardTop
			UITheme.gradient(chip, BZ.cardTop, BZ.cardBot, 90)
			chip.TextColor3 = BZ.muted
			local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			border.Color = BZ.cardEdge; border.Thickness = 2
			border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
			border.Parent = chip
			chip.Activated:Connect(function()
				page = n
				rebuild()
			end)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- card builder (Bazaar dark bordered card)
-- Signature kept close to the old makeRow so rebuild()'s item closures stay
-- recognisable: order, name, infoLine, button spec (+ its text colour),
-- click, preview builder, optional statLine (upgrades), optional stockText
-- (a red bazaarStock warning line, e.g. sequential-unlock "buy the previous
-- rock first"). Price is no longer a separate row -- it is embedded in
-- btnText as a cash pill, matching ClientMain's rockRows/sellList pattern.
local function makeCard(order, name, infoLine, btnText, btnTop, btnBot, textColor, onClick, previewBuilder, statLine, stockText)
	local card = UITheme.bazaarRow(list, 192)
	card.Name = "Card" .. order
	card.LayoutOrder = order
	card.ZIndex = 12

	-- icon tile: dark display case holding the 3D preview (or a glyph),
	-- top-centred instead of bazaarIconSlot's default left-middle so it
	-- still reads as a card inside the 3x2 grid
	local icon = UITheme.bazaarIconSlot(card, 72)
	icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	icon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
	if previewBuilder then
		previewBuilder(icon)
	end

	local n = UITheme.bazaarTitle(card, name)
	n.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20)
	n.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 86)
	n.TextSize = 16
	n.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

	-- two wrapped lines, not one truncated one: an upgrade's desc + level
	-- stat ("Better rarity rolls  Lv. 3/12 +15%") never fits 184px at 11px
	-- (review catch); rocks use a single line and are unaffected
	local info = UITheme.bazaarDesc(card, statLine and (infoLine .. "  \u{2022}  " .. statLine) or infoLine)
	info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
	info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 104)
	info.TextSize = 11
	info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

	-- optional red warning line (sequential-unlock "buy the previous rock first")
	if stockText then
		local stock = UITheme.bazaarStock(card, stockText)
		stock.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14)
		stock.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 132)
		stock.TextSize = 10
		stock.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	end

	-- chunky action / price pill (mock BUY): Bazaar cash/state gradient
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = "ActionButton"
	b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)
	b.Text = btnText
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2
	b.Parent = card
	stylePill(b, btnTop, btnBot, textColor)
	if onClick then
		b.Activated:Connect(onClick)
	end
	return card
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- rebuild
rebuild = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if not current then chipRow.Visible = false; return end
	title.Text = titleWord(current.Title)
	blurb.Text = current.Npc .. "  \u{2022}  " .. current.Blurb
	-- style replacement (2026-08-04, Pet-Sim guide): the header no longer
	-- repaints itself from current.Accent -- the guide gives shop chrome ONE
	-- red, so headerGrad/SquareOff keep the colours they were built with and
	-- every merchant shares the bar. current.Accent is still live data and is
	-- still read where it means something (MerchantDialog.Show, below).

	-- Build a flat list of render closures so pagination is Kind-agnostic: each entry
	-- draws exactly one card when called with its on-page order (1..PER_PAGE).
	local items = {}
	if current.Kind == "Rock" then
		local rocks = shelf()
		for i, rock in ipairs(rocks) do
			local owned = state.OwnedRocks[rock.Id]
			local equipped = state.EquippedRock == rock.Id
			-- SEQUENTIAL UNLOCK, within THIS world's ladder: the tundra shelf is
			-- self-contained, so its first rock is buyable without any valley rock
			local prevRock = rocks[i - 1]
			local unlocked = (i == 1) or (prevRock ~= nil and state.OwnedRocks[prevRock.Id] == true)
			items[i] = function(order)
				local txt, top, bot, textColor, cb
				if equipped then
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "EQUIPPED", P.green1, P.green2, BZ.white
				elseif owned then
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "EQUIP", BZ.header1, BZ.header2, BZ.white
					cb = function() remotes.EquipRock:FireServer(rock.Id) end
				elseif not unlocked then
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "LOCKED", LOCK_TOP, LOCK_BOT, BZ.white
					-- no cb -> disabled button
				else
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "$" .. short(rock.Price), BZ.cash1, BZ.cash2, BZ.cashText
					cb = function() remotes.BuyRock:FireServer(rock.Id) end
				end
				local desc = ("Up to %dm  \u{2022}  %.2fx luck"):format(rock.MaxDistance, rock.Luck)
				local stockText = (not owned and not unlocked and prevRock) and ("Buy the %s first"):format(prevRock.Id) or nil
				makeCard(order, rock.Id, desc, txt, top, bot, textColor, cb,
					function(med) makeRockViewport(med, rock) end, nil, stockText)
			end
		end
	elseif current.Kind == "Upgrade" then
		for i, up in ipairs(UpgradeConfig.List) do
			items[i] = function(order)
				local lvl = UpgradeConfig.Level(state.Upgrades, up.Id)
				local price = UpgradeConfig.Price(up.Id, lvl)
				local pct = math.floor(lvl * up.PerLevel * 100 + 0.5)
				local txt, top, bot, textColor, cb
				if not price then
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "MAXED", LOCK_TOP, LOCK_BOT, BZ.white
				else
					txt, top, bot, textColor = "$" .. short(price), BZ.cash1, BZ.cash2, BZ.cashText
					cb = function() remotes.BuyUpgrade:FireServer(up.Id) end
				end
				makeCard(order, up.Name, up.Desc, txt, top, bot, textColor, cb,
					function(holder)
						local e = Instance.new("TextLabel")
						e.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
						e.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						e.Font = UITheme.GlyphFont
						e.TextSize = 40
						e.Text = up.Icon
						e.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex + 1
						e.Parent = holder
					end,
					("Lv. %d/%d  +%d%%"):format(lvl, up.MaxLevel, pct))
			end
		end
	end

	-- render only the current page
	local total = #items
	local totalPages = math.max(1, math.ceil(total / PER_PAGE))
	page = math.clamp(page, 1, totalPages)
	local startI = (page - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1
	local order = 0
	for i = startI, math.min(startI + PER_PAGE - 1, total) do
		order += 1
		items[i](order)
	end

	renderPageChips(totalPages)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- open / close
-- open to the page holding your next rock to buy, not always page 1
local function firstRelevantPage(m)
	if m.Kind == "Rock" then
		for i, rock in ipairs(shelf()) do
			if not state.OwnedRocks[rock.Id] then return math.ceil(i / PER_PAGE) end
		end
	end
	return 1
end

local function openMerchant(m, world)
	current = m
	currentWorld = world or WorldProgression.Default
	page = firstRelevantPage(m)
	local shop = gui:FindFirstChild("ShopFrame"); if shop then shop.Visible = false end
	local sell = gui:FindFirstChild("SellFrame"); if sell then sell.Visible = false end
	local idx = gui:FindFirstChild("IndexFrame"); if idx then idx.Visible = false end
	rebuild()
	frame.Visible = true
end
local function closeMerchant()
	frame.Visible = false
	current = nil
end
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeMerchant)

---------------------------------------------------------------- entry cue
-- A merchant's walk-in sound is a SoundKit NAME on its MerchantConfig entry, not
-- an asset id -- SoundKit owns every id in the game. Passing nil for `where`
-- makes it 2D, which is right: this is a cue for the player who pressed E, so
-- there is no rolloff to tune. SoundKit.play clones a preloaded template and
-- Debris-cleans the clone, so repeat entries never stack voices. Templates are
-- already warmed by RareCatchClient's SoundKit.preload(), which walks all Ids.
local function playEnterCue(m)
	if not m.EnterSound then return end
	SoundKit.play(m.EnterSound, nil, { volume = m.EnterVolume or 0.35 })
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- prompts
local gameWorld = Workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
-- A merchant can stand in more than one world. `Stall` is the primary and
-- `AltStalls` lists the copies (the Frozen Tundra hub). Each one binds the SAME
-- handler, so the shop behaves identically wherever it is opened from.
local StallPrompt = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.StallPrompt)
local promptParts = {}          -- [Id] = { part, part, ... }
-- Bound through StallPrompt rather than a one-shot WaitForChild: with streaming on,
-- the tundra copy's parts are not replicated to a player standing in the valley, so
-- the old 30s wait timed out and world 2's prompts were never connected at all.
local function bindStall(m, stallName)
	-- the shelf this particular stall stocks; declared in MerchantConfig, not guessed
	local stallWorld = MerchantConfig.StallWorld and MerchantConfig.StallWorld[stallName]
	StallPrompt.Bind(stallName, m.Prompt, function(part, prompt)
		local list = promptParts[m.Id]
		if not list then list = {}; promptParts[m.Id] = list end
		table.insert(list, part)
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
			if who ~= player then return end
			if frame.Visible and current and current.Id == m.Id then
				closeMerchant()
			else
				-- Cue fires here, in the OPENING branch only -- the same Triggered
				-- event doubles as the close-toggle above, and a shop bell going off
				-- as you walk out would be wrong.
				playEnterCue(m)
				-- E starts a short dialogue; the shop opens when the player continues
				MerchantDialog.Show(m.Npc, m.Dialogue, m.Accent, function() openMerchant(m, stallWorld) end, part)
			end
		end)
	end)
end
for _, m in ipairs(MerchantConfig) do
	bindStall(m, m.Stall)
	for _, alt in ipairs(m.AltStalls or {}) do bindStall(m, alt) end
end

-- walk away -> close
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not frame.Visible or not current then return end
	local list = promptParts[current.Id]
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not list or not hrp then return end
	-- nearest, not first: the same merchant now exists in two worlds 11k studs apart.
	-- Parentless parts are ones that have STREAMED OUT -- their last known position is
	-- stale, and counting it would close the panel you just opened in the other world.
	local nearest = math.huge
	for _, part in ipairs(list) do
		if part.Parent then
			nearest = math.min(nearest, (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude)
		end
	end
	if nearest > 24 then closeMerchant() end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- data
local function apply(snap)
	if not snap then return end
	state.Cash = snap.Cash or state.Cash
	state.OwnedRocks = snap.OwnedRocks or state.OwnedRocks
	state.EquippedRock = snap.EquippedRock or state.EquippedRock
	state.Upgrades = snap.Upgrades or state.Upgrades
	if frame.Visible then rebuild() end
end
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function() return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok then apply(snap) end
end)
remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(apply)
remotes.CashTick.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(cash)
	state.Cash = cash
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/MusicClient.client.lua =====
-- MusicClient: a shuffled chill soundtrack for the camp.
--
-- LICENSING: every track is from Roblox's OWN first-party libraries -- APMOfficial
-- (courtesy of APM Music) and DistrokidOfficial. Same reasoning as WeatherClient's
-- ambience: first-party audio keeps playback rights valid in the live game, where a
-- random community upload can be pulled or fail to authorise. All 14 candidates were
-- verified with ContentProvider:PreloadAsync in this place before being shortlisted.
--
-- CLIENT-SIDE on purpose. Music is a per-player experience: each player gets their own
-- shuffle and their own position in the track, and nothing about it needs replicating.
-- Sounds parent to SoundService so they are 2D and global -- music must not fall off
-- as you walk, which is exactly what would happen if it lived on a part in Workspace.
--
-- VOLUME sits deliberately low. WeatherClient runs its ambience beds at 0.08-0.34 and
-- the campfire register is 0.40; music has to sit UNDER both or it competes with the
-- feedback the player actually needs to hear.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Lowered 0.22 -> 0.15. Even at 0.22 the music was sitting level with the skip
-- splashes (0.22 each) and masking them, which is backwards: the splash is the
-- feedback for the thing the player just did, the music is furniture.
local SoundKit = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("SoundKit"))

local VOLUME    = 0.15   -- under the weather beds and well under the SFX
-- The Settings music slider is a MULTIPLIER over VOLUME, never an absolute level.
-- SetCategoryVolume cannot simply write s.Volume here: this script tweens Volume
-- for its own fades, so a direct write would be overwritten by the next fade and
-- lost entirely on the next track. Instead we hold the live scale and re-apply
-- base * scale ourselves, both on slider moves and whenever a track starts.
local musicScale = SoundKit.MusicScale and SoundKit.MusicScale() or 1

-- Volume is written DIRECTLY in steps rather than tweened. Measured in this place:
-- a TweenService tween on Sound.Volume does not move the property, so every fade
-- here silently left the track at 0 and the music was only ever audible after a
-- slider move (SetCategoryVolume writes Volume directly). Direct writes always
-- work, so the fade is a loop. Token-guarded: a new fade supersedes an old one
-- instead of the two fighting over the same property.
local fadeToken = 0
local function fadeSound(snd, to, seconds)
	if not snd or not snd.Parent then return end
	fadeToken += 1
	local myToken = fadeToken
	if not seconds or seconds <= 0 then
		snd.Volume = to
		return
	end
	local from = snd.Volume
	local steps = math.max(1, math.floor(seconds / 0.05))
	for i = 1, steps do
		if myToken ~= fadeToken or not snd.Parent then return end
		snd.Volume = from + (to - from) * (i / steps)
		task.wait(seconds / steps)
	end
	if myToken == fadeToken and snd.Parent then snd.Volume = to end
end
local currentTrack = nil
SoundKit.OnMusicVolume(function(v)
	musicScale = v
	-- Re-level the playing track immediately: a slider is a live control, not a
	-- setting that waits for the next song.
	if currentTrack and currentTrack.Parent then
		task.spawn(fadeSound, currentTrack, VOLUME * v, 0.15)
	end
end)
local FADE      = 3.0    -- seconds of fade in / fade out
local GAP_MIN   = 5      -- silence between tracks, so it breathes instead of
local GAP_MAX   = 11     -- running wall-to-wall like a menu screen

-- Durations are measured, not guessed (PreloadAsync + TimeLength in this place).
local PLAYLIST = {
	{ id = "105008212701444", name = "Mountain Air",          len = 144.1 },
	{ id = "107987350831589", name = "Silent Stream Path",    len = 79.0 },
	{ id = "117716119176266", name = "Ethereal Forest Murmur", len = 80.0 },
	{ id = "99678007903413",  name = "Somewhere Beyond",      len = 81.0 },
	{ id = "120950485414901", name = "Velvet Night Tides",    len = 77.4 },
	{ id = "9039590627",      name = "Heartstrings",          len = 60.1 },
	{ id = "92591332804828",  name = "Open Arms",             len = 60.8 },
}

local folder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("Music")
if not folder then
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Music"
	folder.Parent = SoundService
end

-- Shuffle the whole list, then walk it, then reshuffle. A plain random pick repeats
-- tracks back-to-back often enough to be noticeable on a 7-track list; a bag shuffle
-- guarantees you hear all 7 before any repeats.
local bag = {}
local function refill()
	bag = table.clone(PLAYLIST)
	for i = #bag, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		bag[i], bag[j] = bag[j], bag[i]
	end
end
local lastPlayed
local function nextTrack()
	if #bag == 0 then
		refill()
		-- avoid the seam case: last of the old bag being first of the new one
		if #bag > 1 and bag[1].id == lastPlayed then bag[1], bag[#bag] = bag[#bag], bag[1] end
	end
	local t = table.remove(bag, 1)
	lastPlayed = t.id
	return t
end

local stopped = false
Players.LocalPlayer.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
	if not Players.LocalPlayer:IsDescendantOf(game) then stopped = true end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(4)   -- let the join sequence (offline popup, tutorial) land first
	while not stopped do
		local t = nextTrack()
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.Name = t.name
		s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. t.id
		s.Looped = false
		s.Volume = 0            -- always fade in; a track snapping on at full volume is jarring
		s:SetAttribute("BaseVolume", VOLUME)   -- lets SoundKit scale it without knowing our base
		s.Parent = folder
		s:Play()
		currentTrack = s
		task.spawn(fadeSound, s, VOLUME * musicScale, FADE)

		-- Wait on the measured length rather than s.Ended: Ended does not fire if the asset
		-- fails to stream, which would stall the playlist forever on a bad connection.
		-- The +1 covers small decode differences between the measured and actual length.
		local hold = math.max((t.len or 60) - FADE, 5)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while not stopped and os.clock() - t0 < hold do task.wait(0.5) end

		fadeSound(s, 0, FADE)
		task.wait(0.2)
		if currentTrack == s then currentTrack = nil end
		if s.Parent then s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end
		if stopped then break end
		task.wait(math.random(GAP_MIN, GAP_MAX))
	end
end)

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PlotBillboardVisibility.client.lua =====
-- Brainrot name billboards show ONLY while you're standing inside a plot's circle.
-- Otherwise their BillboardGuis render through walls and clutter the hub / punch through
-- the leaderboard. Purely client-side + per-player: we toggle BillboardGui.Enabled locally.
-- The server (IncomeLoop.updateBillboard) only writes the billboard TEXT, never .Enabled,
-- so this never fights it.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local RADIUS = 30                 -- studs from a plot's centre; covers the 44x44 platform,
local RADIUS2 = RADIUS * RADIUS   -- excludes the leaderboard (~36 away) & neighbours (~67 apart)
local INTERVAL = 0.15             -- seconds between visibility passes

local function setPlotBillboards(plot, enabled)
	local pads = plot:FindFirstChild("Pads")
	if not pads then return end
	for _, model in ipairs(pads:GetChildren()) do
		local bg = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
		if bg and bg.Enabled ~= enabled then
			bg.Enabled = enabled
		end
	end
end

local acc = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	if acc < INTERVAL then return end
	acc = 0

	local bases = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerBases")
	if not bases then return end

	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pos = hrp and hrp.Position   -- nil (dead/loading) -> everything hides

	for _, plot in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do
		local inside = false
		if pos then
			local ok, cf = pcall(function() return plot:GetPivot() end)
			if ok then
				local dx = pos.X - cf.Position.X
				local dz = pos.Z - cf.Position.Z
				inside = (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= RADIUS2
			end
		end
		setPlotBillboards(plot, inside)
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PlotSignClient.client.lua =====
-- PlotSignClient -- renders every pixel of the camp board. (BUILD SPEC v2 §7.1)
--
-- Ownership split: the SERVER (PlotBoardHandler) owns the physical parts, the LikePrompt and
-- all like authority; this CLIENT owns all three SurfaceGuis and their children. A SurfaceGui
-- on real wood reads as scenery and holds its size at every distance -- the old 36-stud
-- camera-facing billboard is exactly why the previous sign felt like HUD spam.
--
-- State arrives as ATTRIBUTES on the plot Model (replicated for free). No per-plot remote,
-- no per-tick string write. EVERY attribute read is defaulted at the read site: ClaimPlotFor
-- writes OwnerUserId before Claimed, and formatShort(nil) errors on its first line.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local plotsFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerBases")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UITheme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UITheme)
local P = UITheme.Palette

local likeRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("LikePlot", 10)
local likeResult = remotes:WaitForChild("LikeResult", 10)

local C = Color3.fromRGB
local MAXDIST = 200         -- board AND plaque share this; a mismatch shows a blank square

-- The nine local copies this file warned about are now one module. NumberFormat.Short
-- is nil-safe, so the "formatShort(nil) errors on its first line" hazard noted above
-- is handled inside the module rather than at each read site.
local formatShort = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat).Short
local function cash(n) return "$" .. formatShort(n) end

-- ===== data plumbing =====
-- PlotSignClient touches neither DataUpdated nor GetInitialData today, and ClientMain's `state`
-- is a file-local, so this script must fetch LikedPlayers itself.
local myLikes = {}
local renderAll   -- forward declaration

local function ingest(snap)
	if type(snap) ~= "table" then return end      -- Main:33 CAN return nil after its 5 s poll
	if type(snap.LikedPlayers) == "table" then myLikes = snap.LikedPlayers end
	if renderAll then renderAll() end
end

-- ===== gui construction =====
local function newSurface(parent, name, face, active)
	local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	sg.Name = name
	sg.Face = face
	sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
	sg.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(550, 300)
	sg.LightInfluence = 0
	sg.AlwaysOnTop = false        -- U6: a physical sign may be occluded; never fake it to the front
	sg.MaxDistance = MAXDIST
	sg.ZOffset = 0
	if active then sg.Active = true end
	sg.Parent = parent
	return sg
end
