-- ===== render =====
local cache = {}    -- [BoardPart] = entry

local function renderEntry(e)
	local plot = e.plot
	if not plot or plot.Parent == nil then return end

	-- EVERY read defaulted at the read site (spec 2.6 nil-default rule)
	local claimed = plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") == true
	local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0
	local ownerName = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerName") or ""
	local earned = plot:GetAttribute("TotalEarned") or 0
	local likes = plot:GetAttribute("PlotLikes") or 0

	local isMine = claimed and ownerId == player.UserId
	local liked = myLikes[tostring(ownerId)] == true

	for _, f in ipairs(e.faces) do
		if claimed then
			f.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(C(226, 138, 54), C(186, 96, 30))
			f.name.Text = (ownerName ~= "" and ownerName or "Camper") .. "'s Camp"
			f.name.TextColor3 = C(255, 246, 228)
			f.title.Text = "TOTAL EARNED"
			f.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
			f.title.TextSize = 40
			f.value.Visible = true
			f.value.Text = cash(earned)
			f.likeCount.Text = likes == 1 and "1 like" or (likes .. " likes")
		else
			f.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(P.gold1, P.gold2)
			f.name.Text = "AVAILABLE PLOT"
			f.name.TextColor3 = C(58, 38, 14)
			-- single centred line; claiming is Platform.Touched, and the board sits OUTSIDE
			-- the r-22 platform, so "walk up to claim" would be a lie
			f.title.Text = "STEP ONTO THE CAMP"
			f.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			f.title.TextSize = 34
			f.value.Visible = false
			f.likeCount.Text = ""
		end
	end

	local L = e.like
	if L then
		local canLike = claimed and not isMine and not liked
		if not claimed then
			UITheme.setColors(L.btn, P.hudMuted1, P.hudMuted2)
			L.heart.Text = "\u{2665}"; L.heart.TextColor3 = C(210, 214, 224)
			L.count.Text = "\u{2014}"
		elseif isMine then
			UITheme.setColors(L.btn, P.hudMuted1, P.hudMuted2)
			L.heart.Text = "\u{2665}"; L.heart.TextColor3 = C(210, 214, 224)
			L.count.Text = tostring(likes)
		elseif liked then
			UITheme.setColors(L.btn, C(226, 84, 88), C(186, 46, 56))
			L.heart.Text = "\u{2665}"; L.heart.TextColor3 = C(255, 236, 236)
			L.count.Text = tostring(likes)
		else
			UITheme.setColors(L.btn, C(226, 84, 88), C(186, 46, 56))
			L.heart.Text = "\u{2661}"; L.heart.TextColor3 = C(255, 236, 236)
			L.count.Text = tostring(likes)
		end
		L.btn.Active = canLike

		-- Cosmetic only: client property writes do not replicate. Server-side
		-- PlotBoardHandler.TryLike is the real gate.
		if e.prompt then e.prompt.Enabled = canLike end
	end
end

function renderAll()
	for _, e in pairs(cache) do renderEntry(e) end
end

local ATTRS = { "Claimed", "OwnerUserId", "OwnerName", "TotalEarned", "PlotLikes" }

local function ensurePlot(plot)
	if not plot:IsA("Model") then return end
	local boardModel = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotBoard")
	local board = boardModel and boardModel:FindFirstChild("Board")
	local plaque = boardModel and boardModel:FindFirstChild("LikePlaque")
	if not board then return end

	local e = cache[board]
	if e and e.plaque == plaque and board:FindFirstChild("BoardGui") then
		renderEntry(e)
		return
	end

	if e then
		for _, c in ipairs(e.conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	end

	e = { plot = plot, board = board, plaque = plaque, faces = {}, conns = {} }

	local old = board:FindFirstChild("BoardGui"); if old then old:Destroy() end
	local oldB = board:FindFirstChild("BackGui"); if oldB then oldB:Destroy() end
	table.insert(e.faces, buildBoardFace(newSurface(board, "BoardGui", Enum.NormalId.Front, false), false))
	table.insert(e.faces, buildBoardFace(newSurface(board, "BackGui", Enum.NormalId.Back, false), true))

	if plaque then
		local oldL = plaque:FindFirstChild("LikeGui"); if oldL then oldL:Destroy() end
		e.like = buildLikeFace(plaque)
		e.prompt = plaque:FindFirstChild("LikePrompt")
		e.like.btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not e.like.btn.Active then return end
			if likeRemote then likeRemote:FireServer(plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex")) end
		end)
	end

	for _, a in ipairs(ATTRS) do
		table.insert(e.conns, plot:GetAttributeChangedSignal(a):Connect(function()
			renderEntry(e)
		end))
	end

	cache[board] = e
	renderEntry(e)
end

-- ===== like feedback: ONE shared path for both inputs, gated on the server's answer =====
-- No optimistic pop. On every rejection PlotLikes does NOT change, so an optimistic "+1"
-- would show forever on a self-like and hide all five server guards.
local function entryForIndex(idx)
	for _, e in pairs(cache) do
		if e.plot and e.plot:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") == idx then return e end
	end
	return nil
end

local function playLikeFeedback(ok, plotIndex)
	local e = entryForIndex(plotIndex)
	if not e or not e.plaque then return end
	local plaque = e.plaque

	if ok then
		local base = plaque.Size
		TweenService:Create(plaque, TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = base * 1.12 }):Play()
		task.delay(0.09, function()
			if plaque.Parent then
				TweenService:Create(plaque, TweenInfo.new(0.09, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
					{ Size = base }):Play()
			end
		end)

		if e.like then
			local pop = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			pop.Name = "Pop"
			pop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			pop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
			pop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
			pop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			pop.TextSize = 52
			pop.TextColor3 = C(255, 236, 236)
			pop.TextStrokeColor3 = C(84, 18, 24)
			pop.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
			pop.Text = "+1"
			pop.Parent = e.like.gui
			TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -20), TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
			}):Play()
			Debris:AddItem(pop, 0.8)
		end

		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
		s.Volume = 0.5
		s.Parent = plaque
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 2)
	else
		if e.like then
			local stroke
			for _, s in ipairs(e.like.btn:GetChildren()) do
				if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then stroke = s end
			end
			if stroke then
				local was = stroke.Color
				stroke.Color = C(255, 70, 70)
				task.delay(0.12, function()
					if stroke.Parent then stroke.Color = was end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

if likeResult then
	likeResult.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(res)
		if type(res) ~= "table" then return end
		playLikeFeedback(res.Success == true, res.PlotIndex)
	end)
end

-- The primary input is the server-owned LikePrompt; no local pop here, the reply drives it.
ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, who)
	if who == player and prompt.Name == "LikePrompt" then
		-- intentionally empty: feedback waits for LikeResult (~50-100 ms, well under the
		-- 350 ms HoldDuration the player already spent)
	end
end)

-- ===== reconcile + teardown (streaming) =====
local function reconcile()
	for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		ensurePlot(plot)
	end
	-- teardown: with StreamingEnabled the per-plot cache would otherwise accumulate
	-- references to destroyed instances over a long session
	for board, e in pairs(cache) do
		if board.Parent == nil then
			for _, c in ipairs(e.conns) do c:Disconnect() end
			cache[board] = nil
		end
	end
end

plotsFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait()
	reconcile()
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, snap = pcall(function() return remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok then ingest(snap) end
end)
if remotes:FindFirstChild("DataUpdated") then
	-- fires for the LIKER and the OWNER; must not assume it is about the local player's plot
	remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(ingest)
end

reconcile()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		reconcile()
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/QuestBarClient.client.lua =====
-- QuestBarClient: ONE always-visible progress bar for the Goals board.
--
-- CLAUDE.md asks for something visibly close to completing at all times; there
-- were zero progress indicators anywhere. This is the first of the three bars --
-- deliberately only the quest one this round.
--
-- Built from the UIKit primitives that already shipped and had ZERO call sites:
-- UI.track / UI.setFill / UI.claimRing. setFill tweens with T.tween.bar
-- (0.40s Quad/Out), so the fill is never snapped.
--
-- NOT a panel and not the retired QuestUI: its own small ScreenGui pinned under
-- the currency cluster (top-left 18,18 + pill height 54). That band is free --
-- the rail is vertically centred, the tabs are top-centre, and panels are
-- canvas-centred so they never reach x < 400 on a real viewport.
--
-- NPC quests have their own tracker (QuestTrackerClient, middle-right, log rows).
-- This is the Goals board, a different system with a different shape -- the two
-- do not overlap on screen or in data.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")
local UIKit = modules:WaitForChild("UIKit")
local T = require(UIKit:WaitForChild("Tokens"))
local UI = require(UIKit:WaitForChild("Builders"))
local formatNumber = require(modules:WaitForChild("NumberFormat")).Short

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local W, H = 300, 62

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "QuestBarUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.DisplayOrder = T.zindex.currency
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local root = Instance.new("Frame")
root.Name = "Root"
root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18 + T.size.currencyPill + 12)
root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.Visible = false          -- until the first payload names a quest
root.Parent = gui

-- match the HUD's uniform fit so this scales with everything else
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = root
local function fit()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	scale.Scale = math.min(vp.X / T.size.canvas.X, vp.Y / T.size.canvas.Y)
end
fit()
do
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
end

local plate = UI.surface(root, UDim2.fromOffset(W, H), "row", T.radius.control, T.stroke.control)

local title = UI.label(plate, "", "chip")
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 100, 18)
title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
title.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1

local count = UI.label(plate, "", "chip", T.color.textAccent)
count.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
count.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 6)
count.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1

-- the primitives that shipped unused
local track, fill = UI.track(plate, UDim2.fromOffset(W - 24, 20), "green", T.radius.small)
track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 30)
track.ZIndex = plate.ZIndex + 1
fill.ZIndex = track.ZIndex + 1

local claimRing = nil
local shownId, shownPct = nil, -1

-- NEAREST TO COMPLETE, in priority order:
--   1. unclaimed AND met  -> ready to claim, the strongest possible "you are one
--      click from a reward" signal, so it outranks any fraction
--   2. otherwise the highest Cur/Target fraction
--   3. ties broken by list order, which is authored easiest-first
local function pick(list)
	local best, bestPct, bestIdx
	for i, q in ipairs(list) do
		if not q.Claimed then
			local target = tonumber(q.Target) or 1
			local cur = tonumber(q.Cur) or 0
			local pct = target > 0 and math.clamp(cur / target, 0, 1) or 0
			if q.Met then pct = 1 end
			if not best or pct > bestPct + 1e-6 or (math.abs(pct - bestPct) <= 1e-6 and i < bestIdx) then
				best, bestPct, bestIdx = q, pct, i
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestPct or 0
end

remotes.QuestState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(list)
	if typeof(list) ~= "table" then return end
	local q, pct = pick(list)
	if not q then
		-- every goal claimed: nothing to show rather than a full empty bar
		root.Visible = false
		shownId, shownPct = nil, -1
		return
	end
	root.Visible = true

	local target = tonumber(q.Target) or 1
	local cur = tonumber(q.Cur) or 0
	title.Text = tostring(q.Desc or "")
	count.Text = q.Met and "READY!" or (formatNumber(cur) .. " / " .. formatNumber(target))

	-- Re-targeting to a DIFFERENT quest snaps (the bar now means something else,
	-- so animating between two unrelated values would read as progress that did
	-- not happen). Progress WITHIN the same quest animates.
	local sameQuest = (shownId == q.Id)
	if not sameQuest or shownPct < 0 then
		UI.setFill(fill, pct, false)
	elseif math.abs(pct - shownPct) > 1e-4 then
		UI.setFill(fill, pct, true)   -- T.tween.bar: 0.40s Quad/Out
	end
	shownId, shownPct = q.Id, pct

	-- pulsing ring only while it is actually claimable
	if q.Met and not claimRing then
		claimRing = UI.claimRing(plate)
	elseif not q.Met and claimRing then
		claimRing:Destroy()
		claimRing = nil
	end
end)

local CF = UITheme.Camp
local FONT = UITheme.Font

local function fmt(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif n >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif n >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.0fK", n / 1e3) end
	return tostring(n)
end
local function new(cls, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(cls)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
-- recolour an already-styled element's border stroke to the campfire black
local function blackRim(o, thick)
	for _, s in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then
			s.Color = CF.ink; s.Thickness = thick or 3; s.Transparency = 0
		end
	end
end

	{ CF.amber1, CF.amber2 },
	{ CF.pine1,  CF.pine2  },
	{ CF.lake1,  CF.lake2  },
	{ CF.ember1, CF.ember2 },
	{ CF.berry1, CF.berry2 },
}
local ICONS = { "\u{1F3AF}", "\u{1F3C6}", "\u{2B50}", "\u{1F525}", "\u{1F48E}" }

local function render(quests)
	clearList()
	local anyClaimable = false
	for i, q in ipairs(quests) do
		local claimable = q.Met and not q.Claimed
		if claimable then anyClaimable = true end
		local acc = ACCENTS[((i - 1) % #ACCENTS) + 1]
		local card, outer = UITheme.accentCard(list, acc[1], 14)
		outer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 92)
		outer.LayoutOrder = i
		outer.ZIndex = 11
		card.ZIndex = 12
		if not claimable then card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18 end

		-- sunburst icon tile
		local icon = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1 }, card)
		UITheme.corner(icon, 10)
		UITheme.sunburst(icon, acc[1], 12)
		UITheme.ink(icon, 3)
		new("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 34,
			Text = ICONS[((i - 1) % #ICONS) + 1], TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ZIndex = icon.ZIndex + 4 }, icon)

		local n = new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -246, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = q.Desc, Font = FONT, TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = acc[1],
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2 }, card)
		UITheme.inkText(n, 2.8)

		local sub = "Reward  $" .. fmt(q.Reward)
		if q.Claimed then sub = sub .. "  \u{2022}  collected" end
		local d = new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, -246, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = sub, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = CF.muted, TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2 }, card)
		UITheme.inkText(d, 1.6)

		local b = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 142, 0, 44),
			TextSize = 18, ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 2 }, card)
		if q.Claimed then
			UITheme.campButton(b, CF.pine2, CF.panelBot)
			b.Text = "\u{2713} CLAIMED"
			b.TextColor3 = CF.pine1
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
		elseif claimable then
			UITheme.campButton(b, CF.pine1, CF.pine2)
			b.Text = "CLAIM"
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() remotes.QuestClaim:FireServer(q.Id) end)
		else
			UITheme.campButton(b, CF.panelTop, CF.panelBot)
			b.Text = "LOCKED"
			b.TextColor3 = CF.muted
			b.AutoButtonColor = false
		end
	end
	tile.setReady(anyClaimable)
	tile.setBadge(anyClaimable and "dot" or "none")
end

remotes.QuestState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(quests)
	if typeof(quests) ~= "table" then return end
	render(quests)
end)

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() panel.Visible = not panel.Visible end)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/QuestTrackerClient.client.lua =====
--[[ ==========================================================================
QuestTrackerClient -- the NPC quest tracker down the right-hand side.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Shows what an NPC has actually asked you to do, so the objective survives
closing the dialogue box.

LAYOUT: flat log rows, not cards. Each entry is

	[icon] Quest Title
	------------------------------
	Italic blurb from the NPC
	[ ] Objective (0/10)

Square-edged, dark and translucent, with GAP = 0 so stacked entries butt
together and read as ONE continuous panel rather than a column of separate
cards. Rounded corners are deliberately absent for the same reason -- at
zero gap they would show as notches between entries.

NOTE the description line is back. It was removed earlier as "a retelling of
the dialogue", but the reference layout this was matched to has one, so the
blurb per quest is authored in QUESTS below. Drop `Blurb` from an entry and
that row closes up on its own.

TYPOGRAPHY OPT-OUT: this tracker sets NoPolish on its ScreenGui. UIPolish
forces every label under PlayerGui to white FredokaOne AND re-asserts it on
any FontFace/TextColor3 change, so without that attribute the italic greys
here would be silently overwritten a frame after they were set.

Three entries are visible at once; a fourth turns the list into a scroller
rather than growing down the screen. The holder resizes to the number of
visible entries, so a single quest is a single row, not a tall empty box.

A completed quest is REMOVED, with no congratulation hold -- once the state
leaves the Steps table the row goes.

Adding a new NPC quest means adding an entry to QUESTS below and nothing else:
give it the state RemoteEvent it already fires, and a Steps table keyed by the
numeric stage that remote sends. A stage with no Steps entry (not started, or
finished) simply shows no card.

The right edge is deliberate: the top-centre belongs to the teleport tabs, the
top-right to the cash pill, the left to the feature rail, and the bottom-right
to Sprint / Luck. The middle-right band is the only free real estate.
========================================================================== ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Italic is not reachable through Enum.Font, so the family asset is pulled off
-- the enum and rebuilt with an explicit weight + style. pcall'd because a future
-- engine change to Font.new must degrade to a plain font, not break the tracker.
local FAMILY = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium).Family
local function face(label, weight, italic, size, colour)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		label.FontFace = Font.new(FAMILY, weight,
			italic and Enum.FontStyle.Italic or Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	end)
	if not ok then label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextColor3 = colour
end

-- is rewritten to white FredokaOne by UIPolish, italics and greys included.

local holder = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
holder.Name = "Tracker"
-- ui(3-fix1): reverted to the original right-edge anchor, restored from
-- ServerStorage.AuditBackups.QuestTrackerClient_pre_ui3. Task 3 moved this
-- left to dodge the (then right-side) GameHUD nav rail; the v2 rail now
-- lives on the LEFT per the 2026-07-30 user decision, so that reason no
-- longer applies and the tracker returns to its original right-edge home.
holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
holder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.40, 0)
holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ENTRY_W + 10, 0)
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
holder.BorderSizePixel = 0

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Padding = UDim.new(0, GAP)
list.Parent = holder

local cards = {}

-- Last visible count, so refreshHolder can tell "a quest appeared/finished" apart
-- from "a counter ticked". Only the former should move the view.
local lastShown = -1

-- Height follows the number of VISIBLE cards, capped at MAX_VISIBLE. UIListLayout
-- skips Visible=false children, so the canvas already measures only live cards --
-- this just stops the holder itself being a tall invisible box that eats clicks.
local function refreshHolder()
	local n = 0
	for _, ui in ipairs(cards) do
		if ui.root.Visible then n += 1 end
	end
	local shown = math.min(n, MAX_VISIBLE)
	local h = (shown > 0) and (shown * ENTRY_H + (shown - 1) * GAP) or 0
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ENTRY_W + 10, h)
	holder.ScrollingEnabled = n > MAX_VISIBLE
	holder.ScrollBarThickness = (n > MAX_VISIBLE) and 4 or 0
	holder.Visible = n > 0

	local contentH = (n > 0) and (n * ENTRY_H + (n - 1) * GAP) or 0
	local maxScroll = math.max(0, contentH - h)

	if n ~= lastShown then
		-- The VISIBLE SET changed, so present from the top. This is not just tidiness:
		-- with AutomaticCanvasSize = Y the engine pins the view to the BOTTOM as the
		-- canvas grows, so the fourth quest appearing scrolled the first one off the
		-- top of the list -- measured CanvasPosition.Y = 72 on a fresh tracker.
		-- It also covers the shrink direction: a finished quest removes a row and
		-- would otherwise strand the view below the remaining content.
		lastShown = n
		holder.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	elseif holder.CanvasPosition.Y > maxScroll then
		-- Count unchanged -- this is a progress tick, and the player may have scrolled
		-- deliberately. Leave their position alone beyond keeping it in range.
		holder.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, maxScroll)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- entry
-- One flat log row. No corners and no keyline: at GAP = 0 the rows have to meet
-- flush or the seams show, which is what makes the stack read as one panel.
local function buildEntry(quest, order)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = quest.Id .. "Entry"
	row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ENTRY_W, ENTRY_H)
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.BackgroundColor3 = PLATE
	row.BackgroundTransparency = PLATE_ALPHA
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.Visible = false
	row.Parent = holder

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = row

	-- icon: small dark tile tinted with the quest accent, holding a glyph
	local box = Instance.new("Frame")
	box.Name = "IconTile"
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15)
	box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 7)
	box.BackgroundColor3 = quest.Accent and quest.Accent.dark or BOX_FILL
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Parent = row
	UIStyle.corner(box, 3)

	local glyph = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	glyph.Name = "Glyph"
	glyph.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	glyph.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glyph.Text = quest.Glyph or "\u{2605}"
	glyph.TextScaled = true
	glyph.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	glyph.Parent = box

	-- title: bold italic, the reference's "Angler Quest" line
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 16)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 6)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	title.Text = quest.Label or ((quest.Npc or "") .. " Quest")
	title.Parent = row
	face(title, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, true, 14, TITLE_INK)

	-- hairline rule under the title
	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Name = "Rule"
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 1)
	rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 26)
	rule.BackgroundColor3 = RULE
	rule.BackgroundTransparency = RULE_ALPHA
	rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rule.Parent = row

	-- blurb: grey italic flavour line
	local blurb = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	blurb.Name = "Blurb"
	blurb.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 15)
	blurb.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 31)
	blurb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	blurb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	blurb.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	blurb.Text = quest.Blurb or ""
	blurb.Visible = (quest.Blurb ~= nil)
	blurb.Parent = row
	face(blurb, Enum.FontWeight.Medium, true, 12, BLURB_INK)

	-- objective: checkbox + "<text> (n/m)", progress inline as in the reference
	local tick = Instance.new("Frame")
	tick.Name = "Tick"
	tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11)
	tick.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 51)
	tick.BackgroundColor3 = BOX_FILL
	tick.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tick.Parent = row
	UIStyle.corner(tick, 2)
	UIStyle.stroke(tick, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1)
	local ts = tick:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if ts then ts.Transparency = 0.55 end

	local obj = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	obj.Name = "Objective"
	obj.Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 16)
	obj.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(31, 49)
	obj.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	obj.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	obj.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	obj.Parent = row
	face(obj, Enum.FontWeight.Medium, false, 13, OBJ_INK)

	return { root = row, scale = scale, title = title, blurb = blurb, obj = obj }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- show / hide
-- A gentle settle rather than the old Back-ease pop: a flat log row springing in
-- looked like a card, which is the language this layout moved away from.
local function show(ui)
	if not ui.root.Visible then
		ui.root.Visible = true
		ui.scale.Scale = 0.94
		TweenService:Create(ui.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end
	refreshHolder()
end

-- Immediate, by request: a finished quest is simply gone. There is no completion
-- banner and no hold -- the row disappears the moment the state leaves Steps.
local function hide(ui)
	if not ui.root.Visible then return end
	ui.scale.Scale = 1
	ui.root.Visible = false
	refreshHolder()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- wiring
for order, quest in ipairs(QUESTS) do
	local ui = buildEntry(quest, order)
	cards[#cards + 1] = ui
	local remote = remotes:WaitForChild(quest.Remote, 30)
	if remote then
		remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
			if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then return end
			local state = tonumber(payload.State) or 0
			local step = quest.Steps[state]

			-- No completion branch by design. Any state without a Steps entry -- not
			-- started, finished, or anything added later -- hides the row, so a quest
			-- vanishes the instant it is done.
			if not step then
				hide(ui)
				return
			end

			-- payload may carry live progress (Step/Of); fall back to the static config
			local sNum = tonumber(payload.Step) or step.Step
			local sOf  = tonumber(payload.Of) or step.Of
			ui.obj.Text = ("%s (%d/%d)"):format(step.Title, sNum, sOf)
			show(ui)
		end)
	end
end

refreshHolder()

-- Real NPC questlines are added to the QUESTS table above -- each one driven by
-- its own state RemoteEvent. The temporary local test quests that used to live
-- here (Marco / Rocco / Enzo / Gino / Test Five) were placeholders and have been
-- removed; the tracker scroller stays and will populate once real quests exist.

-- Server-wide rare catch banner: everyone sees when someone lands a Secret or a Rainbow/Glitched mutation
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local rareCatch = remotes:WaitForChild("RareCatch")
local SoundKit = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.SoundKit)
local Mutations = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.MutationConfig)

-- How triumphant the catch sounds, by tier. Each rung is a LIST OF LAYERS.
--
-- Rarity reads as rarer three ways at once: the samples get longer, the level
-- climbs, and the top three rungs STACK. The stacking is the important part --
-- length and volume alone have run out of headroom by the time you reach Secret,
-- so density has to carry the last stretch. A God is an impact, then a choir over
-- it, then a shimmer on top: three events in 0.32s that read as one huge one.
--
-- ON LAYERING, because this file used to forbid it: the old rule came from layering
-- the TIER sound and the MUTATION sound, both at full level, 0.12s apart -- two
-- unrelated stings that just read as one long ring. These layers are different in
-- kind: they are chosen to compose, the supporting layers sit well under the lead,
-- and the offsets are short enough to fuse into a single hit. The mutation rule is
-- unchanged below -- a big mutation still REPLACES the tier sound, never stacks.
local TIER_SFX = {
	Common    = { { sound = "catchCommon",   volume = 0.13 } },
	Uncommon  = { { sound = "catchUncommon", volume = 0.17 } },
	Rare      = { { sound = "catchRare",     volume = 0.21 } },
	Epic      = { { sound = "catchEpic",     volume = 0.25 } },
	Legendary = { { sound = "catchLegend",   volume = 0.30 } },
	Mythic    = { { sound = "catchMythic",   volume = 0.34 },
	              { sound = "catchSparkle",  volume = 0.18, delay = 0.06 } },
	-- catchDrama (curse01) dropped from Secret with the pass-4 reshuffle: it was from
	-- the same rejected corner as bless/abyss. God keeps it -- God was not complained
	-- about, and the choir is what carries that stack anyway.
	Secret    = { { sound = "catchSecret",   volume = 0.40 },
	              { sound = "catchBigHit",   volume = 0.24, delay = 0.06 } },
	God       = { { sound = "catchBigHit",   volume = 0.44 },
	              { sound = "catchGod",      volume = 0.54, delay = 0.10 },
	              { sound = "catchDrama",    volume = 0.30, delay = 0.10 },
	              { sound = "catchSparkle",  volume = 0.30, delay = 0.34 } },
}
local TIER_FALLBACK = { { sound = "catchRare", volume = 0.21 } }

-- scale: 1 for your own catch, lower for somebody else's -- see the call sites.
local function playCatch(tierName, scale)
	for _, layer in ipairs(TIER_SFX[tierName] or TIER_FALLBACK) do
		local vol = layer.volume * scale
		if (layer.delay or 0) <= 0 then
			SoundKit.play(layer.sound, nil, { volume = vol })
		else
			task.delay(layer.delay, function()
				SoundKit.play(layer.sound, nil, { volume = vol })
			end)
		end
	end
end
-- Mutations with their OWN voice, instead of the generic sting pitched up.
-- These are the top three rungs of the 12-rung ladder and all are vanishingly
-- rare, so each is worth hearing as something completely different:
--   Angel    r12, 0.018% per catch  -> choir
--   Demon    r11, 0.070% per catch  -> deep growl
--   Glitched r10, fusion-only       -> digital glitch
local MUTATION_SOUND = {
	Angel    = "angel",
	Demon    = "demon",
	Glitched = "glitched",
}
SoundKit.preload()

local queue = {}
local showing = false

local function showNext()
	local item = table.remove(queue, 1)
	if not item then
		showing = false
		return
	 end
	showing = true

	local mutPrefix = (item.mutation and item.mutation ~= "" and item.mutation ~= "None") and (item.mutation .. " ") or ""
	label.Text = ("%s skipped up a %s%s (%s)!"):format(item.playerName, mutPrefix, item.brainrotName, item.tierName)
	accent.BackgroundColor3 = item.color
	for _, ray in ipairs(burst:GetChildren()) do
		if ray.Name == "Ray" then ray.BackgroundColor3 = item.color end
	end

	-- Audio for the catch. Broadcast to EVERY player, so someone else's find is
	-- near-silent while yours is merely audible.
	--
	-- Deliberately quiet and NEVER layered. The first version played a chime for
	-- the tier and a second chime for the mutation 0.12s later, both loud, which
	-- just read as one long ring. One sound per catch, and a rare mutation
	-- REPLACES the tier sound instead of stacking on top of it.
	local mine = (item.playerName == Players.LocalPlayer.Name)
	local r = (item.mutation and item.mutation ~= "" and item.mutation ~= "None")
		and Mutations.Rarity(item.mutation) or 0
	if not mine then
		-- someone else's find: same layers, a third of the level, so the ladder is
		-- still legible across the server without anyone else's luck talking over you
		playCatch(item.tierName, 0.30)
	elseif r >= 5 then
		local special = item.mutation and MUTATION_SOUND[item.mutation]
		if special then
			-- its own sample, so NO pitch shifting -- a stretched choir sounds wrong
			SoundKit.play(special, nil, { volume = 0.3 })
		else
			-- otherwise the generic sting, pitched up the rarity ladder
			SoundKit.play("mutation", nil, { volume = 0.22, speed = 0.9 + 0.03 * r })
		end
	else
		playCatch(item.tierName, 1)
	end

	banner.Visible = true
	banner.Position = HIDDEN_POS
	TweenService:Create(banner, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = SHOWN_POS }):Play()
	task.delay(4.5, function()
		local tw = TweenService:Create(banner, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = HIDDEN_POS })
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Wait()
		banner.Visible = false
		showNext()
	end)
end

rareCatch.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(playerName, tierName, brainrotName, tierColor, mutation)
	if typeof(playerName) ~= "string" or typeof(tierName) ~= "string" or typeof(brainrotName) ~= "string" then return end
	-- UIKIT (Task 10): Settings panel GAMEPLAY toggle "hideOwnBanners" --
	-- cheapest real seam in this file: one guard clause, before the item
	-- ever reaches the queue. This skips the WHOLE event for a catch that
	-- was YOURS (banner AND its sound layer together, since both are driven
	-- from the same queued item inside showNext) rather than only hiding the
	-- visual bar -- splitting those would mean duplicating showNext's
	-- sound-selection logic here. Other players' banners are completely
	-- unaffected; this only ever short-circuits an item whose playerName is
	-- the local player's own.
	if playerName == player.Name and player:GetAttribute("HideOwnBanners") == true then
		return
	end
	table.insert(queue, {
		playerName = playerName,
		tierName = tierName,
		brainrotName = brainrotName,
		color = typeof(tierColor) == "Color3" and tierColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 220),
		mutation = typeof(mutation) == "string" and mutation or nil,
	})
	if #queue > 4 then table.remove(queue, 1) end
	if not showing then showNext() end
end)

local function fmt(n)
	n = math.floor(n)
	if n >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif n >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif n >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.0fK", n / 1e3) end
	return tostring(n)
end
local function pct(mult) return ("+%d%%"):format(math.floor((mult - 1) * 100 + 0.5)) end

local state = {}
local function render()
	curLabel.Text = ("%d   \u{2022}   now %s income / %s luck"):format(
		state.Rebirths or 0, pct(state.IncomeMult or 1), pct(state.LuckMult or 1))
	costLabel.Text = "$" .. fmt(state.Cost or 0)
	incLabel.Text = pct(state.NextIncomeMult or 1)
	incSub.Text = "now " .. pct(state.IncomeMult or 1)
	luckLabel.Text = pct(state.NextLuckMult or 1)
	luckSub.Text = "now " .. pct(state.LuckMult or 1)
	tile.setReady(state.CanAfford == true)
	tile.setBadge(state.CanAfford and "alert" or "none")

	local can = state.CanAfford == true
	-- cannot afford: the COST card reads red and the action plate drops out
	if costGrad then
		local ramp = can and CARD_RAMPS.cost or COST_RED
		costGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(ramp[1], ramp[2])
	end
	costLabel.TextColor3 = can and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromHex("FFB3A6")
	if rebirthLabel then
		rebirthLabel.Text = can and "REBIRTH" or ("NEED $" .. fmt(state.Cost or 0))
	end
	if rebirthGrad then
		local ramp = can and S.Action.Go or S.Action.Inert
		rebirthGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(ramp[1], ramp[2])
	end
	rebirthBtn.Active = can
	rebirthBtn.BackgroundTransparency = can and 0 or 0.45
end

	if typeof(s) ~= "table" then return end
	state = s
	setConfirmOpen(false)
	render()
end)

	panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
	setConfirmOpen(false)
	render()
end)
shell.close.Activated:Connect(function()
	panel.Visible = false
	setConfirmOpen(false)
end)
-- Every close path must tear the confirm down, not just the two above: ESC
-- and the rebirth rail button (GameHUDClient) toggle raw Visible, and
-- SideRail's single-open registry force-hides this panel when any other
-- registered panel opens. Watching our own Visible catches every path.
panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if not panel.Visible then
		setConfirmOpen(false)
	end
end)

	if not state.CanAfford then return end
	setConfirmOpen(true)
end)

	if not state.CanAfford then setConfirmOpen(false) return end
	setConfirmOpen(false)
	remotes.RebirthRequest:FireServer()
end)

local state = { XP = 0, Claimed = {}, QuestIds = {}, Progress = {} }

-- one accent per quest card, carried through the card border, the quest name
-- colour and the sunburst behind the icon (done quests go pine green)
local QUEST_ACCENTS = { CF.amber1, CF.lake1, CF.berry1 }

local function render()
	local tierNow = math.floor(state.XP / SeasonConfig.XP_PER_TIER)
	local intoTier = state.XP - tierNow * SeasonConfig.XP_PER_TIER
	xpLabel.Text = ("Season XP: %d   \u{2022}   Tier %d/%d   \u{2022}   %d/%d XP to next"):format(
		state.XP, math.min(tierNow, #SeasonConfig.Tiers), #SeasonConfig.Tiers, intoTier, SeasonConfig.XP_PER_TIER)

	-- quests
	for _, c in ipairs(questFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	for i, qid in ipairs(state.QuestIds) do

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ToastClient.client.lua =====
-- ToastClient -- the ONLY renderer for {Success, Message} server replies.
-- (BUILD SPEC v2 §7.4, USER DECISION U3)
--
-- Before this script, ClientMain's PurchaseResult/SellResult handlers were empty comment
-- bodies, so every server message in the game was silently discarded. Without a renderer
-- every TryLike rejection string goes nowhere and the like feature cannot be QA'd.
--
-- RemoteEvents support multiple connections, so ClientMain's existing (empty) handlers are
-- harmless and are deliberately left untouched -- zero edits to ClientMain from this file.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UITheme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.UITheme)
local P = UITheme.Palette
local CF = UITheme.Camp

local MAX_TOASTS = 3
local HOLD = 2.6
local SLIDE = 0.18
local FADE = 0.35
local WIDTH, HEIGHT = 420, 50

local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "ToastGui"
screen.DisplayOrder = 60
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.IgnoreGuiInset = false
screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screen.Parent = playerGui

local stack = Instance.new("Frame")
stack.Name = "Stack"
stack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
stack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 132)
stack.Size = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, 0)
stack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
stack.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
stack.Parent = screen

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Parent = stack

local live = {}     -- array of active toast wrappers, oldest first
local seq = 0

local function dismiss(entry)
	if entry.dismissed then return end
	entry.dismissed = true
	for i, e in ipairs(live) do
		if e == entry then table.remove(live, i) break end
	end
	local info = TweenInfo.new(FADE, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(entry.card, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(entry.label, info, { TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	if entry.stroke then TweenService:Create(entry.stroke, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play() end
	if entry.gloss then TweenService:Create(entry.gloss, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play() end
	if entry.accent then TweenService:Create(entry.accent, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play() end
	if entry.accentInk then TweenService:Create(entry.accentInk, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play() end
	if entry.textStroke then TweenService:Create(entry.textStroke, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play() end
	Debris:AddItem(entry.wrapper, FADE + 0.05)
end

local function push(success, message)
	-- cap the stack: dismiss the oldest early rather than letting toasts pile up
	while #live >= MAX_TOASTS do
		dismiss(live[1])
	end

	seq += 1
	local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
	wrapper.Name = "Toast" .. seq
	wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, HEIGHT)
	wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wrapper.BorderSizePixel = 0
	wrapper.ClipsDescendants = true      -- lets the card slide in from the right edge
	wrapper.LayoutOrder = seq
	wrapper.Parent = stack

	-- inset from the clipping wrapper: a stroke drawn on the wrapper's own edge is clipped away
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Name = "Card"
	card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -8)
	card.Position = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, 4)   -- off to the right, slides to x = 5
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.Parent = wrapper
	UITheme.campPanel(card)
	UITheme.corner(card, 12)

	-- campPanel adds the heavy border UIStroke; it stays BLACK and the success/fail
	-- colour rides the accent bar instead (campfire style)
	local stroke
	for _, s in ipairs(card:GetChildren()) do
		if s:IsA("UIStroke") and s.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual then stroke = s end
	end
	if stroke then
		stroke.Color = CF.ink
		stroke.Thickness = 3
	end

	local accTop = success and CF.pine1 or CF.ember1
	local accBot = success and CF.pine2 or CF.ember2

	local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
	accent.Name = "Accent"
	accent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 1, -14)
	accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 7)
	accent.BackgroundColor3 = accTop
	accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
	accent.ZIndex = 2
	accent.Parent = card
	UITheme.corner(accent, 4)
	UITheme.gradient(accent, accTop, accBot, 90)
	local accentInk = UITheme.ink(accent, 2)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Msg"
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.TextSize = 18
	label.TextColor3 = CF.cream
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Text = message
	label.ZIndex = 2
	label.Parent = card

	-- heavy black glyph outline: campfire text is never left un-inked
	local ts = UITheme.inkText(label, 2.6)

	local entry = {
		wrapper = wrapper, card = card, label = label, stroke = stroke,
		gloss = card:FindFirstChild("Gloss"), dismissed = false,
		accent = accent, accentInk = accentInk, textStroke = ts,
	}
	table.insert(live, entry)

	TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(SLIDE, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4),
	}):Play()

	task.delay(SLIDE + HOLD, function() dismiss(entry) end)
end

-- Payload guard: every producer in this game uses { Success = bool, Message = string },
-- but a malformed/absent field must never throw inside a remote handler.
local function show(res)
	if type(res) ~= "table" or type(res.Message) ~= "string" then return end
	push(res.Success == true, res.Message)
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "PurchaseResult", "SellResult", "LikeResult" }) do
	local r = remotes:WaitForChild(name, 10)
	if r then
		r.OnClientEvent:Connect(show)
	else
		warn("[ToastClient] remote missing: " .. name)
	end
end

-- TradeClient (Trading Center section) — side-by-side trade window in the
-- game's chunky UIKit skin, structured after the user's reference video:
-- player header chips, YOUR OFFER / THEIR OFFER slot grids with a "+" tile
-- opening an OFFER ITEMS picker, cash row, status line, DECLINE/ACCEPT,
-- a big centre 3-2-1 countdown that never covers the offers, and a
-- TRADE SUCCESSFUL popup listing exactly what you received.
-- Server contract unchanged: TradeRequest / TradeRespond / TradeAction /
-- TradeState {Incoming,Sent,Active,Countdown,Completed,Closed,Error}.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local RarityConfig = require(Modules:WaitForChild("RarityConfig"))
local UIKit = Modules:WaitForChild("UIKit")
local T = require(UIKit:WaitForChild("Tokens"))
local UI = require(UIKit:WaitForChild("Builders"))
local Thumb = require(Modules:WaitForChild("BrainrotThumb"))
local formatNumber = require(Modules:WaitForChild("NumberFormat")).Short

for _, e in ipairs(BrainrotConfig) do infoByName[e.Name] = e end
local tierByName, tierOrder = {}, {}
for i, t in ipairs(RarityConfig) do tierByName[t.Name] = t; tierOrder[t.Name] = i end

local SUFFIX = { k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 }
local function parseAmount(text)
	text = string.gsub(string.lower(text or ""), "[%s,$]", "")
	local num, suffix = string.match(text, "^(%d+%.?%d*)(%a?)$")
	if not num then return nil end
	local mult = suffix == "" and 1 or SUFFIX[suffix]
	if not mult then return nil end
	return math.floor(tonumber(num) * mult)
end

-- ===== data mirror =====
local myCash = 0
local myCounts = {}
local currentTrade = nil
local refreshTradeUI, refreshPicker

local function applySnapshot(snapshot)
	if not snapshot then return end
	myCash = snapshot.Cash or myCash
	myCounts = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(snapshot.Brainrots or {}) do
		myCounts[e.Name] = (myCounts[e.Name] or 0) + 1
	end
	if refreshTradeUI then refreshTradeUI() end
	if refreshPicker then refreshPicker() end
end
remotes.DataUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(applySnapshot)
remotes.CashTick.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(c) myCash = c end)
task.spawn(function() applySnapshot(remotes.GetInitialData:InvokeServer()) end)

	if not cam then return end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	canvasScale.Scale = math.min(vp.X / T.size.canvas.X, vp.Y / T.size.canvas.Y)
end

-- shells: visibility handles that keep UI.panel's sibling hard shadow contained
local function makeShell(name, w, h, z)
	local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
	shell.Name = name
	shell.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	shell.Parent = root

	p.Name = "Surface"

local function refreshScrim()
	local any = false
	for _, f in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		if f:GetAttribute("Modal") and f.Visible then any = true end
	end
	scrim.Visible = any
end

local function addArt(parent, name, size, position)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = size
	holder.Position = position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = (parent.ZIndex or 1) + 1
	holder.Parent = parent
	if not Thumb.add(holder, name, { size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) }) then
		local info = infoByName[name]
		local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
		local sw = Instance.new("Frame")
		sw.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.62)
		sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		sw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		sw.BackgroundColor3 = tier and tier.Color or T.color.white
		sw.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
		sw.Parent = holder
		UI.corner(sw, T.radius.art)
		UI.stroke(sw, T.stroke.hairline)
	end
	return holder
end

local function tierStroke(card, name)
	local info = infoByName[name]
	local tier = info and tierByName[info.Rarity]
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	s.Thickness = 3
	s.Color = tier and tier.Color or T.color.rarityCommon
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = f
end

local function showTradeSuccess(received)
	for _, c in ipairs(doneRow:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local names, total = {}, 0
	for name, count in pairs(received.Items or {}) do
		table.insert(names, name); total += count
	end
	table.sort(names, function(a, b)
		local ia, ib = infoByName[a], infoByName[b]
		local ra = ia and tierOrder[ia.Rarity] or 0
		local rb = ib and tierOrder[ib.Rarity] or 0
		return ra > rb
	end)
	doneSub.Text = total == 0 and "You received:" or ("You received %d item%s:"):format(total, total == 1 and "" or "s")
	local shown = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		if shown >= 4 then
			local more = UI.label(doneRow, ("+%d more"):format(#names - 4), "cardLabel", T.color.textMuted)
			more.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
			break
		end
		shown += 1
		local card = UI.surface(doneRow, UDim2.fromOffset(130, 150), "slot", T.radius.slot, T.stroke.hairline)
		card.ZIndex = donePanel.ZIndex + 1
		tierStroke(card, name)
		addArt(card, name, UDim2.fromOffset(96, 86), UDim2.fromOffset(17, 8))
		local nm = UI.label(card, name, "chip")
		nm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		nm.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 98)
		nm.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
		nm.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nm.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		local ct = UI.label(card, "x" .. (received.Items[name] or 1), "cardLabel", T.color.textAccent)
		ct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		ct.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 118)
		ct.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
	end
	if total == 0 and (received.Cash or 0) == 0 then
		doneSub.Text = "Trade complete!"
	end
	doneCash.Text = (received.Cash or 0) > 0 and ("+ $" .. formatNumber(received.Cash) .. " cash") or ""
	doneShell.Visible = true
	refreshScrim()
end

-- ===== rendering =====
local function fillSlot(slot, name, count, clickable)
	for _, c in ipairs(slot:GetChildren()) do
		-- clear EVERYTHING gui (labels included) or names from the previous render bleed through
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	if name == "+" then
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		b.Text = ""
		b.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 1
		b.Parent = slot
		local plus = UI.label(b, "+", "panelTitle", T.color.textMuted)
		plus.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		plus.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		plus.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 1
		return b
	elseif name then
		tierStroke(slot, name)
		addArt(slot, name, UDim2.fromOffset(64, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(24, 4))
		local nm = UI.label(slot, name, "chip")
		nm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		nm.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 58)
		nm.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 14)
		nm.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nm.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 1
		if count > 1 then
			local badge = UI.label(slot, "x" .. count, "chip", T.color.textAccent)
			badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
			badge.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 3
		end
		if clickable then
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			b.Text = ""
			b.ZIndex = slot.ZIndex + 4
			b.Parent = slot
			return b
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function renderSide(grid, side, mine)
	local names = {}
	for name in pairs(side.Items or {}) do table.insert(names, name) end
	table.sort(names)
	local slotIdx = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		slotIdx += 1
		if slotIdx > SLOTS then break end
		local btn = fillSlot(grid.slots[slotIdx], name, side.Items[name], mine)
		if btn then
			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				remotes.TradeAction:FireServer({ Type = "RemoveItem", Name = name })
			end)
		end
	end
	if mine and slotIdx < SLOTS then
		slotIdx += 1
		local btn = fillSlot(grid.slots[slotIdx], "+", 0, true)
		if btn then
			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				refreshPicker()
				pickShell.Visible = true
				refreshScrim()
			end)
		end
	end
	for i = slotIdx + 1, SLOTS do
		fillSlot(grid.slots[i], nil, 0, false)
	end
	return #names
end

refreshTradeUI = function()
	if not currentTrade or not tradeShell.Visible then return end
	local st = currentTrade
	local other = st.OtherName or "?"
	tradeTitle.Text = "TRADING"
	youChip.nameL.Text = string.upper(player.DisplayName)
	youChip.atL.Text = "@" .. player.Name
	youChip.letter.Text = string.upper(string.sub(player.DisplayName, 1, 1))
	themChip.nameL.Text = string.upper(other)
	themChip.atL.Text = "@" .. other
	themChip.letter.Text = string.upper(string.sub(other, 1, 1))
	local yn = renderSide(yourGrid, st.You, true)
	local tn = renderSide(theirGrid, st.Them, false)
	youChip.cnt.Text = yn .. "/" .. SLOTS
	themChip.cnt.Text = tn .. "/" .. SLOTS
	yourGrid.head.Text = st.You.Confirmed and "YOUR OFFER  - ACCEPTED" or "YOUR OFFER"
	theirGrid.head.Text = st.Them.Confirmed and "THEIR OFFER  - ACCEPTED" or "THEIR OFFER"
	yourCashL.Text = (st.You.Cash or 0) > 0 and ("+ $" .. formatNumber(st.You.Cash)) or ""
	theirCashL.Text = (st.Them.Cash or 0) > 0 and ("+ $" .. formatNumber(st.Them.Cash)) or ""
	acceptLabel.Text = st.You.Confirmed and "UNACCEPT" or "ACCEPT"
	if st.Phase == "Active" then
		countLabel.Visible = false
		if st.You.Confirmed and not st.Them.Confirmed then
			statusL.Text = "Waiting for " .. other .. " to accept..."
		elseif st.Them.Confirmed and not st.You.Confirmed then
			statusL.Text = "PLAYER ACCEPTED, AWAITING YOUR DECISION..."
		else
			statusL.Text = "Add items or cash, then press ACCEPT."
		end
	end
end

refreshPicker = function()
	if not pickShell.Visible or not currentTrade then return end
	for _, c in ipairs(pickGrid:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local offered = currentTrade.You.Items or {}
	local list = {}
	for name, count in pairs(myCounts) do
		local avail = count - (offered[name] or 0)
		if avail > 0 and (pickSearch == "" or string.find(string.lower(name), pickSearch, 1, true)) then
			table.insert(list, { name = name, count = avail })
		end
	end
	if pickSort == "NAME" then
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
	elseif pickSort == "RARITY" then
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			local ra = infoByName[a.name] and tierOrder[infoByName[a.name].Rarity] or 0
			local rb = infoByName[b.name] and tierOrder[infoByName[b.name].Rarity] or 0
			if ra ~= rb then return ra > rb end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
	else
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			local ca = infoByName[a.name] and infoByName[a.name].CashPerSecond or 0
			local cb = infoByName[b.name] and infoByName[b.name].CashPerSecond or 0
			if ca ~= cb then return ca > cb end
			return a.name < b.name
		end)
	end
	pickEmpty.Visible = #list == 0
	for order, item in ipairs(list) do
		local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
		cell.Name = "Cell"
		cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 150)
		cell.LayoutOrder = order
		cell.ZIndex = pickGrid.ZIndex + 1
		cell.Parent = pickGrid
		local card = UI.button(cell, "", "tab", UDim2.fromOffset(128, 150), "chip")
		card.ZIndex = cell.ZIndex
		tierStroke(card, item.name)
		addArt(card, item.name, UDim2.fromOffset(92, 78), UDim2.fromOffset(18, 6))
		local nm = UI.label(card, item.name, "chip")
		nm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		nm.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 90)
		nm.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 16)
		nm.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		nm.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		local ct = UI.label(card, "x" .. item.count, "cardLabel", T.color.textAccent)
		ct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		ct.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 112)
		ct.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
		card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			remotes.TradeAction:FireServer({ Type = "AddItem", Name = item.name })
		end)
	end
end
pickSearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	pickSearch = string.lower(pickSearchBox.Text)
	refreshPicker()
end)
local PICK_SORTS = { "NAME", "RARITY", "VALUE" }
pickSortBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local i = table.find(PICK_SORTS, pickSort) or 1
	pickSort = PICK_SORTS[i % #PICK_SORTS + 1]
	pickSortBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel").Text = pickSort
	refreshPicker()
end)
pickClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	pickShell.Visible = false
	refreshScrim()
end)

-- ===== countdown (server Countdown phase, 3-2-1 in the centre gap) =====
local countdownToken = 0
local function runCountdown(seconds)
	countdownToken += 1
	local token = countdownToken
	task.spawn(function()
		for remaining = seconds, 1, -1 do
			if token ~= countdownToken or not tradeShell.Visible then
				countLabel.Visible = false
				return
			end
			countLabel.Text = tostring(remaining)
			countLabel.Visible = true
			statusL.Text = "Both accepted - trading in " .. remaining .. "...  (DECLINE to stop)"
			task.wait(1)
		end
		if token == countdownToken then countLabel.Visible = false end
	end)
end

local function closeTradeWindow()
	countdownToken += 1
	countLabel.Visible = false
	currentTrade = nil
	tradeShell.Visible = false
	pickShell.Visible = false
	cashBox.Text = ""
	refreshScrim()
end

-- ===== server state =====
remotes.TradeState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(st)
	if typeof(st) ~= "table" or typeof(st.Phase) ~= "string" then return end
	if st.Phase == "Incoming" then
		incomingFromUserId = st.FromUserId
		reqLabel.Text = (st.FromName or "Someone") .. " wants to trade with you!"
		reqShell.Visible = true
		refreshScrim()
		requestToken += 1
		local token = requestToken
		task.delay(st.Timeout or 20, function()
			if token == requestToken and reqShell.Visible then
				reqShell.Visible = false; refreshScrim()
			end
		end)
	elseif st.Phase == "Sent" then
		showToast("Trade request sent to " .. (st.ToName or "player") .. ".")
	elseif st.Phase == "Active" then
		countdownToken += 1
		countLabel.Visible = false
		reqShell.Visible = false
		currentTrade = st
		tradeShell.Visible = true
		refreshScrim()
		refreshTradeUI()
		refreshPicker()
	elseif st.Phase == "Countdown" then
		currentTrade = st
		tradeShell.Visible = true
		refreshScrim()
		refreshTradeUI()
		statusL.Text = "Both accepted - trading..."
		runCountdown(st.Seconds or 3)
	elseif st.Phase == "Completed" then
		local received = currentTrade and {
			Items = currentTrade.Them.Items,
			Cash = currentTrade.Them.Cash,
		} or { Items = {}, Cash = 0 }
		closeTradeWindow()
		showTradeSuccess(received)
	elseif st.Phase == "Closed" then
		closeTradeWindow()
		showToast(st.Message or "Trade closed.")
	elseif st.Phase == "Error" then
		showToast(st.Message or "Trade error.")
	end
end)

-- ===== buttons =====
acceptBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not currentTrade then return end
	remotes.TradeAction:FireServer({ Type = currentTrade.You.Confirmed and "Unconfirm" or "Confirm" })
end)
local function declineTrade()

local tradeZone

local function characterInZone(character)
	if not tradeZone then return false end
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return false end
	local rel = tradeZone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
	local s = tradeZone.Size / 2
	return math.abs(rel.X) <= s.X and math.abs(rel.Z) <= s.Z and math.abs(rel.Y) <= s.Y + 6
end
local lastNearbyKey = nil
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.3)
		local show = characterInZone(player.Character) and not tradeShell.Visible
		nearShell.Visible = show
		if show then
			local others = {}
			for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if other ~= player and characterInZone(other.Character) then
					table.insert(others, other)
				end
			end
			table.sort(others, function(a, b) return a.DisplayName < b.DisplayName end)
			local key = ""
			for _, o in ipairs(others) do key = key .. o.UserId .. "," end
			if key ~= lastNearbyKey then
				lastNearbyKey = key
				for _, c in ipairs(nearList:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
				end
				nearHint.Text = #others > 0 and "Pick a player to trade with:" or "Waiting for players to reach the gazebo..."
				for order, other in ipairs(others) do
					local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
					cell.Name = "Cell"
					cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					cell.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 54)
					cell.LayoutOrder = order
					cell.Parent = nearList
					local b = UI.button(cell, other.DisplayName, "green", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48), "buttonM")
					b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						remotes.TradeRequest:FireServer(other.UserId)
					end)
				end
			end
		else
			lastNearbyKey = nil
		end
	end
end)

local function nearestFreePlot()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local best, bestD
	for _, p in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
		if p:IsA("Model") and not p:GetAttribute("Claimed") and p.PrimaryPart then
			local d = hrp and (p.PrimaryPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or 0
			if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end
local function stallPos(name)
	local stall = gw:FindFirstChild(name)
	local part = stall and stall:FindFirstChild("PromptPart")
	return part and part.Position
end

	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (hrp and pos) then return false end
	return (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude <= dist
end

===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UIPolish.client.lua =====
--[[ ==========================================================================
UIPolish -- game-wide typography pass
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
The UI grew across ~24 client scripts, each picking its own font and text
colour: a survey found FOUR fonts in play (GothamMedium 23x, FredokaOne 18x,
GothamBlack 9x, GothamBold 6x) and 63 distinct text colours. That mixture is
what read as "choppy" -- no amount of per-screen tweaking fixes it, because
the next screen re-introduces the drift.

So instead of editing 24 scripts, this one enforces the rule centrally:

	EVERY TextLabel / TextButton / TextBox under PlayerGui gets
	FredokaOne, pure white, and a dark outline so it reads on any
	background.

WHY THE PROPERTY WATCHERS: most UI here is built as
`Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)` and *then* configured, so DescendantAdded
fires BEFORE the owning script assigns its font/colour. Polishing once on add
would simply be overwritten a line later. We therefore also watch FontFace and
TextColor3 per label and re-assert. No infinite loop: we compare before we
write, and assigning an unchanged value raises no signal.

OPTING OUT: set the attribute `NoPolish = true` on a label, or on any ancestor
(useful for a whole panel). Rarity tiers and similar colour-coded text are the
intended users of this escape hatch.

OUTLINES ARE ONE-PER-LABEL: we only draw one if nothing else already has. See
the comment at the stroke block below -- adding a second one is what the
"choppy" complaint was actually made of.
========================================================================== ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- 2026-08-04 STYLE REPLACEMENT ("Roblox Simulator UI Style Guide" .docx):
-- GothamBold everywhere. This constant is the REAL font switch for the whole
-- game -- the loop below force-sets the legacy .Font property on every label,
-- which overrides any FontFace a panel sets, so UIKit.Tokens' T.font and this
-- line must always move together (changing Tokens alone is a silent no-op).
-- 2026-08-10 SPEC SWEEP: FredokaOne is the HUD-upgrade sheet's READ face --
-- moved in lockstep with UIKit.Tokens' T.font (see its header; changing one
-- without the other is a silent no-op). Ink follows the sheet's #071323.
local FONT       = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
-- 2026-08-13 LEMONPOP: the DEFAULT ground is now the lemon-cream window, so
-- the default text treatment flips from "white + ink stroke" to the theme's
-- dark UNSTROKED ink (LemonPop rule: dark ink on light surfaces, stroked
-- white type only on dark/saturated ones). Dark surfaces opt IN via the
-- PolishOnDark attribute -- honoured on the label or any ancestor, exactly
-- like NoPolish -- which UIKit.Builders sets centrally on row/track/tab
-- surfaces and action buttons. NoPolish still bypasses everything.
local WHITE      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local INKTEXT    = Color3.fromRGB(51, 38, 26)  -- LemonPop textOnWindow #33261A, the default fill
local INK        = Color3.fromRGB(36, 31, 20)  -- LemonPop outline #241F14 (was slate #071323), strokes PolishOnDark text
local STROKE_TAG = "UIPolishStroke"

local function isText(o)
	return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
end

-- honours NoPolish on the label itself or on anything above it
local function optedOut(o)
	local node = o
	while node and node ~= playerGui do
		if node:GetAttribute("NoPolish") then return true end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- LemonPop: honours PolishOnDark the same way -- a dark surface tags itself
-- once and every label inside it inherits the on-dark treatment
local function onDark(o)
	local node = o
	while node and node ~= playerGui do
		if node:GetAttribute("PolishOnDark") then return true end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function strokeFor(o)
	-- 2026-08-10 spec sweep: the cards are LIGHT now, so the white fill only
	-- reads if the ink stroke genuinely carries it -- the old weights were
	-- tuned for white-on-dark, and 14px text at 1.56 ink rendered as a ghost
	-- on the new white detail plates (user capture: the Charm Codex prompt).
	-- Bubble-text weights: text/7, floor 2.2.
	if o.TextScaled then return 2.6 end
	local ts = o.TextSize or 14
	return math.clamp(ts / 7, 2.2, 3.6)
end

-- Any outline that is ALREADY doing this label's job.
--
-- ApplyStrokeMode is the thing that decides: on a text object, Contextual
-- strokes the GLYPHS and Border strokes the rectangle. So a Border stroke on a
-- TextButton is that button's rim and has nothing to do with us, but a
-- Contextual one is a text outline -- somebody else's -- and adding ours next
-- to it means the glyphs carry two.
local function foreignTextStroke(o)
	for _, k in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
		if k:IsA("UIStroke")
			and k.Name ~= STROKE_TAG
			and k.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		then
			return k
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function apply(o)
	if optedOut(o) then return end

	local dark = onDark(o)
	local want = if dark then WHITE else INKTEXT

	if o.Font ~= FONT then o.Font = FONT end
	if o.TextColor3 ~= want then o.TextColor3 = want end

	-- the legacy TextStroke* pair renders muddier than a UIStroke; retire it
	if o.TextStrokeTransparency ~= 1 then o.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 end

	if o:IsA("TextBox") then
		-- LemonPop: boxes sit on light wells, placeholder = warm taupe (was lavender #E1DEEB)
		local ph = Color3.fromRGB(167, 154, 124)
		if o.PlaceholderColor3 ~= ph then o.PlaceholderColor3 = ph end
	end

	-- LemonPop: dark ink on a light ground carries itself -- NO outline. Only
	-- PolishOnDark labels (white type on dark/saturated grounds) keep the
	-- stroked bubble treatment below. Every contextual stroke goes, not just
	-- our own: an unexempted label just had its fill forced to dark ink, so a
	-- leftover glyph outline (UI.label mints one per style spec) would render
	-- dark-on-dark fuzz. Deliberate outlined text belongs under NoPolish.
	if not dark then
		for _, k in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if k:IsA("UIStroke") and k.ApplyStrokeMode ~= Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border then
				k:Destroy()
			end
		end
		return
	end

	-- ONE outline per label. This used to check only for "UIStyleStrokeText",
	-- UIStyle's own named text stroke -- but most panels here never go through
	-- UIStyle.bubbleText, they hang a bare Instance.new("UIStroke") straight off
	-- the label. That is still a text outline, so we cheerfully added a second
	-- one on top at a slightly different weight: a live count found 1032 of 3560
	-- labels carrying two (2.4+2.2, 2.6+1.7, 2.0+1.4 were the common pairs).
	-- Two near-identical outlines do not sit on top of each other cleanly -- they
	-- render as one fat, faintly lumpy edge, which is most of what read as the UI
	-- being "choppy". Whoever drew first owns the outline; they picked its colour
	-- to suit their panel, so leave it be and take ours back out.
	local foreign = foreignTextStroke(o)
	if foreign then
		local mine = o:FindFirstChild(STROKE_TAG)
		if mine then mine:Destroy() end
	else
		local st = o:FindFirstChild(STROKE_TAG)
		if not st then
			st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			st.Name = STROKE_TAG
			st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
			st.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
			st.Color = INK
			st.Parent = o
		end
		local want = strokeFor(o)
		if math.abs(st.Thickness - want) > 0.05 then st.Thickness = want end
	end
end

local wired = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })   -- weak: destroyed labels drop out

local function watch(o)
	if wired[o] then return end
	wired[o] = true
	apply(o)
	-- re-assert whenever the owning script sets its own font/colour afterwards
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FontFace"):Connect(function() apply(o) end)
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function() apply(o) end)
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextSize"):Connect(function() apply(o) end)
end

for _, d in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
	if isText(d) then watch(d) end
end

playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if isText(d) then
		watch(d)
		-- second pass next frame: catches scripts that parent first and
		-- configure across a yield
		task.defer(function()
			if d.Parent then apply(d) end
		end)
	end
end)


===== FILE: game-src/place-full/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/WeatherClient.client.lua =====
-- WeatherClient: event banner + countdown + a full ambient visual kit per event.
-- Every event restyles the whole sky (time of day, atmosphere, bloom, sun rays)
-- so an active event is obvious from the world alone, not just the banner.
-- All of this is client-local: Lighting edits here never touch the server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Forward declarations: restoreVisuals is defined ABOVE all the per-event VFX sections but
-- has to tear each of them down. Without these, every call in restoreVisuals resolves to a
-- nil GLOBAL and errors the moment weather returns to Clear.
local clearAurora, clearBloodMoon, clearHalos

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local function new(cls, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(cls)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

-- client-local sky tint
local cc = new("ColorCorrectionEffect", { Name = "WeatherCC", TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Saturation = 0, Brightness = 0 }, Lighting)

local gui = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "WeatherUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 8 }, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
local banner = new("Frame", {
	Name = "WeatherBanner", Visible = false, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 72),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 44), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
}, gui)

-- ===== ambient visual kits =====
local sky   = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
local atmo  = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BloomEffect")
local rays  = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("SunRaysEffect")

-- snapshot the untouched look so Clear can put everything back exactly
local BASE = {
	Light = {
		ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime, Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
		ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		FogColor = Lighting.FogColor, FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
	},
	Atmo = atmo and { Density = atmo.Density, Haze = atmo.Haze, Glare = atmo.Glare,
	                  Color = atmo.Color, Decay = atmo.Decay } or nil,
	Bloom = bloom and { Intensity = bloom.Intensity, Size = bloom.Size, Threshold = bloom.Threshold } or nil,
	Rays  = rays and { Intensity = rays.Intensity, Spread = rays.Spread } or nil,
	MoonSize = sky and sky.MoonAngularSize or nil,
}

local function tw(obj, props, t)
	if not obj then return end
	TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t or 2.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

-- All ProSoundEffects (Roblox first-party), so playback rights hold in the live
-- game. They parent to SoundService, which makes them 2D/global rather than
-- positional -- ambience should not fall off as the player walks around.

	Airy    = "rbxassetid://9125742262",  -- airy whooshing swells, 33.2s loop

		-- same wind asset as Blizzard, pitched down so it reads gritty, not icy
		sounds = { { Id = AUDIO.Wind, Volume = 0.26, Speed = 0.72 } },
		-- === GRANULAR SAND (low-poly) ===
		-- This used to be 900 five-stud soft blobs, which read as brown HAZE rather than
		-- sand -- and the haze was already being done for free by atmo.Haze 5.2 + FogEnd
		-- 340 above, so the emitter was paying ~1,400 live quads to duplicate it.
		--
		-- Now it emits small, tumbling GRAINS and lets the atmosphere carry the dust wall.
		-- Three things give the granular look, and all three are also what make it cheap:
		--   small + opaque  each grain is ~0.45 studs with an opaque core, so it reads as a
		--                   discrete speck rather than a wisp. NOTE: a hard-edged SQUARE
		--                   grain is NOT reachable with a built-in texture -- Texture = ""
		--                   renders nothing at all (tested), and of the built-in particle
		--                   textures only sparkles_main (star-shaped) and smoke_main (round)
		--                   resolve. smoke_main is the round one; at 0.45 studs its alpha
		--                   falloff is a pixel or two wide, so it still reads granular. For

		--                   swap Texture below and nothing else has to change.
		--   LightEmission 0 sand is not self-lit. Removing the glow also drops these out

			-- plate emits downward, so a low plate plus a fast launch means every grain crosses
			-- camera height in a fraction of a second and spends the rest of its life below the
			-- view. Sand should rip ACROSS you, not drop past you -- so the plate sits high and
			-- the launch is SLOW, letting the +X Acceleration below build the sideways streak.
